descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works.

Enterprise deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere.

About the Role

As an Applied AI Engineer, you will partner directly with Digital Native companies to design, build and deploy AI-powered products and systems. Working alongside customer product and engineering teams, you will take ideas from early experimentation through evaluation, production launch and scale, connecting technical decisions to user experience and measurable business impact.

You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations.

This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve.

title: Applied AI Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Applied AI Engineer - Direct Acquisition

Hybrid in London, UK

We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer to join the Direct Acquisition team.

You'll design and build AI agents that run whole business processes, from planning the work to learning from the results. What you find will steer how far iwoca takes agents across the business.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £5 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Direct Acquisition includes iwoca's Marketing, Sales, Brand and Acquisition Tech teams. Together, they reach UK businesses of all shapes and sizes through paid and organic marketing channels and direct sales.

A new team in Direct Acquisition builds agents that automate and improve acquisition processes. That's its only focus, and it works closely with Acquisition Tech. It's small – a product owner and you – and everyone builds. You'll report to the Head of Direct Acquisition, who sets the commercial direction.

The role

As the Applied AI Engineer, you'll build the agents and the systems around them. Most of the work is system design and backend engineering.

You'll start with direct mail. The first goal is an agent that plans each monthly round, uses iwoca's existing predictive models to build the mailing file, and learns from the results as they come in. The pattern is simple to say and hard to get right: the agent orchestrates, deterministic code does the work, and a human in the loop approves the file before it goes to print. You'll work with the people who run each process to understand the edge cases, and with Core Systems and Compliance on access and controls.

The agents don't exist yet, and much is still open: which processes the team takes on, and what the architecture looks like. You'll own those design decisions and write most of the code yourself, much of it with AI coding tools. Some of this won't work, and finding out why is one of the main outputs of the role.

  • Architecture. You'll design what agents need to run reliably: memory that persists between runs, task management, access to tools, permissions, and a record of every decision and why. You'll build each piece so the next process can reuse it.

  • Guardrails. You'll decide where the agent uses judgement and where code enforces rules the agent can't change, like suppressions, compliance checks and budget limits.

  • Delivery. You'll own each agent end to end: connect it to iwoca's predictive models, data pipelines and channel tools, and run it alongside the current process until it has shown it works.

  • Measurement. You'll track how often agents need a person, where they fail, what they cost, and what they're worth.

The requirements

We're looking for the depth of someone who has solved hard problems, and the pace of someone who moves fast in areas that are new to them.

Essential:

  • System ownership. You've owned a complex system end to end, from design to running it in production, and lived with the consequences of your architecture choices.

  • Design judgement. You've made architecture decisions other people built on, and you can explain the trade-offs and what you'd change. When an idea won't work, you say so and offer a better one.

  • Pace. You've got things live quickly in unfamiliar areas and they kept working once people relied on them.

  • Agent engineering. You've built systems where LLMs take actions – more than chat or summaries – and you can explain what went wrong and how you fixed it. You know when a problem needs an agent and when it needs a for-loop.

  • Controls. You've built permissions, data access rules and audit trails into systems from the start.

  • Constructive challenge. You work well with commercial and product colleagues, and when an idea won't work, you say so and offer a better one.

  • AI leverage. You've used AI coding tools to produce engineering work you couldn't have delivered without them – a service, an integration, or an internal tool others use. You have opinions on how to get the most out of them, and you check their output before it reaches production.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Languages and data tools. You've worked with Python, Go, Snowflake or dbt.

  • Evaluation. You've built evals that measure how an agent performs and where it fails.

  • Marketing and growth tech. You've worked with ad platforms, CRMs or direct mail.

  • Quantitative foundations. You come from a numerical or technical field, such as physics, engineering, maths or computer science.

The salary

We expect to pay from £80,000 to £120,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days' holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we've been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

title: Applied AI Engineer - Remote
descriptionHtml:
Welcome to dexter health!!

At dexter health, we build AI-powered software for care teams. Our mission is to reduce administrative workload in healthcare so caregivers can spend more time with patients.

We are looking for a high-agency AI Engineer to help us build new AI features faster and improve the quality, reliability, and speed of existing AI workflows.

This is a hands-on engineering role. Not research. Not prompt-only. You will turn ambiguous product ideas into working, production-ready AI features.

The role is mostly focused on shipping AI product features, with some AI systems and infrastructure work where needed.

You will work closely with product and engineering, but we expect you to take real ownership. You should be comfortable moving fast, making technical decisions under ambiguity, and using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar every day.

Tasks

As our Applied AI Engineer, you will:

  • Build new AI-powered product features from idea to production

  • Improve existing AI workflows for quality, reliability, latency, and user value

  • Design and implement LLM-based workflows, structured outputs, validation logic, and fallback behavior

  • Build evaluation loops, tests, and quality checks for AI-generated outputs

  • Integrate AI capabilities into existing product and backend systems

  • Work with commercial and open-source LLMs without being tied to one specific provider

  • Support self-hosted model workflows where they make sense for quality, speed, cost, or control

  • Debug AI feature failures across inputs, outputs, data, backend logic, and user flows

  • Use AI development tools as a core part of your daily workflow

  • Ship quickly while keeping production quality high

Requirements

We care less about formal seniority and more about speed, intelligence, ownership, and product impact. We like people who operate with founder-like urgency: they figure things out, make progress under ambiguity, and care about outcomes more than titles.

Must-have

  • Strong software engineering skills, especially in Python or a comparable backend language

  • Experience building AI-powered product features or LLM-based workflows

  • Ability to turn ambiguous product ideas into working software quickly

  • Strong understanding of how to design, test, validate, and improve AI outputs

  • Experience integrating AI workflows into production systems

  • Strong debugging instincts across application logic, data, model outputs, and user-facing behavior

  • Experience with evaluation, testing, validation, or quality checks for AI-generated outputs

  • Serious experience using AI development tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, or similar as part of your daily workflow

  • High intelligence, fast learning speed, bias to action, and ownership mindset

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, fast decisions, and a high-trust startup environment

  • Clear written and spoken English

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with frontend or fullstack product development

  • Experience with self-hosted LLMs, model serving, inference optimization, or similar systems

  • Experience with open-source LLMs and related deployment workflows

  • Experience improving latency, cost, quality, or reliability of AI systems

  • Experience with healthcare software, healthcare data, or regulated environments

  • Experience working with structured data extraction, documentation automation, voice workflows, or workflow automation

  • German language skills

  • Knowledge of nursing homes or elderly care workflows

This role is probably not for you if

  • You are mainly looking for an ML research role

  • You are a prompt engineer without strong coding skills

  • You need detailed specifications before making progress

  • You prefer slow, highly structured corporate environments

  • You are mainly looking for management, not hands-on building

  • You want to use AI tools only occasionally instead of as part of your daily workflow

  • You optimize for perfect process over fast, reliable execution

Benefits

  • Remote work

  • Fair compensation based on skills, experience, and location

  • Ownership of important backend systems

  • Work on software used in real healthcare workflows

  • Modern AI-native development workflow

  • Room to grow with the company

Why?

Caregivers spend too much time on documentation, coordination, and administrative work. We build technology that reduces this burden.

AI is core to our product. But useful AI features do not come from demos alone. They need strong engineering, fast iteration, evaluation, production thinking, and deep ownership of the user outcome.

If you want to build AI product features that ship, improve real workflows, use AI tools every day, and take ownership in a fast-moving team, we would like to hear from you.

title: Architecture Internship Dutch | March 2027 (2)
descriptionHtml:
Geef je carrière een vliegende start

MVRDV is een wereldwijd gerenommeerd architectuur- en stedenbouwkundig bureau met het hoofdkantoor in Rotterdam en kantoren in Shanghai, Parijs, Berlijn en New York. MVRDV werd in 1993 opgericht door Winy Maas, Jacob van Rijs en Nathalie de Vries en zet zich in voor het ontwerpen van innovatieve, maatschappelijk verantwoorde en duurzame architectuur die de toekomst vormgeeft.

Als stagiair bij MVRDV maak je deel uit van een energiek, internationaal team van meer dan 200 professionals uit ruim 40 verschillende landen. Je doet praktijkervaring op in baanbrekende projecten, werkt samen met toonaangevende architecten en verlegt de grenzen van ontwerp en innovatie. Ben jij gepassioneerd over architectuur en wil je leren in een dynamische en creatieve omgeving? Dan horen we graag van je.

Let op: We verzoeken recruitmentbureaus vriendelijk om geen ongevraagde kandidaten of profielen voor deze vacature aan te leveren. Wij verzorgen het wervingsproces intern en accepteren geen voorwaarden of vergoedingen met betrekking tot ongevraagde doorverwijzingen.

Sollicitatieprocedure

  1. Je kunt je sollicitatie indienen vanaf nu tot en met 16 november 2026.

  2. De gesprekken vinden plaats tussen 23 november en 11 december 2026.

  3. Succesvolle kandidaten starten op 1 maart 2027.

Belangrijk: Om in aanmerking te komen voor deze stage moet je gedurende de volledige stageperiode, van 1 maart 2027 tot en met 31 augustus 2027, ingeschreven blijven staan aan een daarvoor in aanmerking komende opleiding aan een universiteit of hogeschool.

Over het Design Collective

Het Design Collective van MVRDV is verantwoordelijk voor het ontwerpen van innovatieve en duurzame gebouwen en constructies. We werken aan een breed scala aan projecten, van kleinschalige woningbouw tot grootschalige commerciële en culturele complexen. Bekijk enkele voorbeelden van onze projecten op: https://www.mvrdv.com/projects.

Het Design Collective richt zich op projecten in de volgende regio’s:

  • Nederland

  • Azië

  • DACH-regio

  • Franstalige landen

  • Noord-Amerika

  • Centraal- en Oost-Europa

  • Taiwan

  • Midden-Oosten

Over de functie

Als Architectuurstagiair bij MVRDV kom je terecht in een dynamische omgeving waar gedurfde ideeën en snel schakelen dagelijks centraal staan. Je wordt begeleid door internationaal vooraanstaande ontwerpers bij projecten en prijsvragen en levert een bijdrage aan ambitieuze concepten, gedetailleerde tekeningen en indrukwekkende visualisaties.

Afhankelijk van jouw profiel en ervaring word je gekoppeld aan specifieke projecten, regio’s en/of projecttypen.

Dit is een uitstekende kans om je vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen, je creativiteit uit te dagen en een realistisch beeld te krijgen van het werken aan de voorhoede van de architectuur.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Assisteren bij de ontwikkeling van concepten en ontwerpvoorstellen.

  • Maken van tekeningen, diagrammen en 3D-modellen.

  • Ontwikkelen van visualisaties en presentatiemateriaal voor prijsvragen en opdrachtgevers.

  • Deelnemen aan teamoverleggen en ontwerpbesprekingen.

  • Onderzoek doen naar materialen, locatieomstandigheden en architectonische referenties.

Wat bieden wij?

Leren van marktleiders

Word onderdeel van een wereldwijd, ambitieus en optimistisch team dat werkt aan architectonische en stedenbouwkundige vraagstukken over de hele wereld. Je werkt samen met professionals uit verschillende disciplines, van ontwerp tot business support.

Stagevergoeding

Je ontvangt een aantrekkelijke stagevergoeding van €1.100 per maand, plus een vergoeding voor je woon-werkverkeer (via een NS-Business Card of kilometervergoeding).

Een levendige werkcultuur

Ervaar een dynamische en internationale werkomgeving met regelmatige excursies, feesten en teamactiviteiten, waaronder deelname aan de Rotterdam Marathon en andere sportevenementen.

Gezond en actief blijven

Geniet van betaalbare vegetarische lunches op kantoor (€4,30 per dag), een ruime bijdrage aan je Urban Sports Club-abonnement en toegang tot OpenUp, ons platform voor mentaal welzijn.

Een inspirerende werkplek

Werk vanuit ons kantoor in de levendige Rotterdamse wijk Blaak, op loopafstand van station Rotterdam Blaak. Een inspirerende omgeving in het hart van de stad.


Wij zijn op zoek naar een fulltime architectuurstagiair (40 uur per week) die van 1 maart 2027 tot en met 31 augustus 2027 bij ons op kantoor komt werken (5 dagen per week op locatie) voor een uitdagende stageperiode van 6 maanden.

Meer specifiek zoeken wij studenten met:

  • Sterke ontwerp- en CAD-vaardigheden.

  • Goede beheersing van Adobe Suite en sterke 2D- en 3D-visualisatievaardigheden (vermeld in je sollicitatie duidelijk je ervaring met de verschillende softwareprogramma’s).

  • Het vermogen om goed samen te werken in internationale teams.

  • Uitstekende mondelinge en schriftelijke beheersing van de Engelse taal; aanvullende talen zijn een pré.

  • Werkgerechtigdheid in Nederland (bijvoorbeeld door EU-burgerschap, een Nederlandse verblijfsvergunning of een Working Holiday-visum). Indien van toepassing kan MVRDV ondersteuning bieden bij de visumaanvraag voor niet-EU-burgers. Dit is afhankelijk van het voldoen aan alle vereisten van de Nederlandse Immigratie- en Naturalisatiedienst (IND). Zorg er daarom voor dat je de juiste gegevens invult in je sollicitatie.

  • Gedurende de volledige stageperiode ingeschreven staan als student (een bewijs van inschrijving is vereist).

Sluit je bij ons aan en doe waardevolle praktijkervaring op in een dynamische en collaboratieve werkomgeving, waar jouw ideeën ertoe doen en jouw ontwikkeling wordt gestimuleerd, of je nu werkzaam bent in design, communicatie, HR, finance of een andere discipline.

Wij kijken ernaar uit je in ons team te verwelkomen!

By combining highly-skilled product and engineering talent with seasoned finance professionals, we’re building the essentials to compete in today’s fast-paced markets. 

The Role: 

We are seeking an experienced Tax Associate Director (or Director) to lead tax matters across our UK, EMEA, and APAC operations. Based out of our London office in the United Kingdom, this is a high-impact individual contributor role within a fast-growing fintech business and will report locally to the UK Finance Director. The individual will act as a strategic leader responsible for managing corporate tax compliance and reporting, transfer pricing, planning and advisory and risk management across the UK, EU and APAC regions to strengthen the overall global tax and, more broadly, finance functions for the Company and support the needs of a rapidly growing organization.   

We are looking for someone who is excited to join a fast-paced organization and contribute to building a best-in-class Tax function as the Company continues to scale across businesses and geographies.  The team is lean and the scope of the role is broad and so the position offers significant opportunities for leadership and growth.  You will serve as the primary tax authority for a complex, multi-jurisdictional enterprise, advising senior business leaders, managing external advisors, and partnering with financial, legal, HR, and product teams to ensure tax efficiency, compliance and strategic alignment.  

Responsibilities: 

Tax compliance and reporting: 

  • Manage end-to-end tax compliance cycle including, but not limited to, the preparation and/or review and filing of corporate income tax returns, VAT/GST and/or withholding taxes using local external advisors, where appropriate.
  • Oversee the calculation and review of current and deferred tax provisions under IFRS / US GAAP for regional entities.
  • Ensure timely and accurate tax disclosures in statutory financial statements.  

Tax planning and advisory: 

  • Collaborate with Head of Tax on global tax strategy ensuring regional alignment with overall group-wide objectives. 
  • Assist with development and implementation of tax planning initiatives, identifying opportunities to optimize effective tax rate and maximize efficiency and tax savings.
  • Assist with M&A tax due diligence and post-acquisition tax integration and legal entity rationalization workstreams, including holding structures and IP ownership.
  • Act as internal tax advisor for various business units and stakeholders, including, but not limited to, finance, legal, operations and HR.
  • Monitor legislative and regulatory developments in UK, EMEA, and APAC jurisdictions (including Pillar Two / BEPS) and assess impact on the business.  

Tax Risk Management: 

  • Support global transfer pricing policies, including local file requirements and ensuring intercompany agreements are properly documented.
  • Identify and assess issues and tax implications across UK, EMEA and APAC subsidiaries; maintain robust internal controls are in place to ensure compliance and mitigate tax risk.  
  • Manage relationship with tax authorities (i.e., HMRC) and assist with support for tax controversy and audits/examinations. 

Other: 

  • Assist with the design and implementation of technology automation initiatives with respect to financial reporting and tax compliance.
  • Assist in operational aspects of the tax function to support tax needs. Gain a deep understanding of the company’s operations, businesses and develop a strong network beyond the tax department.
  • Assist with special projects and initiatives, as necessary, including systems implementation and automation processes.
  • Support other tax workstreams, if needed (e.g., FATCA/CRS). 

Skills & Attributes: 

  • Significant hands-on tax experience and in-depth understanding of UK, EMEA and Asia corporate tax gained in-house at a multinational company.  
  • Exceptional technical knowledge of international tax principles  
  • ACA, CTA, or equivalent professional qualification preferred (or international equivalent).
  • Deep expertise in UK corporate tax is essential; strong knowledge of EMEA and APAC tax regimes strongly preferred.
  • Proven track record managing transfer pricing frameworks in a multi-jurisdictional setting
  • Experience supporting new business development and M&A transactions, including due diligence, structuring and integration.  
  • Background in financial services and/or fintech and understanding of the securities industry and broker-dealer businesses including understanding of financial products is highly desired
  • Strong project management, planning, and organizational skills including the ability to prioritize multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.  
  • Self-starter with the ability to work well independently as well as within a team environment with excellent interpersonal skills.   
  • Collaborative working style with cross functional/business segment teams across geographies. 

We Offer:

At Clear Street, we offer competitive compensation packages, company equity, pension, gender neutral parental leave, and full medical and dental insurance. Our belief has always been that we are better as a business when we are all together in person. As such, we are requiring employees to be in the office a minimum of three days per week.

Our top priority is our people. We’re continuously investing in a culture that promotes collaboration. We help each other through challenges and celebrate each other's successes. We believe that modern workplaces succeed by virtue of having high-performance workforces that are diverse in ideas, cultures and experiences. We put in the effort to make such a workplace a daily reality and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

title: Autonomy Engineer Intern, Reinforcement Learning, 2027 (Zurich)
descriptionHtml:
Skydio is the leading US drone company and the world leader in autonomous flight, the key technology for the future of drones and aerial mobility. The Skydio team combines deep expertise in artificial intelligence, best-in-class hardware and software product development, operational excellence, and customer obsession to empower a broader, more diverse audience of drone users, from utility inspectors to first responders, soldiers in battlefield scenarios, and beyond.

About the role:

Skydio builds the world’s most advanced autonomous drones used across inspection, public safety, defense, cinematography, and more. Your research won’t languish in a paper: it will fly, shaping how pilots and operators complete real missions in complex environments. Develop and deploy reinforcement learning (and adjacent policy-learning methods) that make Skydio aircraft plan, navigate, and control themselves more intelligently, safely, reliably, and efficiently across our ecosystem: handheld apps, ground control, cloud autonomy services, and fleet workflows.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Navigation & avoidance in the wild: Train policies that adapt online to cluttered 3D scenes (forests, bridges, urban canyons), complementing our stack for robust obstacle avoidance and dynamic goal-seeking.

  • RL-augmented planning: Fuse learned cost shaping / value functions with trajectory optimization for smooth, agile flight with tight safety envelopes and mission constraints.

  • Sim to Real at scale: Build scalable datasets and training loops with Isaac Lab, domain randomization, residual learning, and safety filters; validate on real drones weekly.

  • Human-in-the-loop shared control: Learn assistive policies that blend pilot intent, autonomy priors, and uncertainty-aware behaviors for intuitive control handoffs.

  • Fleet & multi-agent: Explore decentralized coordination for coverage, pursuit, and collaborative mapping with minimal comms.

What makes this internship different:

  • Real hardware cadence: Prototype in sim, then flight test on production-ready aircraft and edge compute. Your work is meant to make a difference in the real world, not just in simulation.

  • Safety-first learning: We pair RL with formal constraints, estimation of uncertainty, and conservative action filters for dependable deployment in human environments.

  • Cross-disciplinary mentorship: Collaborate with perception, mapping, controls, and product teams to close the loop from research to field ops.

What makes you a strong fit:

  • PhD student in Robotics, Machine Learning, Controls, or related field.

  • Strong fundamentals in RL, control theory, and motion planning; comfort with safety/robustness concepts.

  • Proficient in Python (PyTorch/JAX/Ray RLlib) and at least one of C++ or CUDA.

  • Hands-on experience with robotics simulation (Isaac Lab/MuJoCo/PyBullet) and sim2real techniques.

  • Experience training/deploying policies for navigation, manipulation, or locomotion on real robots or autonomous vehicles.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Publications (CoRL, ICRA, IROS, RSS, NeurIPS).

  • Experience with onboard inference optimization (TensorRT, quantization, sparsity).

  • Familiarity with modern policy learning beyond vanilla RL: diffusion policies, IL/BC, offline RL, model-based RL.

  • Experience with multi-agent RL or distributed training.

title: B2B Marketing Manager, DACH
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

Like every team at OpenAI, the Marketing team contributes directly to our mission of responsible and widespread AI adoption.

The EMEA B2B Marketing team translates global priorities into regionally relevant programs that drive awareness, consideration, pipeline, adoption, and long-term customer trust. We partner closely with Sales and GTM, Product Marketing, Field and Executive Marketing, Content, Customer Marketing, Partner Marketing, Comms, Events, Marketing Operations, and regional leadership.

DACH is one of OpenAI’s most important markets in EMEA. Our opportunity spans major enterprises and digital natives, ambitious startups, developers, partners, and a highly influential business community navigating the adoption of AI.

About the Role

As the B2B Marketing Manager for DACH, you will own the integrated B2B marketing strategy and execution for Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.

You will be a close commercial partner to local Sales and GTM leadership, translating market insight, revenue priorities, target-account needs, and global launches into locally relevant programs that create pipeline, accelerate complex opportunities, deepen customer relationships, and grow adoption.

You will carry clear pipeline goals and be accountable for Marketing’s measurable contribution to commercial outcomes in DACH. These goals will be established through the regional planning process and will evolve with the priorities and maturity of the market. You will be expected to understand the pipeline, make informed investment decisions, and demonstrate how marketing activity creates, influences, or accelerates revenue opportunities.

This is a generalist role spanning field and executive marketing, demand generation, account-based programs, content, customer marketing, partnerships, events, and product launches. You will bring these channels together into a focused DACH B2B plan, drawing on specialist capabilities within the EMEA B2B Marketing team in London and global Marketing teams. A particularly important partnership will be with the DACH Consumer Marketing Lead: together, you will align market strategy, narratives, launches, audience priorities, channels, and major moments so B2B and B2C activity is coordinated, complementary, and mutually reinforcing.

Close partnership with Marketing Operations will be crucial. Together, you will establish campaign infrastructure, audience and account segmentation, attribution, reporting, and operating rhythms that give Sales and Marketing a reliable view of performance and inform where the team should invest next.

The role requires someone who can move comfortably between strategy and execution: shaping the market plan, participating in pipeline reviews, developing a priority-account program, adapting a global campaign, briefing an agency, supporting an executive event, and personally unblocking delivery when needed.

This role is preferably based in Munich. Berlin may be considered for an exceptional candidate. Regular travel within DACH and to London will be required.

In this role, you will:

  • Own and execute the integrated DACH B2B marketing plan, aligned with regional priorities, local revenue goals, market opportunities, and customer needs. Partner closely with the DACH Consumer Marketing Lead to ensure B2B and B2C strategies and activities are coordinated and complementary, while retaining clear accountability for B2B pipeline and revenue outcomes.

  • Carry pipeline goals for DACH B2B marketing and be accountable for demonstrating measurable contribution to pipeline creation, influence, opportunity progression, and revenue outcomes.

  • Partner closely with DACH Sales and GTM leadership on territory planning, target-account prioritisation, pipeline goals, strategic opportunities, and quarterly business reviews.

  • Build full-funnel programs across field and executive marketing, demand generation, account-based marketing, content, customer advocacy, partnerships, events, and digital channels.

  • Design programs around priority accounts and buying groups, tailoring narratives and engagement for senior decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—and connecting customer proof, partner participation, content, and seller follow-up to create or advance opportunities.

  • Work in close partnership with Marketing Operations to define target audiences, establish campaigns, maintain data and process quality, track performance, improve attribution, and turn results into clear recommendations.

  • Build a regular Sales, Marketing, and Marketing Operations pacing rhythm covering pipeline performance, account engagement, campaign conversion, opportunity follow-up, risks, and investment decisions.

  • Translate global campaigns, product launches, narratives, and assets into locally relevant programs that reflect DACH market dynamics, language, industry priorities, and customer expectations.

  • Work with EMEA specialist teams in London to bring the strongest regional capabilities into the market, while serving as the voice of DACH in regional planning and prioritisation.

  • Develop locally relevant customer stories and advocacy opportunities in partnership with Sales, Customer Success, Customer Marketing, Comms, and senior customer stakeholders.

  • Build joint programs with strategic technology, consulting, and implementation partners where they can extend reach, strengthen customer value, or contribute to pipeline.

  • Own the operating rhythm for DACH B2B marketing, including planning, budget management, agency coordination, campaign pacing, performance reporting, and prioritisation.

  • Build repeatable playbooks and share market learning across EMEA, helping the wider organisation understand what resonates with DACH customers and decision-makers.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have 12+ years of experience in integrated B2B, regional, field, demand generation, or account-based marketing, ideally in enterprise technology, cloud, AI, or SaaS.

  • Have a proven track record of driving measurable pipeline and revenue impact through integrated B2B marketing programs, ideally within large, complex enterprise sales cycles.

  • Have supported high-value products with long sales cycles, multiple decision-makers, and significant commercial scrutiny, and are familiar with engaging senior decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—throughout complex buying journeys.

  • Have held pipeline goals or comparable commercial targets and can clearly demonstrate how your marketing decisions created, influenced, or accelerated revenue opportunities.

  • Have partnered closely with enterprise sellers and Sales leadership on account prioritisation, pipeline reviews, opportunity acceleration, executive engagement, and follow-up.

  • Have worked closely with Marketing Operations on campaign architecture, segmentation, lead and account processes, measurement, attribution, and performance reporting.

  • Are comfortable using pipeline and campaign data to diagnose performance, make trade-offs, and redirect investment—not simply report activity.

  • Are a marketing generalist with experience connecting multiple channels into one coherent market plan, rather than operating within a single specialist discipline, and have a strong track record of partnering with consumer marketing leaders to integrate B2B and B2C strategy and activity without blurring ownership.

  • Understand DACH enterprise buying dynamics and can translate local customer, industry, cultural, and regulatory context into stronger marketing decisions.

  • Can balance local market needs with regional and global priorities, influencing effectively within a matrixed international organisation.

  • Are both strategic and hands-on: able to establish direction and operating structure while personally driving high-priority work to completion.

  • Bring strong commercial judgement, operational discipline, and the ability to make clear prioritisation decisions when opportunities exceed available capacity.

  • Communicate credibly with senior customer decision-makers—particularly technical C-suite audiences—as well as Sales, Marketing, and partner stakeholders.

  • Are energised by AI and motivated to help organisations across DACH adopt transformative technology responsibly.

  • Are fluent in German and English.

title: Backend Engineer - Partner Flow
descriptionHtml:
Backend Engineer - Partner Flow Team

Hybrid in London / Remote within the UK

We’re looking for a Backend Engineer to join the Partner Flow team.

This role is a chance to shape how thousands of small businesses find their way to iwoca. You'll join the team that owns iwoca's partner integrations — the Lending API and embedded flows that let third-party platforms, from major banks to fintechs, offer iwoca loans inside their own customer journeys. You'll own projects, collaborate with stakeholders, and design robust systems to deliver important functionality and measurably improve the experience for our partners and customers.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

iwoca partners with a variety of third-party platforms, ranging from large banks and comparison sites to small fintechs that serve SME customers. These partners use iwoca’s Lending API to embed iwoca loans into their own customer journey. Partnerships are an important and fast-growing source of customers for iwoca.

The Partner Flow team builds new features and optimises existing flows to provide the best possible experience for iwoca's partners and the customers they refer to us. The team’s responsibilities include:

  • Continually improving our Lending API and other developer tools, so that partners can integrate with iwoca quickly and easily.

  • Adding new functionality to facilitate deeper integrations and ensure iwoca is the best embedded finance provider on the market.

  • Improving the conversion rate of customers who come to us through partners - streamlining the journey, running RCTs (randomised control trials) and building models alongside our embedded data scientist to find what works.

The team is made up of three engineers, a data scientist plus a team lead, working closely with an internal team of commercial stakeholders. This role is one of two new engineering hires as we grow the team to meet our ambition.

Partner Flow is remote/hybrid-friendly, meeting up for team days in the office once or twice a month, but not on a fixed schedule. They work in an Agile fashion with two-week sprints and a daily standup.

The role

You’ll work on challenging projects all over iwoca’s codebase - anywhere there are improvements to be made for partners and partner-referred customers. You’ll be encouraged to bring your own ideas and take responsibility for areas of functionality.

Autonomy:

  • Own features and projects from scoping and design through to production.

  • Collaborate with other engineers to meet the team’s goals, whilst being trusted to define your own solutions and work independently on your part of the problem.

  • Design and maintain robust, flexible, and maintainable systems to ensure scalability and fast-paced development.

Impact:

  • Deliver new functionality critical to onboarding important new partners.

  • Run experiments (RCTs) and optimise the funnel to measurably improve how partner-referred customers convert.

  • Leave code, docs, and processes in better shape than you found them.

Purpose and product thinking:

  • Work on systems that genuinely help businesses get the funding they need.

  • Collaborate with our partners and internal stakeholders to design effective solutions.

  • Use data to make decisions, uncover insights, and refine strategies.

AI:

  • We're pushing hard on AI-assisted development. Engineers here write clear technical specs, let skills and agents implement boiler-plate, and hold a high bar on code review — the person, not the model, is accountable for what merges. We expect AI output to be validated for correctness, performance and security like any other change.

  • We give the team unlimited tokens across all models and expect people to experiment.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Experience designing and building scalable back-end systems, ideally in Python.

  • Experience working with relational databases, ideally PostgreSQL, with an understanding of performance and maintainability considerations.

  • Experience building and maintaining APIs that are easy to use, reliable, and well-documented.

  • Experience managing projects end to end, from understanding business problems to designing and delivering technical solutions.

  • Pragmatism in balancing delivery speed with long-term system health.

  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication, focusing on outcomes and impact.

  • A genuine team player: you support your teammates, share knowledge, and care about the team's success as much as your own.

  • AI fluency. Experience using AI coding tools to accelerate real delivery, and a genuine interest in getting better at it - with a pragmatic sense of where it adds value and where it doesn't.

Bonus:

  • Front-end development experience, particularly with React and Typescript.

  • Experience with DevOps practices, including containerisation and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Experience with experimentation (e.g. A/B tests or RCTs) or using data to drive product decisions.

  • Working knowledge of modern data tooling - ideally Snowflake and dbt - used to build analytical or reporting pipelines.

The salary

We expect to pay from £60,000—£85,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage people to explore new areas of interest, adopt better tools – including AI – and apply sound judgement so our products and decisions improve over time.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A choice between a dedicated dental plan or a health cash plan that reimburses everyday medical expenses.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

title: Billing Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs is scaling fast – new enterprise customers, new products, new markets. The Billing Operations Specialist is the person who makes sure every deal that closes is reflected correctly in our systems.

This is an operational ownership role, sitting at the intersection of Sales, Customer Success, Finance, and Engineering – responsible for the full billing lifecycle of our enterprise accounts, from provisioning a new customer on day one to cleanly closing out a churned account. You'll resolve discrepancies before customers notice them, catch configuration drift before it becomes a revenue problem, and build the processes that make billing feel invisible to everyone else. You'll also work on projects and programs that evolve the sophistication of our billing processes and our tooling, and help with things like pricing migrations and other critical efforts.

The ideal person is someone who is obsessive about accuracy and automation, comfortable navigating ambiguity, and energized (not frustrated) by the complexity of managing billing at scale across thousands of accounts.

Provisioning

  • Translate closed-won deals from Salesforce into correctly configured subscriptions in our billing platforms, such as Stripe – pricing plan, billing interval, contract start date, trial periods, discounts

  • Own the reconciliation between executed order forms and what's been requested for provisioning; work with Sales and Legal to resolve any gaps

  • Partner with Engineering to identify automation opportunities and build guardrails that make provisioning faster and more accurate over time

Subscription & account management

  • Process mid-cycle changes and manage renewal mechanics – upgrades, downgrades, seat changes, plan switches, and so on.

  • Handle offboarding cleanly: close subscriptions, issue final invoices or credits, ensure no residual billing

  • Resolve invoice discrepancies raised by customers or flagged by the Customer Success team – incorrect amounts, missing credits, misapplied discounts

Revenue integrity

  • Run periodic audits of active subscriptions to verify billing matches contracted terms

  • Identify and remediate ghost subscriptions, duplicate customers, and orphaned invoices

  • Support month-end and quarter-end close by reconciling billing platforms with Finance's records

  • Surface pricing or configuration anomalies to relevant teams.

Requirements

Must-have

  • 2-5 years in billing operations, revenue operations, finance operations or a similar role supporting B2B or enterprise customers (adjust the range for level)

  • Hands-on experience with a subscription billing platform, ideally Stripe Billing or similar (Chargebee, Zuora, Recurly), including subscriptions, invoices, credits, coupons and billing intervals

  • Experience turning closed-won deals and order forms into correct billing configurations (pricing plan, start date, trial, discounts)

  • Strong attention to detail and a record of catching discrepancies before customers do

  • Can read a contract or order form and spot gaps against what was requested for provisioning

  • Experience reconciling billing data to finance records, including supporting month-end or quarter-end close

  • Comfort working with Salesforce (or another CRM) as the source of truth for deals

  • Clear written communication and ability to work across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal and Engineering

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and with managing a high volume of accounts without losing track

Strong plus

  • Experience with usage-based or hybrid pricing

  • Familiarity with SQL, spreadsheets at scale (pivots, lookups), or BI tools, for audits and reconciliation

  • Experience building automation or scripts, or partnering with Engineering on guardrails (APIs, webhooks, no-code tools)

  • Experience running subscription audits, such as finding ghost subscriptions, duplicate customers and orphaned invoices

  • Experience with pricing migrations or billing-system migrations

  • Exposure to ASC 606 or revenue recognition basics

  • Experience with a quote-to-cash stack (CPQ, contract management, ERP such as NetSuite)

  • Experience at a high-growth SaaS or AI company

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States or Europe.

title: BLP Academy Facilitator
descriptionHtml:
Join BLP and help make the world’s business processes autonomous!

Our agentic platform helps finance and operations teams worldwide remove manual work from their core business processes, so work runs end-to-end with greater control and significant productivity gains.

Today, over 550 enterprise customers use BLP across 1,300+ deployed projects. In the processes we automate, customers achieve productivity improvements of 5 to 10 times.

To date, BLP remains majority employee-owned, with Goldman Sachs holding a minority stake as a growth investor. Our success is driven by deep expertise in technology and business processes, a superior product with strong product-market fit, reflected in an expanding customer base that includes Fortune 500 companies.

BLP is one of Switzerland's fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups; we are now entering our next phase of growth. From our headquarters on Zürich's Bahnhofstrasse, we're expanding globally, with a growing presence across Europe and North America.

Join us and help make autonomous operations the new standard.

Location

This is a full-time position based at our HQ in central Zurich. The BLP Academy happens in person, and so does this role: you are in the room with our clients for every cohort.

Your Mission

You run the room. Two to three days in Zurich that set the tone for every implementation that follows.

Before a project kicks off, our clients send the people who will carry it, their BLP Champions, to the BLP Academy. They learn hands-on on our platform, work through real project scenarios, and meet peers from other enterprises facing the same challenges. Across 1,300+ projects, the customer team has made the difference between a smooth and a slow implementation, so these days matter.

You make them count. You welcome every participant, run and own the sessions, and set the energy in the room from the first coffee to the last evening. You bring in our BLP experts for deep dives and make sure their expertise lands. Our clients go home certified, connected and ready for their implementation, after an unforgettable few days in Zurich. And as BLP expands across Europe and North America, the Academy will grow with it, with you shaping what that looks like.

That takes an unusual mix: part entertainer, part teacher, part professor, with a real curiosity for processes and AI. We care less about where you come from than about what happens when you walk into a room. You will join a fast-growing, global AI company and a team that brings real energy to everything it does. If you light up a room and make complex things simple at the same time, read on.

Key Responsibilities

In the room

  • Host every Academy cohort in Zurich: welcome our clients, set the tone, and be their main point of contact from arrival to departure.

  • Lead the sessions: present, explain, and guide participants through hands-on exercises on the BLP platform.

  • Pace every hands-on block to the room, giving fast learners space to go deeper while making sure nobody gets left behind.

  • Moderate the deep-dive sessions with BLP experts and connect their content to each participant's situation.

  • Keep the energy high across two to three intense days, and host the evenings and everything around the program.

Around each cohort

  • Get every participant ready before they arrive, so the Academy starts with momentum on day one.

  • Make sure every participant completes the BLP Champion Certification and goes home ready for their implementation.

  • Collect feedback and participant NPS, and make every cohort better than the last.

Beyond the classroom

  • Bring the Academy experience to new formats as they launch, from online learning programs for our clients and certification for our implementation partners to onboarding for new BLP colleagues.

What We're Looking For

The following key attributes ensure success in this role:

  • Energy – You bring the room to life on day one and still have it on day three, evenings included.

  • Owning a Room – You lead groups with confidence, from senior client audiences to hands-on sessions, and know when to push, when to pause and when to make people laugh.

  • Patience and Empathy – You notice who is struggling before they say so, and you adapt the pace of a hands-on session to each participant.

  • Communication – You make complex topics simple and convincing, and you can tell whether a participant has really understood or is just nodding.

  • Credibility – You hold your own with senior experts and executives, because you think in structures and understand what you are talking about.

  • Curiosity for Processes and AI – You want to understand how enterprise processes run and what AI changes about them, and you learn fast.

  • Host Mindset – You care that every participant has a great experience, keep a multi-day program running smoothly, and notice the details that make it work.

What You Bring

  • You know how to lead a room, whether that’s a workshop, a training, an event or a client meeting, ideally with senior audiences. We care more about how you got that experience than where: consulting, teaching, events, tech or team leadership all count.

  • You’ve gained several years of professional and relevant experience, in any industry or along any path.

  • You’re excited about AI and how it changes the way businesses work, and you can’t wait to get to know the BLP platform inside out.

  • You’re fluent in German and English, both spoken and written. This is a must, because you’ll run Academy sessions in both languages, often for senior client audiences.

  • Proven experience designing and delivering trainings, workshops, or customer onboarding sessions yourself, ideally to business or technical audiences.

  • Experience with ERP systems or finance processes, workshop or event formats, or AI-driven SaaS is a plus.

How You Grow

As BLP grows, the Academy grows with it, and so does this role. You will be close to our clients, our experts and our leadership, which opens doors across the company as we expand.

Benefits

  • High ownership environment – you own the Academy experience and shape how our clients start their BLP journey.

  • Impact at scale – every cohort you run shapes implementations at enterprises across Europe.

  • Cross-functional exposure – work with project managers, consultants, engineers, product teams and our clients daily.

  • Real growth – fast-paced environment, steep learning curve, and structured career progression.

  • Employee ownership – be part of a majority employee-owned company with a best-in-class stock option program.

  • Energized team – become part of a driven and collaborative group of innovators who bring energy to everything they do.

  • Technology exposure – be at the forefront of AI and enjoy continuous learning opportunities.

  • Offsites – including collaborative team offsites.

Ready to build the future of ERP automation? Join us and own your impact.

Learn more about BLP and our values at https://blp.digital/company/careers.

title: Business Development Intern
descriptionHtml:
Big changes start with people who want to achieve more.

How do employees get to work? Why do company cars sit idle while parking spaces are scarce? And how can we make sustainable mobility the most attractive choice?

At Urban Connect, we turn these challenges into practical solutions. We bring shared e-bikes and company cars, public transport, mobility budgets and digital parking management together on one platform. We help companies reduce costs, make better use of resources and give their employees greater freedom.

Companies such as Roche, Google, SWISS and Lonza already rely on us. Our ambition goes further: we want to transform how companies manage mobility.

To make that happen, we are looking for curious minds who take ownership and want to make a difference together.

Your internship: accelerated learning, real responsibility

Want to understand how a technology company grows—and help make it happen?

During this six-month internship, you will work closely with our Sales and Account Management team, as well as Product and Operations. You will learn to understand customer needs, develop compelling solutions and turn data into tangible business opportunities.

Your initiative matters. You will contribute your own ideas, take on increasing responsibility and see the impact of your work.

How you will make a difference

  • Turn data into opportunities: analyse usage and market data, including vehicle and parking utilisation, and translate your findings into recommendations for better corporate mobility solutions.

  • Drive your own projects: Work with the team lead to take ownership of clearly defined projects, such as analysing products, assessing sales opportunities and developing corporate mobility concepts.

  • Understand the product: learn how customers are set up on our platform, how bookings and billing work, and how vehicles and parking barriers are connected.

  • Work smarter with AI: use AI tools thoughtfully, test new applications and help us improve research, analysis and everyday processes.

  • Help drive growth: identify prospective customers, research their challenges and support the team in winning new business and expanding existing partnerships.

  • Make a compelling case: create clear presentations, well-founded proposals and insightful quarterly reviews that demonstrate the value of our solutions.

  • Keep things moving: maintain accurate customer data and activities in HubSpot, ensuring good conversations lead to clear next steps.

  • Connect teams: resolve technical questions with the Product, Operations and Technology teams and communicate the answers clearly to customers and the Commercial team.

What you bring

  • An excellent degree, for example in business, economics, data science, engineering or industrial engineering. We are looking for excellence, curiosity, creativity and courage - not to have studied a perfect subject.

  • Some practical experience through an internship, part-time job, personal project or entrepreneurial initiative.

  • An analytical mindset, confidence with Excel and the ability to understand and communicate complex ideas and interdependencies clearly and simply.

  • Ability to think outside of the box and to question conventional ways of doing things.

  • Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Copilot - and the excellent judgement to critically assess their output. In fact, good judgment is a key criterion for success with us.

  • An interest in technological progress, the curiosity to truly understand how things work, and the confidence to contribute your questions and ideas to a highly motivated team.

  • Excellent German and good English skills. French is a big plus.

Above all, we value your mindset: you learn quickly, ask thoughtful questions and think ahead. You take initiative, develop suggestions and seek support when you need it. You care about the details, strive to make good work even better and are willing to take a risk sometimes to try something new - even when that means making a mistake and learning from it.

What you can expect

High standards - and an environment of smart, kind people to challenge you to grow.
We are ambitious, give direct, constructive feedback and support one another. Excellence shows up in our everyday work: in thoughtful solutions, careful execution and the drive to keep improving.

A view of the whole business.
You will work at the intersection of sales, customer success, technology and operations, learning how an idea becomes a solution that customers value.

Direct access and room to take initiative.
Good ideas get heard quickly here. Your responsibility grows with your capabilities and commitment.

The opportunity to build a future with us.
If we are a good fit for each other, there is an opportunity to join Urban Connect beyond the internship and grow with the company.

You will also benefit from:

  • Flexible working hours and a beautiful office in Zurich.

  • A monthly mobility budget and access to our e-bikes and shared electric cars.

  • A motivated team that enjoys working together (mostly in person), sharing knowledge, growing together, and celebrating success together!

Ready to make a difference?

Send us your CV and a few personal lines: Why Urban Connect? And what are you proud of having initiated, solved or improved yourself?

We look forward to meeting you.

title: Business Development & Tender Manager (Netherlands) - all genders
descriptionHtml:
Your Mission

As Business Development & Tender Manager NL (all genders) you will identify and drive new business opportunities to help the company grow and become a market leader in the Netherlands.

This high-visibility role combines business development, commercial strategy, value proposition development, tender leadership, strategic account management (municipalities, grid operator, ecosystem partners), as well as stakeholder management. You will not only grow ubitricity presence in the market, building strong relationships with public authorities, key stakeholders and relevant institutions but also develop and adapt our value proposition to the local needs. You will be instrumental in developing and improving our product and service offering. You will be accountable in particular for network size and securing new contracts.

We are looking for highly-motivated individuals with a commercial background, clear business acumen and strong communication skills, who can successfully drive major tenders and develop the Dutch market in line with ubitricity goals and ambition.

Based in our Amsterdam office on Keizersgracht 452, you'll be part of an international, collaborative team that values trust, ownership and open communication. We work in a hybrid setup with three days per week in the office, balancing flexibility with meaningful in-person collaboration. Regular travel within the Netherlands will allow you to build strong relationships with partners and municipalities and make a tangible impact on the country's transition to sustainable mobility.

Responsibilities

  • Owning and leading major public tenders from end to end, bringing together cross-functional teams, coordinating key stakeholders and driving competitive, high-quality bids through to contract award and signature.
  • Identifying and securing new business opportunities with public authorities and strategic partners across the Netherlands.
  • Building and maintaining strong relationships with decision-makers at national, regional and local government level.
  • Shaping and executing ubitricity's commercial strategy and value proposition in the Dutch market.
  • Representing ubitricity at industry events, conferences, trade fairs and market consultations, strengthening our visibility and influence across the sector.
  • Acting as a trusted ambassador for ubitricity within key industry organisations such as NAL, NKL and Elaad.
  • Leading commercial negotiations with public authorities, grid operators and other strategic stakeholders.
  • Building and expanding a strong network across the Dutch energy and e-mobility ecosystem.
  • Monitoring market developments, regulatory trends and competitive dynamics to identify new growth opportunities.
  • Contributing to industry working groups and helping shape the future of smart and grid-aware charging solutions.

Your profile

We're looking for a commercially driven professional who combines strategic thinking with the ability to build relationships and turn opportunities into results.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a related field.
  • 3-5 years of experience in business development, tender management, public affairs, sales or a comparable commercial role.
  • Strong track record of managing complex stakeholder environments and driving projects to successful outcomes.
  • Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to influence decision-makers and build long-term partnerships.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Experience in the e-mobility, energy or infrastructure sector is advantageous.
  • Experience with public procurement, B2G sales or tender processes is advantageous.
  • Full professional proficiency in Dutch and English, with the ability to engage confidently with public authorities and senior stakeholders.

Our Offer

Why Join ubitricity?

  • Help accelerate the transition to cleaner and more sustainable transportation.
  • Work in an international and purpose-driven company with ambitious growth plans.
  • Take ownership of meaningful projects with visible impact.
  • Collaborate with passionate colleagues across Europe.
  • Enjoy a hybrid working environment that combines flexibility with teamwork and connection.
  • Grow professionally while helping shape the future of public EV charging.

Diversity & Inclusion

At ubitricity, we believe that diverse teams build better solutions. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and identities. Even if your experience doesn't match every qualification listed, we encourage you to apply. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we're looking for.

title: Business Informatie Analist Backend Platform
descriptionHtml:
Bouw jij mee aan betrouwbaar functioneel beheer voor applicaties die onze collega’s dagelijks nodig hebben?

Als je aan de slag gaat bij het bedrijfsonderdeel IT, dan ga je de uitdaging aan om Univé fit en wendbaar te houden - in alle IT-opzichten. Je zal terechtkomen op de afdeling IT Kern binnen het team Backend Platform en je richten op de verzekerings- en/of HR-processen.

  • minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in de IT;

  • nieuwsgierig bent naar nieuwe IT ontwikkelingen en innovatie oplossingen kunt bedenken;

Voorkomen, beperken en verzekeren heeft een centrale plek in de strategie van Univé. Wij helpen onze klanten risico’s te voorkomen en schade te beperken. En wat we niet kunnen voorkomen of beperken, verzekeren we gewoon goed.

De afdeling IT Kern, waaronder Backend Platform valt, levert een state-of-the-art IT-fundament voor de Univé-organisatie om de business doelen te realiseren. Voor Backend Platform zoeken wij een Business Informatie Analist. Als Business Informatie Analist werk je in op DevOps gebaseerde Agile teams en ben je continue bezig om de beloftes aan onze klanten waar te maken.

Je werk bestaat onder andere uit:

  • Bewaken van de ketensamenhang: Je overziet de impact van wijzigingen op applicaties, systemen en onderlinge koppelingen en draagt bij aan een stabiele en betrouwbare dienstverlening.

  • Continu verbeteren: Je denkt actief mee over het verbeteren van onze dienstverlening, werkwijzen en samenwerking binnen de Agile teams.

Wat bieden wij

Bij Univé IT bieden we je een uitdagende functie binnen een dynamische organisatie, waarin je veel ruimte krijgt om mee te bouwen aan professioneel en toekomstgericht Backend Platform.

  • Ruimte om mee te denken over marktontwikkelingen, automatisering en de inzet van AI binnen Unive en IT.

Univé is een coöperatieve organisatie die dicht bij haar leden staat. Als IT-organisatie werken we aan een wendbaar, betrouwbaar, veilig en toekomstgericht IT-landschap. Schaalbare technologie, goede processen, standaardisatie en continu verbeteren zijn daarbij belangrijk. Samen bouwen we aan een moderne IT-organisatie waarin we betrouwbaar functioneren, waardestromen goed worden ondersteund en vernieuwing gecontroleerd en toekomstbestendig kan plaatsvinden. title: CDI - Senior Context & Analytics Engineer - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Mission

Un agent ne vaut que ce que valent les données et les connaissances sur lesquelles il répond. Pipelines, modèles de données, définitions de métriques, droits d’accès : vous créez et gouvernez ce socle, et les applications et les agents de nos clients s’appuient dessus. Quand un analyste ou un agent demande un chiffre, la réponse est celle de l’équipe finance, accompagnée de sa définition et de sa source.

Ce poste est fait pour vous si vous voulez que les métiers et les agents puissent se fier aux données, et les utilisent.

Artefact accompagne les plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le déploiement de l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, le département Engineering réunit environ 300 personnes sous la responsabilité du CTO ; vous y rejoignez le chapter AI Applied Engineer, archétype Context & Analytics Engineer.

Activités et responsabilités

Avec les équipes métier et les analystes, il s’agit de définir ce que signifie chaque métrique et de vérifier que les données y correspondent. Sur ce socle, les Product Engineers et les AI Engineers construisent applications et agents.

Les Platform Engineers exploitent l’infrastructure sur laquelle tournent vos pipelines. Les échanges avec les data owners et les équipes de gouvernance du client, la relecture de code entre pairs et l’accompagnement des nouvelles recrues complètent le quotidien.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Construire des pipelines d’ingestion et des modèles de données, avec dbt par exemple.
  • Mettre en place des contrôles de qualité des données et maintenir le lineage.
  • Construire la couche sémantique et les définitions de métriques, pour que les personnes et les agents utilisent les mêmes chiffres, y compris en text-to-SQL.
  • Définir les règles de gouvernance et les droits d’accès.
  • Construire des pipelines de connaissances pour le RAG : indexation, chunking, métadonnées, permissions.
  • Préparer le contexte exploitable par les agents : métadonnées, définitions, lineage et permissions.

Profil recherché

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous écrivez du SQL avec aisance et modélisez les données pour l’analyse.
  2. Des pipelines de données planifiés, testés et surveillés figurent à votre actif.
  3. Aux côtés des équipes métier, vous définissez les métriques et vérifiez que les données veulent bien dire ce que tout le monde croit y lire.
  4. La qualité des données, la documentation et les droits d’accès comptent pour vous.
  5. Les coding agents font déjà partie de votre quotidien, et vous vérifiez ce qu’ils produisent.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Python pour le traitement de données.
  • Une plateforme de données cloud, comme BigQuery, Snowflake ou Databricks.
  • Une couche sémantique ou un metrics store.
  • La préparation de documents pour le RAG : chunking, indexation, métadonnées.
  • Des outils de data catalogue ou de lineage.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Dans un métier où deux tableaux de bord affichent parfois deux chiffres différents, ce poste consiste à rétablir la confiance : un chiffre juste, une définition partagée, une source identifiable. Ce travail, discret quand il réussit, conditionne tout ce que les autres archétypes construisent au-dessus.

Nous sommes des AI makers : l’IA se construit avec nos clients, pas seulement pour eux. Leurs enjeux deviennent les nôtres, et nos choix techniques s’expliquent dans le langage du métier. Les positions que nous prenons sont claires ; elles évoluent face aux faits, jamais sous la pression.

Notre domaine change tous les mois, et ce rythme nous convient : les nouvelles technologies et les nouveaux secteurs s’apprennent vite, et les habitudes qui ne servent plus s’abandonnent sans regret. Devant un problème difficile, le réflexe est de le découper en étapes vérifiables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur le code comme sur les livrables.

Quand il manque quelque chose, pour un client ou pour le chapter, nous le construisons. La progression passe par des retours constructifs, par le partage des connaissances, par la demande d’aide sans attendre et par la reconnaissance du travail des autres. Il y a beaucoup à apprendre, et beaucoup à construire.

Un counsellor accompagne vos premiers mois. L’onboarding technique ouvre le parcours, suivi d’un premier projet client ; si aucun n’est prêt, les starter kits internes prennent le relais.

Le reste s’apprend sur les projets, avec les AI Engineers et l’appui de la communauté Context & Analytics Engineer, notamment le context engineering, c’est-à-dire le travail qui rend les données exploitables par les agents d’IA. À partir de 2027, l’archétype Context & Analytics Engineer disposera de sa propre grille de compétences et de son propre parcours de formation, en plus du socle commun à tous les AI Applied Engineers (évaluation de l’IA, responsabilité en production).

Plus tard, un rôle transverse devient possible (Project Tech Lead, Pre-sales Engineer, Engineering Manager), tout comme les chapters AI Architect et AI Product Manager.

Processus de recrutement

Le processus demande environ quatre heures, réparties en six étapes dont une seule sur site.

  1. Entretien RH (45 min, à distance) : parcours, motivations et points pratiques, comme le calendrier et les prétentions salariales.
  2. Appel avec le CTO (15 à 30 min, à distance).
  3. Screening technique (30 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter AI Applied Engineer) : retour détaillé sur vos projets passés, puis questions techniques et de design de solution.
  4. Code review et live coding (60 min, sur site, avec un membre du chapter) : relecture d’un dépôt de code existant et correction de ses défauts, puis construction d’une nouvelle fonctionnalité avec un coding agent et présentation du résultat.
  5. Cas technique (45 min, à distance, avec un membre du chapter) : cadrage d’un problème métier, proposition d’une solution technique, description de la méthode d’évaluation, puis discussion de vos choix.
  6. Entretien final (30 min, à distance, avec une personne de l’encadrement du département, Engineering Manager ou Director) : reprise des points restés ouverts, choix de l’archétype et du niveau les mieux adaptés à votre profil, et réponses à toutes vos questions.

Selon les étapes, tous les outils d’IA sont autorisés, ou aucun. Lors du live coding, c’est la manière de travailler avec l’assistance de l’IA qui est observée.

Rémunération : 53 000€ à 63 000€ brut annuel (fixe) + jusqu’à 5 000€ de variable selon expérience et séniorité

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l’adéquation avec le rôle.
