title: CEO - Doit Lithuania
descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As CEO of Doit Lithuania, you will build and run the business in Lithuania and grow it across the European Economic Area.

You will be the first senior hire in Lithuania. You will own the regulatory relationship, the build of the team, the partner network and the launch. You will sit on the management board and lead the business day to day.

We’re looking for a generalist who learns quickly, thinks deeply, and enjoys solving difficult problems in a fast-moving, regulated environment.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the relationship with the Bank of Lithuania and other regulators.

  • Build the Vilnius team, including compliance, operations and control functions.

  • Select and negotiate with execution, custody, fund and banking partners.

  • Own the business plan, financial projections, capital plan and budget.

  • Launch the investment platform in Lithuania and roll it out across the EEA.

  • Set up governance, policies and controls that meet EU and Lithuanian requirements.

  • Work with group leadership on product, engineering and growth.

  • Report to the board and take ownership of business and regulatory outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Generalist background in consulting, investment banking, start-ups, private equity or venture capital.

  • Experience building or scaling a business, ideally in financial services or fintech.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn regulation quickly and work credibly with regulators.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with boards, regulators, partners and teams.

  • Comfortable working across product, operations, finance and compliance.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a senior manager.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania.

  • Experience with MiFID II, brokerage, wealth management or fund distribution.

  • Experience building or running a regulated financial business in the EU.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

  • People who see regulation as someone else’s problem.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

descriptionHtml:

Vous préférez construire un marché à partir de zéro plutôt qu'hériter d'un portefeuille tout fait ?

QUI SOMMES NOUS
KT Groupe a construit son succès sur un marché : le fitness. Salles de sport premium, clubs, franchises. Ce marché fonctionne, et il continue de croître.

Aujourd'hui, la direction ouvre un second moteur de croissance : l'hôtellerie, les résidences de tourisme, les spas, les centres wellness et le sport en entreprise. Un marché sur lequel KT Groupe possède déjà le savoir-faire technique, mais pas encore la présence commerciale.

C'est précisément là que vous entrez en jeu.

LE POSTE EN UNE PHRASE

Vous ne reprenez pas un portefeuille : vous le construisez. Ce n'est pas un poste de gestion, c'est un poste de conquête.

Vous allez chercher les projets, vous construisez le réseau de prescription (architectes, maîtres d'œuvre, bureaux d'études, équipementiers, groupes et franchises), et vous conduisez le cycle de vente de la qualification jusqu'à la signature. Vous êtes rattaché à la direction du développement commercial, et vous travaillez au quotidien avec la direction générale, la direction technique et le pôle fitness — votre homologue, sans lien hiérarchique.

Vos missions

Créer et développer le marché du pôle

  • Construire la cartographie du marché : groupes hôteliers, chaînes, hôtels indépendants haut de gamme, résidences de tourisme, spas, centres wellness, entreprises souhaitant équiper leurs locaux.
  • Identifier les décideurs réels : direction générale, direction technique, direction des opérations, asset managers, responsables de l'expérience client.
  • Aller chercher les projets par prospection directe, LinkedIn, réseau personnel, salons et recommandations.
  • Contribuer à la construction de l'offre du pôle : arguments, références, cas d'usage.

Développer les partenariats et la prescription — le levier le plus puissant du poste

  • Identifier, approcher et signer des partenariats avec les prescripteurs du marché : architectes, maîtres d'œuvre, bureaux d'études, équipementiers wellness et spa, groupes et franchises.
  • Construire des accords donnant-donnant, où KT Groupe apporte des marchés à ses partenaires et réciproquement.
  • Faire référencer KT Groupe comme constructeur et aménageur auprès des partenaires.
  • Entretenir la relation dans la durée : un partenariat signé et non animé ne produit rien.

Conduire le cycle de vente de bout en bout

  • Qualifier les demandes entrantes et les opportunités sortantes, mener la découverte, préparer les briefs de chiffrage pour la direction technique.
  • Présenter la proposition, négocier et signer.
  • Rester l'interlocuteur unique du premier contact jusqu'à la signature — un principe de maison chez KT Groupe.

Préparer et exploiter les salons

  • Constituer en amont le pipeline de rendez-vous du salon Meeting Hôtellerie de mars 2027.
  • Assurer un suivi post-salon aussi rigoureux que la préparation.

Tenir la rigueur commerciale

  • Tenir le CRM à jour, réagir vite aux demandes entrantes, participer à la réunion commerciale hebdomadaire.
  • Documenter vos process au fur et à mesure, pour permettre la délégation future.

Vos compétences

Nous n'attendons pas un CV type. Trois chemins peuvent mener à ce poste, et nous arbitrerons en fonction des candidatures reçues :

  • Confirmé du secteur — hôtellerie, spa, wellness, équipement hôtelier, agencement d'hôtels. Vous apportez un carnet d'adresses immédiatement activable.
  • Confirmé B2B, autre secteur — vente de projets à panier élevé (BTP, agencement, mobilier professionnel, équipement, retail, énergie). Vous apportez une méthode de vente éprouvée sur cycle long et une culture du chiffre.
  • Junior à fort potentiel — deux à trois ans d'expérience commerciale, forte envie, pas encore le réseau. Vous apportez de l'énergie et une capacité à vous former sans habitudes à défaire.

Le socle commun, non négociable

  • Vente B2B de projets à cycle long et à panier élevé, à partir de 150 000 €.
  • Capacité à ouvrir un compte à froid, sans lead entrant et sans introduction.
  • Aptitude à lire un besoin d'aménagement, comprendre un plan et dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs techniques.
  • Rigueur dans la tenue d'un CRM et dans le suivi des engagements pris.
  • Qualité de l'écrit professionnel : une proposition mal écrite décrédibilise un projet à 200 000 €.
  • Anglais professionnel apprécié ; permis B et disponibilité pour des déplacements réguliers.

Votre savoir-être

  • Le goût de la chasse : vous ne dépendez pas des leads qu'on vous donne.
  • Une posture de conseil : vous aidez un investisseur à réussir un projet, vous ne vendez pas des travaux.
  • De l'exigence et de la fiabilité : ce que vous annoncez, vous le tenez.
  • De la tenue dans la durée : un cycle de vente de 3 à 4 mois demande de la constance.
  • Une ambition assumée : la part variable est déplafonnée, elle est faite pour ceux qui veulent aller la chercher.

Avantages

Une rémunération pensée pour la performance

Le principe est simple et assumé : un fixe qui sécurise, un variable sans plafond qui récompense la performance réelle.

  • Un fixe mensuel selon expérience et valeur apportée.
  • Une prime versée à la signature de chaque projet de construction ou de rénovation, proportionnelle et non plafonnée.
  • Une prime à la signature d'un partenariat structurant, franchise ou groupe.
  • Une commission sur les marchés que vous apportez, selon les règles en vigueur dans l'entreprise.

Le fixe couvre vos besoins. Le variable, lui, n'a pas de plafond : une personne performante gagne significativement plus que son fixe.

Des moyens et un vrai accompagnement

  • Ordinateur, téléphone, accès CRM, outils de prospection, budget de déplacement, participation aux salons professionnels.
  • Une formation interne : méthode commerciale propriétaire, formation à l'équipement sportif et à l'agencement par le pôle fitness, immersion chantier.
  • Un plan d'intégration structuré sur 90 jours (immersion, structuration, transformation, pilotage), avec des points de situation réguliers avec la direction.
  • Une évolution possible vers responsable du développement du pôle, dès lors qu'une équipe se constitue sous votre responsabilité.

Notre état d'esprit

Chez KT Groupe, la transparence n'est pas affichée, elle est pratiquée : on dit les choses, y compris quand elles sont difficiles, les chiffres sont partagés. On ne compte pas ses efforts quand un projet est en jeu — et on ne compte pas non plus la reconnaissance. Le niveau d'exigence est élevé sur la qualité livrée, chacun assume ses sujets jusqu'au bout, les décisions se prennent vite. On va sur les chantiers, on voit les sites, on rencontre les clients : rien ne se décide uniquement depuis un bureau.

Ce poste n'est pas un poste confortable. Le marché est entièrement à créer, et le premier semestre demande une vraie tolérance à l'incertitude : pas de portefeuille, pas de leads fournis, un rythme de montée en puissance qui dépend largement de vous. Pendant la phase de démarrage du pôle, vous apporterez aussi un renfort ponctuel et cadré dans le temps sur la qualification téléphonique des demandes entrantes du pôle fitness — sans que cela remette en cause votre responsabilité pleine sur votre propre pôle.

Si vous cherchez la sécurité d'un portefeuille existant, ce poste n'est pas pour vous. Si vous voulez construire quelque chose et être payé à la hauteur de ce que vous construisez, la suite est pour vous.

title: Chemical Engineer (Solid Propellants)
descriptionHtml:
Chemical Engineer

We are looking for a Chemical Engineer to develop and improve the propellants and laboratory capability behind our solid rocket propulsion systems. You will combine practical laboratory work with engineering judgement, working on formulation, preparation, characterisation, incoming-material inspection, and the scale-up of propellant solutions from laboratory experiments to propulsion hardware.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

Key responsibilities

  • Develop, formulate, prepare, and improve solid propellants for different propulsion requirements.

  • Plan and conduct laboratory experiments, characterise materials, and document results clearly.

  • Work with propulsion engineers to connect formulation, processing, material properties, and motor performance.

  • Support incoming-goods inspection, supplier engagement, and the evaluation of specialist chemicals and raw materials.

  • Investigate unexpected results, non-conformances, processing issues, and material compatibility questions.

  • Improve laboratory procedures, equipment capability, data quality, safety, and the scale-up of successful formulations.

What we are looking for

  • A degree in chemistry, chemical engineering, materials science, polymer science, energetic materials, or a related field.

  • Hands-on laboratory or process-development experience for solid propellants.

  • Strong understanding of chemistry, materials behaviour, experimental design, and laboratory safety.

  • A careful and methodical approach to traceability, measurement quality, process control, and documentation.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a willingness to investigate unexpected results.

  • The ability to work collaboratively with propulsion, test, manufacturing, quality, and supplier teams.

Desirable experience

  • Solid rocket propellants, binders, oxidisers, metallic fuels, catalysts, or energetic materials.

  • Propellant characterisation, burn-rate measurement, thermal analysis, rheology, mechanical testing, ageing, or compatibility.

  • Scaling a formulation or laboratory process toward repeatable production.

  • Incoming-material inspection, chemical quality control, supplier qualification, or non-conformance investigation.

  • Hazardous chemicals, explosives, or regulated laboratory processes.

  • Laboratory data systems, statistical analysis, or Python-based data processing.

Benefits and important information:

  • We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent.

  • Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success.

  • Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas.

  • Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday

  • Free access to shared company housing

Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week.

We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger.

title: Chief Engineer Operations H/F
descriptionHtml:
📍 Paris / Île-de-France | Environnement Data Center | CDI | Périmètre multisite

Rejoignez mon client au cœur des infrastructures critiques.

Dans un contexte de forte croissance et de développement de ses infrastructures, mon client renforce son organisation Operations en France et crée un poste de Chief Engineer.

Au sein d'un nouvel pôle d'expertise technique transverse, vous devenez le référent technique des opérations sur plusieurs sites stratégiques en France, avec un périmètre prioritaire couvrant notamment deux sites.

Votre mission : apporter votre expertise, sécuriser les opérations et contribuer à faire progresser l'ensemble de l'organisation vers davantage de standardisation, de rigueur opérationnelle et d'excellence technique.

Ce poste s'adresse à un profil expérimenté qui souhaite aller au-delà de l'expertise technique pure et jouer un rôle central dans la structuration des opérations d'un acteur Data Center en pleine croissance.

Vos missions

Votre rôle

Le Chief Engineer intervient comme référent technique et opérationnel multisite.

Vous êtes à la fois :

  • un expert technique capable de challenger les équipes et les prestataires ;

  • un référent opérationnel garant de la sécurisation des opérations ;

  • un acteur transverse capable de fédérer des équipes aux profils et niveaux d'expérience différents.

Vous disposez d'une véritable autorité technique : lorsque les conditions de sécurité ou de maîtrise des risques ne sont pas réunies, vous êtes capable de challenger une opération et, si nécessaire, de prononcer un NO GO sur un mode opératoire ou une intervention.

Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les responsables de site, qui conservent la responsabilité opérationnelle de leur périmètre.

Vos principales missions

1 - Être le référent technique des infrastructures critiques

Vous apportez votre expertise sur l'ensemble des infrastructures techniques du Data Center et êtes capable d'en comprendre les interactions et les impacts opérationnels.

Votre périmètre couvre notamment :

  • les infrastructures électriques HT/BT ;

  • les systèmes de secours électrique ;

  • les UPS / onduleurs ;

  • les groupes électrogènes ;

  • les infrastructures CVC / HVAC ;

  • les systèmes de refroidissement ;

  • la protection et la sécurité incendie ;

  • les systèmes de contrôle-commande et infrastructures associées.

Vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des responsables de site et des équipes Operations, et êtes capable de challenger les différents interlocuteurs internes ou externes sur leurs choix et leurs pratiques.

2 - Sécuriser les opérations

L'une de vos responsabilités majeures sera de garantir que les opérations réalisées sur les infrastructures critiques sont préparées et exécutées dans les meilleures conditions de sécurité et de maîtrise des risques.

À ce titre, vous :

  • challengez les modes opératoires (MOP) ;

  • vérifiez la cohérence et l'exhaustivité des procédures ;

  • identifiez les risques et leurs impacts potentiels ;

  • sécurisez les opérations avant leur réalisation ;

  • challengez les premières analyses et propositions d'intervention ;

  • pouvez émettre un NO GO lorsqu'une opération ne présente pas les garanties nécessaires ;

  • accompagnez les responsables de site dans la prise de décision technique ;

  • contribuez à la mise en place de mécanismes de double vérification.

Vous êtes en quelque sorte le garde-fou technique de l'organisation, avec pour objectif de sécuriser les opérations sans perdre de vue les impératifs de continuité de service.

3- Structurer et harmoniser les pratiques

L'un des enjeux majeurs du poste est de contribuer à l'harmonisation des pratiques entre les différents sites.

Aujourd'hui, les niveaux de maturité et les pratiques peuvent varier d'un site à l'autre. Votre rôle sera de contribuer à construire un socle commun de méthodes et de standards opérationnels.

Vous serez notamment amené(e) à :

  • structurer les processus d'exploitation ;

  • définir et harmoniser les standards techniques ;

  • rédiger et améliorer les procédures et modes opératoires ;

  • mettre en place des workflows opérationnels ;

  • contrôler leur bonne application ;

  • identifier les écarts entre les sites ;

  • proposer et suivre les plans d'amélioration ;

  • partager les bonnes pratiques ;

  • réaliser des REX multisites ;

  • accompagner les équipes dans l'adoption des nouveaux standards.

La capacité à construire et faire vivre des process sera donc aussi importante que votre expertise technique.

4- Apporter votre expertise lors des incidents critiques

En cas d'incident technique complexe, vous intervenez comme référent technique auprès des équipes Facility et Operations.

Vous êtes notamment amené(e) à :

  • analyser techniquement l'incident ;

  • identifier les causes et les impacts potentiels ;

  • apporter votre expertise aux responsables de site ;

  • challenger les analyses proposées ;

  • accompagner les équipes internes et les prestataires ;

  • contribuer à la définition des actions correctives ;

  • participer à la résolution de l'incident ;

  • organiser et partager les retours d'expérience à l'échelle des différents sites.

Votre capacité à prendre du recul, analyser rapidement une situation complexe et apporter une réponse techniquement robuste sera essentielle.

5 - Développer une culture d'excellence opérationnelle

Vous ne vous contentez pas de définir les standards : vous accompagnez les équipes dans leur appropriation.

Vous serez ainsi amené(e) à :

  • former et accompagner les équipes ;

  • expliquer les exigences techniques et opérationnelles ;

  • faire progresser les pratiques ;

  • fédérer autour d'objectifs communs ;

  • accompagner la conduite du changement ;

  • favoriser le partage de connaissances entre les sites.

Vous disposez d'une forte capacité d'influence et savez faire avancer les sujets sans nécessairement disposer d'un lien hiérarchique direct.

6 - Être l'interlocuteur technique des clients majeurs

Vous serez capable de :

  • représenter la société sur les sujets techniques ;

  • expliquer une situation ou un incident complexe ;

  • présenter les actions mises en œuvre ;

  • répondre aux interrogations techniques des clients ;

  • apporter un discours structuré et crédible sur les enjeux d'exploitation et de sécurité des infrastructures.

Une organisation en construction

Vous rejoindrez un pôle d'expertise technique transverse nouvellement structuré, regroupant différentes compétences destinées à accompagner les opérations et les projets.

L'objectif est de créer une véritable communauté d'experts capable d'apporter son expertise à l'ensemble des sites et de faire progresser collectivement les standards d'exploitation.

Vous travaillerez au quotidien avec :

  • les responsables de site ;

  • les équipes Facility et Operations ;

  • les équipes projets ;

  • les experts techniques ;

  • les prestataires et partenaires externes ;

  • les fonctions transverses ;

Le poste est donc particulièrement transverse et nécessite une forte capacité à créer du lien entre les différentes parties prenantes.

Vos compétences

Votre profil

Vous disposez d'une expérience significative dans un environnement Data Center ou infrastructure critique fortement structurée.

Vous avez idéalement évolué dans un environnement où les exigences en matière de procédures, de sécurité opérationnelle, de maintenance et de continuité de service sont particulièrement élevées.

Une expérience dans un environnement critique comparable serait particulièrement appréciée.

Votre expertise technique

Vous disposez d'une excellente connaissance des infrastructures critiques et notamment :

  • électricité HT/BT ;

Vous êtes capable de comprendre l'intégralité de l'infrastructure et les interactions entre les différents systèmes, et pas uniquement votre domaine d'expertise initial.

Vous savez également analyser une problématique technique complexe, identifier les risques et challenger les solutions proposées.

Votre expérience opérationnelle

Vous avez déjà évolué dans un environnement où les procédures et les standards opérationnels occupent une place importante.

Vous êtes à l'aise avec :

  • les modes opératoires (MOP) ;

  • la gestion des changements ;

  • l'analyse de risques ;

  • la maintenance préventive et corrective ;

  • la gestion d'incidents critiques ;

  • les audits et contrôles opérationnels ;

  • les REX ;

  • la standardisation des pratiques ;

  • la gestion de prestataires techniques.

Vous avez surtout envie de faire progresser une organisation, de structurer les pratiques et d'améliorer durablement les opérations.

Vos qualités

Pour réussir dans ce rôle, nous recherchons une personne :

  • dotée d'une forte expertise technique ;

  • structurée et rigoureuse ;

  • capable d'analyse et de prise de recul ;

  • pédagogue et capable de transmettre son expertise ;

  • à l'aise pour challenger ses interlocuteurs ;

  • capable de prendre des décisions et de défendre une position technique ;

  • dotée d'une forte intelligence relationnelle ;

  • capable de s'adapter à différents profils et différents niveaux de maturité ;

  • fédératrice et à l'aise dans un rôle transverse ;

  • capable d'accompagner la conduite du changement.

Votre capacité à adapter votre communication à votre interlocuteur tout en maintenant un haut niveau d'exigence technique sera déterminante.

Avantages

title: Chief Financial Officer
descriptionHtml:
Location: East Croydon, London (next to East Croydon station) · Hybrid: 3 days in the office, 2 days from home
Reports to: CEO (David Fowle), with regular exposure to the Board
Direct reports: Finance Director, team of 4
Start: ASAP

About Hozah

Hozah is a tech-led, award-winning company driving change in the parking industry and reimagining urban mobility. Our mission is simple but powerful: to transform parking into a seamless, automated experience, paving the way for smarter, more sustainable cities. With recent recognition as PayTech Company of the Year, a place among Deloitte's Top 50 Fastest Growing Tech Companies in the UK, and significant VC/PE investment, we're one of the fastest-scaling companies in the country.

The role

Hozah is scaling rapidly and we're looking for a commercial, hands-on CFO to be the right hand to the CEO and a partner to the wider leadership team. This is not a back-office, keep-the-books role; it's a seat at the top table. We want someone who changes how the business thinks about its numbers, its unit economics, and where growth is coming from.

You'll use your knowledge of financial and data technology (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery, Omni, Looker, Metabase) to build the FP&A and forecasting capability the business needs to scale with confidence, and give the CEO, the Board and our investors a clear, forward-looking view of the business.

  • Documentation: Keep accurate, concise and contemporaneous clinical records that hold up to audit.

  • Governance: Contribute to clinical audits, incident learning and quality improvement when asked.

  • Collaboration: Work smoothly with customer support, operational and technology teams to keep the service safe and moving in service of our patient base.

  • Safety Mindset: Patient safety and quality are non-negotiable for you. Red flags don't get past you.

title: Company Operations Lead
descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs moves fast - by design. We run lean, we bias toward action, and we trust our people to figure things out. That's how we've built world-leading AI products in three years with a fraction of the headcount of our peers. But speed at 200 people and speed at 1,000+ people are different challenges, and the systems, habits, and connective tissue that let a company move fast without breaking things don't build themselves.

As our Company Operations Lead, you'll own the infrastructure that lets ElevenLabs keep its velocity as it scales. Not by adding process for process's sake - but by building the right systems, in the right places, at the right time, so that the rest of the company can focus on what they do best. You'll establish the operating layer that keeps a 50-country, hybrid organization coherent; drive the strategic planning cadence that keeps leadership aligned; and deploy a lean team of strategic generalists against the company's most urgent cross-functional challenges.

You’ll be responsible for:

  • Operating Cadence: Running the planning and alignment cycles that keep the company pointed in the right direction. This includes OKR planning, workforce, and headcount planning.

  • Operating System: Building and maintaining the infrastructure layer that lets the company move faster. Systems of record, org taxonomy and governance, and the knowledge management systems that ensure information flow effectively across our remote-first team.

  • AI Enablement & Agentification: Ensuring every team at ElevenLabs has the tools, access, and knowledge to work effectively with AI. You'll own the internal AI enablement framework - managing tool access and rollout, identifying where agents and automation can accelerate how functions operate, and building the learning opportunities and champions programmes that drive deep adoption. You'll work closely with Security, IT, and the Automations team to ensure what gets built is built right.

  • Operations Centre of Excellence: Defining what great operations looks like at ElevenLabs and embedding it across the company. You'll set the blueprint that makes operational excellence repeatable and deploy the team as embedded operators inside other functions, standing up best practices, up-skilling teams, and handing off cleanly once the work is done.

Requirements

We do not require formal experience, certifications, or degrees. We do require:

  • Proven experience building and leading a Strategy & Operations or BizOps function at a high-growth technology company - ideally through a meaningful scaling inflection (Series B–D trajectory or equivalent).

  • Track record of standing up functions and systems from scratch and handing them off, rather than owning a permanent queue.

  • Structured problem-solving background - strategy consulting, a BizOps or Chief of Staff seat with genuine strategic scope, or an operator role that required both systems-building and executive influence.

  • Strong AI and tooling fluency - you should be pushing the organisation on what's possible with AI enablement, not chasing it.

  • Exceptional stakeholder management: you can partner with founders and Leads and earn trust quickly in a flat, high-velocity environment.

Bonus:

  • Experience inside a company that scaled through a 200 → 2,000+ person inflection.

  • Background that spans both consulting and operator roles - you've done the thinking and the building.

  • Familiarity with knowledge management, AI agentification, or internal tooling as an operational discipline.

Location

This role is remote. London or New York preferred.

title: Content Marketing Manager
descriptionHtml:

We are a premium e-commerce company with around 300 employees, 9-figure revenue, and operations across 8 markets, combining Nordic design with a clear focus on quality and customer experience.

What You'll Do

  • Turn the global content calendar and brand pillars into a market-specific plan aligned to local seasonality, holidays, and campaigns, and spot content gaps and opportunities.

  • Own the daily organic social channels (Instagram, TikTok, and others): content creation, planning, and community management, adapting global assets to local tone and interacting with the community in the local language.

  • Localise and adapt blog and on-site content from the global calendar, including cultural adaptation and light on-page SEO, and support blog refreshes.

  • Act as the local-language quality check across all content types and the first point of contact for ad-hoc content needs, escalating to global Creative Ops when full production is required.

What You'll Bring

  • 2–4 years in content marketing, organic social, or a hybrid content/social role, ideally in e-commerce or DTC.

  • Experience working within others' brand and SEO frameworks rather than setting strategy independently.

  • Strong sense for short-form, social-first content plus solid long-form writing and editing, proven localisation experience (real adaptation, not just translation), and photo/video editing for fast social content.

  • Nice to have: experience working with a central/global marketing function and familiarity with GA and native platform insights (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn) for simple performance reporting.

💼 Compensation — Competitive salary · Company pension · Fully paid, capped overtime without endless unpaid crunch

📍 Office Location – Schlesische Str. 27 C, Building C, 6th floor, 10997 Berlin

How to Apply

Sounds like you? We'd love to receive your application. Find out more about us and open roles on our Career Page and on LinkedIn.

title: Corporate Counsel
descriptionHtml:
About IMU Biosciences

IMU Biosciences has developed proprietary platform technologies that generate and translate vast system-level immune data into actionable insights and tools to drive the development of precision medicines across a variety of diseases. IMU leverages advanced immune profiling with proprietary AI and machine learning analytics to uncover novel clinical immune signatures. IMU continues to establish partnerships with leading pharma and biotech companies to advance disease diagnosis, optimise product selection, and improve patient stratification and monitoring - while also building its own pipeline of innovative products.

About The Role

 

We are seeking Corporate Counsel to support IMU Biosciences across key commercial, operational, and clinical matters. In this role, you will draft and negotiate complex contracts, safeguard our IP portfolio, and provide actionable legal counsel to internal teams as we expand our platform capabilities and pipeline. You will be working with a dynamic team of stakeholders working on the cutting edge of biotech and machine learning, with support from the CLO, Contracts Manager and outside counsel.

Core Responsibilities

 

  • Draft, review, and negotiate a wide range of commercial contracts, including vendor agreements, service contracts, and strategic partnerships.

  • Provide clear, practical legal advice and guidance across all commercial matters to internal teams and organizational stakeholders.

  • Help build internal legal policies, contract playbooks, and training programs while managing outside counsel when needed.

 

Team and Ways of Working

You will join a collaborative Legal team comprising the Chief Legal Officer and a Contracts

Manager, with support from external counsel. Each team member takes ownership of their

areas of responsibility, working independently and proactively while collaborating to achieve the team’s and wider business’s objectives.

Skills, Knowledge and Experience

Qualification Requirements

  • Bachelor of Laws (LL.B.), Juris Doctor (J.D.), or equivalent law degree from an accredited institution.

  • Qualified solicitor or active bar admission in good standing in at least one relevant jurisdiction.

  • 3–7 years of post-qualification experience inhouse and/or private practice in biotech, pharmaceutical, or life sciences.

  • Strong foundational knowledge of commercial contracts, intellectual property considerations, and relevant regulatory frameworks in healthcare or biotechnology.

Technical Must-Haves (Essential Skills)

  • Strong proficiency in drafting, reviewing, and negotiating basic commercial contracts and service agreements in a timely fashion based on project needs.

  • Conversant with complex commercial contracts within the biotech or life sciences sector including IP licence provisions, with support as needed.

  • Strong familiarity with regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and healthcare standards relevant to biotechnology and life sciences.

  • Good technical understanding of life sciences relevant to clinical development.

Nice-to-Haves (Desirable Skills).

 

  • Working knowledge of data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR) as applied to clinical, biological, and health data.

  • Experience working with AI/ML and/or platform technologies.

Key Competencies

 

  • Collaborative nature: Works confidently with scientists, commercial colleagues, senior leaders and external partners.

  • Proactive: Takes the initiative to identify and address stakeholder needs as they arise.

  • Advocacy: Can advocate the legal position in cross functional teams

  • Flexible thinking: Able to see more than one approach as project needs and priorities change in a dynamic environment.

 

Why Join Us?

● Competitive salary and company bonus scheme

● Pension, health insurance, life assurance, and income protection

● Fast-paced, collaborative startup culture

● Strong opportunities for career development and progression

title: Customer Care Analyst & Ops - CDI
descriptionHtml:
Green-Got est une institution financière française qui permet à chacun de choisir ce que son argent finance.

Nous construisons l'infrastructure financière du monde de demain.

Depuis janvier 2026, Green-Got est un Établissement de Paiement agréé par l'ACPR, supervisé par la Banque de France. Une reconnaissance qui nous place au niveau des acteurs réglementés de premier plan, et qui change en profondeur ce que nous construisons, et comment.

Green-Got propose :

  • Un compte de paiement associé à une carte pour payer et être payé au quotidien.
  • Une gamme de placements financiers performants pour investir dans les entreprises de la transition.

L'expérience membre est au cœur de ce modèle. C'est le socle sur lequel repose la confiance que nos membres nous accordent, et que l'équipe Customer Care entretient chaque jour.

Green-Got en chiffres :

  • 100 M€ de transactions traitées chaque mois ;
  • 2,3 Md€ de transactions sécurisées depuis notre lancement ;
  • 2 M€ de dons reversés à des projets de transition ;
  • 4,8/5 sur Trustpilot ;
  • 5 % de notre chiffre d'affaires pour soutenir directement des projets de terrain, en finançant directement la Fondation Green-Got.

Le contexte :

📍 Locaux à Paris + télétravail, ouvert au full remote depuis ton pays de résidence ;
📄 CDI : contrat de 39h /semaine ;
💶 28–32K € selon profil ;
🗓 Prise de poste : au plus tôt.

Chez Green-Got, le Customer Care est la voix de nos membres en interne, et la voix de Green-Got auprès d'eux, un rôle stratégique dans une institution financière qui grandit vite et qui doit tenir ses promesses 7 jours sur 7.

Nos membres ont changé de dimension avec nous : Compte Premium, PER, compte commun, offre indépendant. Chaque nouveau produit génère de nouvelles questions, de nouvelles situations, de nouveaux défis. L'ouverture prochaine des services BtoB va encore élargir le périmètre.

Nous cherchons quelqu'un qui aime comprendre, qui sait garder son calme sous pression, et qui considère chaque échange comme une opportunité d'améliorer le produit, pas juste de fermer un ticket.

Tu es à l'aise avec les gens et rigoureux sur le fond. Les deux à la fois.

Vos missions

Tes missions :

Membre de l'équipe Customer Care, tu es le point de relais central entre nos membres et toutes les équipes de Green-Got : produit, tech, compliance, marketing, impact. Ton périmètre est vivant : il évolue avec nos lancements, nos besoins, et la trajectoire de Green-Got.

Ta capacité à t'adapter, à prioriser et à garder un haut niveau de qualité dans tous les contextes est ce qui nous permettra de grandir sereinement.

FRONT - Relation membre 50 %

  • Premier point de contact : tu réponds à nos membres sur tous nos canaux, chat (90 %), email (8 %), téléphone (2 %), avec clarté, empathie et dans les délais.
  • Expertise produit : tu connais Green-Got sur le bout des doigts. Tu accompagnes nos membres sur leurs comptes, leurs transactions, leurs questions, et tu trouves la bonne réponse après investigation.
  • Gestion des nouvelles situations : tu identifies, qualifies et résous les cas inédits. Tu es garant de la qualité du premier contact.

RUN - Support opérationnel 35 %

  • Voix des membres en interne : tu collectes, structures et remontes les besoins, frustrations et suggestions aux équipes produit, tech, marketing.
  • Amélioration continue : tu optimises les process existants, challenges les workflows, et maintiens notre documentation (FAQ, process) à jour à chaque évolution produit.
  • Suivi des incidents : tu identifies les bugs, les remontes aux équipes concernées et en assures le suivi jusqu'à résolution.
  • Recette fonctionnelle : tu participes aux phases de test des nouvelles fonctionnalités avant mise en production.

BUILD - Gestion de projet 15 %

  • Initiative et ownership : tu identifies des leviers d'amélioration de l'expérience membre, tu définis des indicateurs, proposes et mets en œuvre des actions concrètes.
  • Pilotage : tu mets en place les outils et routines nécessaires au suivi de tes projets et en garantis le résultat.

Vos compétences

L'empathie, la rigueur dans l'exécution et la capacité à rester serein quand ça s'accélère sont pour toi des réflexes naturels. Tu comprends que la qualité du service est un engagement, pas une intention. Nous cherchons quelqu'un qui en est convaincu.

Chez Green-Got, nous sommes curieux, exigeants, collectifs, et nous allons vite.

  • Sens du service : tu sais que derrière chaque ticket, il y a une personne. Tu ne fermes pas un ticket, tu résous un problème.
  • Rigueur et organisation : tu priorises, tu documentes, tu assures un suivi sans failles.
  • Aisance rédactionnelle : ton orthographe est irréprochable, tu adaptes le ton à chaque interlocuteur. La précision est ta signature.
  • Curiosité analytique : tu aimes comprendre pourquoi une situation se produit, pas juste la résoudre. Tu identifies les patterns et tu les remontes.
  • Gestion du stress : tu gardes ton calme quand la situation l'exige. La pression ne dégrade pas ta qualité.
  • Anglais opérationnel : tu lis, tu réponds, tu échanges sans chercher tes mots. Nous avons des membres non francophones et nous en aurons davantage.
  • Sensibilité à l'impact : la transition environnementale a une réelle importance pour toi. Tu comprends les enjeux et tu portes la mission de Green-Got avec sincérité.
  • Appétence pour les outils numériques : Intercom, Notion, Slack, Aircall, et une vraie curiosité pour l'IA et l'automatisation appliquées au service client.
  • Formation : BTS, IUT, école de commerce, IAE ou toute formation en lien avec la relation client. Une première expérience en care ou service client est un vrai plus.

Avantages

Green-Got entre dans une nouvelle phase. Avec l'agrément ACPR, nous construisons une expérience membre de premier plan, avec les personnes qui nous rejoignent maintenant.

Le service client de demain ne se construit uniquement avec des scripts et des macros. Il se construit avec des personnes qui comprennent le produit, les membres, et l'enjeu de chaque interaction.

  • Un rôle avec de l'impact réel : dans un secteur en pleine transformation, au contact direct de nos membres chaque jour.
  • De vraies responsabilités : tu n'exécutes pas, tu contribues. Tes remontées terrain façonnent le produit.
  • Apprentissage : aux côtés d'une équipe qui transmet, dans un environnement réglementaire de premier plan.
  • Évolution : les profils les plus engagés grandissent avec nous et prennent des responsabilités clés.
  • Flexibilité : remote possible depuis chez toi et partout en Europe.
  • Équipe : ambitieuse, exigeante, déterminée, et qui passe de bons moments ensemble.

Le package :

  • CDI remote ou Paris.
  • Rémunération : 28 - 32k, selon profil.
  • BSPCE.
  • Mutuelle santé Alan.
  • Une journée d’équipe tous les semestres.

Déroulement des entretiens :

  • Envoie-nous ton CV et tout autre élément qui nous aide à jauger tes compétences et ta motivation.
  • Call rapide pour faire connaissance. Si ça matche, on t’envoie un Business Case à préparer.
  • Entretien en visio avec Vincent (Customer Care Manager) pour analyser le Business Case et te tester / te connaitre.
  • Échange avec un ou plusieurs membres de l’équipe pour le fit culturel.
  • Entretien avec Adèle (Head of Operations).
  • Entretien avec Andréa (CEO).

Nous avons hâte de te rencontrer !

title: Customer Service and Sales administaror
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Cloverleaf Plumbing, Heating & Renewables is a well-established and growing business, proudly serving customers since 1994.

We specialise in plumbing, heating, air conditioning and renewable energy solutions, helping homeowners and businesses improve their comfort and energy efficiency.

As our business continues to grow, we're looking for an enthusiastic, organised and confident individual to join our friendly office team.

About the Role

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys working with people, thrives in a busy office environment, and wants to develop their career in customer relationship and sales.

Initially, the role will focus primarily on general office administration, customer service and supporting the smooth day-to-day running of the business.

However, we're looking for more than someone who simply processes paperwork.

You'll also play an important role in how we welcome new customers, manage incoming enquiries and guide prospective clients through the early stages of their journey with Cloverleaf.

As you become familiar with our services, systems and customers, there will be opportunities to take on greater sales responsibilities, develop your commercial skills and earn additional income through a commission structure.

You don't need to be a heating or renewable energy expert. We're much more interested in finding someone with the right personality, communication skills and willingness to learn.

Key Responsibilities

Office Administration & Operations

  • Manage and coordinate boiler and air source heat pump servicing, including customer reminders, bookings and follow-up communications.

  • Complete manufacturer product and warranty registrations, ensuring accurate records are maintained.

  • Assist with the administration of our company vehicle fleet, including servicing, MOTs, insurance and general vehicle records.

  • Maintain accurate customer information, job records and documentation within our Simpro management system.

  • Support the scheduling and coordination of engineers and customer appointments.

  • Liaise with customers, engineers, suppliers and other members of the team to ensure jobs progress smoothly.

  • Assist with general office administration and other operational tasks as required.

Customer Enquiries & Relationship Management

  • Act as a friendly, professional and confident first point of contact for customers contacting Cloverleaf by telephone, email or through our website.

  • Handle new sales enquiries, asking relevant questions to understand customers' requirements and identify the most appropriate next step.

  • Qualify and organise incoming enquiries, ensuring customers are directed towards the correct service, appointment or member of the team.

  • Build rapport with prospective customers and maintain communication throughout the early stages of their enquiry.

  • Arrange initial consultations, surveys and follow-up appointments with the appropriate team members.

  • Proactively follow up with prospective customers, keeping conversations moving forward and ensuring opportunities are not overlooked.

  • Maintain accurate customer notes and enquiry records to support a structured and professional sales process.

Sales Development & Career Progression

As you gain experience and confidence, we would like you to become increasingly involved in the commercial side of the business.

This could include:

  • Following up on quotations and helping customers make informed purchasing decisions.

  • Developing the confidence to discuss our services, explain their benefits and address common customer objections.

  • Managing your own customer enquiries and progressing opportunities through the sales process.

  • Helping convert enquiries into confirmed appointments and accepted quotations.

  • Working towards agreed sales targets with the opportunity to earn commission.

Full training and ongoing support will be provided as your responsibilities develop.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who combines excellent organisational skills with a natural ability to communicate and build relationships.

Essential Skills & Qualities

  • Previous experience in office administration, customer service or a similar role.

  • Confident, friendly and professional telephone manner.

  • Comfortable starting conversations with new customers and asking questions to understand their needs.

  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage several tasks and priorities.

  • Excellent attention to detail and a reliable approach to completing administrative work.

  • Good written communication and computer skills.

  • A proactive attitude, with the confidence to take ownership of tasks and follow them through.

  • Willingness to learn new systems, processes and technical information.

  • A positive, enthusiastic personality and the ability to work well within a small team.

  • An interest in developing customer relationship and sales skills.

Desirable Experience

  • Experience working in plumbing, heating, air conditioning, renewables, construction or a related industry.

  • Previous experience in a customer-facing sales or sales support role.

  • Experience using CRM or job management software such as Simpro.

  • Experience managing service schedules, customer appointments or maintenance contracts.

  • Previous involvement in following up on quotations or converting customer enquiries into sales.

Industry experience is an advantage but is not essential. We believe that the right attitude, personality and communication skills are just as important as previous technical knowledge.

What We Offer

  • Competitive basic salary of £26,000–£29,000 per annum, depending on experience.

  • Opportunity to earn additional sales commission as your role develops.

  • 20 days' annual leave plus 8 bank holidays.

  • An additional 3 days' paid holiday gifted by the company during our Christmas shutdown.

  • Workplace pension scheme.

  • Friendly, supportive and established team environment.

  • Training on our products, services and business systems.

  • Genuine opportunities for professional development as the company continues to grow.

  • The opportunity to play an important role in a growing business within the renewable energy sector.

How to Apply

If you're organised, enjoy speaking with people and would like a role that offers both variety and the opportunity to develop your career, we'd love to hear from you.

We're particularly interested in hearing from candidates who are confident on the telephone, enjoy building customer relationships and are motivated to take on more responsibility over time.

Please apply with your up-to-date CV and a brief introduction explaining why you feel you'd be a good fit for our team.

About XYZ Reality

XYZ Reality created the world’s first engineering-grade augmented reality for construction. Our site-safe hardhat, The Atom, overlays the design model onto the live build, so our engineers can verify work as it goes in on some of the most complex mission-critical projects in the world.

Our project delivery team runs XYZ's service on site across multiple active projects, from mobilisation to handover.

Customer Success Managers are the face of XYZ Reality for our clients. You'll help people feel the product.
This role is for someone who has spent years in construction delivery, in Electrical Engineering, CSA, Project Controls or Commissioning, and knows the industry inside out. You'll use that experience to connect with site teams on their level, understand their pressures, and show them how XYZ Reality helps them deliver better. You're not a software salesperson. You'll spend a lot of time on sites, working directly with project teams and building trust. You'll also hold your own in a room with VPs and senior client stakeholders, translating field reality into business value.

title: Customer Success Manager
descriptionHtml:
Customer Success Manager

Location: Remote (European/UK time zones) - French and English required

About FullEnrich:

Every go-to-market motion runs on data, but no single provider has ever had complete coverage. We solve that problem: instead of relying on a single data source, we orchestrate 20+ premium providers around the world, automatically querying them and verifying data in real-time until we find the best available contact information. The result is industry-leading coverage and data quality, helping sales and GTM teams connect with the right people faster.

What started as a better way to find emails and phone numbers has grown into a broader vision: becoming the trusted GTM data infrastructure layer powering modern revenue teams and AI agents. Today, more than 6,000 customers, including companies like AWS, Deel, HubSpot, Clay, Intercom, Unify,and Artisan, trust us to power their prospecting and enrichment.

Founded in Paris and now headquartered in San Francisco, we're a team of 50+ people across the US, Europe, LATAM, and Israel, growing quickly and building with speed, ownership, and ambition. That's where you come in.

The Role:

You’ll be joining as a Customer Success Manager in our Customer Success team, reporting to Jemima, our Founding CSM.

FullEnrich has grown to 5,000+ customers, and our CS function has been a team of one until now. We're bringing in our next CSM to own all of our French-speaking customers, across every segment, plus our Scale/SMB book ($10k to $25k ARR). Day to day, you'll onboard new customers, drive adoption, run renewals end to end, and spot the accounts that are ready to grow. Ownership here means your book is yours: you know every account, you close every renewal, and you catch risk before it turns into churn. You'll work closely with Sales, Product and Support, and because the team is still small, you'll help shape the playbooks the rest of CS is built on.

What You'll Do:

Own your book

  • Own the post-sale relationship for all of our French-speaking customers who range from Enterprise to SMB, plus our Scale/SMB book

  • Run onboarding and kick-off calls so new customers reach first value quickly

  • Be the voice of your customers internally, feeding product feedback into the roadmap

Renewals & retention

  • Own renewals end to end: forecasting, commercial conversations and closing

  • Monitor usage, credit consumption and health signals, and act early on risk

  • Run save plays on at-risk accounts before renewal is on the line

Adoption & expansion

  • Drive adoption across our API, CSV/bulk upload and CRM integrations

  • Identify and qualify expansion opportunities, then hand them to Sales with full context

Scaled CS

  • Contribute to one-to-many programs: French-language webinars, office hours and enablement content

  • Help improve our playbooks and keep HubSpot data clean and reliable

What Success Looks like:

By 3 months

  • Confident across the product (API, CSV, integrations) and our CS playbooks

  • Owning your full book, with every account health-scored and a main point of contact in HubSpot

  • Running renewals independently, and you have hosted your first French-language webinar or office hours

By 6 months

  • Book on track for 90%+ gross revenue retention

  • [X]% of the book active and healthy (target to confirm once the health score is defined)

  • A steady flow of qualified expansion handoffs to Sales

By 12 months

  • 90%+ GRR delivered across the book

  • Measurable improvement in adoption and health across the book

  • The trusted internal voice on our French-speaking customers, shaping how we scale CS

What We're Looking For:

  • Native-level French and fluent English, written and spoken

  • 2 to 4 years in a SaaS Customer Success role, owning a book of business

  • A track record of owning and closing renewals, not just managing relationships

  • Comfortable running a high-volume book and prioritising with data

  • At home in a CRM (HubSpot ideally) and using usage data to make decisions

  • Warm, clear communicator who's confident in commercial conversations

  • Builder mindset: you like a fast-growing team where the playbook is still being written

Nice to Haves

  • Background in B2B data, sales tech or GTM tooling

  • Comfortable talking APIs and integrations with technical buyers

  • Confident using Claude to speed up your day-to-day work

The Hiring Process:

  • Intro to FullEnrich with our Talent Team (30 min) – A chance to learn more about you, introduce FullEnrich and the role, and explore whether there's a mutual fit.

  • Meet with our Founding CSM (45 mins) –A chance to dive deeper into your experience and role specific fit

  • Task stage (90 mins)

  • Final with the CEO (45 min) – A chance for you to meet our CEO, Ben, and have a conversation around FullEnrich's values, ambitions, how we work, and what we're building together.

title: Customer Success Onboarding Specialist (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

Deine Mission

Du bist die Stimme unserer deutschen Kunden und trägst direkt dazu bei, dass sie mit Pennylane erfolgreich sind. Du hilfst kleinen und mittleren Unternehmen (KMU), ihre Finanzprozesse zu vereinfachen und das volle Potenzial unserer Finanzmanagement-Plattform auszuschöpfen. Gleichzeitig gestaltest du mit uns den Aufbau von Pennylane in Deutschland.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Onboarding mit Wirkung: Du begleitest neue KMU-Kunden und ihre Steuerkanzleien durch den gesamten Onboarding-Prozess. Du sorgst dafür, dass der Einstieg reibungslos gelingt und Unternehmen schnell von den Möglichkeiten unserer Plattform profitieren.
  • Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen und weiterentwickeln: Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für unsere bestehenden KMU-Kunden. Du baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen auf, erkennst Potenziale für zusätzliche Funktionen und eine erweiterte Nutzung und hilfst deinen Kunden, ihre unternehmerischen und finanziellen Ziele mit Pennylane zu erreichen.
  • Proaktiv beraten: In regelmäßigen Gesprächen prüfst du, wie erfolgreich deine Kunden mit Pennylane arbeiten und wo sie Unterstützung brauchen. Du steigerst ihre Zufriedenheit, optimierst die Nutzung der Plattform und erkennst frühzeitig, wenn eine Abwanderung droht.
  • Gemeinsam den deutschen Markt gestalten: Du arbeitest eng mit unserem deutschen Sales-Team und dem lokalen Leadership-Team zusammen. Gemeinsam entwickelt ihr Abläufe weiter, bündelt Produktfeedback und treibt das Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland voran.
  • Expertise aufbauen und teilen: Du entwickelst dich zur gefragten Ansprechperson für unsere Plattform und die deutsche Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft. Dein Wissen und bewährte Vorgehensweisen gibst du direkt an unsere KMU-Kunden weiter.

Das bringst du mit

  • Relevante Erfahrung: Du hast 2–5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, im Finanzmanagement, in Corporate Finance oder in einer vergleichbaren unternehmensinternen Rolle. Idealerweise hast du selbst mit Finanzprozessen, Rechnungsstellung oder Buchhaltungsabläufen gearbeitet. Erfahrung im B2B-SaaS-Umfeld, bei einem Fintech oder in einer Steuerkanzlei ist ein Plus.
  • Fachliche Grundlage: Du hast ein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Finanzen, Rechnungswesen oder Betriebswirtschaft abgeschlossen. Alternativ bringst du eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter, eine Weiterbildung als Steuerfachwirt oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im Rechnungswesen mit.
  • Verständnis für den deutschen Markt: Du kennst die Anforderungen von KMU an ihr Finanzmanagement und verstehst die zentralen Abläufe rund um Rechnungswesen, Rechnungsstellung und das finanzielle Tagesgeschäft in Deutschland.
  • Kommunikationsstärke und Empathie: Du hörst aufmerksam zu, versetzt dich in deine Kunden hinein und erklärst komplexe finanzielle oder technische Themen einfach und verständlich.
  • Lust, selbst anzupacken: Du möchtest Teil eines Teams sein, das in Deutschland noch am Anfang steht und wächst. Du ergreifst die Initiative, denkst in Lösungen und hast Freude daran, Prozesse von Grund auf mitzugestalten.
  • Reisebereitschaft: Du freust dich darauf, unser Team beim Onboarding im Pariser Headquarter kennenzulernen, und bist bereit, gelegentlich Kunden in Deutschland zu besuchen – etwa einmal im Monat.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem oder verhandlungssicherem Niveau (C2) und fließend Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren internationalen Teams.

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

  • Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.
  • Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage.
  • Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.
  • Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.
  • Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.
  • Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.
  • Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

Wen wir suchen

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

  • Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).
  • Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.
  • Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).
  • Ausreichend Erfahrung, um deine täglichen Aufgaben nach geschäftlichen Prioritäten auszurichten.

Mae, our AI guide inside Mastry, is a real-time AI agent that thinks, speaks, listens and sees, working alongside the tools you already use, like Claude and Copilot.

We closed our latest fundraising round in April 2026, with $500m+ raised in total from VC partners including Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Schroders Capital and Lightspeed. With a $2.1bn valuation, we are Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn, and we are just getting started.

If you want to shape how the workforce wins in the AI era, come and join us.

At Multiverse, we are building a tech-first institution that combines work and learning to close the critical skills gap. The Customer Value Partner (CVP) is the primary architect of this transformation.

In the Enterprise segment, you are the single point of accountability for our customers from the moment a contract is signed. You will lead the end-to-end journey - ensuring every launch is flawless, every program delivers measurable business impact, and every partnership has a clear, data-backed roadmap for expansion. This is a role for an operator who is as comfortable influencing a Director-level stakeholder as they are navigating the data-driven technicalities of a program launch.

 

Once here, you will:

  • Independently lead the end-to-end customer journey for a portfolio of Enterprise accounts, handling greater ambiguity to move customers from initial sales handover to long-term value realization and renewal.

  • Independently build 12-month Mutual Action Plans and Discovery Workshops, establishing the clear governance, success metrics, and operating rhythms required to drive consistent momentum.

  • Oversee launch excellence and the critical "First 90 Days," collaborating methodically with the central Fulfilment team to ensure technical readiness and cohort setup do not create long-term account drag.

  • Lead structured Executive Business Reviews (EBRs) that move beyond data reporting to tell a compelling story of ROI, navigating difficult conversations with sensitivity and adapting responses based on customer emotion.

  • Synthesize delivery outcomes into compelling proof by correlating Multiverse learner data with client-provided business KPIs to justify further strategic investment.

  • Proactively identify expansion and upsell triggers, contextualizing why these opportunities matter within the customer’s specific business environment to build "ready-to-close" commercial cases.

  • Methodically experiment with playbooks and templates to improve how the work is done, acting as a "source of wisdom" for the wider team and the internal voice of the customer.

  • Align Delivery, Product, and Support teams to remove barriers, triangulating patterns from multiple sources to improve the overall Enterprise customer experience.

About You:

  • You bring 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Consulting, with a proven history of managing and growing high-stakes Enterprise B2B relationships.

  • You have proven experience of working within the NHS, or managing NHS accounts or contracts as a supplier or partner, with a solid understanding of how NHS organisations make decisions, buy and work with external providers

  • You are a natural project leader who can leverage internal teams (such as Fulfilment and Admissions) to deliver a seamless customer experience during high-stakes implementation phases.

  • You are data-fluent. You don’t just report on metrics; you interpret complex datasets and correlate Multiverse delivery data with a client’s internal KPIs to build a technical ROI case.

  • You have a "commercial nose" for growth. You understand the mechanics of Net Revenue Retention (NRR) and can build "ready-to-close" expansion cases backed by value proof and mutual action plans.

  • You are "Director-ready." You can hold the room during an EBR and navigate difficult conversations with a balance of empathy and data-backed logic.

  • You thrive in an environment where the CRM (Salesforce) is the source of truth, maintaining high standards of data hygiene to ensure account health is always visible.

Benefits

  • Health and wellbeing: Bupa private medical insurance, a medical cash back plan, therapy through Spill and gym access through Wellhub.

title: Data Center Operations Implementation Manager
descriptionHtml:
Role Overview

We are seeking a Data Center Operations Implementation Manager to own the end-to-end Day 0 to Day 2 transition of Nscale's data centres — spanning construction, fit-out, and live, steady-state local operations — across an assigned region and set of sites. Rather than owning construction execution itself, you'll be the connective tissue between Construction, Network Engineering, Compute/Infrastructure Deployment, and local Operations teams — driving a structured, well-documented transition so every site goes live on schedule and ready to support production workloads. This is an individual-contributor role built on strong stakeholder management, cross-functional influence, and travel to sites during critical transition windows.

What You'll Do

Day 0 to Day 2 Transition Leadership

  • Own the end-to-end Day 0 to Day 2 transition process for each data centre site within your assigned region — spanning construction, fit-out, and steady-state operations.
  • Define and maintain a standardized transition framework and readiness checklist applied consistently across your assigned sites.
  • Track and drive closure of cross-team action items, dependencies, and blockers standing between construction handover and operational go-live.
  • Identify and escalate risks to go-live timelines, and drive resolution across the relevant stakeholder groups.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Track progress and status across Construction, Network Engineering, Compute/Infrastructure Deployment, Facility Engineering, SDM, and local site Operations teams throughout the transition window.
  • Partner with Construction teams to track handover status, outstanding items, and site readiness milestones.
  • Track Network Engineering's buildout, testing, and cutover activities required for a site to go live.
  • Track hardware intake, rack-and-stack, and deployment scheduling with Compute/Infrastructure Deployment teams to stay aligned with the transition timeline.
  • Coordinate with Facility Engineering on site systems and infrastructure readiness ahead of transition.
  • Engage with the Service Delivery Management (SDM) team to ensure alignment with customer needs, SLAs, security, and facility performance.
  • Take part in regular cross-functional syncs and stakeholder reviews to stay current on transition status.
  • Contribute to a shared sense of ownership and accountability across stakeholder teams, even without formal authority over them.

Local Day Two Operations Readiness

  • Partner with local Operations leads to confirm staffing, training, tooling, and support processes are in place before a site transitions to Day 2 ownership.
  • Create and validate standard operating procedures (SOPs) and operational processes required for local Operations teams to run the site post-handover.
  • Create the operational site tool bill of materials (BOM) required for local Operations teams to maintain the site post-handover.
  • Verify the spare parts bill of materials (BOM) is complete and in place ahead of Day 2 handover.
  • Facilitate structured knowledge transfer and handover documentation from Construction, Network, and Compute teams to local Operations teams.
  • Confirm monitoring, ticketing, and ITSM processes are validated and operating before a site is handed to local Operations.
  • Act as an escalation point for local Operations teams during the early post-handover period to smooth the transition.

Reliability, Safety & Compliance

  • Define and enforce Day 2 readiness criteria that a site must meet before transitioning to local Operations ownership.
  • Facilitate root-cause analysis for transition delays or gaps surfaced during handover, and drive remediation across teams.
  • Ensure health, safety, and environmental requirements are validated and documented as part of readiness sign-off.
  • Support certification and audit readiness (ISO 27001, ISO 22237, SOC 2, Cyber Essentials Plus, ISO 22301) ahead of go-live.

Vendor & Supplier Coordination

  • Coordinate with construction contractors and colocation providers as needed to close out remaining items affecting the transition timeline.
  • Track vendor commitments and SLAs relevant to the transition window, and escalate delays that put go-live at risk.
  • Coordinate with the Supply Chain team to align hardware intake and staging with the transition schedule.

Monitoring, Reporting & Analytics

  • Track KPIs and KRIs for the Day 0 to Day 2 transition process (time to transition, readiness checklist completion rate, post-handover incident rate, etc.).
  • Build and maintain dashboards that track transition status across your assigned site pipeline for all stakeholder teams.
  • Produce regular reports for senior leadership on transition status, risks, and blockers.
  • Use data-driven insights to identify systemic bottlenecks in the Day 0 to Day 2 process and drive continuous improvement.

About You

Experience & Background

  • 3-8 years of experience in data centre operations, program/project management, or infrastructure deployment at scale.
  • Proven track record coordinating the transition of new sites into live operations across construction, network, compute, and operations functions.
  • Experience operating in a matrixed environment, influencing outcomes without direct authority over every stakeholder team.
  • Demonstrated success managing multiple concurrent site transitions in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Background in hyperscale, cloud, or HPC data centre environments (preferred).

Technical Knowledge & Expertise

  • Working knowledge of data centre power, cooling, networking, and compute infrastructure, sufficient to coordinate effectively across specialist teams.
  • Familiarity with network deployment and cutover processes, and compute/hardware deployment lifecycles.
  • Knowledge of Layer 1 network infrastructure, including fiber, copper, optics, and transceivers.
  • Familiarity with ITSM tooling, ticketing systems, and monitoring platforms used by local Operations teams.

Influence & Communication

  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence and align Construction, Network, Compute, and Operations teams without direct authority.
  • Excellent cross-functional communication skills, able to translate technical detail between teams with different priorities and vocabularies.
  • Program management discipline, with the ability to track and drive multiple concurrent workstreams to closure.
  • Comfortable operating in ambiguous, matrixed, fast-moving environments.
  • Bias toward ownership, pragmatism, and delivering results with urgency.

Operational Excellence

  • Rigorous tracking of readiness checklists, risk logs, and action items across many concurrent site transitions within your assigned region.
  • Proven ability to build and refine standardized transition frameworks that scale with business growth.
  • Strong attention to detail in transition documentation and handover packages.
  • Willingness to travel to sites during critical transition windows.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with program management tooling (e.g., Smartsheet, Asana, Jira, monday.com) for tracking multi-workstream transitions.
  • Familiarity with network cutover or compute/hardware deployment processes specifically.
  • Experience with ITSM platforms and ticketing workflows.
  • Experience with Palantir Foundry or similar data platforms for operational analytics.

At Nscale, we are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.  We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.
