title: Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Data Foundations team ⭐

At Alan, every decision we make about our members' care, contracts and claims is a data decision. The Data Foundations team builds the platform that makes those decisions possible in a safe way.

  • Being part of the Data Foundations team means you’ll build, maintain, and improve the Data Platform used by everyone at Alan.

  • We enable Alan’s data-driven nature and help our colleagues make the most of their data.

  • Partner closely with people across Alan (technical and non-technical) to understand their needs and build data solutions they can trust and use effectively.

  • We own and manage all data-related tools that power Alan.

  • AI is changing the way companies work with data: agents are becoming first-class users of our data warehouse. It opens a world of new usage and exciting features, as well as concerns around security, data quality and governance. We are building the foundations that allow Alan to make the most of this exciting new paradigm.

  • Alan is expanding quickly: we went from 4 to 6 countries this year and we won’t stop there. Our objective is to onboard new countries in weeks, not months. Having strong data foundations is a cornerstone of that expansion, allowing our teams to make sense of a patchwork of insurance systems, regulations and reporting rules.

  • Examples of our missions:

    • improve the developer experience when building and maintaining data pipelines,

    • enable reliable and secure access to our data warehouse for Alaners and AI agents,

    • strengthen security and governance around our data assets,

    • define and implement standard data practices across Alan,

    • maintain and evolve our core data infrastructure to accommodate Alan's international expansion and growing product breadth…

  • Our core tools include Python, Airflow, Snowflake, AWS/GCP, Metabase, Terraform, dbt, and others.

  • Who you'll work with: Data Foundations is a small, high-leverage team inside the Tech Foundations area, whose mission is to enable product crews through world-class infrastructure, developer experience, operational excellence, and built-in security. You'd be joining as one of its core engineers, working daily with the whole Data community at Alan.

🎯 Expected skills and abilities

You would thrive at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

  • Passionate about owning ambitious problems and developing simple solutions for them.

  • 4+ years of experience demonstrating impact in Data positions. We welcome candidates from early-career to highly experienced profiles. You may already have strong expertise in Data Engineering, or be an experienced data or software engineer looking to deepen your specialization in this area.

  • Experience building and operating production data infrastructure: orchestration (Airflow or similar), a cloud data warehouse, infrastructure as code.

  • Experience designing systems, tools or libraries used by other engineers, scientists or analysts.

  • Proficient in Python and SQL. Setting a high standard of rigor and precision for yourself, interested in your craft.

  • Curious about AI and eager to use it thoughtfully to increase your impact.

title: Data Engineering & Analytics Manager
descriptionHtml:
Insurance is a numbers business, and most of those numbers are harder to trust than they look. You would lead the team that defines the numbers Insify runs on, from the event a customer fires on our website to the report a risk carrier audits months later.


About the Role

You would lead our Data & Analytics team of 3-4 engineers end to end: ingestion, the warehouse and its models, the metric layer, and the analysis and reporting built on top of it. It is a small team with a big surface, so there is nowhere to hide and nothing you can't reach.

We are deliberately not splitting data engineering from analytics. At our size the hard problems sit in the handover between the two, and we want one person who enjoys that whole puzzle.

The team serves four groups with genuinely different needs. Growth wants hourly to daily signals and can live with approximately right. Carrier reporting and corporate finance are calendar-locked and need numbers that reconcile and survive an audit months later. Actuarial needs depth and lineage over speed. Prioritising here is arbitration between things that fail in different ways, and the arbitration is yours.

It's a hands-on role. You can open the warehouse and read the models, you review a new data model before it ships, and your team trusts your technical judgement because you still use it. The job is still the team: its own game, its communication, and each person in it. When something slips, hands-on work is the first thing that yields.


What you'll be doing
  • Leading a team of 3-4 data engineers and analysts end to end: what it builds, how it runs in production, and who you hire and grow to get there
  • Running discovery with the teams we serve: understanding what they need from data, and bringing the platform and datasets that enable them
  • Owning the trade-offs between Growth, carrier reporting, finance and actuarial: deciding what the team works on, driving alignment with key partners across other teams, and saying no when the answer is no
  • Making the platform scale: a new country, carrier or product should mean configuration and reused models, and recurring manual work, like carrier reporting and cash reconciliation, should turn into automation
  • Bringing engineering excellence to how the team works: data contracts with product teams, testing in CI, alerts that get resolved, a way to try changes before they hit production
  • Challenging our ideas and bringing your own. We encourage each other to act this way, so you can expect the same from others

    • What you'll need
  • You've managed or led a data team before, including hiring, feedback and growing people. It doesn't have to be for long, but it has to be real and you have to want more of it
  • Depth on one side of the data stack and working fluency on the other. You still love shipping, you review your team's work, and they trust your judgement on it
  • A track record of shaping what gets built, not only how: you've turned business problems into data priorities, cut scope, and can show the decisions that followed
  • Ownership & impact instinct - when needed you go beyond your team's boundaries to get to results
  • You get real leverage out of AI in your daily work, and you can say where it helped, and where it hurt. Your team gets that from you: you try new tools and ways of working first, and bring the ones that stick

    • Nice to have
  • Experience with reporting that has to reconcile: bordereaux, revenue, cash, ledger
  • Experience building B2B products, especially in insurance & fintech
  • Experience working on a product distributed across different country markets
  • Experience with Databricks, dbt and event tracking (Snowplow or similar)

    • Our stack

    Databricks with Unity Catalog, dbt with SQL-based transformation, running on AWS.

    None of this is a hard requirement, and you don't need to know all of our stack. We care more about how you reason about data, systems and teams than which tools you have used. Strong on most of it? Apply.


    How we hire
    Five conversations, each with a clear purpose, and you hear where you stand after every one:
    1. Leadership. We look at your experience with performance management, personal development and building teams.
    2. Data Model Review. You review a change to our warehouse models with two of our engineers.
    3. Data Platform Design. A modelling and platform problem close to what we deal with.
    4. Values Interview. We look at your approach to work, and how it adds to our Values.
    5. Meet the Founder.
    You get the outcome within three days of your last round, with specific feedback either way.
    We offer
  • Competitive compensation. We offer a salary in the range of 85k-110k EUR plus performance-based equity grants
  • Hybrid. 3 days in the office, 2 from home, up to 4 weeks a year from abroad, 25 holiday days
  • Pension. 6% employer contribution
  • Wellbeing budget. €50 net a month via Epassi, from the gym to takeaway, rolls over
  • Learning and coaching. Internal leadership programs and coaching
  • Central Amsterdam office. Shared lunches, dogs, Friday drinks, high-spec MacBook Pro

    • About Insify

    Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France and Germany, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

    We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

    Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.

À propos de Dastra

Dastra est une plateforme SaaS dédiée à la protection des données, à la compliance et à la gouvernance de l’IA.

Notre mission est claire : Faire de la protection des données une réalité opérationnelle, en plaçant la confiance au cœur des stratégies des entreprises.

Nous aidons les organisations à maîtriser leurs risques pour innover, en transformant des obligations réglementaires complexes (RGPD, IA) en processus simples, concrets et actionnables.

Le rôle

En tant que Data Migration Project Manager, tu pilotes les projets de migration des données clients vers Dastra, du cadrage jusqu'à la livraison.

À la croisée de la gestion de projet, de la data et du conseil client, ton rôle est majoritairement orienté pilotage et accompagnement client (environ 70 %), tout en étant suffisamment à l'aise avec la data et la technique pour comprendre, structurer et mapper les données.

Tes missions

Piloter tes projets de migration de A à Z

Notre outil interne automatise désormais une grande partie des transformations auparavant réalisées via des scripts spécifiques : nous ne cherchons donc pas un développeur, mais quelqu'un qui comprend suffisamment la technique pour prendre les bonnes décisions.

title: Data Science Lead
descriptionHtml:
Data Science Lead | Semiconductor Metrology
Abingdon, UK

Reward and Benefits

  • £70,000 - £85,000 (depending on experience)
  • Annual bonus, 3x salary death in service benefit and private health care BUPA, EMI Share scheme.

If you are a Data Science Lead who enjoys turning measurement data into proof of what is possible, why not join us in Abingdon, Oxfordshire, and build and lead the Data Science team behind advanced semiconductor metrology systems.

We are looking for an ambitious and adaptable Data Science Lead to set up a new Data Science team in our Technology department, reporting to the Technology Director. You will lead a small team, initially a Data Scientist and a Modelling Scientist, and stay hands-on as a working lead data scientist. You will explore and prove new analysis methods, from synthetic data and information-limit studies to modelling, machine learning and AI, to improve the performance of our Metron3D systems and draw more insight from our data.

You will work hand in hand with the Data Analysis team in Engineering: you prove what is possible, they make it robust and shippable. You will also collaborate with R&D, System Design Engineering and Applications Development. We are an AI-first team, and you will set the standard for using AI tools well and safely. If your passion is speed, evidence and finding out what the data can really tell you, we’d love to hear from you.

What you’ll be doing

  • Lead, develop and mentor the Data Science team while staying hands-on, setting priorities and keeping a fast, evidence-based working rhythm
  • Own and deliver the Data Science roadmap: synthetic data, modelling, information-limit studies, algorithm development and data analysis tools
  • Establish the information limit, meaning what is physically extractable given instrument noise, limitations and tip geometry, and use it as the benchmark for every new method
  • Explore, test and benchmark new algorithms (for example PCA, percentile methods and machine learning) on real and synthetic data, covering achievable performance, measurement uncertainty and gauge capability
  • Define the handover to Data Analysis in Engineering (prototype code, test data, acceptance criteria and expected performance), and manage the demo and performance data libraries with Applications Development
  • Use AI tools every day, set the team’s standards for using them well and safely, and track the state of the art in third-party and open-source methods

Education and experience

  • MSc or PhD in Physics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or a similar subject, or [8] years’ relevant experience in data science or quantitative research, including some team leadership

Skills and experience we’re looking for:

  • Experience leading or mentoring a team of data scientists, scientists or engineers
  • Hands-on data science in Python (NumPy, SciPy, pandas, scikit-learn or similar), turning exploratory work into quantified results
  • Heavy, day-to-day use of AI tools in your own technical work, such as coding assistants, LLMs and agentic workflows, with a critical eye for checking their outputs
  • Image processing, signal processing or statistical analysis of measurement data from scientific instruments
  • Statistical methods for measurement systems: uncertainty, repeatability, gauge R&R and drift
  • Machine learning and/or physics-based modelling, with the judgement to pick the right tool for the problem
  • Clear communication of results to technical and non-technical audiences, with evidence-based recommendations
  • Comfortable setting a roadmap and priorities, and knowing when a result is good enough to hand over

We’d love to see:

  • Atomic Force Microscopy or other nano-characterisation (SEM, FIB, profilometry), or semiconductor metrology and process control
  • Synthetic data generation or forward modelling of instruments
  • Building AI-assisted workflows or tooling for a team (agents, automated analysis pipelines, shared prompt libraries), and handing prototypes to software teams to productionise

A bit about us: 

Infinitesima is a privately owned company founded in 2001, as a spin-out of the University of Bristol, by CTO Professor Andrew Humphris. Our dynamic team of scientists and engineers is focussed on enabling the next generation of semiconductor devices through delivery of innovative products to customers around the world. 

Our strength lies in the varied perspectives that come from different cultures, experiences, and identities. We believe that true innovation is fuelled by collaboration, locally and globally. We strive to foster an environment where everyone can contribute meaningfully and thrive. If you require adjustments to take part in the recruitment process, please let us know, we’ll do our best to support you.

Your recruitment journey:

We will interview you: Monday to Friday UK Time 9am to 4.30pm and we'll be as flexible as we can with Global Scheduling

1st stage: (45 minute) Remote meeting to evaluate your experience and technical ability

2nd stage: (2.5 hours) Face to face onsite evaluating technical, presentation and communication skills along with your ways of working and your opportunity to to know more about us

If you're not comfortable with eye contact, let us know at the start of your interview and if REMOTE, once we've said hello, feel free to turn your camera off until the end.

We dress casually so informal attire is absolutely fine for onsite interviews. We want you to feel comfortable when you meet us and if there's anything else we can do to support your journey, just let us know. 

A note on how we use AI:
We use AI only to transcribe our interviews so we can focus fully on you instead of scribbling notes. The AI does not take part in any decision making at any stage. All hiring decisions are made by real humans based on the conversation we have with you.

Location and working pattern:
We recognise the value of flexibility and offer a hybrid working model wherever possible. Most employees work onsite three days per week, although some positions require a greater onsite presence due to the nature of the work and business need

Recruitment agencies: Infinitesima Ltd only works with approved agencies and does not accept unsolicited agency CVs. Please do not submit candidate details in response to this advert or solicit any Infinitesima Ltd employees. Infinitesima Ltd is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited CVs.

title: Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Wordsmith

Wordsmith is building the legal operating system for in-house teams, and we are growing fast.

We believe in-house legal is becoming one of the most important functions in the AI era. Every business is moving faster, but legal work is still too often scattered across inboxes, chats, documents and disconnected systems.

Wordsmith brings that work into one system. Requests come in from across the business, AI agents handle the routine, lawyers stay in control where judgement matters, and every step is captured as work happens.

We are built for in-house legal, not law firms. Our goal is to help legal teams move faster, reduce unnecessary external counsel spend and become a function the business can run with.

More than 500 companies, including Financial Times, Safelite, Trip.com, Canva, Starling and Sage, use Wordsmith. Backed by over $100M from Index Ventures, General Catalyst, Highland Europe and others, we are building one of the defining companies in legal AI.

The role

Deployment Engineers own the technical side of getting Wordsmith live inside a customer.

Once a deal is signed, you’ll connect Wordsmith to the systems our customers already run on. That means identity and SSO, Microsoft 365 and SharePoint, Google Workspace, Salesforce, document management, chat tools, and MCP connections to the wider AI and data stack. You’ll design how data and permissions flow between them, build and test the integrations, and work through each customer’s IT and security requirements until everything works in production.

It’s part integration engineering, part solutions architecture, and part customer-facing problem solving. You’ll be the technical lead on every deployment you own, the person customer IT teams talk to, and the person who works out how to make it work when an integration doesn’t behave as documented.

This is a technical, hands-on role. You don’t need to be a lawyer, and we’re not necessarily looking for one. We’re looking for engineers and technical consultants who understand identity, APIs and enterprise SaaS, and who enjoy making systems talk to each other. Your focus is the technical foundation the rest of the deployment runs on.

You’ll work side by side with our Legal Engineers on every deployment. While you connect Wordsmith to the customer’s systems, they configure the platform itself: workflows, agents, playbooks and automations built around how the legal team works. You’ll plan the deployment together, agree what each integration needs to support, and make sure the connections you build give their configuration the data, documents and permissions it depends on.

What you’ll do

1. Integrations

  • Own the integrations for each deployment, including SSO and SCIM, Microsoft 365, SharePoint and OneDrive, Google Workspace, Salesforce, document management and chat tools

  • Configure and connect Wordsmith to customers’ wider AI and data stack through MCP

  • Build, test and harden integrations so they hold up in production, not just in a demo

2. Identity, Security & Access

  • Set up identity and access, including SSO with Okta, Entra ID and Google, user provisioning, roles and permissions

  • Work through customers’ security reviews, IT questionnaires and data-handling requirements

  • Make sure permissions in Wordsmith respect the permissions in the systems it connects to

3. Technical Solution Design

  • Take the technical handover from Sales and confirm the customer’s systems landscape, constraints and integration scope

  • Design how data, documents and requests flow between Wordsmith and the customer’s tools

  • Advise customer IT on the right architecture for their environment and where the trade-offs sit

  • Work with Legal Engineers to agree what each integration needs to support the workflows, agents and playbooks they’re configuring

4. Technical Delivery & Escalation

  • Lead the technical workstream of each deployment, from environment setup and integration build through testing to go-live

  • Diagnose and fix integration issues, and act as the escalation point for technical problems during rollout

  • Know when a problem needs Engineering, and bring them a clear, reproducible case

5. Improve How We Integrate

  • Turn what you learn into reusable integration patterns, setup guides and technical runbooks

  • Feed connector gaps, API limitations and recurring requests back to Product and Engineering

What we’re looking for

  • Hands-on experience deploying and integrating enterprise SaaS in customer environments

  • Strong working knowledge of identity and access, including SSO (SAML, OIDC), SCIM provisioning, Okta, Entra ID or Google Workspace

  • Experience integrating with the Microsoft 365 and SharePoint, Google Workspace or Salesforce ecosystems

  • Comfortable with APIs, webhooks, authentication flows and reading technical documentation. You can script or write code where it helps

  • Familiarity with MCP or other ways of connecting AI systems to tools and data, or a strong appetite to learn

  • Credible with customer IT and security teams. You can answer their questions and stand behind your architecture

  • Methodical troubleshooter who isolates problems, reproduces them and fixes them

  • Clear communicator who can explain a technical decision to a non-technical stakeholder

Typical backgrounds include

  • Deployment, integration or implementation engineers in SaaS

  • Solutions engineers or solutions architects

  • Technical consultants with Microsoft 365, Google Workspace or Salesforce experience

  • IT or identity engineers who have moved into customer-facing roles

How we work

We’re an in-person team based in Edinburgh or London. You should expect to work from the office or visit customers as your default.

We set a high bar, move quickly and give people meaningful ownership. There will not always be an established playbook, so you’ll need to bring curiosity, structure and persistence to unfamiliar situations.

You’ll sit in the Transformation team, reporting to the VP of Transformation, and work closely with our Legal Engineers, alongside Legal Intelligence, Enablement, Customer Success, Support Engineering and Product.

Our customer teams have clear but closely connected responsibilities: Transformation leads implementation, Support Engineering resolves technical issues, Account Management owns renewals and commercial growth, Customer Success owns adoption, customer health and value realisation, and Enablement owns onboarding, training and customer capability.

Why Wordsmith

Wordsmith is growing quickly, winning new customers and expanding within larger organisations. Wordsmith is only as useful as the systems it connects to. Every new customer brings a different stack, and Deployment Engineers are the people who make Wordsmith work inside it.

You’ll work directly with ambitious in-house legal teams, see how dozens of legal functions really operate, and take that back into a product you help shape. You will work across enterprise identity, productivity and CRM platforms, and on MCP as it develops into a standard. You will own real technical outcomes from your first week and help define how we integrate as we scale.

title: Deployment Strategist - German Speaking
descriptionHtml:
About HappyRobot

HappyRobot is the infrastructure for enterprises to build and orchestrate AI workforces. Our AI workers don't just communicate through voice and email - they make decisions, take action, and run operations autonomously across entire enterprise systems. Born in Y Combinator (S23) and backed by a16z, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo with over $200M raised, we power critical operations for global enterprises worldwide.

Our platform is battle-tested in the most demanding environments, where AI has real consequences. We started in logistics, built our own voice stack, models, and orchestration layer from the ground up, and are now bringing that infrastructure to every enterprise that runs the real economy. Learn more about our vision in our manifesto.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Deployment Strategist to join our team. In this role, you'll partner with Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) across the full deployment lifecycle, from first discovery conversation to live production. You'll lead use case discovery and scoping with senior customer stakeholders, ship prototypes hands-on to prove value early, then stay close to the build through delivery to bring the strategic, business-value lens to every decision. You're the partner who keeps the work pointed at the highest-impact outcomes, ready to pick up the keyboard alongside the FDE when the moment calls for it.

We're looking for engineers with strategic instincts: people who can write code, but whose deepest strength is the strategic, opinionated lens they bring across every phase of a deployment - spotting where value lives, scoping it realistically, and partnering with engineers to capture it from prototype to production.

At HappyRobot, there's no role seniority or hierarchy. We operate as a team of builders. We execute, we build, we own, and we care deeply about our customers and their success.

What You'll do

  • Strategic Leadership and Use Case Discovery: Partner with Global and Regional C-Level executives and VPs to assess AI opportunities and prioritize the highest-impact use cases. Lead curiosity-driven discovery that surfaces the workflows where AI creates the most business value, well beyond what the customer thought to ask for. Build the trusted relationships that let you present findings and challenge assumptions at the most senior levels, keeping technical delivery aligned with their business priorities.

  • Scoping: Frame impact versus effort with rigor on both axes. On business value, pressure-test the realistic upside, question whether the use case as posed will actually deliver the most impact, and explore whether reframing it or pivoting to an adjacent process would unlock more. The art is deeply understanding how to maximize value of this use case for the customer, not just delivering what was asked for. On technical effort, map integrations, data, and platform constraints, and surface the edge cases and dependencies that shape timelines. Land on a plan that's realistic on both.

  • Prototyping: Build prototypes and demos hands-on. Use our platform and AI-powered coding tools to test ideas end-to-end at light scope. Prove value early, before the customer commits.

  • Program Management: Coordinate work across the active deployments in an account. Be the escalation point for the customer and the watchout partner for the FDE. Stay close enough to the build that you both understand the use case deeply, spot opportunities to capture more value, and catch when work is drifting from the highest-impact path.

  • Prioritization: Sequence use cases within an account so each deployment compounds the next. Make the call on what gets built when, what gets parked, and where to invest discovery and building time.

  • Customer Partnership: Be the main business-side point of contact for the account. Build trust with operational and executive stakeholders day-to-day. Translate AI capabilities into language they can act on.

  • Onsite Embedding: Travel onsite for kickoffs, mapping sessions, and key moments where being on the ground changes the outcome.

  • Product Feedback Loop: Bring field signal back to Product and Engineering. Identify reusable patterns, common edge cases, and where the platform needs to evolve.

Must Have

  • Background that mixes technical depth with strategic instinct, and a real history of building things. Common paths include engineering (Computer Science, electrical, industrial, systems), data science, founding a tech startup, product management, or technical / strategic consulting.

  • Comfortable coding -mostly Python- using LLMs and AI-powered tools like Claude Code to ship prototypes fast.

  • Working understanding of APIs, integrations, and how AI agents sit inside enterprise workflows.

  • Strategic instinct: ability to spot the business value behind a workflow and translate it into impact, effort, and prioritization terms a C-level can act on.

  • Excellent communication skills with both executives and operators. Comfortable translating between business and technical without losing either side.

  • Proven ability to prioritize ruthlessly across multiple workstreams and drive outcomes, not just activity.

  • Founder mindset: highly independent, takes ownership, and thrives in a fast-paced environment.

Why join us?

  • Join a world-class team of engineers and builders.

  • Backed by top investors including a16z, Y Combinator, Base10, Prysm Capital and Eurazeo.

  • Have ownership and autonomy of projects and are encouraged to ship.

  • Comprehensive Benefits including healthcare, dental, vision coverage.

  • Competitive salary + equity in a high-growth startup.

Our Operating Principles

Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our work, outcomes, and team success. No excuses, no blame-shifting — if something needs fixing, we own it and make it better. This means stepping up, even when it’s not “your job.” If a ball is dropped, we pick it up. If a customer is unhappy, we fix it. If a process is broken, we redesign it. We don’t wait for someone else to solve it — we lead with accountability and expect the same from those around us.

Craftsmanship

Putting care and intention into every task, striving for excellence, and taking deep ownership of the quality and outcome of your work. Craftsmanship means never settling for “just fine.” We sweat the details because details compound. Whether it’s a product feature, an internal doc, or a sales call — we treat it as a reflection of our standards. We aim to deliver jaw-dropping customer experiences by being curious, meticulous, and proud of what we build — even when nobody’s watching.

We are “majos”
Be friendly & have fun with your coworkers. Always be genuine & honest, but kind. “Majo” is our way of saying: be a good human. Be approachable, helpful, and warm. We’re building something ambitious, and it’s easier (and more fun) when we enjoy the ride together. We give feedback with kindness, challenge each other with respect, and celebrate wins together without ego.

Urgency with Focus
Create the highest impact in the shortest amount of time. Move fast, but in the right direction. We operate with speed because time is our most limited resource. But speed without focus is chaos. We prioritize ruthlessly, act decisively, and stay aligned. We aim for high leverage: the biggest results from the simplest, smartest actions. We’re running a high-speed marathon — not a sprint with no strategy.

Talent Density and Meritocracy
Hire only people who can raise the average; ‘exceptional performance is the passing grade.’ Ability trumps seniority. We believe the best teams are built on talent density — every hire should raise the bar. We reward contribution, not titles or tenure. We give ownership to those who earn it, and we all hold each other to a high standard. A-players want to work with other A-players — that’s how we win.

First-Principles Thinking
Strip a problem to physics-level facts, ignore industry dogma, rebuild the solution from scratch. We don’t copy-paste solutions. We go back to basics, ask why things are the way they are, and rebuild from the ground up if needed. This mindset pushes us to innovate, challenge stale assumptions, and move faster than incumbents. It’s how we build what others think is impossible.

title: Deployment Strategist
descriptionHtml:
About Fleetcraft

We're building the critical infrastructure for the next generation of aircraft.

Aerospace demand is surging. OEMs have decade-long backlogs, new manufacturers are racing to market, and the industry is hundreds of thousands of technicians short.

The world needs more aerospace capacity, but the systems used to maintain and manufacture aircraft are slow, manual, and barely changed in decades. Fleetcraft is the full system to operate and manage aircraft maintenance. Our agents already work alongside technicians and controllers in 10+ maintenance organisations across 4 continents. They capture the repair as it happens and turn expertise into intelligence the whole operation can use.

Our seed was led by Susa Ventures, alongside Liquid 2 VC, early backers of Anduril and Stoke Space. You'll work with a team that has helped launch airlines and put satellites into orbit, and with an aviation advisory board whose members have run major aircraft OEMs, led airworthiness at Gulfstream, and overseen training facilities that educate a quarter of all aircraft mechanics in the US.

The role

As a Deployment Strategist, you’ll own customer implementation end-to-end.

You’ll translate complex operational requirements into AI-solutions, work hands-on with customers to drive adoption, and turn what you learn in the field into sales and engineering priorities.

This is a highly hands-on, high-ownership role. You’ll spend time in our office with the team, but also on-site with customers in hangars, maintenance facilities, and manufacturing environments, around the world. You’ll work directly with technicians, operators, managers, and executives to understand their workflows, deploy Fleetcraft into live environments, and make sure the product becomes mission-critical.

What we're looking for

We’re looking for someone with exceptional learning velocity, commercial instinct, and technical competence. You should be pragmatic, intentional, and very structured. Aerospace experience is not required - the ability to learn quickly, adapt, and handle complex implementations with high emotional intelligence.

You should be technically fluent enough to understand AI and software systems and commercially curious enough to understand what drives customer value.

  • 2+ years in consulting, technical implementation, solutions engineering, or customer-facing roles in enterprise B2B.

  • AI-native: You already use AI extensively in your work, experiment constantly, and instinctively find ways to move faster with it.

  • Technically fluent: You can hold your own with engineers and translate customer needs into actionable engineering requirements.

  • High emotional intelligence: Equally comfortable earning the trust of CEOs, IT directors, senior engineers, aircraft technicians, and pilots.

  • Structured and resourceful: Able to manage multiple deployments, solve complex problems, and bring clarity to ambiguous situations.

  • Bias to action: You take ownership, learn quickly, and prioritise getting things done over perfect plans.

What we offer

£75k–£110k salary plus meaningful early-stage equity.

A small, high-trust team where your decisions move the whole company forward. Relocation support if needed. Modern tools, real-world impact in a regulated industry, and the chance to define how AI transforms aerospace from the ground up.

If you're energised by building production AI systems that solve hard, real-world problems - and you want the ownership and pace that only comes from being early at something important, we'd love to talk.

Interview process

  1. Initial screening interview with a co-founder (30 min)

  2. Technical interview (45 min)

  3. Take home project

  4. In-person meeting (1 hr)

After the in-person meeting we check references and then make an offer.

We're unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role.
Fleetcraft is an equal opportunities employer.

Are you ready to be part of the future?

About the job:

We are seeking a highly skilled DevOps Specialist to architect, implement, and maintain end-to-end CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, with a strong focus on test-driven deployment, automated release management, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices.

The ideal candidate will containerize services using Docker, manage build, compilation, and publishing workflows for JavaScript, TypeScript, and C++ packages, and design robust multi-language build pipelines leveraging CMake or similar build tools.

The role also includes automating build, tagging, and publication processes across web, desktop, and mobile platforms to ensure consistent and traceable releases. Deep expertise in Linux system administration, networking, and IaC tools is essential to deliver

scalable, secure, and highly available deployments.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, architecture, and management of CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions (and similar tools), ensuring fast, reliable, and reproducible software delivery.

  • Implement and enforce test-driven deployment systems, integrating automated testing, validation, and monitoring to maintain code quality and accelerate feedback cycles.

  • Containerize applications and microservices with Docker, optimize image builds, and manage deployment pipelines for distributed environments.

  • Oversee the build, packaging, and publishing lifecycle for JavaScript, TypeScript, and C++ packages, including versioning, semantic tagging, and NPM or internal registry publication.

  • Develop and maintain cross-platform build pipelines using CMake or equivalent tools, ensuring consistent compilation and release workflows across web, desktop, and mobile.

  • Automate end-to-end release processes, including tagging, building, signing, and distributing mobile, web, and desktop applications.

  • Define and manage Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to provision and maintain reliable, scalable, and secure infrastructure environments.

  • Collaborate closely with development, QA, and operations teams to troubleshoot deployment issues, optimize performance, and improve release reliability.

  • Continuously improve observability and feedback loops, leveraging monitoring and alerting systems to maintain operational excellence.


Mandatory:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience architecting and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or equivalent tools at scale in a production environment.

  • Strong proficiency in test-driven deployment methodologies, including writing and maintaining automated test suites for integration and end-to-end validation.

  • Expertise in containerization technologies such as Docker, including image creation, registry management, and basic orchestration patterns.

  • Experience managing package lifecycles for JavaScript and TypeScript, including versioning, compilation, semantic tagging, and publishing workflows to NPM.

  • In-depth knowledge of C++ build systems, specifically CMake, with proven experience optimizing native build and deployment pipelines.

  • Advanced Linux system administration and networking skills, including shell scripting, package management, performance troubleshooting, firewalls, and VPN configuration.

  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in globally distributed teams.

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, Ansible, AWS CDK or AWS CloudFormation.

  • Experience with mobile CI/CD automation, including build, tagging, and publication for iOS and Android applications

  • Advanced knowledge of release management practices, including automated versioning, signing, and artifact distribution.

Preferred:

  • Exposure to observability and monitoring systems, leveraging tools like Prometheus, Grafana, or ELK for deployment health tracking.

  • Experience working in high-availability, security-sensitive environments, especially in fintech, blockchain, or distributed systems contexts.

  • Experience deploying and managing blockchain-based applications.

  • Exposure to AI/ML pipelines, including automated model training, evaluation, and deployment using frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page: https://tether.recruitee.com/

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @tether.to or @tether.io

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

title: DevOps Engineer  - CDI Paris - Theodo Cloud
descriptionHtml:
L’histoire du groupe Theodo et son succès Theodo accompagne depuis 2009 les entreprises innovantes dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de produits digitaux ingénieux - tels que la plateforme TF1+, l'application LCL Pro ou l'application France Identité Numérique - en tirant parti du meilleur de la technologie et de l’approche Lean. Theodo connait une croissance exceptionnelle depuis 15 ans : nos équipes rassemblent plus de 750 Theodoers, principalement des Software Engineers, passionnés de technologie et d’amélioration continue. En 2025, le groupe Theodo génère 100M€ de CA. Theodo Cloud est la practice DevSecOps de Theodo, spécialisée dans la construction d’infrastructures et la cybersécurité cloud. Notre mission : aider les scale-ups et grands comptes à résoudre leurs problématiques business grâce à la tech. Nos équipes construisent des infrastructures scalables, résilientes et sécurisées pour les développeurs et les utilisateurs finaux. L’objectif : faire de l’infrastructure un levier de croissance plutôt qu’un frein. Pionniers de la conteneurisation, nous plaçons aujourd'hui l'innovation au cœur de notre approche Cloud. Nous concevons des offres qui adressent les enjeux les plus actuels du secteur :
  • Accélérer les migrations et modernisations Cloud grâce à l'IA pour créer de la valeur au plus vite.
  • Construire et infogérer des environnements d'industries régulées (ex : HDS pour la santé, SecNumCloud) sans sacrifier le time to market.
  • ⁠Exploiter tout le potentiel des LLMs tout en optimisant la performance cloud, les coûts et la sûreté industrielle.

Ton équipe : L’équipe technique de Theodo Cloud est constituée de deux pôles : - le pôle Build, dédié à nos projets de création, migration et optimisation d’infrastructures - le pôle Run, dédié à l’infogérance des infrastructures de nos clients Au build, tu travailles main dans la main avec un ou une Lead DevOps et un ou une Agile Project Manager pour garantir l’impact de tes actions chez nos clients. Au run, tu rejoins une équipe d’une quinzaine de personnes avec laquelle tu gères un portefeuille de clients. L’équipe run dispose également d’un volet build, dédié à l’amélioration continue des plateformes de nos clients. Nous déterminerons ensemble à l’issue de l’entretien RH le pôle sur lequel nous pouvons te positionner. Tes futures missions : En tant que DevOps Engineer, tu travailles sur des infrastructures cloud en suivant les bonnes pratiques techniques et les standards définis par l’équipe. Au run les missions consistent à : - Réagir aux incidents en production et mener des investigations techniques approfondies - Réaliser les post-mortem et assurer une communication claire et structurée avec les clients - Répondre aux interrogations des clients et formuler des recommandations actionnables pour améliorer la qualité, la fiabilité, la sécurité et la performance de leur infrastructure - Concevoir et découper techniquement des fonctionnalités adaptées aux contraintes projet (qualité, coût, délais) Au build tu apprendras à comprendre et répondre aux besoins d’un client sur sa stratégie d’infrastructure : - montage d’infrastructure from scratch - migrations Cloud et Kubernetes - mise en place de pipelines de CI/CD - mise en place d’outils de monitoring et d’alerting - apport des bonnes pratiques DevOps chez nos clients - participation active aux rituels agiles (Scrum) de l’équipe projet La réalisation d’astreintes est également possible, elle se fait sur la base du volontariat. Ce poste de DevOps Engineer est fait pour les personnes curieuses qui veulent monter en compétences rapidement, au contact d’un large panel d’infrastructures et d’outils (AWS, GCP, Azure, Scaleway, Outscale, OVH, …) et de bugs complexes en production. Theodo Cloud est encore une jeune entreprise où il y a de la place pour construire des choses. En parallèle de ton projet, tu auras du temps dédié pour t’investir sur des sujets qui te tiennent à cœur : la formation des équipes business, la diversité, ou le recrutement technique… Tes perspectives d’évolution : La première étape d’évolution chez Theodo Cloud est de devenir Lead, et de devenir ainsi garant de la stratégie technique et de la montée en compétences de ton équipe. Nous proposons ensuite deux tracks d’évolution possibles : - une track Management, qui t’emmènera vers un rôle d’Engineering Manager - une track Expertise, qui te permettra d’accéder à un rôle de Staff Engineer Une méthodologie basée sur l’apprentissage continu : Chez Theodo, nous avons construit notre approche tech autour d’une conviction forte : on développe d’abord les personnes, avant de développer les produits. Notre Lean Tech® System met l’accent sur l’apprentissage continu : tu évolueras dans un environnement qui investit sur le long terme, où l’objectif est de te permettre de progresser chaque jour, tout en construisant des produits utiles et performants pour nos clients. Profil recherché : - Tu disposes d’une solide formation en école d’ingénieur, avec une première expérience en infrastructures Cloud (Kubernetes, Docker, AWS, GCP...) - Tu fais preuve de rigueur, d’une bonne gestion du stress, et sais intervenir efficacement sur des environnements de production - Tu as l’envie de progresser rapidement et de travailler en équipe Tu ne coches pas 100% des critères mais tu penses tout de même correspondre à notre recherche ? Ne t’auto-censure pas et envoie-nous ta candidature, on se fera un plaisir de l’étudier ! Pour information : - Le poste est proposé en CDI, basé depuis nos locaux à Paris. - Le salaire proposé dépend du niveau d’expérience de chacun : nous en parlons toujours dès le premier appel téléphonique. title: Digital Guest Service / Customer Support Supervisor (all genders) Hospitality in Berlin
descriptionHtml:
We're building the future of urban stays. One city at a time.

Homaris widmet sich einer der drängendsten Herausforderungen moderner Städte: Menschen aus aller Welt brauchen Orte, an denen sie leben, arbeiten und sich zuhause fühlen können. Wir entwickeln und betreiben vollständig digitalisierte Serviced Apartments in den großen Städten Deutschlands. Unser nächster Schritt: Europa und darüber hinaus.

Mit dem nanopartment® verfolgen wir eine Produktvision, die modernes Wohnen auf Zeit neu denkt – auf kleinstmöglichem Raum.

Unser Umsatz verdreifacht sich innerhalb von zwei Jahren – organisch und aus eigener Kraft. Ohne Venture Capital. Ohne Exit-Strategie. Wir denken langfristig und bauen unser Unternehmen konsequent danach auf.

Außergewöhnliche Menschen machen diese Entwicklung möglich. Jetzt suchen wir eine weitere Person, die diesen Weg mit uns gestaltet.

Your Role

Du führst die operativen Fäden unserer digitalen Gästebetreuung. Aus dem Headoffice in Berlin arbeitest du mit dem Guest Service Supervisor Team und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere weltweiten Guest Service Agents. Du sorgst dafür, dass Gäste eine verlässliche Betreuung erleben, und hältst den Rücken frei für Teams, die täglich mit ihnen sprechen. Am Steuer unserer digitalen Rezeption schaffst du im Hintergrund den reibungslosen Ablauf jedes Aufenthalts.

What You'll Do

Betrieb. Du unterstützt das Guest Service Team im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Apartments aus dem Hintergrund reibungslos laufen.

Qualität. Du entwickelst neue Qualitätskonzepte, kontrollierst die Einhaltung unserer Standards in der Gästekommunikation und schulst die Agents fortlaufend.

Kommunikation. Du entwirfst Nachrichtenvorlagen, mit denen Gäste verlässlich, persönlich und im richtigen Ton erreicht werden.

Second Level. Du bist die Ansprechperson für Agents, wenn es komplex wird, und übernimmst die Lösung, wenn es darauf ankommt.

Onboarding. Du begleitest die Einarbeitung neuer Kolleg:innen und die Weiterbildung bestehender Teammitglieder.

Vertretung. Du vertrittst die Teamlead Guest Service bei Abwesenheit und behältst dann das gesamte Team im Blick.

Schnittstelle. Du stimmst dich eng mit internen Abteilungen und externen Dienstleistern ab, als verlässlicher Partner, der Lösungen zu Ende denkt.

What Makes You a Fit

Service mit Haltung. Du hast einen starken Dienstleistungsgedanken und dich stört es nicht, zu unterschiedlichen Tageszeiten sowie in geregelten Abständen am Wochenende im Dienst zu sein.

Erfahrung. Du bringst Berufserfahrung als Reservierungsmitarbeiter:in, Reservation Agent oder Manager:in, Call Center Agent, Rezeptionist:in oder aus einer anderen serviceorientierten Branche mit.

Organisation. Du organisierst und koordinierst souverän und denkst lösungsorientiert.

Kommunikationsstärke. Du findest schnell Zugang zu unterschiedlichen Persönlichkeiten und vermittelst Standpunkte, Ideen und Lösungen klar.

Digitale Werkzeuge. Du kommst mit Software und digitalen Lösungen im Alltag mühelos zurecht. Erfahrung mit Buchungsplattformen sowie den Property-Management-Systemen Apaleo oder Guesty ist ein Plus.

Sprachen. Du beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch fließend in Wort und Schrift (jeweils C1).

Digitale Neugier. Du erkennst Potenziale in neuen Tools und bist begeistert davon, wie KI deinen Arbeitsalltag effizienter macht.

The Environment

Homaris ist konsequent langfristig ausgerichtet. Wir investieren nicht in kurzfristiges Wachstum mit dem Ziel, schnell zu verkaufen. Wir bauen etwas Nachhaltiges und Substanzielles auf – und suchen Menschen, die diesen Weg gemeinsam mit uns gehen und langfristig Verantwortung übernehmen wollen.

Das Tempo ist hoch. Die Herausforderungen sind anspruchsvoll und unmittelbar. Unser Team ist bewusst klein gehalten, sodass jede Person einen spürbaren Beitrag leistet.

Wir nehmen uns nicht immer ausreichend Zeit, unsere Erfolge sichtbar zu machen und gemeinsam zu feiern. Daran arbeiten wir – und freuen uns, wenn du uns dabei unterstützt.

What We Offer

Wir definieren unsere Level nicht anhand von Jobtiteln oder Berufsjahren, sondern danach, welche Themen du eigenständig verantwortest und für welche Entscheidungen du einstehst.

Darüber hinaus haben wir uns intensiv damit auseinandergesetzt, was Menschen brauchen, um ihre beste Arbeit zu leisten und gleichzeitig gut zu leben. Daraus ist ein Leistungspaket entstanden, das genau das widerspiegelt: Gesundheit, Mobilität, persönliche Entwicklung, Flexibilität und einige besondere Vorteile, die das Arbeiten in der Reise- und Hospitality-Branche mit sich bringt. Vieles ist bereits dabei.

Die Details stellen wir dir gerne im persönlichen Gespräch vor.

Next Steps

Wenn dich diese Position anspricht, freuen wir uns darauf, mehr über deine Erfahrungen und deine Perspektive zu erfahren.

Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf.

Du hast Fragen? Melde dich gerne bei Natalie unter oder +49 157 92465807.

Wir schätzen Vielfalt und begrüßen Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Geschlechter, Kulturen und Hintergründe.

And the best part? We’re only just getting started. Omaze is building a business and culture committed to growth and creating significant social impact on a global scale.

🔑 About The Job

We’re looking for an experienced, hands-on accounting and finance leader to provide maternity cover of 14 months during a period of continued business development and finance transformation.

This is a broad role combining financial reporting, month-end delivery, cash and debt-facility reporting, corporate governance support and finance-systems ownership. You’ll work closely with the CFO, Finance and Accounting colleagues, business leaders and external advisers to maintain reliable reporting, effective controls and continuity across key workstreams.

You’ll be equally comfortable reviewing accounting entries, explaining budget variances, coordinating an audit and resolving a NetSuite reporting or access issue. Success will mean keeping essential processes running smoothly while progressing agreed improvements and making risks, decisions and dependencies visible.

🥇 What success looks like

  • Month-end close, consolidated reporting and board-reporting inputs are delivered accurately and on time.

  • Lender reporting and compliance requirements are met, with clear oversight of deadlines and dependencies.

  • Budget holders receive useful analysis and timely support.

  • Audit and adviser workstreams progress with clear ownership and well-organised evidence.

  • Finance systems remain reliable, and agreed implementation and reporting improvements continue.

  • Responsibilities, decisions and outstanding matters are documented to support a smooth handover back.

🔧 What You’ll Be Doing

Audit, governance, tax and technical accounting

  • Coordinate audit delivery, acting as a central contact for auditors and internal stakeholders and tracking evidence requests, issues and deadlines.

  • Draft consolidated and entity level financial statements along with relevant footnote disclosures under IFRS and US GAAP.

  • Initiate implementation of IFRA 18 and ASU 2024-03.

  • Support corporate governance processes and associated financial documentation and reporting.

  • Support the CFO with Senior Accounting Officer (SAO) and Corporate Criminal Offence (CCO) workstreams, including documentation, information gathering and follow-through on agreed actions.

  • Coordinate accounting advisory workstreams, ensuring clear briefs, ownership, timely responses and resolution of outstanding matters.

  • Ad hoc technical accounting assessments, documenting agreed conclusions and supporting implementation.

Financial accounting, close and consolidated reporting

  • Deliver assigned month-end close activities, including intercompany eliminations, and coordinate with entity accounting teams.

  • Review assigned journals, reconciliations and intercompany activity, resolving issues with the relevant preparers and reviewers.

  • Maintain close timetables, support the resolution of blockers and ensure appropriate documentation and review evidence.

  • Support the preparation and validation of financial actuals and analysis for board reporting.

Equity administration and insurance

  • Administer Carta, including reporting, supporting bookkeeping, maintaining records and coordinating approved changes with relevant stakeholders.

  • Coordinate corporate, office and other insurance matters, working with brokers, Legal and business owners on renewals, coverage questions, policy changes and emerging requirements.

  • Maintain clear records of outstanding actions, approvals and responsibilities across both workstreams.

Finance systems and reporting

  • Act as the day-to-day Netsuite administrator, covering month-end requirements, ongoing maintenance, user access, configuration and issue resolution.

  • Facilitate work with external Netsuite support partners, prioritising requests and coordinating delivery, testing and implementation.

  • Develop and maintain Netsuite reporting for Finance, including reports and saved searches that improve visibility and reduce manual work.

  • Administer and maintain Netsuite Account Reconciliation system, including period roll-forwards, assignments and troubleshooting.

Cash, treasury and loan facility reporting

  • Coordinate monthly, quarterly, and annual reporting, certificates, utilisation requests and other required submissions, including event-triggered reporting.

  • Strong hands-on NetSuite experience, including administration, reporting and working with external support partners.

Desirable experience

title: Director, EMEA Field Marketing
descriptionHtml:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.   We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.

What You'll Do:

The Global Field Marketing Organization drives market penetration, customer engagement, and pipeline generation across key regions in the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. The team owns regional go-to-market strategy and execution — high-touch account-based marketing, field programs, third-party conferences, executive engagement, and partner-led motions — and works cross-functionally with Sales, Product Marketing, Events, Brand, and Demand to drive customer acquisition and expansion across enterprise and AI-native accounts.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Director of EMEA Field Marketing to own the customer engagement and pipeline-generation strategy and execution across EMEA, and to establish CoreWeave as a recognized and trusted brand in the region.

This role will lead and grow a team of regional marketing managers, and partner closely with sales leadership to align marketing investments and resourcing around the GEO go-to-market strategy supporting customer acquisition and customer expansion across enterprise and AI-natives. As leader of Field Marketing for EMEA, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing our regional marketing strategy across high-touch account-based marketing, 3rd party conferences, field programs, executive engagement, and partner-led motions.

This role will own how CoreWeave shows up in the region — building awareness and credibility with European AI-native builders and enterprise buyers, and adapting the global brand narrative for a market with distinct data sovereignty, regulatory, language, and cultural requirements. Your leadership will drive the expansion of CoreWeave's presence and reputation in the dynamic and rapidly evolving EMEA AI-Cloud market.

Success is measured by pipeline created and progressed, conversion rates across the funnel, deal velocity in priority accounts, and growth in regional brand awareness and consideration among target accounts.

In this role, you will:

Regional Strategy & Pipeline Ownership

  • Own the EMEA customer engagement and pipeline-generation strategy end to end, carrying accountability for sourced and influenced pipeline targets by segment, country, and priority account.
  • Align marketing investment and team resourcing to the GEO go-to-market strategy, ensuring the regional plan reflects where Sales is prioritizing acquisition and expansion across enterprise and AI-native accounts.
  • Balance investment between near-term pipeline generation and the brand and category-building work required to make CoreWeave a known quantity in EMEA, and be able to articulate the tradeoff.
  • Set the channel mix across ABM, field programs, third-party conferences, executive engagement, and partner-led motions based on ROI analysis and attribution data.
  • Build distinct motions for acquisition and expansion: net-new account penetration and category presence on one side, deeper multi-workload engagement within existing customers on the other.
  • Prioritize across a multi-country region — sequencing investment across core markets and emerging ones rather than spreading coverage thin.
  • Manage a multi-million dollar regional budget with explicit ROI rationale, and defend allocation and resourcing decisions to marketing and sales leadership.

Brand Presence & Market Development in EMEA

  • Own CoreWeave's overall brand presence in EMEA — partnering with the Brand, Communications, and Product Marketing teams to build awareness, credibility, and consideration in a market where CoreWeave is still establishing itself.
  • Adapt the global brand narrative for regional realities: data sovereignty and residency, EU regulatory context, local infrastructure footprint, language and cultural nuance — without fragmenting the global story.
  • Land regional proof points — customer stories, local infrastructure milestones, partner wins — and make them visible in-market.

Sales Partnership & Account-Based Marketing

  • Serve as the senior marketing partner to EMEA sales leadership — in pipeline reviews, account planning, and forecast discussions — translating GEO priorities into funded, resourced programs.
  • Direct high-touch ABM against CoreWeave's priority AI-native and enterprise accounts, partnering with Sales to define coverage, nomination criteria, and progression goals at the account and contact level.
  • Drive disciplined lead and opportunity handoff with Sales and SDR, with agreed SLAs, shared quality definitions, and acceleration plays for stalled or late-stage deals.
  • Build expansion programs alongside Sales and Customer teams that deepen engagement in existing accounts and surface new workloads, teams, and buying centers.

Market Presence & Executive Engagement

  • Expand CoreWeave's presence across the EMEA AI-Cloud market, selecting the third-party conferences, field programs, and technical and developer-led moments where CoreWeave should show up — and holding each to a pipeline and brand thesis.
  • Partner with the Executive Marketing team to connect regional CXO and VP engagement to opportunity progression in named accounts.
  • Work with Partner Marketing to activate partner-led motions in-region — including the regional systems integrators, resellers, and cloud and ecosystem partners that carry disproportionate weight in EMEA — turning joint narratives into named-account plays and co-sell pipeline.
  • Provide clear regional input into global campaigns and launches so they land effectively with EMEA audiences and buyer personas, and flag where regional adaptation is required.
  • Partner with Developer Marketing to grow developer advocacy and engagement with in EMEA communities 

Data-Driven Optimization & Scalable Systems

  • Manage the KPIs that matter — account and contact coverage, engagement, meetings, sourced and influenced pipeline, conversion rates and stage progression — in Salesforce and the marketing automation and ABM stack.
  • Establish testing and optimization frameworks across messaging, audience, channel, and offer: hypothesis, test, measure, then scale or retire.
  • Build the repeatable systems that make regional growth predictable — program briefs and business cases, target account and contact selection, program templates, and playbooks any country team can run.
  • Partner with Marketing Operations and Revenue Operations on attribution, lead scoring, and reporting so regional investment ties cleanly to revenue outcomes, and deliver post-program reporting that drives explicit go/no-go decisions.
  • Work within EMEA data privacy and consent requirements (GDPR and local equivalents), partnering with Legal and Marketing Ops to keep regional data practices compliant.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of regional marketing managers, hiring to plan as the EMEA team scales.
  • Build a team of pipeline-focused field marketers who understand the full customer journey, the sales process, and their own revenue impact.
  • Set clear ownership boundaries and escalation paths so the team coordinates with Events, Brand, Partner Marketing, and Demand Gen rather than absorbing their scope.
  • Represent EMEA performance and plans in global marketing forums, and partner with Americas and APAC counterparts on global initiatives.

Who You Are:

  • Experienced regional marketing leader: 10+ years in B2B marketing at high-growth technology or enterprise companies, with direct pipeline accountability across field marketing, demand generation, or ABM supporting EMEA.
  • People leader: 4+ years leading regional or field marketing teams with pipeline accountability, including hiring and developing marketers across a distributed, multi-country geography.
  • Brand builder in-region: Track record establishing or scaling a brand in EMEA for a company earlier in its regional journey — building awareness and credibility from a low base, and adapting a global narrative to local market realities.
  • EMEA market fluency: Deep understanding of the region's diversity — buying behavior, language and cultural differences, data sovereignty and regulatory considerations, and the partner and ecosystem landscape across core and emerging markets.
  • Sales-aligned operator: Proven experience partnering directly with executive sales leadership to shape GEO go-to-market plans, and allocating marketing investment and headcount against territory and account priorities.
  • Account- and deal-centric: Strong grasp of complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise personas and how ABM, executive engagement, and field programs influence acquisition, expansion, and close rates.
  • Data and analytics depth: Advanced proficiency with pipeline attribution, conversion analysis, and ROI optimization using Salesforce, Tableau and ABM platforms, and BI tooling.
  • Program range: Demonstrated ability to build across the full regional mix — ABM, third-party conferences, field programs, executive experiences, brand and community moments, and partner co-marketing — with clear evidence of impact from each.
  • AI-curious: Genuinely interested in AI infrastructure and how AI-native and enterprise customers build and scale workloads, with the ability to ramp quickly on CoreWeave's platform and market to CTOs, CIOs, VPs of Engineering, and AI/ML leadership.
  • Willingness to travel across the region as programs require.

The starting salary will be determined by job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the market location. We strive for both market alignment and internal equity when determining compensation. In addition to base salary, our total rewards package includes a discretionary bonus, equity awards, and a comprehensive benefits program (all based on eligibility).

descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

As Director of Engineering Operations, you will build structured, repeatable operating capability across Mechanical, Electrical and Controls. You will own engineering planning and capacity reporting, configuration and release administration, supplier engineering readiness, and end-to-end engineering and supplier quality. This is a functional leadership role: you will set the processes that engineering must follow, while authorised engineers keep design approval, Systems Engineering keeps requirements governance, and Commercial Procurement keeps contracts.

What You'll Do

  • Own engineering planning, workload and capacity reporting so that commitments reflect real capacity.

  • Lead configuration and release administration, including Inventor licensing, Autodesk Vault and Jama administration, as a controlled and auditable capability.

  • Define and drive the planning, configuration, release and quality processes that Mechanical, Electrical and Controls are required to follow.

  • Ensure suppliers receive controlled, revision-correct technical information through readiness coordination with the Supply Chain Engineer.

  • Build a functioning supplier-quality and nonconformance process, and stand up the Engineering Quality Lead and Supplier Quality Engineer capability as it is approved.

  • Partner with Systems Engineering, the Systems Integration team, Commercial Procurement and the PMO to keep cross-functional handoffs clean and to give Integration trustworthy readiness evidence.

Who You Are

Nice-to-Haves
