title: Field CTO, UK
descriptionHtml:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The role

The Field CTO role is one of Mistral's senior external technical voices; a role for someone who has earned genuine credibility in the AI field and can engage enterprise boards, CIOs, and CTOs as a peer. You will shape how strategic accounts think about their AI strategy, represent Mistral at major industry events, and publish thought leadership that reflects a real point of view on where AI is going.

You will work closely with regional sales leadership across your territory and bring what you learn from executive conversations back into Mistral's product direction. This is an externally-facing, influence-driven role. The output is measured in relationships built, content published, and executive conversations that move.

 

What You Will Do

Executive engagement

Run Mistral's Executive Briefing Center with your regional VP; a selective program for C-level stakeholders at strategic accounts. Build and sustain trusted-advisor relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, and VP Engineering across your territory.

Thought leadership

Publish regularly: articles, whitepapers, and analysis of where enterprise AI is heading. Brief Gartner and Forrester on Mistral's roadmap and market position. Track frontier research and bring it into customer conversations.

Conference and event presence

Represent Mistral at major industry events through keynotes, panels, and roundtables. Build a public presence that generates inbound interest from enterprise executives and the wider AI community.

Market feedback

Bring what you hear in executive conversations back into product direction. Patterns across accounts on governance requirements and deployment constraints should reach the people building the models.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Demonstrable credibility in the AI field. A public track record in AI: published papers, articles, or talks that reflect a clear, defensible position. Your work should read as credible next to Mistral's technical brand.

  • A stated position on open-weight models and what they change for the enterprises adopting them. Your existing public positions should sit comfortable next to Mistral's.

  • You are fluent in European data sovereignty and on-premise deployment, at the level that holds up with a CTO or VP Engineering asking hard questions.

  • You are comfortable engaging C-level stakeholders across multiple verticals on technical architecture and business strategy, in the same conversation.

  • Cross-vertical fluency, you can credibly engage across financial services, manufacturing, defense, and energy without being a domain specialist in any one of them.

  • 10–25 years of experience in enterprise technology. You have held roles such as: Field CTO, Principal Architect, or VP Engineering at a major cloud or AI company, or a founder who built technical credibility and executive relationships through their own company.

  • Comfortable with 30-50% travel depending on your region.

Nice to have

  • Existing network of CTO and CIO relationships at enterprise accounts in your region

  • Prior Field CTO or equivalent externally facing technical role at a major cloud or AI company

  • Fluent in multiple languages spoken across your region

Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

title: Field Operations Specialist
descriptionHtml:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

 

Role & Mission


You will be the operational backbone of Alta Ares' field demonstration team — ensuring that every client and partner demonstration runs flawlessly, from equipment preparation through to mission debrief.


On the ground, you are the go-to support for pilots, operators, and engineers: handling logistics, setting up and dismantling demo sites, keeping the equipment fleet in condition, and solving problems on the fly. Your versatility and resourcefulness set you apart — you move seamlessly from a hardware check to a client interaction, from a flight case to a transport declaration, without losing pace or precision.

 

Key Responsibilities

Demonstration Preparation

  • Prepare and verify all equipment before each mission: drones, ground control stations, batteries, and tooling

  • Pack into flight cases and conduct pre-departure checks

  • Keep inventories accurate and up to date

Checklists & Continuous Improvement

  • Own the operational and equipment checklists — execute them on the day

  • Update checklists after each mission based on field feedback

  • Formalise and improve processes continuously

Logistics & Transport

  • Organise outbound shipments and equipment returns

  • Prepare all transport documentation and coordinate with carriers and the supply chain

  • Ensure material arrives on time and in compliance with applicable regulations, including for sensitive or dual-use equipment

Field Deployment

  • Install and strike the demonstration site

  • Support pilots during flight operations

  • Serve as the on-site point of contact for ground teams, host nation staff, and client representatives

Equipment Maintenance

  • Monitor the condition of the demonstration fleet and report anomalies

  • Carry out first-level maintenance interventions

  • Keep the hardware mission-ready at all times

Administrative Support

  • Prepare authorisation requests and write mission reports

  • Manage expense claims and travel bookings

  • Keep tracking tools up to date: backlog, planning, and mission logs


Candidate Profile

  • Military background or defence sector experience strongly valued: logistics, field support, or operations

  • Understanding of the defence ecosystem required — genuine commitment to national and European sovereignty

  • Versatile and resourceful: you move from a manual handling task to a client conversation without missing a beat

  • Rigorous on equipment and procedures — with the instinct to formalise and improve what can be

  • Comfortable working independently and as part of a team

  • Available for frequent travel, including internationally and in degraded security environments, sometimes at short notice

  • Professional English — mandatory

  • French driving licence (Permis B) — mandatory; heavy goods licence (Poids Lourd) appreciated

  • Experience in drone piloting or the UAS/C-UAS ecosystem is a plus

  • Experience shipping sensitive equipment is a plus

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Graduate)
descriptionHtml:
About us

STRATOS is a London-based, high-growth technology startup. We build commercial data products on Palantir Foundry for large industrial businesses, and

we're growing fast on the back of strong commercial traction. The team is young and exceptionally talented: former MBB consultants alongside strong

engineers, and we're about to double in size.

Why Forward Deployed Engineering

We have a scalable technology backbone, but we believe Forward Deployed Engineering is the future of differentiated B2B software in the GenAI age. Rather than shipping static tools, we partner closely with customers to deliver tailored solutions, where the value is created in the implementation, not just the codebase.

The Role

  • Most graduate schemes put you on a rotation for a year before you touch anything real. Here you'll be working on a live customer problem in your first month.

  • We're looking for Junior Forward Deployed Engineers to join the team and:

  • Deploy our existing product offering to new and existing customers.

  • Own, define and build new use cases on top of our core data asset and product, delivering bespoke value and solving real, unique problems for each customer.

What you'll get:

  • A rare, in-demand skillset. You'll work hands-on with Palantir Foundry every day, building deep expertise in a platform few engineers get access to.

  • No prior Foundry experience needed. We'll teach you, and that's the point.

  • Someone to learn from. You'll pair with a senior engineer from day one. The team is small enough that you learn by sitting next to people, not through a training curriculum.

  • Problems that matter. You'll be close to the customer, working on high-value problems where the impact of what you build is visible immediately.

  • Room to grow. We anticipate doubling the size of the engineering team, which means leadership, ownership and scope arrive early for the people who grab them.

What you'll do

  • Deploy and customise the STRATOS core product suite for new and existing customers.

  • Integrate external data sources: pulling data in via REST APIs and cloud storage, and connecting to customers' CRM systems.

  • Contribute to the STRATOS core product suite, extending existing products and helping build new ones from the ground up.

  • Rapidly deploy bespoke workflows on the front line to solve unique problems for specific customers.

What we're looking for

  • Proficiency in Python and SQL is a must.

  • Prior internship experience in a technical role is a must. We'll ask you to walk us through what you built and what you'd do differently.

  • The ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-changing environment.

  • The ability to work with a wide range of stakeholders: managing the technical side of projects, liaising with our Commercial Product Managers, and understanding each customer's context and problems through a business lens.

Nice to have

  • Prior experience with Palantir Foundry is heavily valued but not essential.

  • Experience with PySpark.

What we offer

  • Equity through our stock option programme, so you share in the long-term success and growth of the company.

  • Private healthcare.

  • Pension scheme.

  • 25 days of annual leave, plus bank holidays.

  • Work from abroad: up to four weeks a year, and up to two weeks at a time.

  • Visa sponsorship available.

  • A company committed to social and environmental responsibility: we pledge to be a net-zero CO₂ company and donate 1% of our revenue to social causes.

How we hire

  • Intro call with our recruiter

  • Call with Solomon, our VP Engineering

  • Two hours in person with Marco (CTO) and Solomon

  • 30-minute final conversation with Nico, our CEO

Practicalities

  • London-based, 3 days a week in our Farringdon office

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About SANOVIO

SANOVIO makes buying and selling medical supplies easier. On our AI platform, hospitals, purchasing groups and suppliers work together in one place instead of juggling emails, Excel lists and disconnected systems. Hospitals can buy together, and suppliers reach that bundled demand more easily.

Our software, SANOVIO aOS, uses AI agents to take over the tedious work: cleaning up product data, comparing requests and offers, bundling demand and keeping orders on track. It connects to the systems our customers already use.

When needed, SANOVIO Fulfillment also takes care of the physical side: finding manufacturers worldwide, quality checks, financing, warehousing and delivery. The goal is simple: less admin work, and more time and money for patient care.

About the Role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are the bridge between our customers and our product, on both sides of the platform: healthcare providers and purchasing groups on one side, suppliers on the other. At its core, this role is about talking to customers. You work directly with procurement, logistics and IT teams, understand how they really work and make SANOVIO work inside their world: you connect our platform to their ERP, materials management and supplier systems, untangle their data and processes, and ship the solutions that make them successful.

This role is for builders who are just as comfortable in a customer workshop as in a code editor. Whether you studied business informatics, industrial engineering, computer science or mathematics, or bring experience in technical product management, product engineering or software engineering with a strong design sense: what matters is that you love solving messy real-world problems end to end. We hire for skills, not for degrees.

Tasks

  • Talking to our customers every day: leading workshops with procurement managers, IT departments and suppliers, and being a trusted partner for our customers

  • Owning customer implementations end to end, from kickoff and process analysis to go-live and continuous improvement

  • Analyzing and redesigning procurement processes on both sides, from requisition and ordering at healthcare providers to order handling at suppliers, and uncovering optimization potential

  • Designing, building and running integrations between SANOVIO and our customers' ERP systems (such as SAP), materials management and supplier systems

  • Onboarding and harmonizing customer data (e.g. article master data, catalogs, order histories) and building robust data pipelines and mappings

  • Configuring and extending our AI agents for customer-specific workflows such as data matching and order automation

  • Prototyping and shipping customer-facing workflows, tools and dashboards with a strong focus on usability for non-technical users

  • Bringing customer insights back into the product and turning recurring solutions into product features together with our engineering team and the founders

Communication and customer focus

  • You enjoy talking to customers: you listen carefully, ask the right questions and explain technical topics in plain language

  • Native-level German and very good English, so you can confidently lead conversations and workshops with our customers

  • Confident with all kinds of stakeholders, from procurement managers to IT departments

  • Willing to work on-site in Munich and to travel regularly to customers in Germany and Switzerland

General Profile

  • Degree in Business Informatics (Wirtschaftsinformatik), Industrial Engineering (Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen), Computer Science, Mathematics or a similar field. Skills matter more to us than your degree, so equivalent hands-on experience counts just as much

  • Strong process understanding: you enjoy mapping, analyzing and improving business processes such as procure-to-pay or supply chain

  • High ownership, structured problem-solving and the drive to deliver fast in ambiguous environments

  • This is a junior role: a great fit if you're a recent graduate or have up to five years of professional experience. Internships and working student jobs count too

Technical skillset

  • First hands-on experience with system integrations and interfaces (e.g. REST APIs, webhooks, EDI or file-based interfaces), whether from work, internships or university projects

  • Solid coding skills (e.g. TypeScript/JavaScript or Python) and good SQL and data skills

  • Product and design affinity: you care about UX and can turn complex workflows into simple, intuitive interfaces. Experience with Figma or building UIs is a plus

Bonus if you

  • Worked at a startup or software company focused on SAP/ERP, integration platforms, process mining or procurement software (internships and working student jobs count too)

  • Have first experience as a Technical PM, Product Engineer, Solutions or Implementation Engineer, or ERP consultant

  • Have built with LLMs or AI agents, e.g. for data extraction or matching

  • Bring domain knowledge in healthcare, hospitals, procurement or supply chain

  • Can share a portfolio, GitHub or case studies of projects you shipped

Benefits

  • A steep learning curve: you learn integration work, process consulting and product building at the same time, working closely with the founders

  • Real ownership and direct impact on how we work with our customers

  • Great central office in Munich with regular team events and dinners

  • Monthly wellness budget

  • Access to the AI and productivity tools you need

  • Regular customer visits across Germany and Switzerland

  • Compensation package including cash, performance bonus and shares

About the interview process

Step 1: Intro call

Casual intro call to get to know each other, introduce SANOVIO and talk about your experience.

Step 2: Case study

A practical case based on a real-world challenge from our platform, for example how you would connect a hospital or a supplier to SANOVIO and redesign its ordering process. You'll present your approach to the team, just like you would to a customer.

Step 3: Personal fit

Meet one of our co-founders to get a feel for our culture and working style.

Step 4: Offer & reference checks

If we see a great fit, you will get an offer, including a competitive compensation package. We'll also ask for two to three references.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer | Utilities
descriptionHtml:
Jij vertaalt complexe vraagstukken in energie en infrastructuur naar AI die echt wordt gebruikt.

Van netcongestie en aansluitaanvragen tot inspecties en klantprocessen: utilities werken met complexe systemen, grote hoeveelheden informatie en hoge eisen aan betrouwbaarheid.

Als Senior Forward Deployed AI Engineer werk je dicht op de operatie van de klant. Je brengt "we willen iets met AI" binnen weken terug tot een use case die je kunt testen, of je zegt eerlijk dat het (nog) niet kan. Daarna ontwerp en bouw je de oplossing en breng je hem live in cycli van dagen. En dan maak je jezelf overbodig.

Wat ga je doen?

Je slaat de brug tussen business en techniek: je zit aan tafel bij de klant, ontwerpt de oplossing en implementeert vaak ook zelf.

  • Use cases scherp krijgen: samen met business development voer je discoverygesprekken, toets je use cases aan echte data en systemen en bouw je in dagen een proof-of-value.

  • Ontwerpen en uitvoeren: je ontwerpt de agentic architectuur, kiest per situatie het patroon dat past en brengt de oplossing in korte cycli naar productie, samen met onze AI Engineers.

  • Overdragen en meten: de klant kan de oplossing zelf draaien, en na go-live meet je of hij echt gebruikt wordt. Dát is je maatstaf.

  • Ons slimmer maken: wat je leert, maak je herbruikbaar voor de volgende klant, en je helpt nieuwe FDE's op weg.

Ongeveer 10% van je tijd gaat naar pre-sales en 90% naar delivery; business development is commercieel eigenaar.

AI voor processen die moeten blijven draaien

Je kent de praktijk van energiebedrijven, netbeheerders of andere utilities: technische assets, werkorders, klantvragen, datastromen en de afstemming tussen operationele en IT-systemen. Denk aan:

  • Aansluitaanvragen sneller verwerken in tijden van netcongestie, met AI die de informatie ordent en medewerkers helpt bij de beoordeling.

  • Agents die inspectierapporten, technische documentatie en werkorders samenvatten en voorbereiden voor monteurs en planners.

  • Klantcontact over contracten en jaarafrekeningen.


Wat breng je mee?

  • Aantoonbare ervaring in utilities, zoals energie, netbeheer of technische infrastructuur: je kent de processen, data en systemen van binnenuit.

  • Je hebt AI-oplossingen met LLM's en agents ontworpen, in productie gebracht én onderhouden, inclusief evals, guardrails, monitoring en security.

  • Sterk in Python en SQL, en hands-on met minimaal één cloud (Azure, AWS of GCP) en een dataplatform zoals Databricks, Snowflake of Fabric.

  • Je werkt dagelijks met coding agents en beoordeelt kritisch wat ze opleveren.

  • Ervaring in een klantgerichte rol, zoals consultancy, pre-sales, solutions engineering of je eigen startup.

  • Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels.

Mooi meegenomen: ervaring met assetmanagement, slimme-meterdata of OT/IT, en met klassieke ML zoals lastprognoses.

Wat dit níet is

  • Geen individuele detachering. Je werkt aan projecten namens adesso, met een team achter je.

  • Geen PoC-kerkhof. We bouwen om te gebruiken.

  • Geen slides zonder code. Je advies komt met een werkende versie.

  • Geen agent omdat het kan. Soms is de simpelste oplossing de beste, en dat zeg je dan.

Het team

Je wordt onderdeel van ons AI Engineering-team: AI engineering consultants in twee rollen. De Forward Deployed AI Engineer (FDE) is eigenaar van het klantprobleem en ontwerpt de oplossing, inclusief de agentic architectuur. De AI Engineer gaat de diepte in op bouw, data, MLOps en schaal, en denkt vanaf de klantvraag mee over de juiste aanpak.

Je krijgt ruimte om je eigen werk vorm te geven, maar je bent nooit alleen verantwoordelijk voor alle specialismen.

Twijfel je welke rol het best bij je past? Solliciteer dan gewoon; we kijken samen.

Waarom adesso? Omdat je bij ons écht kunt meebouwen.

Bij adesso Nederland draait het om meer dan alleen technologie. We bouwen slimme oplossingen die daadwerkelijk waarde toevoegen voor onze klanten. Geen eindeloze experimenten of AI omdat het hip is, maar technologie die werkt en impact maakt.

We zijn onderdeel van de internationale adesso Group, met ruim 11.500 collega's op meer dan 60 locaties. Tegelijkertijd zijn we in Nederland een relatief klein en persoonlijk team, met korte lijnen, veel vrijheid en ruimte voor eigen initiatief.

Groot genoeg om impact te maken, klein genoeg om het verschil te voelen.

AI-native: wij omarmen AI, ook in ons eigen werk

We geloven dat AI fundamenteel verandert hoe we software bouwen, met data werken en klanten helpen. Daarom bouwen we niet aan losse experimenten, maar aan dataplatformen, AI-first applicaties en agentic oplossingen die echt onderdeel worden van bedrijfsprocessen.

Dat geldt ook voor hoe we zelf werken. Met onze Agentic Delivery-aanpak en eigen tools kun je echt vliegen:

  • Context en kennisbank: agents werken met wat er écht speelt bij de klant, en kennis en beslissingen blijven herleidbaar voor mens én agent.

  • AgentOps en governance: zicht op wat agents doen en controle over wat ze mogen, zodat ze veilig en binnen de regels werken.

  • adSCAILE: ons eigen framework waarmee je samen met AI-agents bouwt, geïntegreerd, veilig en traceerbaar, in cycli van twee tot vier dagen in plaats van sprints van weken.

Je gebruikt deze tools dagelijks en helpt ze verder te ontwikkelen. adesso is bovendien Select Partner in het Claude Partner Network van Anthropic. En we blijven kritisch: niet alles hoeft met AI. De beste oplossing staat altijd voorop.

En misschien wel het belangrijkste: de mensen

Je komt terecht in een team waar vakmanschap, ondernemerschap en kennisdeling centraal staan. Je werkt met ervaren specialisten en groeit door in technische visie en in verantwoordelijkheid voor klantrelaties.

We houden van collega's die nieuwsgierig zijn, kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Mensen die goed zijn in hun vak, maar ook plezier hebben in samenwerken. Je krijgt bij ons vertrouwen, verantwoordelijkheid en de vrijheid om ideeën daadwerkelijk uit te voeren.

Wat krijg je van ons?

  • 8% vakantiegeld;

  • Contract voor 32 tot 40 uur per week;

  • Een leaseauto of mobiliteitsvergoeding naar keuze, bovenop je salaris;

  • 27 vakantiedagen en 4 studiedagen;

  • €3.600 persoonlijk ontwikkelbudget per jaar en ruimte voor certificeringen;

  • Hybride werken met flexibele werktijden;

  • Goede pensioenregeling;

  • Doorgroeimogelijkheden in een specialistenspoor;

  • Internationale kennis en ontwikkelmogelijkheden, gecombineerd met een hecht Nederlands team;

Zullen we kennismaken?

Je hoeft niet aan ieder technisch punt te voldoen. We zijn vooral benieuwd naar wat je hebt gebouwd, welke keuzes je hebt gemaakt en waar je naartoe wilt groeien.

Een cv of LinkedIn-profiel is genoeg om het gesprek te starten. Daarna volgen een kennismaking, een technisch gesprek en een praktijkcase.

Bij adesso werk je niet alleen aan de technologie van morgen. Je krijgt ook de ruimte om mee te bepalen hoe we die bouwen.

Full-Stack Engineer - Broker Terms Team

Hybrid in London, United Kingdom

We're looking for a Full-Stack Engineer to join the Broker Terms team.

You’ll build the systems behind every offer iwoca makes through brokers, and see your work in the terms each business gets.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

Broker Terms is a growing team that owns the full offer terms strategy for businesses that come to iwoca through a broker – both first-time and repeat customers. It sets pricing, loan amounts, durations, and broker commissions, and owns the offer user interface (UI) brokers use in the Introducer Portal. The broker network is iwoca's biggest acquisition channel, and the team is directly responsible for the terms that win those customers.

The team is small and interdisciplinary – commercial strategy, engineering and data science. It turns business questions into quantitative problems, and findings into timely decisions. It works on short-term gains and longer-term bets, and judges both by Customer Lifetime Value – what a business is worth to iwoca across all its borrowing.

There are no fixed office days, and the team meets up for lunch once or twice a month.

The role

As a full-stack engineer in Broker Terms, you'll make changes across iwoca's codebase wherever they'd improve an offer. Most of it is backend – the code that calculates each offer's terms – with some frontend on the UI where brokers see them.

You'll own features and projects from scoping and design through to production, and choose how to build them. You'll help decide what goes on the team's roadmap. You'll learn from the team's experienced engineers, and from the people who price broker offers.

The team is light on process – a daily stand-up, a weekly meeting and regular retrospectives – and you'll have a say in how it works. Brokers see your changes in the Introducer Portal, and A/B tests show you which ones raised Customer Lifetime Value. Your work helps businesses get the funding they need.

Live project examples:

  • Model-based pricing. Developing the systems that let a model set bespoke pricing for each customer.

  • No-fee test. Testing how the product performs without drawdown fees, and how that changes the way customers repay.

  • Loan durations. Building longer-duration Flexi-Loans with flexible repayments.

  • Offer display. Improving how offers appear to brokers and customers – a better journey, and easier testing for the team's data scientists.

  • Commission systems. Upgrading iwoca's broker commission systems.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Backend engineering. You've designed and built backend systems that run in production, ideally in Python, Django and PostgreSQL. You've modelled their data with performance and maintenance in mind.

  • Frontend engineering. You've built and maintained user interfaces in production, ideally in TypeScript and React.

  • Ownership. You've taken features end to end, and kept them working once people relied on them.

  • Trade-offs. You've weighed delivery speed against the long-term health of a system, and can explain what you chose and why.

  • AI leverage. You've built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • DevOps. You've used containers and CI/CD pipelines to deploy your code.

  • Experimentation. You've worked on A/B tests or other experiments, and used the results to decide what to build next.

  • Product thinking. You've found the business need behind a feature request, and planned the technical work to meet it.

  • Financial services. You've worked on lending, payments or pricing systems.

The salary

We expect to pay from £60,000 to £85,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

title: Graduate Mechanical Design Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Company

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

Hiring now

We are hiring as soon as possible. This role is for someone who has already graduated, or who will complete their degree in time to start with us very soon. We are not able to consider final-year students who graduate in summer 2027 or later, and this is not a graduate scheme with a fixed annual intake.

Role Overview

This is a first full-time engineering role on the NEO-1 satellite. You will design satellite hardware and help keep the satellite's full CAD assembly organised as the design matures, learning from our lead designer and working in a small, multidisciplinary team. You will take ownership of real parts early, translate requirements into manufacturable designs and support their validation through prototyping and environmental testing.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop mechanical hardware for the satellite, such as brackets, panels, component mounts, thermal-control hardware and cable and harness routing, with guidance from the lead designer.

  • Work in the satellite's large 3D CAD assembly alongside the wider design team, learning how to keep interfaces, configurations and revisions in step as several designers work in the same model.

  • Support assembly configuration, PLM data (3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX') or similar), bills of materials and engineering change control (ECO/ECR/ECN), so that models, drawings and interfaces stay consistent as changes are released.

  • Run interference and clash checks and help maintain the digital mock-up, working with each subsystem owner to allocate space and resolve conflicts.

  • Produce dimensioned, manufacturing-ready drawings using GD&T, with review from senior engineers.

  • Support design reviews (PDR and CDR) and qualification, working with structural and thermal engineers.

  • Work with manufacturers and suppliers to make designs easier to build, and to balance cost, mass and reliability.

  • Support prototype builds, integration and environmental test campaigns, iterating designs based on results.

  • Collaborate with electrical, software, systems and thermal engineers to integrate mechanical components into the satellite platform.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical, aerospace or a related engineering discipline, completed or completing very soon.

  • Hands-on 3D CAD skills from university projects, a placement or an internship (SolidWorks preferred; CATIA, NX or Creo also considered).

  • Working knowledge of GD&T and experience producing engineering drawings, including from coursework or a team project.

  • Solid grounding in mechanical design principles, materials and thermal management, with a working understanding of structural mechanics.

  • Evidence of designing, building and testing something real, such as a placement project, Formula Student, a UAV, or a rocketry or satellite team, including troubleshooting and iteration.

  • Clear communicator who is comfortable explaining and defending design decisions, and open to feedback and challenge in a fast-moving team.

Preferred Experience

  • A placement, internship or year in industry in aerospace, space, motorsport or another high-reliability field.

  • Experience of several people working in one CAD assembly, for example in a Formula Student or university team, including how files and revisions were controlled.

  • Exposure to PLM or PDM systems (for example 3DEXPERIENCE ('3DX'), Windchill, Teamcenter, ENOVIA or SolidWorks PDM) or to formal engineering change processes (ECO/ECR/ECN).

  • Experience of design reviews, documented requirements and standards.

  • Satellite, CubeSat or rocketry project experience, including hardware that has launched.

  • Basic FEA familiarity and exposure to manufacturing processes.

Why NewOrbit Space?

  • Pioneering space technology - Your work on our RF gridded ion thrusters and VLEO satellite platform will redefine satellite operations and challenge traditional LEO.

  • Ownership and impact - You'll have a level of ownership that's rare in the space industry, and you'll take part in the full lifecycle of satellite technology.

  • Equity and competitive salary - Alongside a competitive salary you receive a company ownership stake, so you share in the technology you help build and in our collective success.

  • Comprehensive benefits - Private health insurance with dental and optical cover, and annual health check-ups.

  • Hybrid working - One dedicated remote day per week.

  • Visa sponsorship and relocation support - We sponsor visas and provide relocation support for candidates moving to join us.

Finance deserves better

Finance teams at fast-growing companies run global, real-time businesses on a patchwork of legacy ERPs and point solutions. Every new entity, market or tool adds another system to stitch together and another hire to keep the numbers reconciled.

Light gives them a way out.

We build the finance solution that lets finance teams have it all, through three parts that work as one:

  • Our apps adapt Light to how each business runs, from procurement to billing to reporting.

  • Our agents operate the repetitive work that used to need another hire, so finance teams spend their time on the decisions that matter.

We take on the ERP and the legacy point solution world with something fast to implement, AI-native from the ground up, and better the more you use it.

Today we run the finance function for companies like Lovable, Legora and Keyshot, with backing from Atomico, Balderton, Seedcamp, Cherry and Entrée, and teams across Copenhagen, London and Stockholm, with remotes world over.

The Role

We're looking for a Growth Marketing Manager to join our growth team and open up the channels we haven't really touched yet.

We've built a lean, efficient demand generation engine on the core paid channels you'd expect at a Series A B2B company, with Google Ads and LinkedIn doing the heavy lifting. It works, and it fills our pipeline every month. Now we want to find the next sources of pipeline, and we need someone who knows how to build them from scratch.

You'll work alongside our Senior Growth Marketing Manager, VP Marketing and the wider marketing team, with the freedom to test, learn and scale the channels that move the number. You'll sit close to sales, product and design, and you'll own the results of everything you launch.

We've proven the core of our growth engine works. Now we want to see how far it can go, and we want you to build the parts we haven't tried yet. If you love starting channels from scratch and watching them turn into pipeline, let's talk.

title: Head of Compliance and Risk (UK)
descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

BJAK is Southeast Asia’s largest digital insurance platform, expanding financial access through automation, data, and digital scale. As we grow across markets, we are committed to building a platform that is safe, compliant, and trusted.

We are hiring a Head of Compliance and Risk (UK) to lead regulatory strategy, risk governance, and compliance operations for our UK market entry and expansion alongside the CEO. This role is expected to hold the SMF16 (Compliance Oversight) Senior Management Function once approved, and will act as our primary point of contact with the FCA.

This is a build role: you'll be creating frameworks, policies, and controls from scratch rather than inheriting an existing function.

 

Why This Role Matters

The Head of Compliance and Risk (UK) will:

  • Design and enforce compliance frameworks that enable safe scaling of digital financial services.

  • Ensure BJAK operates in accordance with UK regulatory standards, especially FCA requirements.

  • Protect consumers through transparent, fair, and ethical practices.

  • Establish BJAK as a trusted partner with regulators, partners, and industry stakeholders.

  • Build compliance capability and culture across the company.

 

What You Will Do

Regulatory Leadership & Strategy

  • Develop and maintain compliance frameworks aligned with UK regulatory requirements.

  • Lead regulatory readiness for market entry, licensing, and ongoing supervision.

  • Serve as the primary contact with the FCA and relevant UK bodies.

  • Interpret regulatory changes and guide business strategy accordingly.

 

Risk Governance & Compliance Operations

  • Build policies and controls covering AML, KYC, data privacy, consumer duty, distribution, and claims-related compliance.

  • Conduct risk assessments and implement remediation plans for identified gaps.

  • Establish monitoring, testing, and reporting processes for ongoing compliance.

  • Ensure internal audits, compliance reviews, and control testing are operationalised.

 

Consumer Protection & Business Integrity

  • Embed fairness, transparency, and responsible selling throughout the organisation.

  • Oversee product compliance, marketing reviews, pricing governance, and distribution oversight.

  • Implement complaint handling frameworks aligned with regulatory standards.

 

Cross-Functional Support & Training

  • Partner with product, operations, legal, marketing, and commercial teams to ensure compliant execution.

  • Provide guidance on regulatory implications of new products, partnerships, or distribution models.

  • Deliver training to ensure teams understand and execute compliance responsibilities.

 

You Will Thrive in This Role If You

  • See compliance as a strategic enabler, not a blocker.

  • Operate with high integrity, sound judgment, and strong attention to detail.

  • Communicate clearly and influence leaders using data and logic.

  • Enjoy building frameworks and scaling systems from early-stage to mature environments.

  • Thrive in fast-paced, evolving settings where regulation meets innovation.

 

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of compliance, risk, or regulatory experience within financial services, insurance, insurtech, or fintech.

  • Deep understanding of UK regulatory frameworks, including FCA rules and consumer duty requirements.

  • Experience in compliance for digital platforms, distribution, or insurance products (preferred).

  • Proven ability to design policies, conduct risk assessments, and manage complex compliance programs.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including dealing with regulators.

 

Bonus (Nice to Have)

  • Experience in start-up or high-growth environments.

  • Previous SMF experience.

  • Background in insurtech, digital distribution, or online marketplaces.

  • Knowledge of GDPR, AML, sanctions, or cross-border compliance.

 

Location Requirement

  • This role is based in the UK. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our London office at least 3 days per week.

 

Why Join Us

  • Shape compliance for a fast-growing international fintech-insurtech platform.

  • Build frameworks that enable safe, inclusive financial access at scale.

  • Work closely with leadership and regulators to drive responsible innovation.

  • Competitive compensation with long-term growth and international career opportunities.


Compensations Range

  • We offer a highly competitive package, ranging from £100,000 to £150,000, reflecting both experience and suitability for this pivotal role.

title: Head of India
descriptionHtml:
The Role

India is the biggest remittance market with over $130 billion a year flowing home to it, from everywhere: engineers in the Bay Area and Sydney, cabbies in Toronto, construction crews in Dubai, shopkeepers in Leicester, students in Berlin. From Punjabis, Gujaratis, Tamils, Malayalis and Telugus. From people wiring $3,000 a month to a Mumbai mortgage and people sending $80 to a village in Bihar. Your job is to win this market.

You are someone who gets excited by the nuances of the Indian diaspora and how to reach each group, and who wants to own the P&L, the regulatory landscape and pricing at the same time. If you find the price sensitivity of each cohort exciting, and "why do Malayali nurses cluster in specific hospital systems, and what does that mean for acquisition?" as interesting as "what's RBI's latest remittance policy and which banks make the best partners," this is it.

As the GM, you own the P&L, and set pricing. For customer growth, you decide which communities to acquire and in what order. Know the RBI's rules well enough to see the openings inside them, not just the limits. A Gujarati family in New Jersey and a Punjabi trucker in Brampton got abroad through completely different networks, and reaching them takes completely different channels.

Reports to the Head of South Asia. Builds a team of FX Advisors in India and growth managers in sending markets. The face of India inside and outside the company. Total ownership. Be your own CEO

What You'll Own

  • The P&L. Volume, gross profit and CAC across every India corridor. Not influence, own. A miss is your miss. A beat is your win.

  • Strategy and sequencing. Which sender markets, which communities, which channels, in what order. US, Canada, UK, Europe, Australia and UAE to start. Build the plan, defend it to leadership, execute it.

  • Pricing. India is the most rate-sensitive, most competitive remittance market in the world, up against competitors who reprice daily. Set FX and fee strategy corridor by corridor.

  • The regulatory and partner landscape. RBI rules, bank partnerships, payout rails. Know the terrain cold and own the local relationships.

  • Product. Obsess over UX and the services NRIs actually need. Closer to the customer than anyone in the company, and what you hear feeds straight into product, pricing and customer support.

  • The diaspora puzzle. Community partnerships, temples and gurdwaras and churches, cricket leagues, student associations, remittance-heavy employers, influencers, festivals (Diwali is a season, not a day). Get in front of each community authentically, and cheaply.

  • The team. Hire, coach and retain people in India and in sending markets. Small, dense, fast.

Who You Are

  • 10 to 15 years in high-growth environments: startups, operations, consulting, finance, fintech. Has owned a number and talks about it the way owners do.

  • Diaspora-fluent. Real knowledge of and networks in the Indian diaspora, and real curiosity about it. Migration patterns, community structures, who sends money to whom and why.

  • Commercially sharp. Holds pricing, unit economics and CAC math in their head, and works the data directly. Excel or Sheets required, SQL a real plus.

  • A hustler with judgment. Closes a bank partnership Monday, reviews corridor margins Tuesday, shows up at a community event in Jackson Heights on Saturday. Likes all three.

  • A regulatory realist. Understands (or can quickly master) RBI rules and the compliance realities of moving money into India. Treats compliance as a partner, not an obstacle.

  • Multilingual, ideally. Fluent in English. Hindi, Gujarati, Punjabi, Tamil, Telugu or Malayalam are genuine assets.

Location: London or Dubai. Regular travel to India and sending markets is part of the job.

Why This Role

India is the largest remittance market in the world, and winning it moves the whole company forward. This role owns that outcome, with the authority and the accountability that come with it. It also drives real value for the customers: Immigrants work hard for this money, and every basis point saved goes home.

About Us

 

We’re building the world’s leading cross-border fintech for emerging markets - empowering families, fuelling local economies, and changing how millions access financial services.

 

Since our launch in 2019, we have transformed how money moves across borders with our operations spanning 6 out of 7 continents and covering both the busiest and most underserved (remittance) corridors. We tapped into a massive shift - from banks to phones - bringing digital finance to places where traditional systems never reached. The next stage of growth will fuel a network of services and products especially designed to make money more accessible to diaspora communities including local cards, and additional savings and payments features.

 

We’re growing fast, backed by world-class investors, and scaling a product that blends real world impact with cutting edge fintech innovation.

 

Here’s a little more:

  • Founded by Harvard grads and 3-time founders who previously built Segovia (acquired) and GiveDirectly (>$300M revenue, fastest-growing NGO in the world)

  • Backed by top investors including Spark Capital, Canaan, Reid Hoffman, Breyer Capital, Unbound, Wamda, and more

  • Built by global top performers from Bain, Google, McKinsey, Uber, Checkout, Bolt, and beyond - we move fast, stay humble, and care deeply about our mission

  • Truly global team - 250+ people, 50+ nationalities, 50+ languages

  • Guided by our values - ownership, impact, humility, and heart - in deed, not just word

 

Taptap Values

Impact first

Team next

Accept reality

Propose solutions

Win with grit

Be proactively candid, with yourself and others

Love the particular

Own it

Create positive energy

Maybe, even have fun

 

Taptap Send is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. All employment decisions are decided on the basis of qualifications, experience and business need. We strongly encourage applications who are members of underrepresented communities to apply.

If you require reasonable adjustments to be made during the recruitment process, please do not hesitate to let us know. Any information you provide us in this respect will only be used to accommodate your requirements.

Note: we recognize imposter syndrome is real - any candidate that does not perfectly fit every characteristic of this role is still strongly encouraged to apply.

title: Head of UK, Ad Solutions
descriptionHtml:
About the Team

OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. In support of that mission, the Ads Solutions team partners closely with advertisers, agencies and strategic partners to help businesses unlock value through AI-powered advertising solutions while maintaining strong standards for user trust, platform integrity and responsible innovation.

As OpenAI’s advertising business continues to scale, the Head of UK will play a critical role in growing the UK business, building strategic advertiser and agency relationships, and developing a high-performing commercial team. You will work closely with EMEA and global leadership to translate OpenAI’s advertising strategy into a clear plan for the UK market.

About the Role

We are seeking a Head of UK, Ad Solutions to lead and scale OpenAI’s advertising business in the United Kingdom. Based in London, you will lead a team of Client Partners and Customer Success Managers supporting UK advertisers and agencies, with responsibility for country strategy, revenue performance and advertiser success.

This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role. You will identify the sectors, customers and partnerships that offer the greatest opportunity for sustainable growth, build executive-level relationships across the UK advertising industry, and establish the operating discipline needed to deliver ambitious commercial goals.

You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Operations and Policy teams to ensure UK advertiser needs inform product development and go-to-market decisions. Working alongside regional and global account teams, you will also help UK-based advertisers and agencies grow their international activity through coordinated account plans.

The ideal candidate combines deep knowledge of the UK advertising market with strong people leadership, commercial judgement and operational rigour. You are equally comfortable coaching a team, engaging a CMO or agency leader, solving customer challenges and building a business in a fast-moving environment.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the UK commercial strategy, revenue goals and business performance, translating regional priorities into clear plans and accountable execution.

  • Recruit, lead, coach and develop a team of Client Partners and Customer Success Managers, building a high-performance, inclusive and customer-focused culture.

  • Prioritise UK sectors, advertiser segments and strategic accounts, allocating resources to accelerate adoption, retention and sustainable revenue growth.

  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships with leading UK advertisers, agency holding companies, independent agencies and strategic partners.

  • Develop agency and technology partnerships that expand advertiser access, improve customer outcomes and support a scalable UK business.

  • Partner with sales and customer success teams to strengthen the full advertiser lifecycle, from onboarding and campaign activation to measurement, renewal and expansion.

  • Drive forecasting, pipeline management, account and territory planning, and business reviews to improve execution and revenue predictability.

  • Help advertisers define success and build evidence-based investment cases, using campaign performance and measurement insights to guide growth.

  • Represent the voice of UK advertisers and agencies internally, translating customer feedback and market insights into actionable input for Product, Engineering and leadership teams.

  • Coordinate with EMEA and global teams on international customer opportunities, product launches and shared account strategies.

  • Partner with Policy, Legal and other relevant teams to support responsible market growth, strong platform integrity and user trust.

  • Establish repeatable processes and playbooks, and represent OpenAI’s advertising offering at industry events and in senior customer and partner discussions.

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have significant experience in digital advertising, media or technology, with a strong track record in senior commercial leadership.

  • Have experience leading high-performing sales, account management, customer success or revenue teams, including hiring and developing exceptional talent.

  • Have a proven record of exceeding revenue targets and building or scaling an advertising business in the UK.

  • Bring deep knowledge of the UK advertising ecosystem, including major advertisers, agency holding companies, independent agencies and technology partners.

  • Can build trusted relationships with C-suite executives and agency leaders, and personally influence complex, strategic commercial opportunities.

  • Combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, sound judgement and strong operational discipline.

  • Understand digital advertising products, performance measurement and the commercial needs of both brand and performance advertisers.

  • Are highly data-driven and use analytics to prioritise opportunities, assess customer outcomes and drive accountability.

  • Work effectively across functions and geographies, aligning local priorities with regional and global goals.

  • Thrive in ambiguity and enjoy building teams, processes and new commercial opportunities from the ground up.

  • Are excited by the possibilities of AI in marketing and committed to helping advertisers adopt transformative technologies responsibly.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. title: Human Resources Administrator
descriptionHtml:
About Us
At algo1, we are reinventing one of the world’s most familiar experiences: the in-store grocery trip. We are building an AI-native product that understands each shopper, responds to their context in real time and makes an everyday experience less stressful, more personal and more engaging.

We’re backed by leading investors and founded by two entrepreneurs: one with a track record of building companies, and the other a leader in retail data and shopper analytics. Together, they have brought together frontier AI researchers and engineers, product and strategy leaders, and senior operators from major UK and US grocery businesses.

The people who join now will have an opportunity to shape the product, the engineering culture, and what algo1 becomes.

The Role
This role reports to our Chief of Staff and works closely with our leadership team and hiring managers across the business. It is part-time and currently set at two days per week (0.4FTE).

You’ll keep our people operations running smoothly as we grow, from the moment a candidate accepts an offer to the everyday policies, systems and reporting that help our team do their best work. You’ll make sure the details are right, the paperwork is compliant, and every new joiner gets a great first impression of algo1.

What You’ll Own

  • Support our hiring process. Coordinate the admin behind every hire, keeping candidates and hiring managers informed and making sure nothing falls through the cracks between offer and first day.

  • Manage right to work and visas. Carry out right to work checks, manage visa and sponsorship processes, and keep accurate, compliant records.

  • Prepare offers and contracts. Customise offer letters and employment contracts for each new hire, and manage the signing process through DocuSign.

  • Maintain people policies and processes. Keep our policies and processes up to date, and communicate them clearly so everyone knows how things work and where to find them.

  • Run our people systems. Look after our people systems and the data within them, keeping records accurate and processes efficient.

  • Building a great place to work. Contribute ideas and energy to the culture, engagement and employee experience initiatives that make algo1 a great place to work.

  • Support the Chief of Staff. Take on a variety of projects for our Chief of Staff, from operational improvements to one-off initiatives across the business.

About You

Must Have

  • People operations experience. Experience in an HR / people operations or recruitment coordination role, ideally in a fast-growing business.

  • Attention to detail. A meticulous approach to contracts, records and data, with the discretion to handle sensitive information confidentially.

  • Systems confidence. Comfort working with HR systems, e-signature tools like DocuSign, and spreadsheets to keep data accurate and produce reports.

  • Clear communication. The ability to write and explain policies and processes in a way that is friendly, clear and easy to follow.

  • Flexibility. We are a start-up. Being comfortable with ambiguity and the need to adapt is important.

Nice to Have

  • UK employment compliance. Working knowledge of UK right to work checks and experience supporting visa and sponsorship processes.

  • Sponsor licence knowledge. Familiarity with managing a UK Skilled Worker sponsor licence and its reporting duties.

  • HR qualification e.g.CIPD.

  • AI and automation curiosity. An interest in using AI tools to streamline admin and improve people processes.

How We Work
This is a fast-paced environment. The people who thrive here are curious, proactive, and organised. If you’re happiest when you’re making things run better, you’ll fit right in.

We draw our energy from being together, so this is a part-time, office-based role. It suits someone who enjoys the quick conversations and shared momentum that comes from working together. Our office is on what we think is the best garden square in London, just a couple of minutes from Tottenham Court Road, so it’s easy to get to and a great place to be.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary (pro rata)

  • 25 days’ annual leave (pro rata).

  • A part-time role with a working pattern agreed together.

  • Real ownership from day one.

  • The chance to help shape the culture of a fast-growing AI company.

descriptionHtml:

Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Alta Ares recrute un technicien réglementation drones pour appuyer le responsable sécurité des vols. Il prendra en charge les dossiers réglementaires (SORA, PPDRA) et la conformité des opérations et des sites de vol.

Dossiers réglementaires : rédiger et suivre les demandes d’autorisation en catégorie spécifique (SORA, PPDRA, déclarations STS), préparer les dossiers d’accès à l’espace aérien et les protocoles avec les gestionnaires d’aérodromes, tenir à jour le MANEX et les procédures.

Sites de vol : visiter les aérodromes et les centres d’essais en vol, vérifier leur conformité et leur adéquation à nos besoins, et rédiger un rapport de visite.

  • Bac+2 à Bac+5 en aéronautique, en réglementation aérienne ou équivalent

  • Maîtrise de la SORA et de la rédaction de PPDRA, avec des dossiers déjà déposés

  • Bonnes notions d’espace aérien et de coordination avec les gestionnaires d’aérodromes

  • Anglais professionnel

  • Rigueur, qualité rédactionnelle, autonomie, aisance relationnelle, goût du terrain

Nice to have

  • Connaissance de la réglementation des aéronefs d’État (DSAÉ)

  • Brevet de télépilote ou expérience opérationnelle de vol

Mandatory

  • Déplacements fréquents sur les sites d’essais et les aérodromes, permis B indispensable

title: Internship: Explainable AI for the qualification of aerospace algorithms
descriptionHtml:
Background

Machine learning is increasingly used in aerospace for tasks that have traditionally relied on human experts or on fixed rule-based procedures. For such tasks, data-driven algorithms promise gains in speed, consistency and sensitivity. Before they can be used in practice however, they must be qualified, which means it has to be demonstrated with sufficient substantiation that the algorithm performs its intended function reliably within a defined set of conditions. The qualification approaches used in the sector today were developed for human operators and for conventional systems whose behaviour can be traced back to explicit requirements. They do not translate directly to algorithms whose behaviour is learned from data, and emerging guidance from aviation authorities names explainability as a key ingredient of trustworthy AI, while leaving open how it should be demonstrated in practice.

Performance figures on a test set do not show why an algorithm reaches a decision, whether it relies on physically meaningful information, or how it behaves outside the data it was trained on. Explainable machine learning offers a wide range of methods to address this, from feature attribution and saliency methods, to example-based and concept-based explanations, but it is still an open question which of these can provide evidence that is strong enough to support qualification. This project therefore investigates how explainability methods can contribute to the qualification of machine learning algorithms for aerospace, starting from an use case, and provides a comparative assessment of several methods.

Assignment

The assignment will include the following tasks:

  • A literature study on the qualification of machine learning algorithms in safety-critical sectors and on explainability methods for machine learning (e.g., attribution and saliency methods, example-based and concept-based explanations, interpretable models, uncertainty quantification), including the ways in which explanations themselves are evaluated.

  • A use case provided by NLR, for instance automated defect detection, and identification of the substantiation needed to qualify the algorithm, translated into criteria that explanations should meet.

  • Implementing several explainability methods for the use case and analysing them against these criteria, for example their faithfulness to the model, their robustness and their usefulness to domain experts.

  • Assessing how the resulting explanations can serve as evidence in the qualification of the algorithm, and formulating recommendations for the use of explainability in qualification.

Results

The final outcomes of this assignment will be:

§ A structured assessment, as part of a literature study, of explainability methods for machine learning and their suitability for qualification in aerospace, together with a justified selection of the use case.

§ An implementation and comparative evaluation of several explainability methods on the selected use case, with recommendations on how explainability can support the qualification of the algorithm.

§ A technical report, either an MSc thesis following the guidelines of your faculty or an internship report, describing the approach, results, and conclusions of the work.

Duration

For an MSc thesis, the standard duration of a thesis at your faculty applies (typically 9 months). For an internship, the duration is 6 months.

Profile

  • You are an MSc student in Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics or a similar master.

  • You have a strong background in machine learning, preferably deep learning. Knowledge of explainable AI is a plus.

  • You have experience with programming in Python and with machine learning libraries, for instance PyTorch or scikit-learn.

  • You have an affinity with aerospace, inspection or certification, and are motivated to bring machine learning closer to qualified use in practice.

What we offer

  • A challenging graduation project/internship in a high-tech result orientated work environment

  • Weekly supervision and availability of the technical staff for support

  • An internship allowance

  • Working in an actual R&D project as part of the team

  • Internship results to be used in the current and future projects

About NLR

Royal NLR has been the ambitious research organisation with the will to keep innovating for over 100 years. With that drive, we make the world of transportation safer, more sustainable, more efficient and more effective. We are on the threshold of breakthrough innovations. Plans and ideas start to move when these are fed with the right energy. Over 800 driven professionals work on research and innovation, from aircraft engineers to psychologists and from mathematicians to application experts. Our colleagues are happy to tell you what it's like to work at NLR. This assignment will be managed by the Avionics Systems and Maintenance Engineering (ASAM) department.

title: IoT Embedded Systems Engineer
descriptionHtml:
• Take ownership of the development of IoT systems, with a focus on embedded software, system architecture, and hardware and firmware integration

  • Design and develop robust, efficient, and scalable embedded software for IoT products based on microcontroller platforms and, optionally, Linux based systems

  • Provide technical guidance for hardware development in collaboration with external partners, including reviewing and challenging PCB designs to ensure functionality, quality, and manufacturability

  • Collaborate closely with mechanical, software, and cloud engineering teams to ensure seamless end to end system integration

  • Define and refine product requirements from initial concept through to mass production in collaboration with internal and external stakeholders

  • Develop and integrate prototypes and support the transition from development into serial production together with manufacturing partners

  • Contribute to the continuous evolution of the embedded platform, including MCU based solutions as well as optional Linux and Yocto based components

  • Develop pragmatic testing strategies to ensure the functionality, reliability, and quality of both hardware and firmware

  • Support development and manufacturing partners with debugging, technical documentation, and production ramp up

  • Provide Level 3 technical support for complex system, firmware, and hardware related issues

  • Travel approximately 5 to 10 percent to support development partners, product validation activities, and product launches


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems, Computer Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience

  • Several years of hands on experience in embedded development, including firmware development and hardware related engineering

  • Strong understanding of hardware design and PCB layouts, with the ability to review design decisions and collaborate effectively with hardware development teams

  • Strong expertise in embedded firmware development and software architecture for microcontroller platforms such as ARM Cortex, ESP32, or STM32

  • Experience with sensor integration and wireless communication technologies such as BLE and WiFi

  • Experience with embedded Linux systems, particularly Yocto, is an advantage, especially in environments combining System on Modules with MCU based architectures

  • Broad system level understanding of mechanics, sensors, actuators, and their integration into robust IoT products

  • Hands on experience with hardware testing, debugging tools, and automated production testing

  • Familiarity with certification standards such as CE and FCC is an advantage

  • Fluent in German and English, with additional languages considered a plus

title: IT Manager (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Über Buena

Buena, finanziert von Google Ventures, macht alles rund um Immobilien so einfach und transparent wie den Kauf eines ETFs. Wir übernehmen Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und entwickeln sie digital weiter.

Mit jeder Übernahme wachsen auch unsere Anforderungen an die IT: Neue Mitarbeitende, Geräte und Standorte sollen zuverlässig zusammenarbeiten. Dafür suchen wir eine Person, die unsere IT übernimmt und mit unserem Wachstum weiterentwickelt.

Deine Rolle

Du verantwortest zunächst die IT unserer Berliner Zentrale. Du sorgst dafür, dass Mitarbeitende arbeitsfähig sind, Zugänge sicher verwaltet werden und Geräte sowie Netzwerk zuverlässig funktionieren.

Gleichzeitig entwickelst du Standards und Abläufe, die auch bei der nächsten Hausverwaltung funktionieren. Mittelfristig begleitest du die IT-Integration unserer Tochterunternehmen und arbeitest dabei eng mit unserem externen IT-Partner zusammen.

Du berichtest direkt an unseren Head of Product. Mit wachsender Verantwortung kannst du dich in die Rolle des Head of IT für die Buena-Gruppe entwickeln.

Was du bei uns machst

  • Du hältst unsere IT in Berlin am Laufen. Du unterstützt Kolleginnen und Kollegen vor Ort, löst technische Probleme und betreust unser UniFi-Netzwerk.

  • Du verantwortest Google Workspace. Du verwaltest Nutzer, Gruppen, Berechtigungen, Shared Drives und Lizenzen und setzt verlässliche Sicherheitseinstellungen um.

  • Du organisierst Ein- und Austritte. Neue Mitarbeitende starten mit eingerichteten Konten und Geräten. Beim Austritt kümmerst du dich um Zugriffsrechte, Datensicherung und die Rücknahme der Hardware.

  • Du verwaltest unsere Geräte. Du betreust Laptops und Mobilgeräte mit NinjaOne sowie Apple-Geräte über den Apple Business Manager und die angebundene Geräteverwaltung.

  • Du verbesserst wiederkehrende Abläufe. Du erkennst unnötige Handarbeit, automatisierst sinnvolle Schritte und dokumentierst Prozesse so, dass andere damit arbeiten können.

  • Du begleitest neue Standorte. Du verschaffst dir einen Überblick über deren IT, planst notwendige Anpassungen und setzt sie gemeinsam mit unserem IT-Partner um. Dafür reist du gelegentlich zu unseren Hausverwaltungen.

Was du mitbringst

  • Du hast mehrere Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der Systemadministration und kannst eine IT-Umgebung eigenständig betreuen.

  • Du kennst Google Workspace gut und hast Erfahrung mit Geräteverwaltung, beispielsweise NinjaOne, Jamf oder Intune.

  • Du bist mit macOS, iOS und dem Apple Business Manager vertraut und verfügst über solide Netzwerkgrundkenntnisse, idealerweise mit UniFi.

  • Du hast bereits einen IT-Prozess verbessert, eine neue Lösung eingeführt oder eine Systemumstellung begleitet und kannst deinen eigenen Beitrag erklären.

  • Du gehst Fehlern systematisch auf den Grund und kannst entscheiden, was zuerst gelöst werden muss.

  • Du erklärst technische Themen verständlich und arbeitest verbindlich mit Mitarbeitenden und externen Dienstleistern zusammen.

  • Du möchtest vor Ort in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg arbeiten, bist zu gelegentlichen Reisen bereit und sprichst sehr gut Deutsch sowie gut Englisch.

Eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation ist hilfreich. Einschlägige Praxiserfahrung zählt genauso. Führungserfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung; du solltest Lust haben, mit der Aufgabe zu wachsen und zunehmend übergreifende Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Was du bei uns bekommst

  • Verantwortung für einen Bereich, den du aktiv mitgestaltest.

  • Die Perspektive, mit Buena in eine Head-of-IT-Rolle hineinzuwachsen.

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Head of Integration und kurze Entscheidungswege.

  • Attraktives Gehalt und 500 € „Close-to-Office“-Bonus.

  • MacBook und Studio Display.

  • 110 € Essenszuschuss und 50 € Fitnesszuschuss.

  • Bücher: Buena zahlt jedes Buch, das du lesen möchtest.

  • Tägliches Frühstück und Spezialitätenkaffee im Büro.

Lerne uns kennen.

Im Bewerbungsprozess sprechen wir über Aufgaben und Entscheidungen aus deiner bisherigen Arbeit. Vor Ort lösen wir gemeinsam ein praxisnahes IT-Szenario. Dabei interessiert uns, wie du Probleme eingrenzt, Prioritäten setzt und deine Überlegungen erklärst.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

title: IT Stage
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij op zoek naar een uitdagende IT-stage waarin je jouw technische kennis in de praktijk kunt brengen én jezelf verder kunt ontwikkelen? Bij Cefetra in Rotterdam hebben we vanaf februari 2027 een stageplek beschikbaar voor een enthousiaste en leergierige IT-student.

wie zijn wij?

Cefetra Group bestaat uit verschillende handelsbedrijven die actief zijn binnen de agrarische sector en de voedingsingrediëntenindustrie, waaronder toonaangevende merken binnen de ingrediëntenmarkt. Samen hebben we ongeveer 800 medewerkers, verspreid over 39 kantoren in 17 landen wereldwijd.

We werken nauw met elkaar samen om onze klanten de best mogelijke service te bieden. Samen met onze leveranciers bouwen we sterke supply chains en creëren we waarde door grondstoffen in te kopen en te leveren aan de internationale voedingsmiddelen-, diervoedings- en energiesector.

Bekijk hier onze corporate video.

De stage

Als IT Support Stagiair(e) word je onderdeel van het IT-team en ondersteun je collega’s bij hun dagelijkse IT-vragen. Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor gebruikers en helpt bij het oplossen van technische problemen, zowel op afstand als op kantoor. Hierdoor krijg je een goed beeld van hoe IT-support binnen een internationale organisatie werkt.

Tijdens je stage houd je je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het bieden van eerstelijns IT-support en oplossen van hardware-, software- en netwerkproblemen;

  • Het beheren van gebruikersaccounts, wachtwoorden, licenties en apparaten;

  • Het installeren, configureren en uitgeven van laptops en mobiele telefoons;

  • Het registreren en opvolgen van incidenten en aanvragen via het ticketsysteem.

Daarnaast werk je samen met ervaren IT-specialisten aan projecten op het gebied van infrastructuur, werkplekbeheer en procesverbetering. Hierdoor ontwikkel je niet alleen je technische vaardigheden, maar leer je ook hoe IT een belangrijke bijdrage levert aan de dagelijkse werkzaamheden binnen een internationale handelsorganisatie.

Tijdens je stage maak je ook kennis met de technologieën en systemen die binnen onze IT-omgeving worden gebruikt. Je werkt met Microsoft 365, Azure, Active Directory, Intune en Windows Server voor het beheren van gebruikers, apparaten en applicaties. Daarnaast doe je ervaring op met Cisco Meraki voor netwerkbeheer, Citrix voor virtuele werkplekken en applicaties, VMware voor gevirtualiseerde serveromgevingen en TeamViewer voor ondersteuning op afstand.

Zo krijg je een brede kijk op zowel moderne cloudoplossingen als traditionele IT-infrastructuur.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent nieuwsgierig, servicegericht en krijgt energie van het oplossen van technische uitdagingen. Je neemt initiatief, werkt graag samen met anderen en bent niet bang om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen.

Daarnaast beschik je over analytisch en probleemoplossend vermogen, goede communicatieve vaardigheden en ben je flexibel en betrouwbaar. Idealiter herken je jezelf in het volgende:

  • Je volgt momenteel een mbo-opleiding richting ICT, Informatica, Systeem- en Netwerkbeheer of een vergelijkbare opleiding;

  • Je hebt affiniteit met IT-support en systeembeheer;

  • Je bent leergierig en wilt graag praktijkervaring opdoen binnen een professionele IT-omgeving;

  • Je beschikt over basiskennis van Windows, Microsoft 365 en netwerken;

  • Je kunt zowel zelfstandig als in teamverband werken;

  • Je beheerst zowel de Nederlandse als de Engelse taal goed.

Wat bieden wij?

Een unieke kans om ervaring op te doen binnen een snelgroeiende, internationale organisatie. Zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid staan centraal binnen onze bedrijfscultuur.

Wij bieden:

  • Een uitdagende stage binnen een internationale organisatie;

  • Begeleiding door ervaren IT-professionals;

  • Veel ruimte om te leren en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen;

  • Werken met moderne technologieën en professionele IT-omgevingen;

  • Een stagevergoeding van €525 per maand op basis van een fulltime dienstverband;
