title: Machine Learning Engineer II - Growth & Personalisation
descriptionHtml:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Global Engineering teams tackle complex technical challenges across a global, three-sided marketplace, building and scaling systems that serve millions of customers, riders and partners every day.

We're looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our London office as part of a Global DoorDash Engineering team (working hybrid, 3 days in the office).

Our New Verticals team exists to grow monthly active usage outside of restaurant ordering — groceries, retail, and everything in between. That means turning someone who only orders restaurant food into someone who also uses the app for a grocery run, and turning dormant users into active ones. You'll work on the surfaces that make that happen: the homepage, vertical landing pages, and the notifications that bring people back. This role sits closer to the personalisation and ranking side of that mission, working alongside colleagues across DoorDash, Deliveroo and Wolt.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Build and improve ranking models for vertical landing pages (grocery, retail), deciding what a user sees first when they land on a store page

  • Design models that blend new-vertical content into a homepage built around restaurant ordering, without disrupting the core experience

  • Build personalisation models that translate a user's existing behaviour into relevant recommendations for verticals they haven't tried yet

  • Contribute to notification targeting — who gets notified, with what message, and when, to drive adoption of new verticals

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • Minimum 3+ years of experience as an ML Engineer or Data Scientist, with a proven ability to write high-quality production code in Python

  • Experience with end-to-end model productionisation

  • A bias to simplicity, where you care most about achieving impact

  • Background in personalisation, ranking, or recommender systems; exposure to causal inference or uplift modelling is a genuine plus but not expected

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving. We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale
Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast
Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership
Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders
High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

💰 Share in the success you help create
Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the role

Linkup is the web search engine built for AI. Our infrastructure crawls, indexes and serves the live web to AI agents, and it’s scaling fast.

We’re looking for a top‑tier Machine Learning Engineer to join Linkup and work hand‑in‑hand with our CTO, Denis Charrier, and the rest of the tech team.

Your core responsibilities will be to:
Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents

  • Design, train and ship ranking and retrieval models for AI agents

  • Bring new ranking signals into the engine, beyond pure relevance

  • Build the evaluation framework that tells us what really improves search quality

  • Optimize model serving for latency and GPU cost

  • Turn customer and benchmark feedback into ranking improvements, with clear before/after numbers

     
 

Requirements

You’re a great match if you:

  • Are excited to help build Google for AI agents- and believe in Linkup’s mission

  • Have strong hands-on experience in information retrieval, ranking or search in production.

  • Build rigorous evals and check the data behind every number

  • Care about latency, cost and reliability as much as model quality

  • Thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership startup environment

 

Example Projects

  • Ship a new ranking model to production and prove the gain on our eval sets

  • Push our models to the next level: better answers, lower latency, lower cost per query

  • Build and maintain the evaluations framework that measures every change to our search engine

 

Our Stack

Python, PyTorch, Hugging Face, vLLM, Ray, Spark / Databricks, Vespa, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Terraform

Details

The ideal candidate will play a central role in our engineering team, partnering closely with the founders. The models you ship will decide what thousands of AI products read every day.

We offer a flexible remote‑work policy- see the details here.

Join us and leverage your expertise to push the boundaries of AI!

 

About Linkup

 

Our Vision

We believe in a future of AI agents and the agentic web. These digital entities can create more value for humanity than we ever could alone, but they depend on the internet to operate, collaborate, take action, and gather information.

AI agents need web search. To perform well, they require information that is current, reliable, and context‑specific—not the diffuse, steadily aging knowledge frozen at their last training cut‑off.

Modern web search is built for humans, not AIs. Instead of trusted facts, it serves links, ads, and click‑bait. People want visually engaging pages; AI systems need structured truth. An AI can absorb oceans of data, while human attention barely skims the surface. Humans think visually and intuitively; AI reasons in latent space.

Web 2.0 is sunsetting. The deck is being reshuffled, and the Bing‑Google search oligopoly is crumbling. Indexing ever more pages is no longer the goal; semantically organizing facts for AI systems is. In the coming agentic web, Google’s ad‑driven model has no natural home.

Search for AI must be rebuilt from the ground up. We are reconstructing the web as a rigorously structured knowledge layer, mapping every concept, entity, and claim into a coherent semantic graph. This foundation delivers verified facts and rich context to AI instantly, unlocking faster reasoning, higher accuracy, and radically more useful answers for everyone.

Humans search Google; AI searches Linkup.

 

Our Mission

Reality never stands still, and neither should intelligence. Linkup reconnects language models to a living stream of verified facts, ensuring AIs remain as current and insightful as the world they serve.

Our mission is to deliver the world’s freshest, most trusted knowledge to AIs.

 

Our Culture

Our culture is built on the following values:

  • Mission. We believe we play a critical role in building the agentic web. We are 100% committed to our mission of bringing the reality of the world to AI agents.

  • Speed. We build fast, we build to last. We get things done, well.

  • Ownership. We empower every team member to take ownership of their projects, ensuring they see them through to successful completion.

  • Teamwork. Our strength lies in our unity. We rely on one another and embrace our diversity as a core asset.

  • Humility. We maintain low egos, showing respect for others and continuously learning from their insights and experiences.

We expect all team member to take an active role in shaping our company culture.

 

Our Team

We are a small technical team, working shoulder to shoulder to build the web of agents.

A bit more about our 3 co-founders:

  • Philippe Mizrahi- Led the development of Lyft’s Autonomous Vehicles marketplace. Previously launched Amundsen, an open source search engine.

  • Denis Charrier- Founding Engineer at Niland, an audio search company (acquired by Spotify), then Staff Engineer at Spotify. 15y of software development experience.

  • Boris Toledano- Led robotics at Carrefour, after 3y at McKinsey & Co working on public affairs and digital transformation.

title: Manager Cloud Architect - Paris
descriptionHtml:
Présentation du poste :

Concevoir une architecture d’IA, c’est engager une entreprise pour plusieurs années : l’emplacement des données, la gestion des accès, la manière dont un agent passe en production sous le regard des équipes de sécurité. Ces choix structurants, vous les construisez avec nos clients.

Tout le reste, ce sont les ambitions fonctionnelles et techniques du client, son cadre réglementaire, son budget, les compétences qu'il peut réellement mobiliser en interne, la gouvernance qu'il veut installer, et un écosystème d'éditeurs qui gravite autour de lui. Votre rôle est de trouver le point d'équilibre entre ces forces, de le faire accepter, puis de le réajuster dès que l'une d'elles bouge.

Votre point de départ n’est pas la technologie, mais l’ambition métier. Vous la traduisez en une plateforme data ou agentique pensée pour s’intégrer au système d’information existant, avec son histoire, ses contraintes et ses équipes. Votre rôle ne s’arrête pas à la validation du schéma cible : vous accompagnez les équipes de delivery jusqu’à la mise en production.

À titre d’exemple, chez l’un de nos clients, chaque nouvel agent repose désormais sur une plateforme commune qui gère nativement les droits d’accès, le monitoring et les coûts. Chaque cas d’usage s’appuie ainsi sur les fondations posées pour les précédents.

Ce poste s’adresse à vous si vous aimez embrasser un système dans son ensemble, prendre les décisions qui engagent et en expliquer les raisons.

Artefact est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes entreprises mondiales pour déployer l’IA : 3 000 AI makers dans plus de 30 pays, plus de 1 000 clients. En France, vous rejoignez le département Engineering (environ 300 personnes, sous la responsabilité du CTO), au sein du chapter AI Architect.

Activités et responsabilités :

Sur un projet, vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les AI Applied Engineers, qui construisent et font tourner ce que vous concevez, et avec les AI Product Managers, qui portent le produit avec le client.

Côté client, deux publics sont à convaincre : les directions métier, avec lesquelles vous définissez la cible, et les équipes IT, sécurité, réseau et exploitation, sans l’adhésion desquelles rien ne passe en production. Une architecture qu’elles n’ont pas validée ne dépasse pas le stade du document. Vous êtes aussi l'interlocuteur des achats, de la conformité et des éditeurs qui veulent se positionner.

Au sein du chapter, vous relisez les designs de vos pairs, contribuez à faire grandir les architectes et les profils d’ingénierie qui vous entourent, et mettez en commun ce qui fonctionne. Vous travaillez également avec nos partenaires technologiques et les autres équipes d’Artefact.

Vos responsabilités :

  • Traduire les objectifs, les contraintes et les délais du client en une architecture que le métier comme l’IT comprennent, et défendre vos choix devant eux.
  • Concevoir des plateformes data et agentiques, on premise, dans le cloud ou en hybride.
  • Découper les périmètres techniques en fonction de la façon dont les équipes du client sont organisées.
  • Arbitrer entre les options en pesant leur valeur métier, leur coût total, leur conformité, leur dépendance à un éditeur et la capacité du client à les faire vivre.
  • Aider le client à évaluer et à mettre en concurrence des éditeurs, sans parti pris.
  • Préparer les propositions commerciales : cadrer la solution, la chiffrer et construire la roadmap de delivery.
  • Tenir la ligne  pendant le delivery : relire les designs, trancher les arbitrages et réajuster la cible quand le contexte du client change.
  • Faire vivre les patterns de référence et les bonnes pratiques du chapter, et suivre de près les évolutions de l’IA, du cloud et de la data.

Profil recherché :

Nous recherchons une personne qui pense comme un consultant et raisonne comme un ingénieur. Les architectes qui réussissent chez nous sont, entre autres, des profils techniques passés par le conseil, des pre-sales engineers, des FDEs, ou des personnes avec une expérience en tant que CTO.

Les indispensables :

  1. Vous avez conçu une architecture data ou IA qui a été mise en production, et vous savez expliquer pourquoi vous avez écarté les autres options, techniques ou non.
  2. Vous avez déjà recommandé une option techniquement moins séduisante parce qu'elle correspondait mieux au budget, aux compétences, à la gouvernance ou à la réglementation du client.
  3. Vous maîtrisez au moins un grand cloud (Google Cloud, Azure ou AWS) ainsi que les fondamentaux de la sécurité et du réseau : IAM, gestion des secrets, architecture réseau.
  4. Vous avez rédigé des dossiers d’architecture (HLD et LLD) qui ont servi de base à une équipe de delivery.
  5. Vous avez codé pendant une partie significative de votre parcours. Aujourd'hui, vous savez lire du code, challenger un design et dire ce qu'exige un système en production : CI/CD, monitoring, gestion des incidents.
  6. Vous avez déjà cadré et chiffré une solution, par exemple pour une proposition commerciale ou un plan projet.
  7. Vous avez défendu une architecture à la fois devant une direction métier ou un comité de direction, et devant les équipes sécurité et exploitation, en reliant la valeur business, les choix techniques et le plan de delivery.

Un plus, pas un prérequis :

  • Architecture de plateformes agentiques : RAG, orchestration multi-agents, choix des technologies couche par couche.
  • Gouvernance des données à l’échelle d’une grande entreprise : data mesh, gestion des accès.
  • Plateformes on premise, hybrides ou souveraines, basées sur des technologies open source ou sur Kubernetes.
  • Standards de run : SLA, PRA et PCA.
  • Une expérience de CTO, de tech lead ou dans un rôle au contact des clients.
  • Une certification d’architecture cloud.
  • Une pratique régulière des coding agents.

Ce poste n'est probablement pas pour vous si votre expertise porte sur une seule plateforme ou un seul éditeur et que vous souhaitez continuer à l'approfondir. Ni si construire et écrire du code est ce qui vous anime le plus : le rôle d'AI Applied Engineer vous correspondra mieux.

Pas besoin de cocher toutes les cases pour postuler : si vous avez l’essentiel des indispensables et l’envie d’apprendre le reste, parlons-en.

Process de recrutement :

  • HR Interview (30-45 min) : Échange sur votre parcours, vos compétences managériales et l'adéquation culturelle avec un Talent Acquisition Specialist.
  • Architecture Case  (60 min) : Session d'architecture avec un AI Architect basé en France sur un cas basé sur une vraie mission.
  • US / Manager Interview (60 min) : Échange avec un Director / Partner pour évaluer le fit managérial, opérationnel et la posture client.

Rémunération : Package :  75 000 € à 85 000 € brut annuel (fixe) + 8 000 € de variable, selon expérience et séniorité.

Présentation de l’entreprise

Artefact est un cabinet de conseil spécialisé en data et en intelligence artificielle, qui accompagne les entreprises pour transformer ces technologies en impact business concret et mesurable.

A la croisée du conseil, de la data et de la technologie, nos 2 500 collaborateurs dans 27 pays mettent leurs expertises en commun pour concevoir, développer et déployer des solutions qui répondent aux enjeux de transformation de nos clients.

Envie d'en savoir plus? Découvrez Artefact, nos expertises et notre culture : https://www.artefact.com

Chez Artefact, nous sommes convaincus que la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des perspectives fait la richesse de nos équipes. Nous nous engageons à offrir un environnement inclusif et des opportunités équitables, où chacune et chacun peut évoluer et exprimer pleinement son potentiel. Nos recrutements reposent sur les compétences, le potentiel et l'adéquation avec le rôle.

title: Manager (m/w/d) Einkaufsberatung
descriptionHtml:
Deine Rolle bei ProcuVia

title: Manager Service Operations & AI
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij een ervaren IT Operations Manager die niet alleen een supportorganisatie kan aansturen, maar ook kansen ziet om dienstverlening slimmer en efficiënter te maken met AI? Dan hebben wij een interessante uitdaging voor je.

Voor Fivespark, een ambitieuze Managed Service Provider in Amstelveen, zoeken wij een Manager Service Operations & AI. In deze veelzijdige functie combineer je operationeel leiderschap met procesverbetering, automatisering en de verdere ontwikkeling van een eigen AI-agent.

Je krijgt de verantwoordelijkheid over een team van 12 supportprofessionals én speelt een belangrijke rol in de transformatie naar een steeds verder geautomatiseerde IT-dienstverlening.

Over Fivespark

Fivespark is een innovatieve Managed Service Provider die bedrijven en overheden ondersteunt met moderne IT-oplossingen.

De organisatie werkt aan de Managed Service Provider van de toekomst, waarin automatisering, kunstmatige intelligentie en datagedreven processen een steeds grotere rol spelen.

Een belangrijk onderdeel hiervan is Sparkle, een intern ontwikkelde AI-agent die nu al ondersteunt bij ticketregistratie, triage, klantvragen en routering. De ambitie is om Sparkle verder te ontwikkelen tot een volwaardige digitale collega die steeds meer operationele processen zelfstandig en betrouwbaar kan uitvoeren.

De organisatie kenmerkt zich door korte lijnen, een informele werksfeer en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en verantwoordelijkheid.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Manager Service Operations & AI ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dagelijkse aansturing en verdere professionalisering van de tweedelijns supportorganisatie. Tegelijkertijd speel je een centrale rol in het ontwikkelen en implementeren van AI en automatisering.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan uit vier belangrijke onderdelen.

Leidinggeven aan de supportorganisatie

  • Je geeft leiding aan een team van 12 tweedelijns supportmedewerkers.

  • Je coacht en ontwikkelt medewerkers en zorgt voor duidelijke prioriteiten, structuur en samenwerking.

  • Je bewaakt de kwaliteit, capaciteit, continuïteit en prestaties van de dienstverlening.

  • Je signaleert knelpunten en vertaalt deze naar concrete verbeteracties.

Doorontwikkelen van AI-agent Sparkle

  • Je bent functioneel eigenaar van Sparkle en bepaalt mede de visie, roadmap en prioriteiten.

  • Je vertaalt operationele uitdagingen naar praktische AI-toepassingen.

  • Je zorgt ervoor dat Sparkle veilig, betrouwbaar en gebruiksvriendelijk functioneert.

  • Je werkt samen met technische specialisten aan de verdere ontwikkeling van deze digitale collega.

Processen verbeteren en automatiseren

  • Je analyseert bestaande operationele processen en identificeert mogelijkheden voor automatisering.

  • Je optimaliseert workflows, kennisbanken en werkinstructies.

  • Je zorgt voor een goede samenwerking tussen medewerkers en AI.

  • Je draagt bij aan de ambitie om minimaal 75% van de standaard operationele processen met AI te ondersteunen of volledig te automatiseren.

Verandering begeleiden

  • Je werkt samen met Operations, Software Development, Business Consultancy en externe partners.

  • Je begeleidt medewerkers in de overgang naar een meer AI-gedreven manier van werken.

  • Je creëert draagvlak, communiceert helder en zorgt ervoor dat veranderingen daadwerkelijk worden doorgevoerd.

Wie zoeken wij?

Wij zoeken een operationeel sterke manager die structuur weet aan te brengen, medewerkers kan motiveren en tegelijkertijd vooruitkijkt naar de mogelijkheden van nieuwe technologie.

Je begrijpt hoe een IT-supportorganisatie werkt, weet hoe je processen beheersbaar en voorspelbaar maakt en krijgt energie van het continu verbeteren van de dienstverlening.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • Hbo- of wo-werk- en -denkniveau.

  • Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring binnen Managed Services, ICT Operations of IT Service Management.

  • Ervaring met het aansturing, coachen en ontwikkelen van operationele teams.

  • Goede kennis van ITIL-processen en servicemanagement.

  • Affiniteit met AI, automatisering en digitale innovatie.

  • Sterke analytische en organisatorische vaardigheden.

  • Het vermogen om technische mogelijkheden te vertalen naar concrete operationele verbeteringen.

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en ervaring met verandermanagement.

Je hoeft geen AI-developer te zijn. We zoeken juist iemand die begrijpt hoe je AI en automatisering succesvol inzet binnen een operationele IT-organisatie en medewerkers hierin weet mee te nemen.

Wat kun je verwachten?

Je komt rechtstreeks in dienst bij onze opdrachtgever en krijgt een sleutelrol binnen een organisatie die volop investeert in de toekomst van IT-dienstverlening.

Je kunt rekenen op:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris van €4.487 tot €6.494, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.

  • Een mobiliteitsbudget van €850 per maand, vrij in te zetten op de manier die bij jou past.

  • Een fulltime dienstverband.

  • Flexibele werkmogelijkheden en ruimte om hybride te werken.

  • Veel zelfstandigheid en directe invloed op de ontwikkeling van de organisatie.

  • Ruime mogelijkheden voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling.

  • De kans om actief bij te dragen aan innovatieve AI- en automatiseringsprojecten.

  • Een informele en professionele werkomgeving met korte lijnen.

  • Een betrokken team van collega's dat samenwerkt aan verbetering en innovatie.

Waarom is dit een interessante functie?

Wat deze rol bijzonder maakt, is de combinatie van peoplemanagement, operationele verantwoordelijkheid en AI-innovatie.

Je krijgt niet alleen de opdracht om een bestaande supportorganisatie goed te laten functioneren, maar ook om deze klaar te maken voor de toekomst.

Daarbij krijg je de ruimte om processen structureel te verbeteren, nieuwe technologie toe te passen en daadwerkelijk invloed uit te oefenen op de manier waarop IT-dienstverlening wordt georganiseerd.

Een mooie uitdaging voor een ervaren Service Delivery Manager, IT Operations Manager of Support Manager die toe is aan een volgende stap.

Interesse?

Wil jij leidinggeven aan een IT-supportorganisatie én een belangrijke rol spelen in de verdere ontwikkeling van AI binnen Managed Services?

Dan komen wij graag met je in contact!

title: Marketing Data Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world’s first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Marketing Data Analyst

Location: Weybridge, Surrey, United Kingdom

Established in 2004, Inside Ideas Group is a rapidly growing global agency network that helps clients drive their businesses forward from the inside. We partner with over 300 clients in more than 40 countries, delivering ideas, technology and creativity that make a measurable impact. 

As part of The Brandtech Group, we are pioneers in using advanced AI technologies to transform the way we create, optimise and deliver work. Our AI capabilities enhance efficiency, support smart decision making and unlock new levels of creativity for our teams and clients. 

We are now looking for a skilled Data Analyst to join our onsite team supporting in London. 

About the Role 

As the Data Analyst, you will be responsible for delivering insight that drives improvements across the full commercial ecosystem spanning customer experience on, retailer investment effectiveness, marketing and sales performance, and the broader post-purchase, onboarding and promotional landscape. 

A core part of your remit will be the design, build and ongoing management of a marketing and sales performance dashboard, underpinned by Google BigQuery and delivered in Looker Studio. This will serve as a critical decision-making tool for marketing, e-commerce, retail and CX teams surfacing insight such as campaign uplift, halo effects, retailer investment impact and share performance across products and markets. 

Alongside this, you will analyse customer journeys, benchmark competitors, oversee content performance and support the planning and execution of onboarding and e-commerce promotions using platforms like GWI to create digital personas and audience profiles. 

You will collaborate closely with CX, marketing, product and e-commerce teams as well as HQ and local market stakeholders to ensure insight informs decisions at every stage. 

This role requires strong analytical capability, expertise in data modelling and SQL, and the ability to translate complex commercial questions into dashboard logic and actionable recommendations. 

What You Will Be Doing 

Marketing & Sales Performance Analytics  

  • Design, build and maintain a marketing and sales performance dashboard in Looker Studio, underpinned by BigQuery, combining sell-out sales data, market volume and share data, and campaign activity logs. 
  • Define the underlying data model, transform source files and design the reporting layer to support consistent, scalable KPI delivery. 
  • Identify and quantify the impact of retailer investment, including uplift in sales and market share during campaign periods. 
  • Analyse correlations between campaign activity and commercial performance to determine which marketing levers are most effective. 
  • Measure and report on halo effects across products and retailers resulting from promotional and campaign activity. 
  • Define and calculate key performance metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
  • Work with GFK or other syndicated market data sources to enrich performance analysis with market volume and share context. 

Customer Experience & Digital Analytics 

  • Conduct analysis of the current customer experience, including user behaviour, content and campaign performance and conversion pathways. 
  • Benchmark key customer journeys against competitor websites to identify gaps and opportunities. 
  • Provide regular insight into paid promotions, post-purchase experience and customer satisfaction trends. 
  • Support planning, optimisation and operational management of post-purchase and onboarding experience. 
  • Analyse content utilisation, engagement and drop-off points, and recommend enhancements. 
  • Collaborate with HQ and local teams on onboarding content production and implementation. 
  • Support feature management including evaluation, testing performance and monitoring adoption, with ongoing analysis of content effectiveness and customer experience updates. 
  • Reporting, Dashboards & Stakeholder Insight 
  • Build and maintain dashboards, reports and ad hoc analyses across customer experience, onboarding, e-commerce, retail performance and promotion activity. 
  • Translate data into clear insights that guide decision-making within marketing, CX, digital and commercial teams. 
  • Present findings clearly to stakeholders at all levels, ensuring insight is embedded in planning and operational processes. 
  • Use platforms like GWI to build digital personas and audience profiles that support broader marketing planning. 

What You Need to Be Great in This Role 

Essential 

  • Proven experience as a data or insight analyst within digital, e-commerce, retail, marketing or agency environments. 
  • Strong proficiency in Google BigQuery and advanced SQL, including data modelling and reporting layer design. 
  • Hands-on experience building dashboards in Looker Studio, with a clear understanding of how to structure underlying data models for robust, scalable dashboard performance. 
  • Demonstrable experience combining sell-out sales, market share and campaign activity datasets to generate commercial insight. 
  • Ability to define and calculate metrics including uplift, baseline, market share, activity intensity and halo effects. 
  • Strong marketing analytics capability, including campaign effectiveness measurement across paid and promotional channels. 
  • Good understanding of digital customer journeys, content performance metrics and e-commerce KPIs. 
  • Experience with analytics platforms such as Google Analytics GA4, Adobe Analytics or similar. 
  • Excellent communication and storytelling ability — capable of translating complex business questions into dashboard logic and presenting findings clearly to non-technical audiences. 
  • Experience working with multi-market teams and managing stakeholder expectations across business functions. 
  • A passion for data-driven decision-making and an interest in how AI can enhance analytics workflows. 

Preferred: 

  • Proficiency in Python (pandas) for data transformation, automation and workflow scripting. 
  • Broader experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), including automating data ingestion and transformation workflows. 
  • Experience working in retail, e-commerce or retailer media environments. 
  • Familiarity with GfK or other syndicated market data sources. 
  • Experience with additional BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

title: Marketing Lead (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
bunch is building the backbone of private markets. We are enabling next-gen fund operations with one integrated system that combines secure data infrastructure, AI-powered workflows and expert fund services. If you value ownership, growth through real responsibility, and working with a thoughtful, ambitious team, this role might be for you.

Your Role

As Marketing Lead, you turn marketing into a reliable source of qualified pipeline across the UK, Luxembourg and Germany. You report to the Co-Founder and own the marketing plan, budget and team.

Our buyers are GPs, CFOs, COOs and fund operations teams at VC and PE managers. Trust in this market comes from expertise, references and the institutions they already rely on, and almost nobody speaks to the CFO and operations team directly. We will. The founders set the company narrative; you build the engine that carries it to market.

Top priorities

Own marketing’s pipeline contribution

  • Set marketing’s pipeline target by market with the CEO and own the result: qualified pipeline in euros across the UK, Luxembourg and Germany.

  • Define and run the marketing plan and budget for each market, and decide which programmes to scale and which to stop.

  • Grow our presence beyond our current client base and build our position with larger fund managers.

Build the engine across three vectors

  • Content and credibility: a weekly publishing cadence built on what our fund specialists, founders and clients know (operational deep dives, migration and capital-call guides, case studies with named clients), co-publications and webinars with the institutions and voices our buyers trust, and the data and insights lane: bunch as the source the market and journalists call about European private markets operations. You orchestrate; you run the writer.

  • Field: an events programme you produce in-house for fund CFOs and COOs, who rarely attend the investor events, built as a ladder: a 10-person series per market, seller-owned events, partner events with law firms, auditors and banks, and from there larger flagship formats, eventually a bunch conference.

  • Growth and online: with our Growth Marketing Manager and our sales ops and data team, the digital channels, pooled audiences and the HubSpot attribution and MQL→SQL layer that turn attention into qualified pipeline.

Own positioning and product marketing, with Product

  • Positioning and messaging by tier, release go-to-market, and sales enablement (one-pagers, battlecards, demo narratives). Product owns the roadmap and release notes; you own how the market hears about them.

  • Become an expert in our product: sit with client onboarding and the fund specialists until you can demo and explain the platform yourself.

Work hand in hand with sales

  • Run the marketing surround on named target accounts in HubSpot and hand engagement signals on to the sales team, so their next touch lands warm. Sellers own their accounts; marketing never emails a prospect one-to-one.

descriptionHtml:
Über Valova

Wir entwickeln KI-Software für Krankenhäuser, die administrative Prozesse in Dokumentation, Kodierung und Abrechnung automatisiert. Damit entlasten wir Klinikteams, sichern Erlöse und schaffen mehr Zeit für Patient.

Unser ambitioniertes Team aus Medizin, Technologie und Business arbeitet daran, die Krankenhausverwaltung nachhaltig zu verändern.

Warum diese Rolle zählt

In der MD-Prüfung werden Erlöse gesichert oder verloren. Jede verpasste Frist, jede fehlende Unterlage und jede schwache Begründung kostet Kliniken Geld, das sie längst erwirtschaftet haben, und ab 2027 steigen die Prüfquoten deutlich. Valova ist gebaut, um das zu ändern, aber nur, wenn unsere Software MD-Prüfungen so gut versteht wie die besten Expert:innen auf beiden Seiten des Tisches.

Genau hier kommst Du ins Spiel. Als unsere MD-Expertin bzw. unser MD-Experte sorgst Du dafür, dass Valova den Prüfprozess von Anfang bis Ende beherrscht, und bringst unser Produkt in den Klinikalltag. Du bist die Brücke zwischen Prüfpraxis und Code und zwischen unserem Team und den Menschen, die täglich mit Valova arbeiten.

Was Du bewirkst, siehst Du schwarz auf weiß: in weniger verlorenen Prüfungen, erfolgreichen Widersprüchen und Stunden, die das Medizincontrolling zurückgewinnt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Valova die MD-Prüfung beibringen: Du übersetzt Prüfgegenstände, Fristen nach PrüfvV und die Prüfquotensystematik in klare fachliche Anforderungen.

  • Prüfrisiken früh erkennen: Du entwickelst Regeln und Testfälle, die prüfanfällige Fälle und Dokumentationslücken erkennen, bevor die Rechnung rausgeht.

  • Die Verteidigung aufbauen: Du legst fest, wie Valova für jeden Fall eine belegbare Argumentation vorbereitet, von der Unterlagenauswahl bis zum Widerspruch.

  • Veränderungen im Blick behalten: Du verfolgst PrüfvV, Prüfquoten und Rechtsprechung und bringst Änderungen ins Produkt.

Was Du mitbringst

  • Fundierte Ausbildung: Eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung in einem Gesundheitsfachberuf mit Weiterbildung zur Kodierfachkraft oder im Medizincontrolling, oder ein Medizinstudium.

  • MD-Erfahrung: Mindestens drei Jahre im MD-Prüfgeschehen, idealerweise als Gutachter:in beim Medizinischen Dienst, alternativ im Medizincontrolling einer Klinik.

  • Sicher im Detail: Du kennst Dich mit ICD-10-GM, OPS, DKR und PrüfvV aus und weißt, woran ein Gutachten scheitert.

  • Präzises Denken: Du hinterfragst gern Prozesse und beschreibst Regeln so genau, dass Software sie umsetzen kann.

  • Kommunikationsstärke: Du bist im Gespräch mit Ärzt:innen, MD, Kostenträgern und Technik gleichermaßen sicher.

  • Ein Plus: Erfahrung mit KIS- oder Prüfmanagement-Software (z. B. Orbis, SAP IS-H, i.s.h.med) oder Software-Einführungen, Erfahrung mit Sozialgerichtsverfahren sowie erste Erfahrung mit Datenanalyse (Excel, SQL) oder KI-Anwendungen.

  • Dir fehlen ein oder zwei Punkte, aber Du bist überzeugt, die richtige Person für diese Rolle zu sein? Dann bewirb Dich trotzdem. Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen.

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Flexible Arbeitszeit. 30 bis 40 Stunden pro Woche, Du entscheidest. Unbefristeter Vertrag.

  • 100 % remote in ganz Deutschland, optional mit dem Team in München oder Berlin.

  • Faires Gehalt, orientiert an Deiner Erfahrung und mindestens auf Klinik-Niveau. Die konkrete Spanne nennen wir Dir schon im ersten Gespräch.

  • Direkter Draht zu den Gründern. Du arbeitest täglich mit Sophia, Ärztin und ehemalige McKinsey-Beraterin, und Christian, der zwei Health-Tech-Startups gegründet und ein Jahrzehnt lang klinische Systeme gebaut hat. Keine Hierarchieebenen, kein wochenlanges Warten auf Freigaben.

title: Meewerk Stage Continuous Improvement (Power BI & Power Automate)
descriptionHtml:
Ben jij analytisch sterk en wil je impact maken binnen een internationale organisatie? Dan moeten we jou hebben!

Jouw rol
Bij Heras krijg je de kans om als stagiair bij te dragen aan het Nimble-programma: een strategisch verbeterprogramma gericht op het vereenvoudigen en automatiseren van bedrijfsprocessen. Als stagiair werk je aan het verbeteren van processen binnen domeinen zoals sales, projecten in nieuwbouw en finance. Je analyseert hoe processen vandaag werken en vertaalt dit naar slimme oplossingen met behulp van Power BI en Power Automate. Je levert concrete procesverbeteringen, procesbeschrijvingen, automatiseringen en Power BI dashboards voor operationele en financiële sturing aan alsmede werkende Power Automate flows. Tenslotte lever je een meetbare bijdrage aan efficiëntie (bijv. tijdbesparing of minder fouten).

Jouw werkzaamheden

  • In kaart brengen van huidige processen en knelpunten.

  • Automatiseren van handmatige processen met Power Automate.

  • Ontwikkelen van dashboards en rapportages in Power BI (zonder daadwerkelijk programmeren).

  • Verbeteren van datakwaliteit en inzicht in KPI’s.

  • Samenwerken met business teams en IT-specialisten.

Benieuwd naar de ervaringen van een stagiair bij Heras? De eerste indruk: dynamisch in plaats van stoffig - Heras Nederland

Wie zijn wij?
Heras is een vooraanstaand Europese totaalleverancier van permanente perimeter protection oplossingen. Wij opereren vanuit meer dan 24 landen en hebben meer dan 1100 hoogopgeleide experts in dienst. Opgericht in 1952, vervult en overtreft Heras de beveiligingsbehoeften van klanten in heel Europa. Het is dankzij deze staat van dienst, samen met het blijvend groeiende vakmanschap van onze medewerkers, dat wij ons experts in perimeter protection kunnen noemen. 

Onze cultuur, werksfeer & waarden
Wij hebben binnen Heras een informele, open en toegankelijke cultuur. We zijn trots op ons werk, producten en dienstverlening. We hebben een no-nonsense mentaliteit, tonen ondernemerschap, zijn energiek en werken allemaal gedisciplineerd volgens de drie kernwaarden; betrokkenheid, betrouwbaarheid en deskundigheid. Heras is gewaardeerd op een Ecovadis Zilveren Ster en dat plaatst ons bij de duurzaamste 15% bedrijven van Nederland. Onze doelstelling is streven naar Goud in de komende jaren en volledig CO2 neutraal zijn in 2050. Wil je hier meer over weten? https://www.heras.nl/over-heras/kwaliteit-en-veiligheid/


Jouw profiel

  • Je volgt een HBO- of WO-opleiding (bijv. Bedrijfskunde, Technische Bedrijfskunde, IT, Data of Finance)

  • Je zoekt een 3e of 4e jaars stage waarbij de nadruk ligt op meewerken of bouwen van dashboarding

  • Je hebt interesse in procesverbetering en data

  • Je hebt basiskennis van of affiniteit met Power BI en/of Power Automate

  • Je bent analytisch, proactief en communicatief sterk

  • Onze voorkeur gaat uit naar een kandidaat die de Nederlandse taal goed beheerst

  • Hoewel het niet zelf programmeren beterft vindt je het wel leuk om zelf oplossingen te verzinnen en te testen

Wat bieden wij jou?
Bij Heras bieden wij jou een meewerkstage binnen een zeer dynamische omgeving waarbij elke dag anders is met veel variatie en afwisseling. Je draagt je steentje bij aan een veilige omgeving en helpt om onze samenleving te beschermen. Tenslotte zijn er volop mogelijkheden om jezelf te ontwikkelen en door te groeien. Wij bieden het volgende:

  • Stagevergoeding van €500,- bruto o.b.v. fulltime

  • 2 verlofdagen per maand

  • Flexibiliteit en vrijheid

  • Reiskostenvergoeding van 0,23ct per kilometer tussen 5- en 60km enkele reis

  • Laptop voor gebruik bij Heras

Iets voor jou?

title: Mid-Market Account Executive - France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers — the bar for entry is high, but those who execute are well rewarded for it.

While the rest of the tech scene is scaling back, our France team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €20k to €200k, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded with the stability of a market leader, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in France, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role you will:

  • Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline.
  • Get In Early: The France Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now.
  • Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.
  • Navigate Complexity: Move beyond feature-pushing to sell high-level ROI and safety outcomes to sophisticated economic buyers (MDs and FDs) in the field and the boardroom.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • The Winning DNA: A minimum of 18 months in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.
  • Verified Overachievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment. We'll want to see this on your resume.
  • Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt more than the brand name on your previous CV.
  • Native French language

An ideal candidate also offers:

  • Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.
  • A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don't rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.
  • A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Mid-Market Account Executive - France
descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is a fortress in a volatile market. We are a $1.9B ARR, NYSE-listed powerhouse that sells essential technology to the physical operations powering the global economy. This is a seat built for high performers and incredibly driven individuals who want to accelerate their careers — the bar for entry is high, but those who execute are well rewarded for it.

While the rest of the tech scene is scaling back, our France team continued to perform above 100% last year. We are looking for territory owners who want to manage deal cycles from €20k to €200k, selling a complex suite of 15+ products to 8 different personas, including MDs and Finance Directors. If you want to be pushed to your limit and rewarded with the stability of a market leader, this is the place.

Whilst the role can be worked remotely anywhere in France, there is a need to visit clients in the region as required (typically fortnightly basis).

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • Your mantra is #alwaysbeprospecting: The world of operations is vast. Your customers are often out in the field and the best way to catch them is live on the phone. Samsara's top reps do constant research to find companies and contacts to expand their pipeline.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you'll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You are a life-long learner: Samsara sales are complex. You will need to learn about businesses where you previously had little knowledge. The payoff is big but you have to be willing to put in the work.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven't been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara's high-performance Sales culture means you'll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.

In this role you will:

  • Own your destiny: Operate as a pure revenue leader, responsible for 80-90% net-new logo acquisition through self-sourced pipeline.
  • Get In Early: The France Mid-Market is a high-achieving segment in the company. The window to build something significant is open right now.
  • Sharpen Your Edge: Access elite enablement — Command the Message and MEDDPICC coaching — built to make you a more effective closer.
  • Navigate Complexity: Move beyond feature-pushing to sell high-level ROI and safety outcomes to sophisticated economic buyers (MDs and FDs) in the field and the boardroom.

Minimum requirements for this role:

  • The Winning DNA: A minimum of 18 months in a full-cycle, outbound-heavy SaaS closing role. You must have a proven history of building your own pipe from scratch.
  • Verified Overachievement: A track record of hitting and exceeding quota in a competitive, complex environment. We'll want to see this on your resume.
  • Strategic Grit: Experience managing multi-stakeholder deal cycles and technical POCs. We value your ability to hunt more than the brand name on your previous CV.
  • Native French language

An ideal candidate also offers:

  • Intellectual Curiosity: You are eager to learn the inner workings of diverse industries, from waste management to food distribution, to better align our technology with their operational pain.
  • A Repeatable Sales Framework: You don't rely on luck or intuition. You have a structured methodology that delivers success and you understand that consistent, high-quality inputs lead to predictable results.
  • A Data-Minded Approach: You are a student of your own funnel. You understand how to structure your activity—prospecting volume, discovery depth, and multi-threading—to ensure a consistent output and forecast accuracy.
  • Continuous Process Iteration: You possess a relentless drive for self-improvement. You are someone who actively seeks feedback, iterates on their approach, and understands that evolving your tactics is the only way to stay ahead of the market.

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in ----- ----- or ----- For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Mid/Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist (Remote - Germany)
descriptionHtml:

🚀 EverAI — Building the Future of AI Companionship

One of the Top 15 Largest & Fastest-Growing AI Companies in the World

At EverAI, we’re shaping what it means to connect with AI. With 50 million users and counting, we're not just building products — we're creating entirely new categories.

Our flagship product is the world’s largest AI companionship platform, redefining relationships for millions. It is governed by our proprietary moderation system, EverGuard — an internal AI designed to ensure everything we build is safe, ethical, and human-first.

And we’re only just getting started!

Alexis Soulopoulos [CEO]

Thomas Lacroix [Co-founder & CMO]

Maruša Fasano [CFO/Legal]

• Ex-CFO/M&A @Curatible (exited to Blackstone)

• Ex-President of the Board @SotremoSA (exited)

• Co-founder/CFO @SoftOne (exited)

Your Role

We scaled to 50 million users in just 2 years with a lean team of 100 people. Last year, we doubled our headcount.

Now, we’re scaling again, and the next hires will shape what EverAI looks like at 100+ people. As our third Talent Acquisition Specialist, you’ll be central to that build, as you’re joining at a defining stage.

You’ll work closely with our CEO, Alexis, and partner with leaders across the business to help assemble the team behind one of the fastest-growing AI products globally. We hire internationally and across every function of the company, with a strong focus on tech, bringing together people from leading tech hubs around the world.

You’ll also have the opportunity to influence how Talent Acquisition evolves as we grow: refining our internal workflows, experimenting with new AI tools, launching employer branding initiatives, testing sourcing strategies that keep our quality bar high, and so on.

Key Mission

Identify, attract, and land top global talent, while helping build a recruitment stack that matches the scale and ambition of a company serving 50M users worldwide.

Key Responsibilities

You will be responsible for:

Talent Mapping & Sourcing:

  • Global Talent Scouting: Help map and engage elite talent from Tier 1 tech hubs and companies worldwide. You’ll identify and connect with candidates who aren’t actively applying through thoughtful outreach and strong networking.

  • Smart Sourcing: Support the implementation of an AI-first recruitment stack. You’ll use tools, from AI agents to niche technical communities and unconventional channels, to help us find exceptional talent

  • Relationship Building: Maintain long-term relationships with passive talent globally to ensure we stay ahead of hiring needs as we continue scaling

Candidate Experience & Evaluation:

  • World-Class Candidate Experience: Own the candidate journey from the first discovery call to the final close. Ensure every interaction with EverAI, whether candidates join us or not, is clear, respectful, and high-quality

  • Interviews and Screenings: Conduct structured interviews to assess technical aptitude and cultural alignment, and provide concise, actionable summaries for Hiring Managers and Leadership

Process Innovation & Collaboration:

  • Hiring Operations: Work closely with Founders and Team Leads to improve hiring workflows, remove friction, and strengthen how we operate as we grow past 100+ employees

  • Employer Branding and other Initiatives: Contribute to creative initiatives and content that position EverAI as the #1 destination for the world’s best AI talent

Your Qualifications

Must-haves

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in recruitment, with at least 2 years in tech recruitment

  • Experience working in a start-up or scale-up environment

  • Global sourcing experience: You have a track record of helping attract talent from major tech hubs (USA, EU, LATAM, etc.)

  • Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and other recruitment tools

  • You thrive in a high-trust environment where you are empowered to learn, improve processes, and make an impact

Others

🗣 Strong communication & collaborative skills (perfectly fluent in English)

🎯 Goal-oriented, ownership and commitment

⚡️ Doer mindset - we are moving fast and we need people who can find the right balance between executing, planning and strategy

🧢 Humble - willing to learn, open to feedback

🍭 #NSFW - you are comfortable hiring for products that are based on uncensored models and content

Bonus points

  • Experience in AI recruitment or familiarity with the AI space

  • Exposure to employer branding, compensation benchmarking, or broader TA initiatives

Why EverAI?

📈 Exponential Growth: From 50M users in 2 years, to 100M next — and 500M beyond

🚀 Track Record of Category-Creating Innovation: We consistently launch world-first AI applications — setting the pace, not following it

🌍 Global Impact: Top-tier user growth, real-world adoption, and cultural relevance

🧠 Proven Leadership: A senior team that’s launched, scaled, and exited & IPO’d multiple scale ups — now fully focused on reshaping AI companionship

👥 Elite Remote Team: 100% remote and built to win — world-class talent from Tier 1 tech companies, with a culture of ownership, velocity, and radical creativity

🛡️ Ethical Core: Our AI ecosystem is governed by EverGuard, our proprietary AI moderation technology, ensuring responsible development at scale

What We Offer

✍️ Contract Type: We prefer B2B, but we’re flexible, what matters is long-term commitment and impact
📍 Work From Anywhere: Fully remote. Choose the environment where you do your best work
🏝️ Paid Time Off: 4 weeks (20 working days) of PTO per year to recharge and reset
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Annual Gathering: A yearly in-person meetup to connect, brainstorm, and celebrate wins together
❤️‍🩹 Health & Wellness Support: Monthly allowance of100 USD for health insurance expenses & access to unlimited 1:1 sessions with psychologists and lifestyle experts through OpenUp (also available to up to three of your family members)
🏢 Co-Working Space Budget: Work from a co-working space up to twice per month (35 EUR / 40 USD per visit) to stay inspired and connected
📚 Learning Budget: Dedicated funds to support your professional growth: courses, books, conferences, events, or certifications
💻 Company Laptop & Equipment: Laptop provided + monitor budget up to 250 USD + keyboard/mouse/mic/headphones budget up to 150 USD
⚡ AI Tools Access: Premium access to ChatGPT, Hugging Face, Claude Code, and any other tool needed to excel at your job, power your ideas and workflows

🎯 Top Tier Talent Is Our Multiplier

We’re a fully remote group of A-players from Tier 1 tech, led by an exec team who’ve launched, scaled, and exited multiple companies. We move fast, and care deeply about what we build — and who we build it with.

We’re looking for exceptional talent ready to ship & distribute world-first AI products at scale, fast, and co-create with us this category-defining business.

If that’s you — reach out and apply!

title: ML Researcher
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Base Compute is an AI inference lab. Our mission is to bring AGI on device. We believe in a world where everyone has access to intelligence: fast, private and always available on your device.

We’re building the infrastructure for the next generation of on-device AI, from silicon-level optimizations to distributed inference systems.

We’re working on hard problems at the intersection of inference efficiency, model intelligence and autonomous research.

The Role

We’re looking for a Founding ML Researcher to work at the frontier of on-device AI. This role is for someone who identifies problems and potentials, designs and executes experiments and derives insights that translate into real-world performance.

You’ll have significant ownership over our research agenda and direct influence on the technical bets the company makes.

What You’ll Work On

  • Inference research: Identifying and validating new approaches to on-device efficiency, including speculative decoding variants, novel quantization schemes and entirely new techniques yet to be discovered

  • Model routing research: Building the intelligence that decides how requests are served between on-device vs. frontier API models

  • Autoresearch pipelines: Designing systems that can autonomously explore, hypothesize and evaluate research ideas that accelerate our R&D loop

  • Evaluations and benchmarks: Developing rigorous evals that measure performance in the real world, outside of clean academic settings

What We’re Looking For

  • PhD in ML or equivalent industry research experience

  • Deep understanding of LLM architectures and the principles of AI inference

  • Expertise in a relevant topic, such as speculative decoding, quantization theory, model distillation, reinforcement learning

  • A track record of producing results that people build on: research papers, open-source projects or blog posts that prove out novel ideas

  • Good communication: the ability to explain complex ideas simply, give honest feedback and document findings in a reproducible way

  • Nice-to-haves:

    • Familiarity with GPU and accelerator architectures and kernel optimization (CUDA, ROCm, Metal, Triton, etc.)

    • Experience deploying models under on-device constraints (memory bandwidth, latency budgets, and thermal and power ceilings)

What We Offer

  • Equity and strong base salary

  • Direct influence on technical direction: your ideas will shape the roadmap

  • Work on genuinely hard problems that haven't been solved yet

  • Small team, fast iteration, low bureaucracy

Location

The team is based in Melbourne and Berlin and works in-person from the office most days. We require strong written and spoken English, since the team collaborates across time zones.

title: MLE, Data Enrichment
descriptionHtml:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Data Enrichment Teams

Our Data Enrichment team builds the ground-truth datasets and classifiers that describe complex driving scenes across Wayve's data corpus. Drawing on Wayve's World Foundation Model, we help teams find rare scenarios, expose performance gaps and develop better perception and driving models, supporting the safety and reliability of Wayve's ADAS and AI Driver products. As a Machine Learning Engineer, Data Enrichment, you will tackle computer vision problems spanning road geometry, spatial relationships, road users and driving behaviour.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

• Work with internal customers to define scene and scenario attributes, dataset requirements and measurable acceptance criteria for annotations and classifiers

• Design and refine annotation tasks and labelling instructions, using pilots, annotator agreement and expert review to resolve ambiguity and measure quality

• Curate and deliver ground-truth datasets for other teams to train and evaluate models, addressing rare scenarios, class imbalance and coverage across countries and vehicle platforms

• Build and evaluate computer vision models that draw on Wayve's World Foundation Model to identify scene attributes and driving behaviours

• Use error analysis to identify gaps in data, labels and model performance, and test approaches to improve them

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

• Ground-truth datasets and classifiers that describe road geometry, spatial relationships, road users and driving behaviour

• Integrating classifiers with enrichment infrastructure to run inference across existing and newly collected driving data, making predictions available for corpus analysis and scenario mining

• Improving reusable tools for annotation, training, evaluation and inference

• Documenting dataset and classifier quality, and communicating limitations to colleagues across disciplines

 

🙌 You should apply if

• You have practical experience developing and evaluating computer vision models for image or video understanding, including interpreting spatial relationships in visual data

• You have strong Python programming skills and experience with a modern machine learning framework such as PyTorch

• You have experience curating training and evaluation datasets and assessing annotation quality, with an understanding of class imbalance, data leakage and representative evaluation

• You have taken machine learning models beyond experimentation into use, with reproducible training, evaluation and inference

• You can investigate model failures and determine whether improvements need better data, clearer labels or changes to the modelling approach

• You can translate an ambiguous customer request into clear technical deliverables and quality criteria, and communicate performance and limitations to colleagues from different disciplines

• Desirable: experience with 3D geometry, multi-camera systems or temporal scene understanding; autonomous driving, ADAS or robotics; adapting pretrained, foundation or vision-language models; human annotation workflows, active learning or model-assisted labelling; SQL, distributed data processing and batch inference

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins)

  • Competency Interviews (Programming in Python and MLE domain interview)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (systems design and hiring manager interview)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment.

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

 

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

At Propellerhead, the Technical Strategist role focuses on the delivery of resilient software systems that power everything from complex infrastructure to innovative new platforms. This role works alongside our Product Strategists to shape the technical specification and platform direction for a portfolio of client products.

We’re looking for someone who combines architectural insight with a strong hands-on engineering background and a genuinely AI-native way of working. You will have spent the formative part of your career as a software developer and still be confident with understanding the structure of software solutions. You’ll be applying and reinforcing Engineering standards for programming, and shape the technical solutions our AI-assisted pipeline builds, in a lean and evolutionary manner. Importantly, you will be responsible for ensuring that client platforms align with our technical strategy. You will work closely with the Chief Technologist and Engineering Principal to apply standards, patterns, and tooling in client contexts, and provide informed input into technical strategy through client platform insights and delivery experience.

Propellerhead operates a hybrid working model (work from our office and from your own home). While you must be based in Auckland for this role, we warmly welcome applications from across New Zealand and internationally who are planning to relocate to Auckland. This particular role requires regular in-person office attendance.

We offer a culture built on trust, continuous learning, and meaningful impact. You'll join a team that values integrity over ego, and clarity over complexity.

If you're looking to contribute your insight and engineering experience to projects that matter - we would like to hear from you.
