title: New Business Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next New Business Account Executive.

About the job

This position is needed to sell into high value ISV, High Tech, AI Native and Enterprise companies. You will play a key role in further growing Twilio’s Communication business across UK/I/Northern Europe. You will be responsible for sourcing new, high value customers as well as driving the sales process from internal leads to qualifying new prospects and handling deals to closure.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Be responsible for net new customer acquisition and driving ACV for a specific set of accounts while maintaining the highest levels of customer satisfaction.
  • Work closely with your SDR and SE teams to own, drive and build intelligent outreach campaigns into new prospects
  • Source new leads and drive sustainable pipeline growth each quarter
  • Master creating pricing proposals, negotiating terms and managing the contract process. Ideally, you also have experience selling communications solutions to a technical and business audience, building trust and mutual respect with technical customers and peers.
  • Are passionate about what you do and you are able to think outside of the box and have extraordinary interpersonal and communication skills to make complex contractual, technical, and financial details sound simple.
  • Able to balance challenging priorities and handle multiple projects/deals at the same time.

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • 4+ years of Sales experience and a track record of personally selling and closing complex solutions to ISVs, high tech, AI Native, enterprise and software companies. 
  • Strong experience identifying, mapping and prospecting accounts
  • Proven success in selling complex, technical solutions such as cloud communications platforms, APIs, Conversational AI and/or enterprise software
  • Experience in account management, developing large enterprise clients, and a history of meeting or exceeding sales targets
  • Background in working within a quota-driven environment with proven ability to close high-value deals (e.g., six to seven figures)
  • Expertise in solution-based selling or consultative selling 
  • Strong negotiation and contract management skills, including handling complex deals with long sales cycles.
  • Prospecting and lead generation skills—ability to develop a pipeline through multiple channels, including direct sales, partnerships, and networking.
  • Ability to build and nurture relationships with C-level executives, decision-makers, cross-functional partners and key stakeholders in large enterprises
  • Strong presentation and negotiation skills
  • Comfortable working in a dynamic / environment. 
  • Familiar working with MEDDPICC sales qualification methodology and other Sales methodologies

Desired:

  • Ideally, you also have experience selling both to a business and technical audience
  • Understanding of the CPaaS & Customer Engagement ecosystem and familiarity with:
    • Cloud communications (voice, SMS, chat, video, etc.).
    • Contact centre agent productivity and Conversational AI
    • APIs and integrations for communication services.
    • Telecommunications industry dynamics.
    • Knowledge of enterprise technology architecture and the technical needs of large organizations, including how CPaaS solutions integrate with existing systems.

Location

This role will be remote and based in UK or Ireland.

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, approximately 25% travel is anticipated to help you connect in-person in a meaningful way. 

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

title: Outcome Testing and Controls Assurance Officer
descriptionHtml:
About Allica Bank

Allica is the UK’s fastest growing company - and the fastest-growing financial technology (Fintech) firm ever. Our purpose is to help established SMEs, one of the last major underserved opportunities in Fintech.

Established SMEs are the backbone of local communities - representing over a third of our economy - yet have been largely neglected both by traditional high street banks and modern fintech providers.

Role Description

This role is responsible for delivering Outcomes Based Testing (OBT), providing independent, evidence-based assurance that Allica is consistently delivering good customer outcomes in line with the FCA's Consumer Duty. The role also undertakes Secondary Controls Testing in accordance with Allica's Risk Management Framework.

The successful candidate will plan and execute a portfolio of testing activities, communicate findings clearly to stakeholders, and agree, monitor, and support action plans through to resolution. They will work collaboratively with Risk Business Partners and the wider First Line of Defence (1LoD) Controls team.

Beyond completing testing against a defined framework, the role requires a proactive and analytical approach. The role holder will identify root causes, drive meaningful remediation, and provide constructive challenge to stakeholders, helping to improve customer outcomes and strengthen Allica's control environment.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Conduct outcome-based testing across Allica’s customer facing journeys to assess whether customer outcomes are consistent with Consumer Duty obligations. 

  • Review customer cases, communications and operational activity to identify potential customer harm, process weaknesses or customer experience issues, including the treatment of vulnerable customers. 

  • Assess both process execution and customer experience, ensuring documentation is complete, communications are clear and customers do not face unnecessary barriers or delays. 

  • Communicate Outcomes Based Testing results clearly to relevant stakeholders, ensuring findings are understood and owned. 

  • Agree appropriate action plans with stakeholders to remediate instances of poor outcomes and track these through to closure. 

  • Deliver Secondary Controls Testing, assessing the design and operating effectiveness to obtain an overall rating for each control, in line with Allica’s Control Testing Standards. 

  • Communicate control testing output to stakeholders and agree action plans where control weaknesses or failures are identified. 

  • Accurately update RiskSmart with control test results, ratings, findings and associated action plans. 

  • Maintain regular engagement with Risk Business Partners across the wider 1LoD Controls team on control testing outputs, sharing themes and supporting a consistent testing approach. 

  • Escalate significant issues, risks or thematic concerns in a timely manner. 

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of Outcomes Based Testing and controls testing methodology, templates and reporting. 

  • Ensure all testing is conducted objectively and independently, in line with Allica's Risk Management Framework and relevant regulatory requirements, including the FCA Consumer Duty and Conduct Rules. 

  • Support reporting and insight through dashboards and analysis, contributing to root cause identification and continuous improvement initiatives.

Personal Attributes & Experience

  • Capable of working in a fast-paced environment, managing complex, competing and alternating priorities across control testing and outcomes based testing with a constant focus on delivery. 

  • Strong analytical and investigative skills, with the ability to identify root causes behind poor customer outcomes or control failures, not just symptoms. 

  • A confident, clear communicator, able to present findings and constructively challenge stakeholders at varying levels of seniority. 

  • Show curiosity and sound judgement when assessing customer journeys and identifying potential customer harm or process weaknesses. 

  • Demonstrate a proactive and solution-focused mindset, with a desire to improve processes and customer experience. 

  • Be able to work independently with minimal supervision, while remaining a collaborative and engaged member of the wider team. 

  • Have experience of controls testing, quality assurance, outcomes-based testing, or 1st/2nd line risk and assurance work, ideally within Financial Services. 

  • Have a working knowledge of the FCA Consumer Duty and Conduct Rules, and how these apply in practice to Allica’s products and supporting customer journeys. 

  • Be explicit in demonstrating where they've gone the extra mile, embraced new challenges, or stood out from their peers in a previous testing, assurance or risk role.

Working at Allica Bank

At Allica Bank we want to ensure our employees have the right tools and environment in which to succeed in their role and in support of our customers.

Our employees are at the heart of everything we do, so our benefits are designed with you in mind:

  • Full onboarding support and continued development opportunities

  • Options for flexible working

  • Regular social activities

  • Pension contributions

  • Discretionary bonus scheme

  • Private health cover

  • Life assurance

  • Family friendly policies including enhanced Maternity & Paternity leave

Don’t tick every box?

Don’t worry if you don’t have all the skills or requirements listed on the job description. If you think you’ll be a good fit, we’d still love to hear from you!

Flexible working

We know the ‘9-to-5’ isn’t right for everyone. That’s why Allica Bank is fully committed to flexible and hybrid working. Please let us know what is best for you and, if we can, we will do our best to accommodate.

Diversity

We’re a diverse bunch here at Allica, with all kinds of experiences, backgrounds and lifestyles. Our openness and differences make us stronger, and we want everybody to feel comfortable bringing as much of themselves to work with them as they like.

title: People — Employment and Labor Law  (France)
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

The Employment & Labour Law role 🇫🇷

Alan is growing fast: new health services, new entities, new countries, and a 2027 People agenda with social elections and many individual situations.

Each of these brings legal obligations, and today we rely mostly on external counsel. In Alan's terms, "compliance" means everything we do to follow a mandatory rule that would become a risk if we got it wrong.

The role makes sure Alan's employment practices are legally secure, pragmatic and humane. You will be our in-house expert on French employment and labour law, for both individual and collective matters. You are a People teammate first, with a strong legal foundation.

Scope

Alan operates in 8 countries.

This role is based in France and covers French employment and labour law.

It works in tandem with the People Compliance owner, who covers the other countries, and with the International Expansion hire for new country openings. Curiosity for other jurisdictions is a plus, but it is not the core of the role.

You will join the People team, work closely with the People Compliance owner, the People lead and the individual situations crew, and be mentored by Alan's Compliance Key Function on how we practise legal topics at Alan.

The People team

The People team is made up of 13 people who work in an environment shaped by Alan's Leadership Principles. Every one of them is a genuine fan of our products (Culture being one of them) and deeply committed to Alan's Prevention and Health mission.

The team covers Learning and Development, Payroll and Admin, Employee Experience and Operational Efficiency, Compliance and Employment Law, Comp and Ben, and M&A and International Expansion.

It is a generalist team: everyone shares core missions, including individual situation management and HRBP responsibilities. Then each person owns one or more cross-functional topics depending on their flavour. In your case: French employment and labour law.

Your missions

On top of the core missions shared across the People team, you will work on a diverse range of high-impact topics:

  • Employment law expertise: be the go-to person on French individual and collective employment law, with a strong focus on working time, night work and on-call rules (astreinte, rest periods), where the rules are strict and a creative, well-grounded approach makes a difference.

  • Legal watch: monitor French labour-law changes, flag what matters for Alan, and use AI agents for legal watch and ongoing compliance checks.

  • Obligations register: turn obligations into simple tools and processes, tracked in a register.

  • Health and safety at work.

  • Audits and inspections: support labour inspections, URSSAF audits and the related compliance reporting.

  • Social dialogue: support the People lead in preparing CSE information-consultations, running the 2027 social elections, and drafting and updating company agreements (working time, profit-sharing, agreements for new services).

  • Corporate structure: work through the People impact of Alan's evolving legal entities, such as which entities sit in the UES and what it means for our agreements.

  • New services: bring a risk-based view early to projects with People impact, such as new health services, and help set up processes that protect Alan while keeping the flexibility and autonomy we want Alaners to have.

  • External counsel: write clear briefs, ask sharper questions, reuse existing frameworks and challenge the advice you receive.

  • Beyond France (occasionally): contribute, when needed, to topics in other countries, alongside the People Compliance owner.

  • Raising the team's expertise: share your legal knowledge with the crew and the wider People team.

  • AI and automation: use them to multiply the impact of your work.

Outcomes within your first months in the team

By 2.5 months

  • You have contributed to a live CSE topic (e.g. preparing an information-consultation) and to at least one other live topic (e.g. working-time or on-call policy, an agreement for a new service).

  • You have shadowed and been reverse-shadowed on individual situation management.

By 5 months

  • You own CSE information-consultations end to end, and a workstream such as a company agreement, with the crew as a sounding board.

  • You are involved in preparing the 2027 social elections.

  • You handle French individual situations without supervision, including the legal analysis.

  • A first legal-watch automation is running.

  • Crew members and leads come to you as the go-to expert on French employment law.

Is this what you are looking for?

You may be a great fit for this role if:

  • You have a legal background in French employment and social law (e.g. M2 in droit social).

  • You have around 4+ years of hands-on experience applying French employment law, typically in a law firm (ideally international), or you are a lawyer who has already moved into a People role.

  • You master both individual and collective matters.

  • You are excellent in French (negotiation level) and professional in English (our internal processes and documentation are in English).

  • You put context before opinion: you understand how Alan works first, then adapt the playbook instead of applying it as is.

  • You put business value before legal reflex: you start from the outcome and creative options, tell material risk from theoretical risk, and give practical answers. You are comfortable with a scale-up's risk appetite.

  • You have a transversal mindset: a strong anchor in labour law, and real appetite to cover compliance, expansion and other topics.

  • You are autonomous: you take initiative, flag risks early and own your outputs.

  • You are rigorous: your work is precise and your writing is clear and concise.

  • You are curious and coachable: open to feedback, with a clear idea of what you want to learn.

  • You are AI-enthusiastic: you already use AI in your daily work and stay critical of the output.

  • You show judgement and discretion with confidential information and sensitive human situations.

Nice-to-have

We are not looking for all of the below. Any one of these can be a strong signal.

  • Hands-on experience with CSE meetings, information-consultations, social elections or company agreements.

  • Experience in the health sector, insurance, a regulated environment or a scale-up.

  • M&A or reorganisation experience.

  • Exposure to other jurisdictions (Belgium, Spain).

Level range

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the C0 - D level range.

title: People Partner
descriptionHtml:
About Radiant

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of the team you've previously managed.

The role

You’ll act as a trusted advisor to managers and employees, providing practical guidance and support across employee relations, performance management, manager coaching and the wider employee lifecycle. Combining hands-on HR expertise with a solutions-focused approach, you’ll help managers navigate complex people matters confidently, ensure consistent and compliant People practices across our global teams, and drive continuous improvement through data, technology and automation as Radiant continues to scale.

What You'll Do

  • Act as the day-to-day point of contact for employees and managers on HR questions across the full employee lifecycle: onboarding, policy interpretation, benefits, and performance management.

  • Managing employee relations, providing expert support and recommending appropriate actions to address queries or problems. Proactively reviewing data to spot employee relations trends and suggest solutions, coaching Managers to tackle issues early on.

  • Track legislative changes, including the Employment Rights Act reforms, and lead their implementation.

  • Maintain accurate employee records and HR systems, and help build out People processes and documentation as the team grows.

 

Compliance

 

  • Help ensure compliance with employment law and best practice across the UK, Europe and the US, in consultation with the HRBP and external counsel as needed.

  • Compliance and risk. Make sure People processes meet UK employment law, data protection requirements, our ISO requirements and Radiant's own policies. Ensure the team keeps policies and manager guidance up to date as legislation changes.

Immigration and visas

  • Help design and run the performance reviews and calibration process.

  • Link performance outcomes to development, promotion and reward decisions.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years in a People Partner, HR Business Partner or senior generalist role, ideally in a scaling tech or high-growth business.

  • Deep, current knowledge of UK employment law and confidence applying it to real situations.

  • CIPD Level 5 or 7, or an employment law qualification.

  • Confident and knowledgeable enough to manage employee relations issues independently, with sound judgement on when to escalate.

descriptionHtml:
Your mission

At Sunday Natural, we’re on a mission to bring premium wellness products to millions of customers across Europe. As we accelerate our growth, we are expanding our acquisition strategy and exploring new ways to connect with customers.

As our Performance Marketing Manager – Native Ads (all genders), you will help build and scale Native Advertising as a new acquisition channel, combining creative storytelling, data-driven campaign management and end-to-end funnel optimisation to drive sustainable growth.

  

Your role:

You will take ownership of our Native Advertising campaigns, from developing compelling ad creatives and advertorials to managing campaigns across platforms such as Taboola and Outbrain and Meta.

Combining creative execution with analytical excellence, you will build, test and optimise entire conversion funnels, leveraging AI-powered tools, performance tracking and continuous experimentation to turn engaging content into measurable business results.

Your mandate: Establish Native Advertising as a scalable, high-performing acquisition channel – transforming creative ideas and data-driven insights into sustainable customer growth.

  

Your Responsibilities & Impact

Native Advertising & Campaign Optimisation

  • Channel Development: Establish and scale Native Advertising as a new customer acquisition channel, identifying growth opportunities and shaping its strategy.

  • Campaign Ownership: Independently plan, launch and manage campaigns on platforms such as Taboola and Outbrain, continuously optimising targeting, placements and budgets to maximise profitability.


Creative Development & Conversion Funnels

  • Creative Strategy & Execution: Independently develop compelling ad creatives, headlines and visuals that capture attention and drive engagement.

Analytics, Tracking & Collaboration

What You Bring:

Proven expertise in managing and optimising campaigns on platforms such as Taboola, Outbrain, Meta or comparable networks. Experience in B2C/D2C, particularly nutrition, food, supplements or wellness, is a strong plus.

  • Creative & Content Expertise: Strong copywriting and storytelling skills, with hands-on experience creating conversion-focused advertorials, ad creatives and landing page content.

  • Analytical Mindset & Reporting: You confidently analyse performance data, understand tracking and attribution, and translate insights into actionable improvements. Experience with Voluum or comparable tracking and reporting tools is a strong plus.

  • AI & Automation: You are confident using AI-powered tools to create, test and optimise advertising content and creative assets.

  • Conversion Focus: You understand how creatives, advertorials, landing pages and customer journeys influence conversion rates and campaign profitability.

  • Ownership & Initiative: You work independently, proactively identify opportunities and enjoy building and scaling new initiatives with measurable impact.

  • Communication & Collaboration: Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams, communicate insights clearly and manage external partners effectively.

  • Language Skills: Excellent German (C1 level), including strong copywriting skills, and strong English communication skills.

  • We offer 28 days of paid time off per year plus up to 5 days off between Christmas and New Year

descriptionHtml:
What we’re all about.

We find, when we come together in the pursuit of excellence, great things happen. And that’s how we do things at Quantexa – together. Our business is data, but our culture is collective. We’re about growth – but not just the bottom line. We create a culture where people feel empowered to do their best work. We might work across continents and time zones, but that doesn’t stop us from collaborating. We’re connected. We celebrate our successes together, and we unite to tackle the challenges.

At Q, we’re looking for people who share that vision. People like you.

The Opportunity

Our part-time Leadership Personal Assistant (PA) to our Executive Committee will be a central point in enabling our Senior Leaders to focus on creating the biggest impact for our clients, our colleagues and our business strategy. This is for a fixed period of 6 months, role, working Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday, and you’ll be office based on all three days.

You’re a brilliant communicator, in writing and in person, with laser-focused attention to detail and a curious, intuitive, agile and practical approach to a busy, varied senior team. You’re a connector, seamlessly making things happen across Quantexa. What makes you Q will help you flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

Our 8 Senior Leaders head up our functions, and our CEO works with his own dedicated PA. You’ll start by supporting 4 of the Senior Leaders, working alongside our current PA. From January, you’ll provide maternity cover, looking after all 8 Senior Leaders until our PA returns from maternity leave in May. Support will be tailored to each leader, from regular day-to-day help to occasional, ad hoc requests.

Our Senior Leaders are used to being self-sufficient, so many of your duties will be cross-functional or project-focused. As you support them, we’ll support you. You’ll report to our Chief Operations Officer, who’ll help you juggle priorities and focus your time on the things that add the most value.

The Senior Leaders are appreciative, hardworking and will value the contribution you bring to making their lives easier. We’re growing fast, and you’ll be an integral part of our journey, with the chance to push the boundaries of what’s possible and make a difference to a lot of people.

What you’ll be doing

  • Acting as the point of contact between our Senior Leaders and internal/external clients, distributing correspondence in an efficient and mindful manner.

  • Creating, drafting and formatting communications for diverse audiences and formats, such as PowerPoint presentations and reports.

  • Planning and coordinating off-sites, meetings and small team events for Senior Leaders and their teams.

  • Attending meetings, taking minutes, delegating actions and managing progress.

  • Managing diaries, scheduling meetings and booking travel.

Requirements

What you’ll bring.

  • Always one step ahead: you embrace change, instinctively know what needs to get done, then make it happen.

  • Excellent communication: you write and speak well for diverse audiences, and you’re creative and detail-focused in getting the message across.

  • Teamwork, one of our core values: you’re a people person who builds strong relationships with colleagues, investors, the board and clients.

  • Customer-focused: you thrive on delivering a great service and making life easier for those you support.

  • Resilient, tenacious and a pleasure to work with, making Q fun wherever you are.

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse work environment, continuously improving to ensure everyone belongs. Our recruitment process is designed to be inclusive and accessible. No matter your race, beliefs, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, neurodiversity, or abilities—whoever you are—if you're a passionate, curious, and caring human eager to push the boundaries of what’s possible, we want to hear from you.

title: PMO Operations Specialist (f/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is building the future of clean energy through laser-driven inertial fusion. Backed by our $240M Series A - the largest fully secured Series A in the global fusion industry we are scaling rapidly across multiple geographies.

Based in Germany and the US, we have brought together the top scientific and engineering minds using proven technologies to unlock fusion power at commercial scale. Focused Energy is working to realize game-changing scientific innovation that promises to deliver a clean, sustainable and abundant source of power globally.

Your Role

As a PMO Operations Specialist, you'll play a central role in building and running the operational foundation of our growing Project Management Office (PMO). Working closely with the PMO Lead, you'll turn newly developed processes into practical, well-documented ways of working that are consistently adopted across dozens of active initiatives.

You'll own the day-to-day operating rhythm of the PMO, from weekly project reporting and portfolio data quality to project lead onboarding, training, and process improvement. You'll work across teams, including scientists, engineers, and project leads, helping make project management processes simple, effective, and accessible to everyone.

This is an opportunity to join the PMO during its early development and make a meaningful impact on how Focused Energy plans, tracks, and delivers its most important initiatives. You'll bring structure to complexity, ensure important details don't fall through the cracks, and help build a scalable foundation for the company's continued growth.

What You'll Do

  • Own the PMO Operating Rhythm: Coordinate and manage the weekly project reporting cycle across dozens of active initiatives, ensuring timely updates, accurate information, and consistent visibility into project progress.

  • Drive Portfolio Data Quality: Monitor project information, identify missing or inconsistent data, follow up with project leads, and ensure leadership and teams can rely on accurate portfolio reporting.

  • Make PMO Processes Work in Practice: Translate newly designed PMO processes into simple, documented, and usable workflows that can be adopted consistently by project leads and non-PM colleagues.

  • Lead Project Onboarding and Training: Coordinate onboarding for new project leads and deliver training on PMO processes, tools, reporting expectations, and ways of working to build confidence and self-sufficiency.

  • Improve Processes and Efficiency: Identify recurring manual tasks, process gaps, and opportunities for improvement, helping streamline workflows and flag opportunities for automation.

  • Drive Improvement Initiatives: Partner with the PMO Lead on selected PMO improvement projects, taking ownership of execution, coordination, documentation, and follow-through.

  • Support Cross-Functional Collaboration: Prepare and support workshops, meetings, and working sessions, ensuring the right information is available, discussions stay organized, and agreed actions are followed through.

  • Maintain Clear Documentation: Ensure PMO processes, project information, and supporting documentation are complete, accessible, and consistently maintained.

  • Keep Things Moving: Proactively identify overdue actions, unclear responsibilities, and emerging gaps, escalating risks to the PMO Lead before they impact project delivery.

Who You Are

  • You have a degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • You bring experience in project management, PMO operations, project coordination, or business operations, ideally within a technical, engineering, R&D, or fast-growing organization.

  • You understand project management fundamentals and the importance of consistent reporting, reliable documentation, clear ownership, and effective coordination across multiple initiatives.

  • You are highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage competing priorities, recurring deadlines, and large volumes of project information without losing sight of the bigger picture.

  • You are comfortable translating processes and concepts into practical workflows, documentation, and guidance that people outside of project management can easily understand and adopt.

  • You take an ownership-driven approach to your work, naturally identifying what's missing, unclear, or unfinished and proactively driving it toward resolution.

  • You are a clear and confident communicator in both German and English, able to follow up persistently and constructively with stakeholders across different functions and levels of technical expertise.

  • You enjoy working with diverse teams, including scientists, engineers, and business professionals, and can adapt your communication style to different audiences.

  • You demonstrate good judgment and understand when to make decisions independently versus when to escalate process or scope changes to leadership.

  • You have a continuous improvement mindset and are interested in simplifying processes, reducing manual work, and leveraging automation and AI tools to improve efficiency.

  • You thrive in an evolving environment where processes are still being established and enjoy bringing structure, consistency, and momentum to a growing organization.

What We Offer

  • Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

  • Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

  • Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

  • Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges and shaping the future of our company.

  • Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

  • Vacation Days: We support your work-life-balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

  • Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

  • Retirement Plan: If you decide for a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

  • Equipment: We offer state-of-the-art Windows or Apple Laptops. In addition, you will receive a keyboard, mouse and headset so you are fully equipped from day 1.

  • Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

  • Mobility with NAVIT: We partner with NAVIT to support your flexible commuting needs whether it’s a public transportation ticket, taxi rides or car-sharing you choose what fits your lifestyle.

  • Fitness with Wellhub: We care about your health. Get access to a wide range of gyms, fitness studios and wellness services across Europe through our partnership with Wellhub.

 


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Focused Energy will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Certain roles may be eligible for incentive compensation, equity, benefits.

title: Portfolio Risk and Treasury Manager
descriptionHtml:
📈 Who We Are:

We are rebuilding the energy transaction, making it transparent and fair.

We're rebuilding how energy is bought and sold. That means cutting out middlemen, connecting businesses directly with renewable generators, and ensuring every transaction is traceable and transparent.

We're a 160+ person team - operators, data scientists, engineers, customer champions and energy experts - backed by top-tier investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Hitachi Ventures, Allianz, AlbionVC and Atomico. We closed a $75M Series B round in early 2026, taking our total funding to $94M, and we now power energy for over 4,000 UK businesses across 8,500+ sites, with over £75m in value returned to businesses and generators so far.

We're a technology company solving the energy industry, not an energy company. Some people call us a neo-utility, the neo-bank idea, applied to energy.

The industry is noticing. We were crowned Europe's Most Exciting Tech Company at the GP Bullhound Allstars awards, came in at #6 on LinkedIn's Top Startups 2026 in the UK, #7 on the Scaling Europe 50 of Europe's fastest-growing companies, and #14 on Sifted's AI 100.

Learn more about us on our website.

🎙️ The Role

We're hiring a Portfolio Risk and Treasury Manager.

This role reports directly to the CFO and sits in our Finance team. You will be tem's first dedicated hire in risk oversight and treasury, independent of the teams whose positions and processes you oversee and challenge. It's a solo, individual-contributor role for now: no team to manage, but real ownership of a complex, cross-functional, load-bearing area that touches our pricing and trading engine, FP&A, cash management and our commercial and people teams, and that increasingly matters to how investors, the board and funding partners see tem's risk maturity.

tem doesn't yet have anyone who owns liquidity as a discipline, or a second line of defence on risk. Growth in our business is capital-intensive: every collateral demand, margin call, commission payment and new market adds to the cash we need to carry, and the cost of that cash is rarely visible in the decisions that create it. You will build that capability from scratch, bringing treasury and independent risk oversight together, so that tem's risk and liquidity management stands on its own rather than marking its own homework.

In your first 12 months, you might:

  • Stand up tem's second line risk function: independent oversight and challenge of our first line risk processes, with risk appetite and limits that are set, monitored and acted on.

  • Build the liquidity models tem runs on, short and long term: working capital, collateral, margin calls, cash runway, and the credit facilities and letters of credit behind them.

  • Put cost of capital into our commercial pricing decisions, so the liquidity a deal consumes is visible at the moment the deal is made.

  • Work with the CFO to secure liquidity provision that scales ahead of the business and new markets.

  • Replace manual portfolio reconciliation with automation, and build our operational risk framework from the ground up.

🚀 Responsibilities

  • Second line oversight: establish and run independent oversight and challenge of tem's first line risk processes across trading and portfolio activity, input into risk appetite and the setting of notional and VaR limits, and monitor ongoing adherence.

  • Liquidity modelling: build and maintain short-term (cash runway, margin call forecasting) and long-term (growth and new market funding) liquidity models, covering generator collateral, hedging counterparty collateral, variation margin, credit facilities and letters of credit.

  • Working capital: own working capital efficiency as a measured, targeted discipline rather than a byproduct of other teams' decisions, working closely with Finance's cash management team.

  • Cost of capital and pricing: develop tem's cost of capital framework, make it usable in pricing, give our pricing and commercial teams the cost of capital impact of their decisions, and challenge decisions that consume liquidity without adequate return.

  • Liquidity risk: model liquidity risk from volume and price variance on energy volumes, run stress scenarios and report liquidity headroom against them.

  • Liquidity supply and funding: work with the CFO to engage lenders, credit facility providers and collateral and letter of credit providers, keep liquidity provision ahead of the business with early visibility of when new capacity is needed, and prepare liquidity and risk materials for funding partners, investors and the board.

  • Operational risk: build tem's operational risk framework from the ground up, including incident reporting and management, and drive automation of portfolio data reconciliation, from hedge contracts and confirmations through to hedge settlement and cash reconciliation with Finance.

  • Reporting and stakeholders: build automated, async-first risk reporting (dashboards and written updates by default, a live sync only when something needs real-time discussion), represent tem with hedging and generator counterparties and funding partners, and communicate risk and liquidity positions clearly to leadership.

🎯 Requirements

Must-Haves

  • Risk management or treasury experience from a fintech, quant trading or other digital-native environment: modern, tech-first risk practices rather than legacy, spreadsheet-driven ones.

  • Knowledge of energy markets, energy trading or energy risk management and portfolio balancing.

  • Liquidity modelling experience: working capital, collateral and margin dynamics, and cash forecasting over short and long horizons.

  • Risk modelling experience, including VaR and stress testing, and an understanding of cost of capital and how to translate it into commercial decisions.

  • Data literate: comfortable working with and drawing conclusions from portfolio and risk data.

  • Genuinely curious and intellectually sharp (this is a thinking role, not a process-running one), and confident communicating with senior stakeholders, external counterparties and funding partners.

Desirable

  • Experience raising or managing credit facilities, letters of credit or other trade finance.

  • Experience of US electricity markets.

  • Operational risk experience, or familiarity with the Ofgem regulatory environment.

  • Comfortable using AI tools as part of day-to-day work. No coding or SQL required.

✨ Benefits & Perks

  • Stock options so everyone has ownership in our mission.

  • 25 days holiday plus public holidays. Swap public holidays for the ones that matter most to you, and enjoy your birthday off.

  • Remote first and flexible working, with clear core hours and no internal meetings on Friday afternoons.

  • Up to GBP1,200 or EUR1,400 per year for your remote setup.

  • Up to GBP150 or EUR170 per month for wellbeing.

🗣️ Interview Process

  • First call with our Talent Team.

  • Behaviour Interview with the Hiring Manager.

  • Technical Interview with the Team (90 mins). You'll meet with potential peers in this session and will discuss how you would model and stress tem's liquidity, where you would set and monitor risk limits, and how you would make cost of capital usable in pricing decisions, including a practical exercise.

  • Bar Raiser Interview with Stakeholders.

We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, and identities, including those that are traditionally underrepresented in the tech and energy sectors. If you’re excited about this role but not sure you meet every requirement, we’d still love to hear from you. Your unique perspective could be exactly what we’re looking for.

Über uns

Über 5 Millionen Menschen in Deutschland sind pflegebedürftig, und jedes Jahr werden es mehr. Ihnen stehen Leistungen zu, die oft nie ankommen, weil Formulare, Zuständigkeiten und Behördensprache dazwischenstehen.

Jeden Fall einzeln zu prüfen und bis zur Entscheidung zu begleiten, war bisher zu aufwendig. Mit KI geht das zum ersten Mal für viele Familien gleichzeitig. Genau das macht Decari: Wir prüfen, welche Leistungen infrage kommen, etwa ein höherer Pflegegrad, Hilfe zur Pflege oder Eingliederungshilfe, und begleiten die Anträge bis zur Entscheidung. Pflegedienste in mehreren Bundesländern arbeiten bereits mit uns. Unser Ziel: Jede Familie in Deutschland bekommt die Pflegeleistungen, die ihr zusteht.

Wir sind ein kleines, AI-natives Team mit Erfahrung aus der Versicherungs- und Pflegebranche. Wir waren frühe Mitarbeiter in Startups, die von Sequoia, Accel, Index Ventures und Y Combinator finanziert wurden und zusammen über 100 Mio. Euro eingesammelt haben. Neue Ideen testen wir erst einfach und von Hand, was funktioniert, automatisieren wir, und unsere Abläufe ändern wir jede Woche, manchmal täglich. Wir übernehmen Ownership und haben wenig Ego.

Deine Rolle

In dieser Rolle baust du Decari mit uns auf. Du arbeitest direkt mit Julien (Operations) und den Gründern und bist operativ und taktisch mittendrin: Du sprichst jeden Tag mit Familien und Pflegediensten, siehst, wo es hakt, und gestaltest den Prozess aktiv mit. Das geht als Pflichtpraktikum oder als Werkstudent:in (bis 20 Stunden pro Woche, tagsüber). Du suchst ein anderes Modell? Sprich uns an.

Berlin, hybrid: im Praktikum mindestens 4 Tage pro Woche im Office, als Werkstudent:in mindestens 2. Start ab sofort, für mindestens 6 Monate, bezahlt, danach ist eine Festanstellung möglich.

Was du machst

  • Du bist der erste Kontakt der Familien zu Decari und verbringst den größten Teil deines Tages am Telefon. Im Gespräch findest du heraus, ob und wie wir helfen können.

  • Du bringst Fälle ins Ziel. Aus einem guten Gespräch machst du einen vollständigen Fall und bleibst dran, bis alles da ist, was wir für den Antrag brauchen.

  • Du betreust unsere Pflegedienste mit. Für sie bist du die erste Ansprechperson zu ihren Familien.

  • Du verbesserst den Funnel. Du kennst die Zahlen von der Anfrage bis zum Antrag, bringst Ideen ein und testest sie direkt.

  • Du baust mit uns Automatisierungen. Was wir oft genug von Hand gemacht haben, übernimmt danach die KI.

Du passt gut zu uns, wenn

  • Du gern telefonierst, auch 50 Mal am Tag, und dich eine Mailbox oder ein Nein nicht aus dem Takt bringt

  • Du gut zuhörst, empathisch bist und schnell und fehlerfrei schreibst

  • Du anpackst und dir für unglamouröse Arbeit nicht zu schade bist

  • Du Ownership übernimmst: Dinge jetzt erledigst, die einfachste Lösung suchst und selbst einen Weg findest, wenn du feststeckst

  • Du KI im Alltag nutzt und neue Tools schnell lernst

  • Du sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift besitzt (C1), weil du täglich mit Familien telefonierst und diese berätst. Eine weitere Sprache wie Polnisch, Türkisch, Russisch oder Arabisch ist ein Plus

  • Du studierst und suchst ein Pflichtpraktikum oder einen Werkstudentenjob, zum Beispiel in BWL, Gesundheitsmanagement, Sozialer Arbeit oder Jura.

Eher nichts für dich, wenn

title: Praktikum - Growth + Business Development (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
Täglich fahren Millionen Autos durch Deutschland. Mit Platz, der nicht genutzt wird. Wir ändern das.

MUVN verbindet Fahrer:innen mit freiem Laderaum mit Menschen, die etwas transportieren müssen. Günstig, versichert, ohne Umweg. Kein neuer Fuhrpark. Keine neue Logistik. Einfach bessere Nutzung von dem, was schon unterwegs ist.

Du bekommst in drei oder sechs Monaten Praktikum ein eigenes Projekt. Abgestimmt auf dein Profil und das, was MUVN gerade wirklich braucht. Ein echtes Thema, für das du von Anfang bis Ende Verantwortung trägst.

Du brennst für Startups, Business Development und unternehmerisches Denken? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig! 🚀

Aufgaben

Was du konkret machst, hängt von dir ab. Zu Beginn schauen wir gemeinsam, wo deine Stärken liegen und wo wir den größten Hebel brauchen. Daraus entsteht dein Schwerpunkt. Die Bereiche, in denen wir arbeiten:

  • Business Development
    Du identifizierst Wachstumshebel, recherchierst Märkte und Partnerpotenziale und machst aus Ideen konkrete Entscheidungsgrundlagen. Nicht für die Schublade.

  • Operations & Prozessoptimierung
    Was noch nicht skaliert, machst du skalierbar. Du erkennst Reibung in Abläufen und baust Lösungen, nicht nur Berichte.

  • Marketing & Growth
    Du entwickelst und testest Wachstumsstrategien, arbeitest an Performance Marketing und misst, was wirklich funktioniert. Bauchgefühl ist ein Anfang. Daten sind das Ziel.

  • Zusammenarbeit mit den Gründern
    Du arbeitest direkt mit Katharina, Massimo und Emre. Du siehst, wie Entscheidungen entstehen, und bringst deine Perspektive ein.

Qualifikation

Du studierst BWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Management oder etwas Ähnliches. Oder du hast einen anderen Hintergrund und kannst trotzdem erklären, warum du genau richtig bist.

Was bei uns funktioniert: Du denkst schnell, arbeitest strukturiert und übernimmst Ownership für dein Thema, ohne dass jemand täglich nachfragen muss. Du willst verstehen, wie Startups wirklich funktionieren, nicht nur wie sie auf LinkedIn klingen.

Driven people > Degrees. Dein Mindset zählt mehr als dein Abschluss.

Benefits

Das bieten wir dir:

  • Dein Schwerpunktprojekt: abgestimmt auf dein Profil, mit echter Ownership von Tag 1

  • Flexible Arbeitsmodelle: Arbeite, wann und wo es für dich am besten passt.

  • Aufwandsentschädigung: Du erhältst eine Aufwandsentschädigung während deinem Praktikum.

  • Gründern: kein HR-Filter, keine Hierarchie dazwischen

  • Hybrides Arbeiten & Remote: Flexibilität ist bei uns Programm.

  • Offsites mit dem Team: Gemeinsam erreichen wir mehr.

  • Free MUVN Rides: Für dich entstehen keinerlei Nutzungsgebühren.

  • Corporate Benefits: Rabatte in hunderten Onlineshops.

Mehr Infos zu unseren Benefits und unseren Firmenwerten findest du auf unserer Karriereseite.

Schick uns deinen CV und zwei, drei Sätze dazu, welcher Bereich dich am meisten reizt und warum wir bescheuert wären, dich nicht einzuladen.

Oder schick ein kurzes Video. Macht uns ehrlich gesagt noch neugieriger als jedes Anschreiben.

Fragen? Direkt an Katharina.

Let's get it muvn. 🚀

title: Pre-Sales Engineer - Energy Retail
descriptionHtml:
Location: London or Bristol, UK (hybrid, three days a week in the office)

Level: Senior Engineer C3

Team: Growth

Salary: £60,000 - £75,000 + discretionary bonus

Contract: Permanent

Reporting To: Head of Sales Engineering

Please note: This role requires an existing right to work in the UK. We can’t offer visa sponsorship, but we review sponsorship role by role, so keep an eye on our careers site for future opportunities.


About Kaluza

Kaluza is the Energy Intelligence Platform, turning energy complexity into seamless coordination. We help energy companies overcome today’s challenges while accelerating the shift to a clean, electrified future.

Our platform orchestrates millions of real-time decisions across homes, devices, markets and grids. By combining predictive algorithms with human-centred design, Kaluza makes clean energy dependable, affordable and adaptive to everyday life.

With teams across Europe, Asia and Australia, and a joint venture with Mitsubishi Corporation in Japan, we power leading companies including OVO, AGL and ENGIE, as well as innovators like Volvo and Volkswagen.


What you’ll do

As a Pre-Sales Engineer, you are a trusted technical contributor within our team, helping deliver impactful sales engagements through configuration and development in our demo environments. You’ll play a contributor role to larger deals, and often lead pre-sales activities for smaller or less complex opportunities. You are a key part of the commercial engine, helping us scale by ensuring our technical pre-sales efforts are thorough, accurate, and client-focused.

This role will report to the Head of Demo Engineering and you’ll be part of a team that works on sales to Kaluza’s largest clients globally. You will have broad expertise on Kaluza’s product suite and our value differentiators and will develop depth in particular areas of our products. You will have a good understanding of the challenges facing energy retailers from a client or user perspective and be able to show-case how our solutions solve them.. 

You will play a crucial role in building product demonstrations and collateral that evangelises the Kaluza platform.

  • Own and deliver demo activities for small to mid-size opportunities, especially during high team capacity periods. This includes configuring and delivering tailored product demonstrations and responding to client technical questions with clarity and confidence.

  • Support technical delivery on complex deals, working alongside senior team members to prepare solution configurations, contribute to discovery conversations, and ensure client requirements are well captured and translated.

  • Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, and Engineering teams to scope solutions, validate feasibility, and communicate trade-offs in a clear and client-friendly manner.

  • Lead or contribute to proof-of-concept (PoC) projects, ensuring they reflect client needs and demonstrate our platform’s ability to deliver measurable outcomes. Track PoC success criteria and highlight risks or gaps to the wider team.

  • Represent the Pre-Sales function in internal planning and alignment sessions, helping ensure technical accuracy, smooth handovers, and clear documentation for post-sale teams.

  • Document and share learnings from client engagements, including product feedback, recurring questions, and potential areas for improvement in our pre-sales approach or demo assets.


What you’ll bring 

Ideally, you’ll have:

  • Software development experience in a regulated industry using TypeScript, with a track record of designing and building complex solutions to customer problems

  • Experience architecting solutions on AWS, knowing which technologies to use when and the trade-offs involved

  • Confidence working with and explaining event-driven architectures and asynchronous APIs

  • Experience in a commercial or client-facing technical role, ideally selling SaaS in a regulated industry, with examples of adapting a solution to meet a customer’s unique needs

  • The ability to distil complex concepts into clear, simple points, and to work through differing opinions with empathy

  • Comfort working autonomously across multiple opportunities, handling ambiguity and knowing which data to use to measure success

An interest in renewable energy and the challenges facing energy retailers will help you hit the ground running.

Tech stack: TypeScript, AWS, event-driven architectures, asynchronous APIs


Our Values

Five values guide how we work at Kaluza:

  • Play to win: Collective pride in decarbonising energy at scale.

  • Solve the real problem: Cutting through complexity to focus on real-world outcomes.

  • Build trust every day: Consistency, transparency and doing what we say.

  • Own the outcome: Full accountability, wins and setbacks, without ego.

  • Go further together: Collaboration, respect and different perspectives.


Our Perks

  • Time off and family: 26 days’ holiday, plus 26 weeks’ full pay for new parents with no qualifying service period

  • Health and security: Private medical insurance with virtual GP, life assurance, pension scheme, free mortgage advice and eye tests

  • Pay and flexibility: Discretionary bonus, a Flex Fund of 5% [of salary] to spend on the benefits you want most, retail discounts through Perks at Work

  • Growth and setup: Personal learning budget, home office budget

  • Climate: Furthr, our climate action app


Come as you are

We want to meet people from all walks of life. The more inclusive we are, the better our work will be, and we recognise talent on merit and potential. If you’re excited about the role but don’t tick every box, we’d still love to hear from you.

Find out more on our careers page and LinkedIn. Our Applicant Data Protection Policy is here.

title: Pricing Engine Product Manager
descriptionHtml:
Akur8 is one of the leading providers of insurance pricing and rating technology. Our mission is to modernize how insurers assess, price, and manage risk.

Our SaaS platform combines transparent machine learning, predictive analytics, and rating technology to turn complex insurance workflows into scalable, data-driven systems. Insurers use it to model and rate risk up to 10x faster while keeping transparency, explainability, and regulatory trust.

As the product suite expands, we are building an end-to-end platform for pricing, reserving, and forward-looking risk decisions.

Recognized globally, Akur8 has been featured in:

  • CB Insights' Insurtech 50 (2025)

  • CNBC's InsurTech Top 150 (2025)

  • InsurTech100 Global Insurtech Top 100 (2025)

  • Professional Equality Index 97/100 (2025)


Akur8 has 50+ nationalities across 8 global offices and serves 420+ clients across 4 continents. We’re an equal opportunities employer, and we value the different perspectives that help shape better products and decisions.

Deploy is Akur8’s stateless rating engine, delivering subsecond insurance premium computations across a wide range of industry use cases.

It sits at the intersection of two key functions in insurance. Actuaries extract insights from data and make the statistical decisions that shape the business. IT teams, in turn, build and maintain the reliable systems that put those decisions into production.

Today, these two worlds operate with different skills, priorities and tools, connected through slow, manual handoffs between teams.

Deploy replaces this process with a shared foundation that aligns actuarial and IT teams and reduces time-to-market. Building it requires a deep understanding of how both functions are organised, what each is trying to achieve, and the complex ecosystem behind an insurance product and its pricing. This is what makes the role both dynamic and challenging.

At Akur8, we value a builder mindset. We embrace the AI revolution by providing the right tools and removing barriers, so that everyone contributing to product development maximises their impact.

We’re looking for a Pricing Engine Product Manager to join the Deploy team, a cross-functional role focused on solving problems and rapid delivery of results to our customers.

To succeed, you’ll build a solid understanding of how the different parts of our platform interact, allow you to abstract customer problems into a clear framework, turning complex challenges into clean solutions.

We’re interested in people who are motivated by solving problems and comfortable diving deep into the details. You take innovative approaches to find intuitive solutions to seemingly complex problems.

You also share our builder mindset, and you get excited about delivering fast iterations on difficult challenges.

Main responsibilities

  • Continuously deepening your understanding of actuarial ratemaking and IT deployment challenges, including product models and Policy Admin System design.

  • Working at pace, with short iteration cycles, to shape user flows and prototypes that tackle complex API management and distil insurance complexity into clean, opinionated solutions.

  • Defining frameworks and approaches that address user pain points, prioritising what matters and setting aside what doesn’t.

  • Leading user interviews to build a thorough understanding of end users’ challenges and objectives.

For this key role within our Product Management team we’re keen to speak to applicants that meet the following criteria.

  • A Master's degree or PhD in a quantitative discipline

  • 3+ years experience in either the P&C insurance industry or with products managing, defining and orchestrating high performant API connections and integrations.

  • Excellent quantitative & analytical skills

  • Proficient in leveraging LLM tools - and with a product builder mindset focused on delivering fast paced iteration of prototypes

  • Very strong problem solving skills with a focus on providing and creating robust solutions

  • Effective communication skills (to exchange with both technical & non-technical stakeholders / clients).

  • Fluent English language skills



Important: You must possess the authorisation to work in France, although we are equally open to visa sponsorship should you meet the above criteria.

At Akur8, we do value a builder mindset and we embrace the AI revolution by enabling tools and removing barriers to let contributors maximize their impact in our product development.

But it’s not all work, you’ll also be part of a dynamic team that enjoys spending time together and having fun.

In addition to this, we will provide you with:

  • Competitive salary + annual bonus

  • Hybrid office / home office policy

  • 25 days of paid holidays + RTT

  • Gym membership with Gymlib

  • On-site gym facilities / corporate sporting activities

  • Excellent health insurance (including possibility of family coverage)

  • Swile lunch vouchers

  • Public transportation reimbursement + sustainable mobility allowance

  • Relocation support

  • Sponsored crèche access

  • Free cafeteria with fresh fruit, drinks and snacks

  • Great office in the heart of the 9th arrondissement of Paris

As part of our recruitment process, we may carry out background checks in line with the applicable laws and regulations in the countries where we operate. These checks may include verification of employment history, education, and, where legally authorized, criminal records. Any background checks will be performed lawfully before formal employment contracts are signed, with the candidate’s consent, and all information collected will be handled confidentially.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist with certain stages of the recruitment process. These tools are used to support our recruitment team and do not replace human decision-making. title: Principal BMS & PMS Controls Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Volta

Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds.

The role

As Principal BMS & PMS Controls Engineer, you will be Volta's technical authority for building and power management controls. You will set the controls architecture, standards and acceptance regime that every DSX site is built to, across Europe and North America.

This is a principal-level individual contributor role. Reporting to the Senior Director, Global E2E DSX Execution, you will decide how controls are specified, integrated and proven, and your standards will be used by design, delivery, commissioning and operations teams across the whole portfolio.

What you will do

Controls architecture and standards

  • Set Volta's global controls architecture for BMS and PMS, including system boundaries, network design, redundancy and integration with facility monitoring and compute.

  • Own the controls standards library: sequences of operation, points schedules, alarm philosophy, naming conventions and FAT/SAT requirements.

  • Define controls requirements for high-density AI workloads, including liquid cooling, CDU integration and power-to-compute interfaces.

Technical authority

  • Make the final technical call on controls design deviations, vendor proposals and integration disputes across all sites.

  • Shape vendor and framework strategy with Procurement, setting the technical bar suppliers are selected against.

  • Set controls security requirements with Systems Security, covering segmentation, access and secure remote support.

Capability and improvement

  • Use operating data and incidents to evolve the standards and the reference design.

  • Coach and raise the capability of controls engineers and specialists across Volta and its partners.

What we are looking for

  • Recognised senior authority in BMS/PMS or mission-critical controls, typically 12+ years, with data centre experience essential.

  • A track record setting controls architecture and standards across a portfolio of sites, not a single project.

  • Deep knowledge of electrical and mechanical control sequences, supervisory platforms, and protocols such as BACnet and Modbus.

  • Experience making and defending high-consequence technical decisions with vendors, designers and executives.

  • Experience defining FAT/SAT and integrated systems test regimes for controls.

  • Ability to influence across functions and regions without direct authority.

Nice to have

  • Controls for high-density AI facilities and direct liquid cooling.

  • OT security and controls network architecture, for example IEC 62443.

  • Standardising controls across an international portfolio.

What We Offer

At Volta, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted and able to grow. We're building a company where you can make an impact, keep a healthy balance between work and life, and build a career you're proud of.
As a global team, we do our best to provide great benefits wherever you're based. While some benefits vary by country due to local regulations, we believe looking after our people is simply the right thing to do.

  • Competitive salary based on the work you do here, not your previous salary

  • Equity in Volta, giving you the opportunity to share in the company's long-term success

  • Retirement/pension contributions

  • Comprehensive health, wellbeing and insurance benefits

  • Generous number of vacation days each year

Additional Information

Background Checks

All offers of employment at Volta are conditional on the satisfactory completion of pre-employment screening, which includes confirmation of your right to work, verification of your employment history and a criminal record check, where this is permitted by local law. Screening is carried out by Zinc, an accredited third-party provider, after an offer is made and all information is handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection law.

Equal Opportunity

Volta is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and make employment decisions based on skills, qualifications, experience and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic.

Accessibility

Volta is committed to providing an accessible recruitment experience for all candidates. If you require accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the application or interview process, please contact us at

Candidate Privacy Notice

By applying, you consent to the processing of your personal data for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the UK GDPR, EU GDPR and relevant US state privacy regulations. Your data will be shared only with those involved in the hiring process and will not be used for unrelated purposes. For details, see our Recruitment & Candidate Privacy Notice.

Note to Recruitment Agencies

Volta does not accept unsolicited CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies. Any unsolicited submissions, including those sent directly to hiring managers or employees, will be treated as the property of Volta. No agency fees will be payable unless a valid, signed recruitment agreement is in place, and the agency has been specifically engaged for the relevant vacancy.
