title: Projectleider Gebiedsontwikkeling
descriptionHtml:
Als projectleider gebiedsontwikkeling bij Waalpartners speel je een cruciale rol in het realiseren van de nieuwbouwopgaven van onze opdrachtgevers. Jij bewaart het overzicht, staat naast de opdrachtgever en draagt bij aan oplossingen voor de uitdagingen die woningbouw met zich meebrengt. Zo hebben we recentelijk meegedacht voor de nieuwe woonomgeving ‘Vlijweide’ in Dordrecht. Bij deze locatie ontwikkeling komt nogal wat bij elkaar. Water, bodem, ecologie, een primaire waterkering én verschillende partijen met ieder hun eigen verantwoordelijkheid en expertise. En dat alles om een toekomstbestendig nieuw woongebied te ontwikkelen.

Dit ga je doen

Met je brede kennis en jarenlange ervaring sta je stevig in een dynamische projectomgeving. Zowel in de voorbereidende als de uitvoerende fase zorg je ervoor dat het proces vloeiend blijft verlopen, ook bij langdurige integrale projecten. Je eigen netwerk zet je in om de dienstverlening van Waalpartners verder te profileren. Als projectleider ben je bovendien de spil in de ontwikkeling van zowel medewerkers als de organisatie.

Dat doe je niet alleen: samen schop je ‘t verder. Je werkt nauw samen met het management en de overige projectleiders over offertes, de bureauplanning en kansen in de markt.

Dit ben jij

Je bent open, nieuwsgierig en staat als leidinggevende stevig in je schoenen. Je omgeving ziet je als collegiaal en je neemt verantwoordelijkheid over je project en de ontwikkeling van de projectteamleden.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Een salaris tussen €4.500 – €6.900 bruto o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.

  • Groeipad. Met onze Waalacademy bouw je stevig aan je eigen ontwikkeling.

  • Flexibele werktijden. Kom je liever om half 8 binnen, in plaats van half 9? Geen probleem.

  • Hybride werken. We zien je graag op kantoor, omdat we veel met elkaar en onze opdrachtgevers overleggen en samenwerken. Natuurlijk is er ook ruimte om thuis te werken, daarom mag je 2 dagen per week vanuit huis werken (o.b.v. fulltime dienstverband).

  • 27 vakantiedagen

  • Resultaatafhankelijke winstdeling. Draaien we samen een goed jaar? Dan profiteer jij daar ook van!

  • Een goede pensioenregeling onder het oude pensioenstelsel.

  • Een elektrische auto van de zaak, die je ook privé mag gebruiken

  • Plezier. We werken niet alleen aan de ontwikkeling van onze omgeving en onszelf, maar hebben ‘t ook leuk met elkaar. Onze personeelsvereniging organiseert regelmatig activiteiten, we gaan samen op citytrip of een paar kilometer hardlopen.

Dit breng jij mee

  • Je hebt de drive om een project voor alle belanghebbenden tot een goed einde te brengen.

  • Jij vindt het belangrijk om jezelf, samen met je collega’s, te blijven ontwikkelen.

  • Je hebt een civieltechnische opleiding (hbo werk- en denkniveau).

  • Je spreekt vloeiend Nederlands en kunt jezelf goed verwoorden: In gesprek en op papier.

  • Je hebt de ervaring om complexe projecten te doorzien en te begeleiden.

  • Je hebt gevoel voor thema’s als binnenstedelijke herinrichting, klimaatadaptatie of geotechniek.

title: Projektleiter Montage (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Kälte-, Klima- und Lüftungstechnik · Projektabwicklung · Baustellenkoordination · Kalkulation

Vollzeit | Standort Erkrath | Baustellen- und Projekttermine nach Bedarf

Du willst Projekte nicht nur verwalten, sondern dafür sorgen, dass sie auf der Baustelle funktionieren?

Dann übernimm bei uns Verantwortung von der Besichtigung und Kalkulation über die Planung und Bestellung bis zur Begleitung der Montage. Du hältst die Fäden zusammen, packst Probleme an und findest Lösungen, statt auf andere zu warten.

Wer wir sind

Kältetechnik Ollbrink ist ein familiengeführtes Mehrgenerationen-Handwerksunternehmen. Von unseren Standorten in Bochum und Erkrath realisieren und betreuen wir Lösungen rund um Kälte-, Klima- und Lüftungstechnik für Kunden aus Einzelhandel, Industrie und Mineralölsektor. Als Teil eines starken Unternehmensverbunds verbinden wir gewachsene Erfahrung mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und neuen Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

Warum diese Position?

Für unseren Standort Erkrath suchen wir keinen klassischen Bereichsleiter und auch keinen reinen Verkäufer. Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Praktiker, der Montageprojekte aktiv vorbereitet, organisiert und bis zum Abschluss begleitet. Du arbeitest selbstständig, gibst den Monteuren eine klare Richtung und sorgst dafür, dass Material, Termine, Qualität und Wirtschaftlichkeit zusammenpassen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Besichtigung und technische Bewertung von Baustellen sowie Abstimmung der Anforderungen mit Kunden und Projektbeteiligten

  • Erstellung, Kalkulation und Nachverfolgung von Angeboten sowie Bearbeitung passender Ausschreibungen

  • Kontrolle von Projektfortschritt, Terminen, Kosten, Qualität und Wirtschaftlichkeit

  • Klärung technischer und organisatorischer Probleme und Entwicklung umsetzbarer Lösungen, bei Bedarf unter Einbindung geeigneter externer Fachpartner

  • Aktives Beobachten der Projektauslastung: Wenn Folgeprojekte fehlen, bringst Du Ideen ein, stößt Vertriebsaktivitäten rechtzeitig an und holst Dir bei Bedarf Unterstützung, statt abzuwarten

  • Mitarbeit an praxistauglichen Verbesserungen unserer Abläufe am Standort Erkrath

Was Du mitbringen solltest

  • Eine technische Ausbildung im Bereich Kälte-, Klima-, Lüftungs-, Anlagen- oder Versorgungstechnik; eine Weiterbildung zum Meister oder Techniker ist von Vorteil, aber nicht zwingend entscheidend

  • Erfahrung in der praktischen Abwicklung von Montage-, Bau- oder Anlagenprojekten

  • Technisches Verständnis, kaufmännisches Grundgefühl und Sicherheit im Umgang mit Angeboten, Materialbestellungen und Projektkosten

  • Die Fähigkeit, Monteure klar anzuleiten, Arbeiten zu kontrollieren und auf der Baustelle verbindlich aufzutreten

  • Eine selbstständige, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise und die Bereitschaft, Themen konsequent bis zum Abschluss zu verfolgen

  • Kommunikationsstärke im Kontakt mit Kunden, Lieferanten, Nachunternehmern und anderen Gewerken

  • Ein gutes Gespür für neue Projekte und die Bereitschaft, vertriebliche Impulse zu setzen, ohne dass Du ein klassischer Vertriebsprofi sein musst

  • Führerschein Klasse B sowie Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Dienstreisen, insbesondere für Baustellenbesichtigungen, Baubesprechungen und Projekttermine

Was Dich bei uns erwartet

  • Unbefristete Perspektive

Ein langfristig angelegtes Arbeitsverhältnis in einem familiengeführten Unternehmen.

  • Dienstwagen

Ein Dienstwagen für Deine projektbezogenen Termine und Baustellenbesuche, auch zur privaten Nutzung nach individueller Vereinbarung.

  • Eigenverantwortung

Du organisierst Deine Projekte mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen und direkter Abstimmung.

  • Moderne Arbeitsmittel

Eine angemessene technische und digitale Ausstattung für Deine Projektarbeit.

  • Weiterentwicklung

Fachliche Weiterbildungen und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten passend zu Deiner Aufgabe.

  • Starker Verbund

Du profitierst von den Strukturen und Benefits unseres Unternehmensverbunds.

  • Leistungsbezogene Prämien

Jährliche Bonusauszahlung durch den Verbund

  • Zusätzliche Leistungen

300 EUR Gesundheitsbonus pro Jahr sowie Zuschüsse zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und zu vermögenswirksamen Leistungen (VL).

  • Gesundheit und Mobilität

Fahrradleasing und Angebote des Gesundheitsprogramms CareHuman ergänzen unser Leistungspaket.

  • Abwechslungsreiche Technik

Projekte für Kunden aus Einzelhandel, Industrie und Mineralölsektor sorgen für unterschiedliche technische Anforderungen.

  • Finanzielle Unterstützung bei der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge und Bezuschussung von vermögenswirksamen Leistungen

  • Gemeinsame Teamevents

Ganz offen

Diese Position ist nichts für jemanden, der Projekte nur vom Schreibtisch aus begleitet oder bei Schwierigkeiten auf eine Entscheidung von anderen wartet. Baustellen laufen nicht immer nach Plan. Deshalb brauchen wir jemanden, der sich ein Bild vor Ort macht, Prioritäten setzt, mit den Beteiligten spricht und eine tragfähige Lösung organisiert. Gleichzeitig erwarten wir, dass Du die Auslastung im Blick behältst und frühzeitig aktiv wirst, wenn neue Projekte fehlen. Du musst dabei nicht alles allein können, aber Du solltest erkennen, wann Unterstützung erforderlich ist, und sie gezielt einbinden.

title: R&D Facility & Safety Specialist
descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

YOUR IMPACT

As an R&D Facility & Safety Specialist, you will work with the Engineering Program, Safety and Operations teams to ensure the smooth and safe operation of Proxima’s Swiss industrial facilities. This is a high-ownership role requiring strong organizational and communication skills supporting structured technical thinking.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Act as the Sicherheitsbeauftragte/r (SiBe) or Safety Contact Person for Proxima Fusion’s Swiss subsidiary.

    • Coordinate our safety organisation and keep its documentation up to date

    • Coordinate risk assessments with team leads and external safety specialists

    • Investigate incidents and near misses, and advise management on risks and corrective actions

    • Own emergency and evacuation planning, first-aider coverage and drills

    • Manage safety inductions, safety training, and access rights to facilities

    • Act as the point of contact for regulators and authorities

  • Organise the day-to-day running of our two Swiss R&D facilities: workspace layout and housekeeping, shared areas and equipment booking, storage, waste disposal, and the interface with building owners and neighbors

  • Own maintenance and operations of our tooling, equipment and technical infrastructure: preventive maintenance, repairs, calibration, and inspections

  • Manage and procure consumables and stock materials for manufacturing

WHO YOU ARE

  • An experienced technician, technical engineer, safety engineer, or operations specialist with experience in hardware development environments

  • At least 3 years of work experience in either a research institute or an industrial setting

  • Holding SiBe/KOPAS training (SUVA or equivalent), or willing to complete it in your first three months; experienced applying health and safety practice in Switzerland or the EU

  • A proactive, detail-oriented team player who takes full ownership of delivering results.

  • A confident, self-aware communicator who collaborates well and can negotiate effectively with suppliers and external partners.

  • Fluent in German and conversational in English.

  • Holding a driving license valid in Switzerland.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Training or qualifications in industrial safety

  • Experience in warehouse management - knowledge of incoming goods best practices and experience building an in-house process.

  • Knowledge of fire safety and industrial hazards

  • Experience with cryogenic, pressure equipment, chemical and electrical hazards

  • Experience with heavy lift equipment and operations

  • First aid training

  • Qualified in Switzerland to operate overhead cranes or forklifts

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • On-site Technical Panel (3x60 min)

.

At Proxima Fusion, our mission is bold: making limitless clean energy a reality. To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: R&D - Software Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in!

We are looking for an R&D Software Engineer to bring production-grade software and data practices into our R&D measurement work. As we scale up VIO, our measurement data, metadata, and codebase are growing fast. You will take our existing measurement software and data practices to the next level, making them robust and maintainable, and building on how we organize data so it supports analysis, yield, and root cause investigations at scale. As channel counts grow, PCMs and test vehicles multiply, and test setups become more varied, you will standardize our experimental workflows so measurement throughput never becomes the bottleneck.

You will also be the link between R&D, the software team in Product, and the data team in Operations, so our efforts stay aligned.

What you’ll be doing

  • Data management: Develop and maintain how R&D measurement data and metadata are stored, linking each device to its related tests, components, and setup history, so cross-device comparisons and yield questions become a quick query.

  • Measurement software: Turn measurement prototypes from experimental physicists and RF test engineers into robust, tested, maintainable code, and maintain the R&D measurement codebase for VIO devices, their components, and PCM test vehicles.

  • Code architecture & quality: Review, refactor, and maintain modular Python code following modern software practices (automated testing with PyTest, CI/CD, documentation, version control).

  • Collaboration: Work day-to-day with experimental physicists, RF test engineers and electrical engineers to improve their measurement code, and connect R&D with the software team in Product to bring in best practices.

About Trigger.dev

Trigger.dev is an open source platform used by developers to build production-grade AI agents. It's an SDK and the infrastructure to run agents reliably at scale, so teams can focus on the product instead of the plumbing.

Our Cloud product is a managed service where we deploy our users' code and auto-scale from zero to millions of executions. With the rise of AI, being able to offload async tasks reliably is a key part of any developer's toolkit - we're building the infrastructure to make that a reality.

We're a small team shipping fast, and as we accelerate building new features and expand the team, we want to make sure the quality and polish of what we ship keeps pace. That's where you come in.

We're looking for a Design Engineer to help raise the bar on UX and visual quality across our product and marketing surfaces. You'll blend design sensibility with real engineering ability, and be able to take a rough idea, a Figma file, or even just a problem statement, and turn it into a well-crafted, production-quality experience yourself, without needing a traditional design-to-dev handoff.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for someone who cares as much about how something feels to use as they do about how it's built.

What you'll be doing

You'll do a variety of things including:

  • Designing and building high-quality, polished UI across our web app and marketing site

  • You'll work closely with the rest of the engineering team to build new features with a focus on design craft and great UX.

  • Owning design decisions end-to-end: from rough concept through to shipped, production code

  • Building and evolving our design system and component library so quality scales as the product grows

  • Improving accessibility, responsiveness, and interaction polish across existing product surfaces

  • Prototyping new ideas quickly in code as well as static mockups, so we can iterate fast

  • Helping instil a stronger design/UX sensibility across the wider engineering team

title: Endear - Product Designer
descriptionHtml:
Location: Remote, US-based
Team: Product & Design — IRL
Type: Full-Time, Employee
Compensation: $100K–$129K base
Target Start: January 2027 or earlier

Our Story

At Endear, we’re building the modern CRM for retail teams — starting with the frontline.

Our software helps retail teams build stronger customer relationships through thoughtful, intuitive technology. From clienteling and customer capture to appointments and in-store experiences, Endear gives brands the tools they need to create more personal interactions and drive measurable growth.

We work with brands like Allbirds, Reformation, and Alo Yoga, and we’re continuing to evolve Endear into an increasingly AI-first product built around how modern retail teams actually work.

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Product Designer to join our IRL (in real life) team, which owns the in-store side of Endear — including appointments, events, customer check-ins, and the administrative experiences behind those workflows.

You’ll design for store associates and managers running clienteling day to day, as well as admin users who help shape how those teams operate and manage their workflows.

In this role, you’ll own features and projects from understanding the problem through research, testing, iteration, and production-ready design, while partnering closely with our Head of Product Design on vision and direction.

The IRL roadmap is early. Many of these features don’t exist yet, so you’ll be defining problems through research before designing solutions.

This role is well suited for someone comfortable creating clarity when the solution isn’t obvious.

What You’ll Accomplish

In your first 6 months, you’ll…

  • Take ownership of IRL features from discovery through production-ready design

  • Build a strong understanding of how store associates, managers, and admin users work within Endear

  • Run research from early discovery through usability testing

  • Design complete, accessible product experiences, including loading, empty, error, permission, and other key states.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to shape solutions early in the process

  • Use customer insight and data to inform design decisions and iteration

In your first year, you’ll…

  • Build deeper ownership across the IRL product

  • Deliver product experiences that improve how retail teams manage clienteling and in-store workflows

  • Build a strong rhythm of discovery, testing, and continuous learning

  • Strengthen your collaboration across Design, Product, and Engineering

  • Demonstrate clear user and business impact through the work you ship

You’ll Thrive in This Role If…

  • You enjoy taking ownership of a feature while collaborating closely on the broader vision and direction

  • You’re comfortable with ambiguity and zero-to-one product work

  • You naturally think beyond the happy path and account for edge cases and complete product states

  • You care about creating accessible experiences and solving the right problem, not just creating polished UI

  • You enjoy working closely with Product and Engineering throughout the design process

  • You’re comfortable using research, data, and customer feedback to guide decisions

  • You move quickly, seek feedback, and iterate based on what you learn

  • You’re curious about designing for AI

You Have Experience With

  • 2–5 years working in product design

  • Independently owning features from discovery through implementation, with support on vision and direction

  • Running user research from discovery through usability testing

  • Translating broad or ambiguous problems into clear product solutions

  • Working closely with Design, Product, and Engineering teams

  • Designing complex, accessible workflows and accounting for loading, empty, error, and permission states

  • Using qualitative and quantitative data to inform design decisions

  • Building within established design patterns while knowing when something needs to evolve

  • Using AI tools as part of your workflow and applying judgment to AI-generated output

  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong product thinking and execution, and where you can articulate the impact of your work, with data where you had access to it

Align With What We Value

At Endear, we live by five core principles. Here’s how they translate into what we’re looking for in this role:

  • Customer First: You start by understanding the people using the product, run thoughtful research, and use what you learn to shape better experiences.

  • Take Ownership: You take responsibility for your features, follow through on the details, and care about the quality of what ships.

  • Enable Autonomy: You communicate clearly, collaborate early, and give Product and Engineering the context they need to make strong decisions together.

  • Under Promise, Over Deliver: You set realistic expectations, think through the details, and deliver complete, production-ready work.

  • Innovate & Deliver Value Quickly: You’re comfortable experimenting, using AI and other tools thoughtfully, and moving quickly without sacrificing sound product judgment.

About the Team

Endear’s product organization is structured across three product teams: AI, IRL, and Core Flows, with one designer dedicated to each.

As the IRL designer, you’ll work closely with a Product Manager and 2–3 Engineers while also being part of Endear’s three-person design team. You’ll report to the Head of Product Design, who will provide vision, direction, mentorship, and support as you grow in the role.

You’ll partner most closely with:

  • Head of Product Design: vision, direction, mentorship, feedback, and design leadership

  • Product Team: roadmap alignment, priorities, customer needs, and business context

  • Engineering Team: feasibility, implementation, and iteration

You’ll have access to mentorship, an education budget, and support around Endear’s AI processes to help you continue developing your craft and expanding how you use AI in your work.

We’re a small team with big ambitions — collaborative, customer-obsessed, and deeply excited about the problems we’re solving in retail.

Our Hiring Process

  1. Recruiter Screen

  2. Behavioral Interview with the Hiring Manager

  3. Team Portfolio Review with Design, Product + Engineering

  4. Final leadership conversation

  5. Offer 🎉

Compensation & Benefits

  • Base Salary: $100K–$129K

  • Fully remote, US-based team

  • Comprehensive healthcare (medical, dental, vision)

  • Co-working or home office stipend

  • Flexible PTO and unlimited vacation

  • Education and learning support

  • Opportunity to shape foundational product work in a transformative industry

Location: This role is remote and US-based. Our full team comes together for an all-team standup every Monday at 8:00 AM Pacific, so you’ll need to be available at that time.

Apply Even If You Don’t Check Every Box

If this role excites you but you’re unsure if you meet every requirement, reach out anyway. No retail or e-commerce background is required. We care about your product thinking, skills, motivation, and how you approach problems more than we do about perfect resumes.

descriptionHtml:

Stimmen unsere Company Values mit deiner Vision überein? Dann ist Pennylane der richtige Ort für dich!

 

Unsere Vision

Wir wollen das beliebteste finanzielle Betriebssystem für KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und Steuerberatungsgesellschaften werden.

Wir helfen Unternehmern, sich von zeitraubenden Aufgaben rund um Buchhaltung und Finanzen zu befreien, während wir ihnen gleichzeitig Zugang zu wichtigen Finanzinformationen verschaffen, um die besten Entscheidungen für ihr Unternehmen zu treffen.

 

Über uns

Pennylane ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Fintechs in Frankreich (und jetzt auch in Deutschland!).

In 5 Jahren unseres Bestehens haben wir Folgendes erreicht:

💻 Wir haben uns als bahnbrechende Buchhaltungs- und Finanzsoftware für kleine Unternehmen und ihre Buchhalter bekannt gemacht.

💰 Wir haben insgesamt 225 Millionen Euro eingesammelt, unter anderem von Sequoia, dem berühmten Fonds aus dem Silicon Valley, der früh in Unternehmen wie Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal und viele mehr investiert hat...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Wir sind von 7 Mitbegründern auf 900 zufriedene Pennylaner angewachsen: Wir gelten heute als einer der besten Arbeitsplätze in Frankreich (auch remote), mit einer Bewertung von 4,6/5 auf Glassdoor.

🌍 Wir haben ein internationales Umfeld mit mehr als 25 Nationalitäten aufgebaut, mit einer starken Remote-freundlichen Kultur, in der 30 % der Mitarbeiter bereits aus allen Teilen Europas arbeiten.

🤝 Wir haben das Vertrauen Tausender von Kunden und Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften gewonnen und hervorragende Bewertungen erhalten.

🚀 Bereits mehr als 900.000 KMU (kleine und mittlere Unternehmen) und über 5000 Wirtschaftsprüfungsgesellschaften nutzen Pennylane in Frankreich!

 

Deine Mission

Als Stimme unserer Kunden in Deutschland bist du verantwortlich für ihren Erfolg mit der Pennylane-Plattform.

Deine Kernaufgaben:

- Kunden-Onboarding: Du übernimmst die vollständige Einarbeitung (Onboarding) neuer Kunden – sowohl Unternehmen als auch Steuerberaterkanzleien – in die Pennylane-Plattform. Du stellst sicher, dass sie schnell den größtmöglichen Mehrwert aus unserer Lösung ziehen.

- Bestandskundenbetreuung: Du bist der primäre Ansprechpartner für unsere bestehenden Kunden. Du pflegst eine vertrauensvolle Beziehung, identifizierst Upsell-Potenziale und stellst sicher, dass die Kunden Pennylane optimal nutzen, um ihre Geschäftsziele zu erreichen.

- Proaktive Beratung: Du führst regelmäßige Health-Checks und Reviews durch, um die Kundenzufriedenheit und -bindung zu maximieren und Churn vorzubeugen.

- Interne Projektarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit dem deutschen Sales-Team und dem Management zusammen, um Prozesse zu optimieren, Feedback zu Produktanforderungen zu liefern und zum strategischen Wachstum von Pennylane in Deutschland beizutragen.

- Expertentum: Du entwickelst dich zum Produktexperten für die Finanz- und Buchhaltungslandschaft in Deutschland und teilst dieses Wissen mit unseren Kunden.

  

Das bringst du mit

- Erfahrung: 2-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Buchhaltung, Account Management oder einer ähnlichen kundenorientierten Rolle, idealerweise im Kanzlei-Umfeld oder alternativ im SaaS- oder Fintech-Bereich.

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellter, Steuerfachwirt oder Steuerberater oder Studium im Finance-Bereich

- Branchenwissen: Ein tiefes Verständnis für die Bedürfnisse von Unternehmen und/oder Steuerberatern in Bezug auf Finanzen, Rechnungsstellung und Buchhaltung ist notwendig.

- Soft Skills: Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Empathie und ein Talent dafür, komplexe Sachverhalte einfach zu erklären.

- Hands-on Mentalität: Als Teil eines Early-Stage-Teams in Deutschland bist du proaktiv, lösungsorientiert und bereit, Prozesse von Grund auf mitzugestalten.

- Reisebereitschaft: Für das Onboarding im Pariser HQ und für regelmäßige Besuche bei unseren Kunden innerhalb von Deutschland (ca. 1mal im Monat

- Sprachen: Verhandlungssichere Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau oder Muttersprache) und fließende Englischkenntnisse (für die Zusammenarbeit mit dem internationalen Team).

  

Was wir tun, um dein Arbeitsleben besser zu machen

🏢 Du kannst remote aus deinem Wohnsitz arbeiten, solange es in Deutschland liegt. Regelmäßige Arbeit aus dem europäischen Ausland ist möglich, wenn die Zeitverschiebung zur MEZ (Mitteleuropäische Zeit) maximal zwei Stunden beträgt.

🌴 Unabhängig davon, wo du ansässig bist, erhältst du 30 von Pennylane bezahlte Urlaubstage. 💵 Du erhältst ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungspaket.

📈 Du erhältst Unternehmensanteile, um vom Erfolg mitzuprofitieren, den du gemeinsam mit uns aufbaust.

🏡 Du erhältst ein Budget, um dein Zuhause in einen komfortableren Arbeitsplatz zu verwandeln, sowie eine monatliche Pauschale, um in einem Coworking Space zu arbeiten, wann immer du möchtest. In Berlin haben wir ein Office, aus dem regelmäßig gearbeitet werden kann.

🇬🇧 Du erhältst Zugang zu Busuu, um dein Englisch oder Französisch zu perfektionieren.

💻 Du erhältst die neueste Apple-Ausrüstung.

🎉 Wir legen Wert auf regelmäßige gemeinsame Veranstaltungen wie unsere Tech Days (die Remote-Pennylaner alle 3 Monate zusammenbringen) oder unser jährliches Firmenseminar, um wichtige Momente des Zusammenhalts für alle zu schaffen.

 

Wen wir suchen

Um bei Pennylane erfolgreich zu sein, benötigst du:

- Englischkenntnisse (das Niveau wird je nach Abteilung, für die du dich bewirbst, bewertet und eingeschätzt).

- Begeisterung für ein sich ständig wandelndes Arbeitsumfeld.

- Hohe Kooperationsbereitschaft (innerhalb deines Teams oder mit anderen Stakeholdern).

Wir wissen, dass einige Menschen eher zögern, sich zu bewerben, wenn sie das Gefühl haben, nicht die gesamte Liste der Kriterien zu erfüllen. Wenn du unsicher bist, ermutigen wir dich, dich trotzdem zu bewerben: Wer weiß, vielleicht ist es der Beginn einer sinnvollen und langfristigen Zusammenarbeit.

 

Wir möchten auch betonen, dass wir Vielfalt, Gleichheit und Inklusion voll und ganz befürworten und unser Bestes tun, um ein sicheres und integratives Umfeld zu schaffen. Wir verpflichten uns, gleiche Beschäftigungsmöglichkeiten unabhängig von Geschlecht, sexueller Orientierung, Herkunft, Behinderungen oder anderen Merkmalen, die dich ausmachen, zu gewährleisten. We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.

The Role

The goal of this role is pipeline revenue, driven through relationships. The Partner BDM is where the global partnership strategy meets the market, and you own the partner pipeline and revenue target for your region — you are the person who drives the strategy to meet and exceed that number. Every relationship, every lead, every partner conversation in your territory goes through you. You execute all three partnership pillars locally — integration depth, reseller acquisition, and long tail activation — and you feed the national programs run by Isabel and the Director of Reseller Partnerships with the contacts, intelligence, and HubSpot discipline that makes those programs possible.

This role also carries a global partner management component. In addition to your regional territory, you will be assigned one or two global partner accounts — relationships that span multiple BDM regions and require a consistent strategic, commercial presence above the regional level. You will manage these accounts directly, briefing with the Global Partner Marketing Manager before any senior contact touchpoint and feeding back the account intelligence that informs RPG's global partner strategy.

The BDM is not a lone hunter. You are supported by intelligence briefs from the Director of Partnership Strategy, onboarding infrastructure from the Partner Operation and Enablement Manager, co-sell support from the Director of Channel Growth Reseller, and global account context from the Global Partner Marketing Manager. The discipline of using those inputs — requesting briefs before first calls, completing HubSpot fields that trigger Isabel's onboarding, registering every lead in Introw on the day — is what makes the whole system work.

Your Role

Pipeline and revenue ownership — your region

  • Own the partner pipeline and revenue target for your region — you are the person who drives the strategy to meet and exceed this number, not just a contributor to it

  • Build and maintain a consistent bottoms-up pipeline plan, built up against your region's targets and TAM — showing exactly how your book of business adds up to your target, by partner type and by deal stage

  • Forecast monthly, ahead of the full-team KPR review — reforecasting pipeline and revenue coverage against target, reconciling to the latest refreshed regional targets/TAM where these have moved, so gaps are visible early and plans can be adjusted before target dates, not after

Regional partner development — all partner types

  • Build and manage the full partner portfolio in your territory: integration partners, resellers, consultants, hotel management companies, and referral partners

  • Source new reseller and consultant contacts in your region — using the Ideal Reseller Partner Profile as the qualification standard

  • Execute the partner conversation playbook for each contact type: open with the partner intelligence brief, use the CS manager and KAM conversation guides for integration partners, apply the reseller screening framework for agency contacts

  • Request a partner intelligence brief from the Director Channel Growth - Integration before every first partner outreach — no first conversation without a brief

  • Complete the 4 mandatory HubSpot fields (deal stage, partner fields, agreement file, partnership type) before advancing any deal past the signed stage — this triggers Isabel's onboarding program

  • Register every qualified lead in Introw on the day it is received, tagged by source type (integration referral / reseller / consultant / reactivated dormant)

Global Partner Account Management

  • Own one or two assigned global partner accounts — relationships where the partner operates across multiple BDM territories and requires consistent commercial management above the regional level

  • Build the regional strategy for each assigned global account that generates pipeline — not just relationship maintenance; you are responsible for identifying where the pipeline comes from in your territory and driving it

  • Coordinate with Global Partner Marketing Manager before any senior touchpoint at a global partner account — global commercial context will be provided; you provide the regional relationship intelligence

  • Maintain the account relationship at the appropriate contact levels (sales, CS, KAM, implementation) — applying the multi-level engagement model from the Partner Activation Playbook

  • Feed the Head of Global Partnerships and the Global Partner Marketing Manager with global account intelligence after every significant touchpoint — health signals, competitive intelligence, co-marketing opportunities, and any escalation requirements

  • Support the coordination of co-marketing and QBR activity with the global partner where it involves your region

Long Tail Activation — Regional subset

  • Own your regional subset of the 272 dormant signed partners — the Director Channel Growth - Reseller & Consultant,provides the segmented list, you own the outreach

  • Execute the tiered re-engagement approach: Tier 1 (60–90 days dormant) with a personalized message within the first week of assignment; Tier 2 with re-qualification before any effort; Tier 3 with a single attempt then escalation to Isabel to archive

  • Report progress on your regional dormant subset to Isabel weekly during the H2 activation sprint

Market intelligence and HubSpot discipline

  • Surface partner contacts and market intelligence to the Reseller PM in the bi-weekly regional intel exchange — which reseller types are gaining traction, which are declining, what competitive signals are emerging

  • Flag any integration partner conversation where an all-in-one competitive angle appears — the Strategy Manager updates the competitive library with field intelligence

  • Maintain HubSpot contact and deal records at the expected quality standard — the data in HubSpot is what the whole team uses to run the business; poor data quality breaks Isabel's onboarding, Isabel's dormancy tracking, and Introw attribution simultaneously

  • Participate in the monthly full-team KPR review — presenting your regional lead pipeline and flagging any structural blockers

Your Profile

  • 2+ years in a B2B business development, partnerships, or commercial account management role — ideally in SaaS, hospitality technology, or a related field

  • Demonstrates advanced proficiency in German (C2 level), with excellent command of both

  • Track record of building relationships and generating pipeline from scratch in a defined territory — not managing inbound, but generating outbound

  • Comfortable operating across multiple partner types and conversation styles in a single week — integration partnership conversations require a different approach than reseller qualification

  • HubSpot or CRM discipline — this is a non-negotiable requirement; the quality of your data determines the quality of the team's output

  • Based in the target territory — regional credibility and proximity to local partners is part of the role

Nice to Have

  • Existing network in the hotel technology ecosystem (PMS, channel manager, consultants, or revenue management) in the relevant territory

  • Experience managing global or multi-territory accounts in addition to a local territory portfolio

  • Familiarity with Introw, PartnerStack, Reditus, or similar partner and commission tracking platforms

  • Revenue management or hospitality operations background — understanding how an independent hotel owner thinks is a genuine advantage in partner conversations

What We Offer at RoomPriceGenie 💪

At RoomPriceGenie, we don’t just offer jobs; we offer an adventure! 🚀 Join us in an exciting startup atmosphere where you can grow your career while changing the world for tens of thousands of independent hoteliers. 🌍 Our global and diverse team is fueled by passion and a shared mission. We thrive in a culture that’s all about transparency, respect, and making a real impact together.

title: Senior AWS Platform Engineer
descriptionHtml:
At Luscii, we are creating space for care by building digital health applications that help people manage their health. Applications such as the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. Together with healthcare professionals around the world, we build technology that helps users receive the right care in the right place. Millions of people rely on our products every month, and behind every reliable healthcare experience is a cloud platform that simply works. As engineer working on our apps, you will play a vital role in modernising the cloud platform that powers the platform, creating a more reliable, scalable and future-proof foundation for millions of users worldwide.

OMRON Connect is one of the largest digital health platforms in our ecosystem, connecting millions of users with their healthcare data through OMRON devices. Much of the platform has grown over many years and was partly built by external partners. Today, we're investing heavily in bringing that knowledge, ownership and technical excellence in-house. This is not about replacing everything overnight. It is about making thoughtful engineering decisions, modernising step by step, and building a cloud platform that gives our engineering teams the foundations, tooling and confidence they need to deliver safely and independently.

Your work will have a direct impact on the reliability, scalability and cost-efficiency of a platform serving several million monthly active users across the world. You will help shape our cloud and engineering standards, introduce modern practices where they genuinely add value, and make Infrastructure as Code, observability and safe continuous delivery the default rather than the exception. By creating reusable infrastructure, improving developer experience and removing unnecessary complexity, you will help teams move faster without compromising reliability or security. Along the way, you will collaborate with engineers, influence technical direction and leave the platform in a significantly better state than you found it.

Your role

You will become one of the technical driving forces behind the cloud platforms that power our digital health applications. Working closely with fellow engineers, product teams and colleagues across countries, you will help shape and improve our cloud infrastructure, strengthen the developer experience and ensure reliability, security and scalability are built into the foundations of our technology. Your exact focus will evolve with the needs of our teams and the opportunities you identify to make a lasting impact.

This is a role for someone who enjoys solving difficult engineering problems without chasing complexity for complexity's sake. You will help us balance innovation with pragmatism, modernising a live healthcare platform while maintaining the stability that patients and healthcare professionals depend on every day.

What you will be doing, among others:

  • Design, build and evolve our AWS platform using Terraform as the single source of truth, while driving the gradual modernisation of our cloud landscape;

  • Build reusable infrastructure, deployment pipelines and platform tooling that enable engineering teams to ship independently and safely;

  • Introduce pragmatic cloud-native and event-driven solutions where they genuinely improve scalability, reliability and maintainability;

  • Make observability a default through standardised monitoring, logging, dashboards and alerting across the platform;

  • Improve deployment practices with automated CI/CD, progressive delivery and reliable rollback strategies;

  • Embed security, compliance and cost optimisation into the platform through automated guardrails and best practices;

  • Coach fellow engineers, review infrastructure and application code, and raise the overall cloud engineering bar through collaboration and example.

The responsibilities outlined above reflect how we currently envision this role. As we continue to grow and evolve, the scope and focus of the position may naturally change, influenced by your own ideas and insights. The way we work is built around the belief that everyone's input matters. If you see opportunities to improve the way we do things, or believe a process could be designed differently to achieve a better outcome, we encourage you to bring those ideas forward. Discuss them with your teammates, challenge the status quo, and help shape how we move forward together.

Why Luscii?

Read more about working at Luscii / OMRON and how we work as a team. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy. Luscii is part of OMRON DH; together we built for the long term. To work on making healthcare better.

Most important benefits

  • Salary: Naturally, this depends on your background, experience, and relevant expertise. You may think of a maximum salary of approximately €86.000,- to €94.000,- per year for this position.

  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii.

  • Flexible setup: Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here.

The ideal candidate…

… probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for someone who enjoys taking ownership of complex technical challenges, makes pragmatic engineering decisions, and is excited about helping others succeed along the way.

You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust.

  • You have at least 6 years of experience building and operating large-scale cloud platforms, with deep hands-on AWS expertise and including the same amount of experience in senior-level ownership of modern cloud architectures;

  • You have extensive experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and treat infrastructure with the same rigour as application code;

  • You have a strong understanding of cloud-native, serverless and event-driven architectures, and the judgement to apply them pragmatically;

  • You know how to build reliable production systems with observability, automated deployments and safe release practices built in;

  • You enjoy modernising legacy platforms through incremental improvements rather than big-bang rewrites, while bringing others along in the process;

  • You have strong backend engineering experience, preferably with Node.js and TypeScript;

  • You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities;

  • English is our primary language for all internal communication at Luscii, so you're fluent in that language.

Interested? Apply now!

Would you like more information? Feel free to contact our recruiter Björn Bogerd via

What does the recruitment process look like?

We organise three interviews for each vacancy. It is an extensive process, but we want to ensure that there is a good fit in regards to a potential collaboration, our culture and our way of working. All interviews are conducted online and the entire procedure is planned in advance to keep momentum.

descriptionHtml:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionaryin 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

As a Backend Senior Software Engineer on the Data Layer team, you'll help build and evolve the storage and query layer that keeps Camunda 8's process data fast, accurate, and available at scale. Spanning both relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, the data layer and its data pipelines power everything from process monitoring to the new agent-driven automation capabilities we're rolling out.

As part of the Data Layer team, you will work on both technically challenging and rewarding projects, such as reshaping how we store and retain process data, streaming data to external systems, and evolving our secondary storage systems to perform at ever greater scale.

At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, design, QA, and support, and work with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence how our data layer evolves to meet our customers' needs.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and maintain backend services for the data layer that stores and serves Camunda 8's process data, spanning relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, with an eye toward correctness, performance, and scale.

  • Own the end-to-end delivery of engineering initiatives, working with Product Management and colleagues across the business to break down requirements into concrete solution designs, driving projects to timely and high-quality delivery.

  • Help evolve how we process, retain, and expose process data, so customers can work with their data the way they need to.

  • Invest in making our secondary storage systems more performant and scalable as usage grows, and build tooling that makes it easier to understand, troubleshoot, and safely operate the data layer in production.

  • Participate in L3 support and on-call rotations, partnering with Support and SRE to investigate data layer production issues, and feeding what you learn back into the product.

What You Will Bring to the Role:

Must Haves:

  • At least 7 years of experience as a backend engineer, in Java, with a strong focus on backend systems and production data stores

  • Deep experience with both Relational Databases (ideally PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, or MSSQL), and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, with a practical understanding of query performance, indexing, and data modeling trade-offs

  • Proven experience leading medium-to-large engineering initiatives (3+ months) end-to-end — solution design, project planning, coordinating across teams, and driving predictable delivery.

  • Comfortable investigating slow queries, execution plans, and index usage to root-cause data-related production issues.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills in a remote-first environment: you translate requirements into actionable technical work with Product, and give and receive clear, direct feedback in code review.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience building workflow automation or process orchestration software.

  • Experience building or maintaining CI pipelines.

  • Understanding of database migration tooling (e.g. Liquibase, Flyway) and schema evolution in a live system.

This role will focus on high-impact campaigns aligned to the Financial Services industry, leveraging industry-specific insights to personalize the buyer journey and deepen executive engagement.

title: Reporting & Data Analyst (6-Month FTC)
descriptionHtml:
THE ROLE📝 

We’re looking for a Reporting & Data Analyst to help Form3 develop a more reliable, scalable and accessible reporting capability across the organisation. 

This is a six-month fixed-term contract with two clear priorities: completing and enhancing the Customer Service reporting suite in AWS QuickSight, and building trusted, reusable datasets that enable teams to create and maintain their own reporting. 

You’ll work across the business to improve data quality, reduce manual reporting and establish stronger documentation, governance and knowledge transfer for the future. 

  • Complete and enhance the Customer Service reporting suite and reporting deck in AWS QuickSight. 
  • Design, build and document reusable datasets for multiple reporting use cases. 
  • Integrate key business systems into curated reporting datasets. 
  • Translate stakeholder questions into clear data and dashboard requirements. 
  • Establish consistent business metrics, definitions and reporting logic. 
  • Automate manual reporting and duplicated data preparation where possible. 
  • Validate reporting outputs and investigate data-quality issues. 
  • Provide knowledge transfer to internal teams and support a longer-term reporting roadmap. 

WE’RE LOOKING FOR 🔍 

Essential 

  • Experience in a Reporting Analyst, Data Analyst, BI Analyst or similar role. 
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining dashboards using AWS QuickSight or a comparable BI platform. 
  • Practical experience using SQL and Python for reporting, data transformation or analysis. 
  • Experience working with multiple data sources and translating stakeholder requirements into accurate, maintainable reporting. 
  • A self-sufficient and pragmatic approach, with the ability to take ownership and deliver within a focused six-month engagement. 

Desirable 

  • Experience using Amazon Athena or a similar cloud-based data querying service. 
  • Experience creating curated datasets for self-service reporting. 
  • Experience improving data quality, reporting governance and technical documentation. 
  • Experience working in a start-up, scale-up or small team where you have had broad ownership. 

TECH STACK ⚙️ 

  • AWS QuickSight - building dashboards, reporting suites and reusable datasets. 
  • SQL - querying, transforming and validating reporting data. 
  • Python - supporting data transformation, automation and reporting workflows. 
  • Business and operational systems - integrating data sources into trusted reporting datasets.

INTERVIEW PROCESS ✍️ 

Stage 1: Screening Call with Talent Team 

Stage 2: Practical Technical Task 

Stage 3: Interview with the Hiring Manager, including a discussion of your technical task and your approach to reporting, data quality, stakeholder requirements and self-service analytics 

We always aim to stick to the above process, however there may be occasions when an additional interview stage is needed for us to be sure we’re hiring the right fit for the role. 

HIRING LOCATIONS📍 

Here are the locations that we are hiring from for this position. 

  • United Kingdom 

All new joiners start their first day in our office to collect the equipment needed to work remotely. We'll also arrange for some of your team to come in to say hi, ensuring you're supported and have a positive first few days with Form3! 

BENEFITS 🏝️ 

Form3 are a 100% remote, flexible business and are able to offer part-time working arrangements. We believe this enables our people to achieve amazing things with a healthy work-life balance. 

For further information on what it’s like to work here, and for more information on our full benefits package, visit our careers page. If you have any other questions, we’d be happy to discuss these with your during the interview process. 

ABOUT FORM3 💭 

Revolutionising the world of payments with our cloud-native, multi-cloud platform. For more information about Form3, check out the following pages: 

What we do | Life at Form3 | Benefits | Payments Cannot Fail Series | .Tech Podcast 

OUR DEI&B COMMITMENT 

We hire talented people from a variety of backgrounds and experiences and are committed to a work environment based on diversity, open-mindedness and curiosity. We’re united by our company values (we even created them together!) and we celebrate our unique differences. 

Our employee lifecycle processes are designed to embrace equal opportunity and prevent discrimination against our people regardless of personal characteristics. It is our strong belief that the more inclusive and belonging we are as a business, the better our work will be. 

As an inclusive employer, we guarantee to interview all neurodiverse and physically disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria for this role. We also encourage candidates to notify us of any reasonable adjustments that may be required during the recruitment process. This includes providing job adverts in alternative, accessible formats or adjustments required at interview stage. 

If you consider yourself to be neurodiverse or physically disabled under the UN definition of disability and would like to be considered under this scheme and/or require any reasonable adjustments please let us know by sending an email to clearly stating your consent for us to process this data.

For more information please refer to our Recruitment Data Policy.

title: Business Analyst / Requirements Engineer 80-100% (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Arbeitsort: Zürich (GreenCit)

Die Swiss Learning Hub AG ist ein EdTech-Unternehmen für digitales Lernen. Von der Beratung bis zur Implementierung von cloudbasierten Komplettlösungen begleiten wir unsere Kunden in allen Belangen der digitalen Transformation. Unsere Plattform deckt die gesamte berufliche Lernbiografie ab – von der Erstausbildung über die betriebliche bis zur tertiären Bildung.

Evento ist unser Produkt für die Administration von Bildungsinstitutionen. Wir entwickeln es gemeinsam mit einer Gruppe internationaler Fachhochschulen, Universitäten, Berufsfachschulen und Schweizer Kantonen weiter. Tausende Personen aus der Schulverwaltung sowie Lehrkräfte, Lernende und Studierende setzen Evento täglich ein.

Aufgaben

Du arbeitest im Requirements Engineering für Evento und verantwortest dabei die Anforderungen der gesamten Bandbreite unserer Kundschaft mit: Fachhochschulen, Universitäten und Berufsfachschulen.

Das heisst: Du arbeitest direkt mit den Fachverantwortlichen dieser Institutionen, verstehst deren Prozesse tief genug, um Anforderungen hinter den Anforderungen zu erkennen, und führst widersprüchliche Interessen zu tragfähigen Lösungen zusammen.

Du bewegst dich dabei in mehreren fachlich dichten Domänen gleichzeitig – Studiengangstrukturen, Curriculumsplanung und Leistungsnachweise im tertiären Bereich, Lehrverhältnisse, Klassen- und Semesterplanung, Qualifikationsverfahren und Notenwesen in der Berufsbildung. Die Bildungsstufen unterscheiden sich in Terminologie, rechtlichen Rahmenbedingungen und Prozesslogik, teilen aber dasselbe Produkt – eines mit gewachsener Historie und grosser installierter Basis. Das verlangt Urteilsvermögen dafür, welche Anforderung sich lohnt, welche als gemeinsame Lösung taugt und welche nicht.

Die Rolle ist bewusst gestaltend angelegt: Du bringst deine Sicht in Priorisierungsentscheide ein und prägst mit, wie sich Evento fachlich weiterentwickelt.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Anforderungen aus Fachhochschulen, Universitäten und Berufsfachschulen eigenständig erheben, analysieren und spezifizieren – von der ersten Kundenidee bis zur umsetzungsreifen Beschreibung

  • Umsetzungsvarianten erarbeiten, gegeneinander abwägen und die Machbarkeit mit der Entwicklung klären

  • Workshops und Abstimmungen mit Stakeholdern mehrerer Institutionen und Bildungsstufen selbstständig vorbereiten, moderieren und zu Entscheiden führen

  • Widersprüchliche Anforderungen über Institutionen und Bildungsstufen hinweg zu einer produktfähigen Lösung zusammenführen, statt für jeden Kunden einen Sonderfall zu bauen

  • Gemeinsamkeiten zwischen den Bildungsstufen erkennen und dort, wo es fachlich trägt, auf ein gemeinsames Konzept führen

  • Qualität, Konsistenz und Nachvollziehbarkeit der Anforderungen über Releases hinweg sicherstellen

  • Eng mit Produktmanagement, Entwicklung, Test und Support zusammenarbeiten

  • Tests, Abnahmen und Rollouts fachlich begleiten

  • Verantworten, dass die Programmdokumentation bei der Auslieferung neuer Versionen aktuell und belastbar ist

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

  • 2 bis 4 Jahre Erfahrung in Business Analysis, Requirements Engineering oder einer vergleichbaren Rolle

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Weiterbildung in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich, oder eine gleichwertige Laufbahn

  • Sicherheit im methodischen Handwerk: Erhebungstechniken, Spezifikationsformen, Modellierung von Prozessen und Datenstrukturen, Umgang mit Traceability

  • Vorzugsweise Erfahrung in einer fachlich komplexen Domäne – Kenntnisse des schweizerischen Bildungssystems, sei es aus dem tertiären Bereich oder aus der Berufsbildung, sind ein deutlicher Vorteil, ebenso Kenntnisse von Evento

  • Bereitschaft, spec-driven zu arbeiten und AI-gestützte Werkzeuge in der Spezifikations- und Dokumentationsarbeit einzusetzen

  • Strukturierte, analytische Arbeitsweise und die Fähigkeit, komplexe Sachverhalte präzise und verständlich zu formulieren

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Benefits

Direkter Zugang zu den Fachverantwortlichen internationaler Fachhochschulen, Universitäten, Berufsfachschulen und Schweizer Kantone – keine Anforderungen aus zweiter Hand

  • Fachliche Breite über die gesamte Lernbiografie hinweg, von der Berufsbildung bis zur tertiären Stufe

  • Ein Produkt mit tausenden täglichen Nutzenden, an dem deine Spezifikationen sichtbar wirken

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege in einem Unternehmen mit rund 60 Mitarbeitenden

  • Ein Umfeld, das methodisch nachzieht: spec-driven, AI-gestützt, mit Anspruch an belastbare Dokumentation

Wir arbeiten in einem dynamischen und anspruchsvollen Umfeld mit spannenden Herausforderungen. Wenn du auch in hektischen Zeiten den Humor nicht verlierst und eine offene, unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeit mitbringst, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Bei uns erwarten dich viel Eigenverantwortung und Raum zur Entfaltung, abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben in einem engagierten Team, eine offene Du-Kultur, flexible Arbeitsmodelle mit Homeoffice an bis zu 3 Tagen pro Woche.

title: Research Staff, Voice AI Foundations - Remote
descriptionHtml:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

The Opportunity

Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone.


The Role

As a Member of the Research Staff, you will pioneer the development of Latent Space Models (LSMs), a new approach that aims to solve the fundamental data, scale, and cost challenges associated with building robust, contextualized voice AI. Your research will focus on solving one or more of the following problems:

  • Build next-generation neural audio codecs that achieve extreme, low bit-rate compression and high fidelity reconstruction across a world-scale corpus of general audio.

  • Pioneer steerable generative models that can synthesize the full diversity of human speech from the codec latent representation, from casual conversation to highly emotional expression to complex multi-speaker scenarios with environmental noise and overlapping speech.

  • Develop embedding systems that cleanly factorize the codec latent space into interpretable dimensions of speaker, content, style, environment, and channel effects -- enabling precise control over each aspect and the ability to massively amplify an existing seed dataset through “latent recombination”.

  • Leverage latent recombination to generate synthetic audio data at previously impossible scales, unlocking joint model and data scaling paradigms for audio.  Endeavor to train multimodal speech-to-speech systems that can 1) understand any human irrespective of their demographics, state, or environment and 2) produce empathic, human-like responses that achieve conversational or task-oriented objectives.   

  • Design model architectures, training schemes, and inference algorithms that are adapted for hardware at the bare metal enabling cost efficient training on billion-hour datasets and powering real-time inference for hundreds of millions of concurrent conversations.

The Challenge

We are seeking researchers who:

  • See "unsolved" problems as opportunities to pioneer entirely new approaches

  • Can identify the one critical experiment that will validate or kill an idea in days, not months

  • Have the vision to scale successful proofs-of-concept 100x

  • Are obsessed with using AI to automate and amplify your own impact

If you find yourself energized rather than daunted by these expectations—if you're already thinking about five ideas to try while reading this—you might be the researcher we need. This role demands obsession with the problems, creativity in approach, and relentless drive toward elegant, scalable solutions. The technical challenges are immense, but the potential impact is transformative.


It's Important to Us That You Have

  • Strong mathematical foundation in statistical learning theory, particularly in areas relevant to self-supervised and multimodal learning

  • Deep expertise in foundation model architectures, with an understanding of how to scale training across multiple modalities

  • Proven ability to bridge theory and practice—someone who can both derive novel mathematical formulations and implement them efficiently

  • Demonstrated ability to build data pipelines that can process and curate massive datasets while maintaining quality and diversity

  • Track record of designing controlled experiments that isolate the impact of architectural innovations and validate theoretical insights

  • Experience optimizing models for real-world deployment, including knowledge of hardware constraints and efficiency techniques

  • History of open-source contributions or research publications that have advanced the state of the art in speech/language AI


Ideal Researcher Profile

An ideal researcher, as evidenced by the recurring themes across these foundational papers, excels in five key areas: (1) Statistical & Mathematical Foundations, (2) Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation, (3) Data-Driven & Scalable Systems, (4) Hardware & Systems Understanding, and (5) Rigorous Experimental Design. Below is a synthesis of how each paper highlights these qualities, with references illustrating why they matter for building robust, impactful deep learning models.



1. Statistical & Mathematical Foundations

Mastery of Core Concepts

Many papers, like Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models and Neural Discrete Representation Learning (VQ-VAE), reflect the importance of power-law analyses, derivation of novel losses, or adaptation of fundamental equations (e.g., in VQ-VAE's commitment loss or rectified flows in Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers). Such mathematical grounding clarifies why models converge or suffer collapse.

Combining Existing Theories in Novel Ways

Papers such as Moshi (combining text modeling, audio codecs, and hierarchical generative modeling) and Finite Scalar Quantization (FSQ's adaptation of classic scalar quantization to replace vector-quantized representations) show how reusing but reimagining known techniques can yield breakthroughs. Many references (e.g., the structured state-space duality in Transformers are SSMs) underscore how unifying previously separate research lines can reveal powerful algorithmic or theoretical insights.

Logical Reasoning and Assumption Testing

Across all papers—particularly in the problem statements of Whisper or Rectified Flow Transformers—the authors present assumptions (e.g., "scaling data leads to zero-shot robustness" or "straight-line noise injection improves sample efficiency") and systematically verify them with thorough empirical results. An ideal researcher similarly grounds new ideas in well-formed, testable hypotheses.


2. Algorithmic Innovation & Implementation

Creative Solutions to Known Bottlenecks

Each paper puts forth a unique algorithmic contribution—Rectified Flow Transformers redefines standard diffusion paths, FSQ proposes simpler scalar quantizations contrasted with VQ, phi-3 mini relies on curated data and blocksparse attention, and Mamba-2 merges SSM speed with attention concepts.

Turning Theory into Practice

Whether it's the direct preference optimization (DPO) for alignment in phi-3 or the residual vector quantization in SoundStream, these works show that bridging design insights with implementable prototypes is essential.

Clear Impact Through Prototypes & Open-Source

Many references (Whisper, neural discrete representation learning, Mamba-2) highlight releasing code or pretrained models, enabling the broader community to replicate and build upon new methods. This premise of collaboration fosters faster progress.


3. Data-Driven & Scalable Systems

Emphasis on Large-Scale Data and Efficient Pipelines

Papers such as Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision (Whisper) and BASE TTS demonstrate that collecting and processing hundreds of thousands of hours of real-world audio can unlock new capabilities in zero-shot or low-resource domains. Meanwhile, phi-3 Technical Report shows that filtering and curating data at scale (e.g., "data optimal regime") can yield high performance even in smaller models.

Strategic Use of Data for Staged Training

A recurring strategy is to vary sources of data or the order of tasks. Whisper trains on multilingual tasks, BASE TTS uses subsets/stages for pretraining on speech tokens, and phi-3 deploys multiple training phases (web data, then synthetic data). This systematic approach to data underscores how an ideal researcher designs training curricula and data filtering protocols for maximum performance.


4. Hardware & Systems Understanding

Efficient Implementations at Scale

Many works illustrate how researchers tune architectures for modern accelerators: the In-Datacenter TPU paper exemplifies domain-specific hardware design for dense matrix multiplications, while phi-3 leverages blocksparse attention and custom Triton kernels to run advanced LLMs on resource-limited devices.

Real-Time & On-Device Constraints

SoundStream shows how to compress audio in real time on a smartphone CPU, demonstrating that knowledge of hardware constraints (latency, limited memory) drives design choices. Similarly, Moshi's low-latency streaming TTS and phi-3-mini's phone-based inference highlight that an ideal researcher must adapt algorithms to resource limits while maintaining robustness.

Architectural & Optimization Details

Papers like Mamba-2 in Transformers are SSMs and the In-Datacenter TPU work show how exploiting specialized matrix decomposition, custom memory hierarchies, or quantization approaches can lead to breakthroughs in speed or energy efficiency.


5. Rigorous Experimental Design

Controlled Comparisons & Ablations

Nearly all papers—Whisper, FSQ, Mamba-2, BASE TTS—use systematic ablations to isolate the impact of individual components (e.g., ablation on vector-quantization vs. scalar quantization in FSQ, or size of codebooks in VQ-VAEs). This approach reveals which design decisions truly matter.

Multifold Evaluation Metrics

From MUSHRA listening tests (SoundStream, BASE TTS) to FID in image synthesis (Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers, FSQ) to perplexity or zero-shot generalization in language (phi-3, Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models), the works demonstrate the value of comprehensive, carefully chosen metrics.

Stress Tests & Edge Cases

Whisper's out-of-distribution speech benchmarks, SoundStream's evaluation on speech + music, or Mamba-2's performance on multi-query associative recall demonstrate the importance of specialized challenge sets. Researchers who craft or adopt rigorous benchmarks and "red-team" their models (as in phi-3 safety alignment) are better prepared to address real-world complexities.



Summary

Overall, an ideal researcher in deep learning consistently demonstrates:

  • A solid grounding in theoretical and statistical principles

  • A talent for proposing and validating new algorithmic solutions

  • The capacity to orchestrate data pipelines that scale and reflect real-world diversity

  • Awareness of hardware constraints and system-level trade-offs for efficiency

  • Thorough and transparent experimental practices

These qualities surface across research on speech (Whisper, BASE TTS), language modeling (Scaling Laws, phi-3), specialized hardware (TPU, Transformers are SSMs), and new representation methods (VQ-VAE, FSQ, SoundStream). By balancing these attributes—rigorous math, innovative algorithms, large-scale data engineering, hardware-savvy optimizations, and reproducible experimentation—researchers can produce impactful, trustworthy advancements in foundational deep learning.




Foundational Papers

This job description was generated through analysis of the following papers:

  • Robust Speech Recognition via Large-Scale Weak Supervision (arXiv:2212.04356)

  • Moshi: a speech-text foundation model for real-time dialogue (arXiv:2410.00037)

  • Scaling Rectified Flow Transformers for High-Resolution Image Synthesis (arXiv:2403.03206)

  • Scaling Laws for Neural Language Models (arXiv:2001.08361)

  • BASE TTS: Lessons from building a billion-parameter Text-to-Speech model on 100K hours of data (arXiv:2402.08093)

  • In-Datacenter Performance Analysis of a Tensor Processing Unit (arXiv:1704.04760)

  • Neural Discrete Representation Learning (arXiv:1711.00937)

  • SoundStream: An End-to-End Neural Audio Codec (arXiv:2107.03312)

  • Finite Scalar Quantization: VQ-VAE Made Simple (arXiv:2309.15505)

  • Phi-3 Technical Report: A Highly Capable Language Model Locally on Your Phone (arXiv:2404.14219)

  • Transformers are SSMs: Generalized Models and Efficient Algorithms Through Structured State Space Duality (arXiv:2405.21060)

title: Responsable de la Sécurité des Systèmes d’Information (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
Description du poste

Le RSSI Groupe aura pour mission de définir, piloter et contrôler la stratégie de cybersécurité du Groupe, avec quatre objectifs principaux :

  1. Réduire l'exposition du Groupe aux risques cyber susceptibles d'affecter ses activités, ses données, ses clients ou son image.
  2. Travailler en collaboration avec la DSI, s’assurer que les bonnes pratiques au niveau du SI soient mises en place.
  3. Garantir notre capacité à répondre aux exigences réglementaires, contractuelles et clients en matière de sécurité.
  4. Structurer la préparation et le suivi des audits, en assurant la mise en œuvre et la clôture des plans d'actions associés.
  5. Donner à la Direction une vision consolidée du niveau de risque cyber, des priorités et des actions engagées.

Vos principales missions

Le RSSI Groupe aura notamment la responsabilité de :

    • Définir la stratégie et la feuille de route cybersécurité Groupe ;
    • Identifier et évaluer les principaux risques cyber auxquels le Groupe est exposé ;
    • Proposer à la Direction les priorités et investissements nécessaires à leur maîtrise ;
    • Définir les règles et politiques de sécurité applicables au Groupe ;
    • Coordonner les actions cybersécurité entre les différentes entités ;
    • Accompagner les filiales et les projets stratégiques sur les sujets de sécurité ;
    • Piloter la conformité aux différentes exigences applicables au Groupe ;
    • Préparer et coordonner les audits clients, réglementaires et internes ;
    • Piloter les plans de remédiation issus de ces audits ;
    • Structurer la gestion et l'escalade des incidents cyber ;
    • Développer la sensibilisation et la culture cybersécurité auprès des collaborateurs et du management ;
    • Évaluer les risques liés aux fournisseurs et partenaires critiques ;
    • Mettre en place des indicateurs permettant à la Direction de suivre régulièrement le niveau de risque et l'avancement de la feuille de route.

Requirements

Idéalement : 5 à 10 ans d'expérience en cybersécurité, dont une expérience en gouvernance ou management de la sécurité.

Une expérience dans un environnement :

  • Industriel ;
  • Aéronautique ;
  • Défense ;
  • International ;

Compétences

Le candidat devra maîtriser ou connaître :

  • Gouvernance cybersécurité ;
  • Analyse de risques ;
  • Gestion des audits ;
  • Gestion des incidents ;
  • Gestion des vulnérabilités ;
  • IAM ;
