title: RF Test & Validation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

As RF Test & Validation Engineer, you own the characterization and validation of Harmattan’s in-house radio, from boards to integrated systems. You take RF measurement work off the designers’ plate and turn it into a repeatable, automated discipline: setups, measurements, and clear results fed back to the design team. You also keep the RF lab in working order as test capacity grows. You work primarily within the Radio team, with occasional exposure to other RF-based teams.

Responsibilities

  • Run RF characterization and validation of radio boards and integrated radio systems.

  • Build and maintain automated RF test benches, including interconnects, harnesses, and fixtures.

  • Develop reusable Python suites for instrument control and data capture across standard RF measurements.

  • Perform pre-compliance and compliance-support measurements, including EMC and thermal testing.

  • Test antennas, both standalone and integrated on systems.

  • Support the integration of the radio on our systems.

  • Analyze results, flag anomalies, and deliver clear, structured reports to RF designers.

  • Own the RF lab: track calibration, manage fixtures and accessories, and identify equipment gaps.

  • Support team members who are less experienced in RF testing.

Candidate Requirements

  • Hands-on experience running RF characterization with VNA, spectrum analyzer, signal generator, power meter, AWG, and oscilloscope.

  • Solid grasp of standard measurements such as S-parameters, P1dB, IIP3, sensitivity, and spurious.

  • Experience building reusable test automation, Python preferred.

  • Skilled in fine-pitch SMD and coaxial-cable rework on RF boards.

  • Careful around input-power damage thresholds, protecting both instruments and devices under test.

  • Rigorous and perceptive: interprets results before reporting and spots anomalies early.

  • Writes clear, structured reports.

  • Keeps a shared lab tidy and works well alongside designers.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

We are looking for an ambitious, German-speaking Sales Development Representative (SDR) to help us accelerate our growth across the DACH market.

Reporting to the SDR Team Lead, you will play a critical role in generating a qualified sales pipeline by engaging with prospective clients. Joining a high-performing sales team, you’ll sell a disruptive corporate travel and spend platform, learn from experienced industry leaders, and build a foundation for rapid career progression within Perk.

 

What You'll Do

  • Multichannel Outreach: Execute targeted outreach campaigns using phone, email, and LinkedIn/social touches to engage target prospects.

  • Lead Qualification: Conduct discovery calls with key decision-makers—such as CFOs, Travel Managers, and Office Managers—to assess fit and schedule qualified meetings for Account Executives.

  • Value Articulation: Clearly communicate Perk’s value proposition and build immediate credibility with prospective clients.

  • CRM Hygiene: Maintain accurate prospect data and activity tracking within Salesforce.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with Marketing to refine target accounts, test new messaging, and optimize the lead-qualification process.

  • Product Mastery: Stay expert-level on Perk’s product offerings and industry trends.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Languages: Native or near-native fluency in German with professional fluency in English.

  • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication, with strong phone-based rapport-building skills.

  • Sales Acumen: Familiarity with B2B SaaS sales processes or outbound prospect outreach.

  • Process & Execution: High organizational skills, comfort working with CRMs (Salesforce preferred), and a focus on hitting output metrics.

 

What Success Looks Like in This Role

  • Consistent Pipeline Generation: You hit and exceed your monthly targets for qualified meetings booked and opportunities created.

  • High Outreach Discipline: You maintain steady, structured daily outreach activity (calls, emails, social touches) using Salesforce and modern sales tools.

  • Value-Driven Discovery: You master Perk’s value proposition early, allowing you to ask smart discovery questions and handle client objections with confidence.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: You collaborate seamlessly with Account Executives to ensure smooth handover of leads and high show-up rates for meetings.

  • Growth Mindset: You actively apply feedback from coaching sessions, continuously refining your messaging and cold-calling techniques.

 

Interview Process

  1. Recruiter Screen: 30-minute virtual chat with Talent Acquisition.

  2. Role Assessment: 60-minute in-person interview & practical exercise.

  3. Values & Culture Fit: 30-minute virtual interview.

 

What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with our generous allocation of vacation days plus public holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with your choice of private healthcare or a gym allowance

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Make your money go further with our flexible compensation plan

  • Focus on your family with 17 weeks’ paid parental leave during your child’s first year

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Nurture your language skills with in real-life English, Spanish, and Catalan lessons

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

 

Want to Learn More Before You Apply?

Join our DACH team for The SDR Diaries: DACH Edition to hear directly from our current SDRs about life at Perk! We’ll cover day-to-day responsibilities, live objection handling, real experiences relocating to Barcelona, and tips for navigating our interview process.

 

🔗 Register for the event here: https://luma.com/kztwu46o

How We Set You Up to Succeed (Work Schedule)

  • First 6 Months (Onboarding & Probation): 5 days a week in our Barcelona office. This gives you hands-on coaching, real-time feedback on live calls, and direct access to your manager while you master the role.

  • Post-Probation Schedule: Standard hybrid model, 3 days in the office and 2 days working from home.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Sales Director
descriptionHtml:
About 9fin

9fin is the AI platform powering global debt markets — the world’s largest asset class at over $145 trillion.

Debt markets are vast, global, and mission-critical, yet still run on fragmented data, PDFs, and manual workflows. 9fin replaces this broken infrastructure with a single platform that centralises proprietary credit data, deep analysis, and high-value workflows across global markets.

Today, 9fin powers teams at 300+ blue-chip institutions worldwide, including global banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms, and advisors. The business is scaling at exceptional speed, with rapid expansion in the US and best-in-class retention driven by deep workflow adoption.

We’re at a defining inflection point. With proven product-market fit and strong, global market pull, 9fin is accelerating toward becoming the category-defining platform for debt markets worldwide.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Sales Director to lead the volume end of our Sales organization in EMEA. Tiers 2 and 3 make up the broad base of our client portfolio: a large number of banks, asset managers, private equity firms, law firms and advisors, with smaller account sizes than our Tier 1 and strategic clients. Retention, expansion and coverage at scale drive growth here.

You’ll lead a team of 6–8 Account Managers, each owning a book of Tier 2 and Tier 3 clients, and a small number of Account Executives winning new clients in the same tiers. You’ll own renewals and net retention for the segment, build a repeatable operating rhythm across a high volume of accounts, and grow a team within our newly tiered sales organization.

This is a hands-on leadership role reporting to the Head of Sales, EMEA & APAC. You’ll combine coaching with disciplined pipeline and forecast management, and you’ll be accountable for how your team performs against its number.

What you’ll work on

Every day is different, but here’s an example of the kind of things you’ll work on:

  • Lead the Tier 2 and Tier 3 EMEA team to consistent, forecastable delivery quarter over quarter.

  • Own segment net retention and expansion, and make sure every account has a renewal plan well ahead of its date.

  • Coach and manage a team of 6–8 Account Managers, and Account Executive, through weekly pipeline, renewal and forecast reviews.

  • Set coverage models and account prioritization so your team spends its time where the revenue and risk are.

  • Run a clear operating cadence across the segment, including book and territory planning, account plans and a shared methodology.

  • Recruit, onboard and develop the team, including training on demos, usage analysis and client reviews.

  • Manage performance through structured reviews, goal setting and development plans.

  • Partner with Customer Success, Sales Engineering, Enablement, Rev Ops, Marketing and Product to remove barriers to growth and bring client feedback into the roadmap.

  • Work with the Head of Sales, EMEA & APAC and the US team to keep handovers, tiering and territories consistent globally.

  • Keep accurate CRM records and forecasts, and use the data to coach and make decisions.

About You

This role will be a great fit if you:

  • Have 5+ years of experience leading account management or commercial teams, ideally in capital markets, fintech or data and SaaS.

  • Have a track record of managing high-volume books and delivering retention and growth across them.

  • Are comfortable owning a team number and can show how you’ve consistently hit it.

  • Are a proactive coach, not a reactive manager. You share process, help your team plan ahead and don’t wait for forecasts to slip.

  • Have run a disciplined cadence of pipeline reviews, forecasting and account planning.

  • Have a good knowledge of financial markets and the ability to build relationships across the buy side, sell side and advisory community.

  • Are comfortable with CRM tools (Salesforce preferred) and use data to drive decisions.

  • Build trust across a matrixed commercial organization and partner effectively with Customer Success, Sales Engineering, Enablement, Rev Ops and Product.

  • Thrive in ambitious, fast-moving environments where expectations are high, opportunities are abundant, and no two days look the same.

    Our benefits

    We’re a scaling start up, and we enjoy sharing our success, when the company succeeds, we always reinvest that in our people. We also offer huge amounts of responsibility, an abundance of opportunity for growth and a platform to truly excel.

     

    Financial & Insurance

    • Competitive Salary (our salary bands are benchmarked at the top end of the market)

    • Equity options

    • Pension (your minimum contributions are 4% with 9fin matching up to 7%)

    • Private Medical Insurance

    • Paid sick leave with Income Protection for long periods of illness

    • Group Life Assurance

    • Season Ticket Loan & Cycle to Work schemes

    Time off

    • 25 holiday days per year

    • Local public holidays (with the ability to exchange them for alternative days)

    • Work abroad for up to 3 months a year

    • 1 month paid sabbatical after 5 years of service

    • Enhanced parental leave & flexible working arrangements available

    Growth & Culture

    • Bi-annual team socials

    • Summer and Winter company social events

     

Hybrid Policy

9fin is a hybrid company, and the office is a regular part of how we work. From January 2027, all employees will work from their designated 9fin office on Tuesdays and Wednesdays. Some teams may be asked to be in the office more often, where the nature of their work calls for it. For the rest of the week, you may work from wherever works best for you and your team. Your Talent Partner will share hybrid working details for this role.

9fin is an equal opportunities employer

As a Sales Director at Adlook, a leading ad tech company, you will be crucial in driving revenue growth by strategically developing business with upper-funnel focus clients and independent agencies. Utilising Adlook's innovative advertising solutions, you will be responsible for cultivating and nurturing relationships, and securing new business.
Responsibilities

  • Drive new business
  • Engage with senior advertiser executives to drive deal growth
  • Identify and prioritize efforts to connect with key decision-makers across large corporate advertisers and media agencies as a subject matter expert in the marketplace, educating businesses about Adlook offerings and staying informed about industry trends

  • Good media and communication skills

  • Strong relationship-building skills within brands and agencies

  • You will get to work with amazing people in one of the fastest-growing sectors in online advertising
  • Opportunity to work in a truly international environment
  • Friendly atmosphere while working with a dynamic team of open-minded professionals with a passion for Internet technology and advertising solutions

title: Sales Manager (m/w/d) | Remote
descriptionHtml:
Wir bei Insurgo sind nicht nur ein Technologie-Unternehmen. Wir sind Innovatoren, die den Weg für digitale Lösungen in der Versicherungswirtschaft ebnen. Hunderte Maklerbüros arbeiten bereits mit unserer Software, unser Postfach Plus nimmt ihnen bis zu 80 Prozent ihres Verwaltungsaufwands ab, und unsere Kunden bewerten uns über 900 Mal.

Immer mehr Makler kommen von sich aus auf uns zu. Deshalb bauen wir unseren Vertrieb aus und suchen dich: jemanden, der Makler versteht, gerne mit ihnen spricht und Abschlüsse macht.

Aufgaben

Du verantwortest den Weg vom ersten Kontakt bis zum zufriedenen Kunden. Du arbeitest eng mit Geschäftsführung, Marketing, Product Management und Support zusammen und berichtest direkt an den Geschäftsführer.

Neukunden gewinnen: Du nimmst Anfragen von unserer Website und aus unseren Kampagnen auf, qualifizierst sie, führst Demos durch und bringst sie zum Abschluss.

Bestandskunden entwickeln: Du sprichst aktiv auf unsere Kunden zu und zeigst ihnen, wie Zusatzprodukte wie Postfach Plus und der Insurgo Agent ihren Alltag weiter entlasten.

Wert verkaufen: Du machst für jedes Maklerbüro greifbar, welche Tools Insurgo ersetzt und wie viel Zeit es spart. Du argumentierst über Nutzen, nicht über Rabatt.

Prozess mitgestalten: Du steigst in unseren Vertriebsprozess ein und baust ihn mit uns weiter aus. Pipeline, CRM und Forecast hast du im Griff.

Präsenz zeigen: Du vertrittst Insurgo auf Messen wie der DKM und bei Branchenveranstaltungen und knüpfst dort Kontakte.

Feedback weitergeben: Was Makler dir erzählen, landet bei uns im Produkt. Du bist das Ohr am Markt.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit:

  • Branchenerfahrung: Du kennst die Versicherungsbranche und den Alltag von Maklern aus eigener Erfahrung, zum Beispiel aus einem Maklerbüro, einem Pool, einem Versicherer oder einem Softwareanbieter für Makler.

  • Vertriebserfahrung: Du hast bereits erste Jahre im Vertrieb gearbeitet, idealerweise im B2B oder mit einem erklärungsbedürftigen Produkt.

  • Abschlussstärke: Du gehst aktiv auf Menschen zu, fasst nach und bringst Gespräche zu einer Entscheidung.

  • Eigeninitiative: Du wartest nicht auf Leads, sondern suchst dir Chancen selbst. Du übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Zahlen.

  • Kommunikation: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, am Telefon, im Video-Call und per Mail.

  • Reisebereitschaft: Messen und gelegentliche Kundentermine vor Ort gehören für dich dazu.

  • Pluspunkt: Erfahrung mit einem Maklerverwaltungsprogramm oder einem CRM.

Benefits

  • Ein ambitioniertes Team aus A-Playern

  • Moderner Arbeitsplatz mit Top-Ausstattung

  • Fixgehalt plus attraktive, leistungsbezogene Provision

  • Offene Kommunikation und ergebnisorientiertes Arbeiten

  • 100€ Arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersversorgung

  • 50€ Gutscheinkarte jeden Monat, steuerfrei zur freien Verfügung

  • Teamevents, die in Erinnerung bleiben

  • Sicherer und unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag

Voraussetzung für diese Position ist ein Wohnsitz in Deutschland sowie eine bestehende Arbeitserlaubnis.

title: Sales Manager, UK - SMB/MM/Enterprise
descriptionHtml:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50.

The Role

We’re hiring a hands-on sales leader for the UK. You’ll build, lead, and coach the regional Sales team, deliver against ARR and pipeline goals, and build a repeatable local growth engine.

You'll act as the business lead for your market, with accountability for revenue. As a sales leader, you'll lead and coach the sales team, stay close to customers and deals, and build a repeatable sales approach that fits your market. As an orchestrator, you'll coordinate the local pipeline generation activities that feed your number, including marketing and pre-sales. You'll work closely with leaders across BDR, Growth, Field Marketing, Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Solutions Engineering, Deployment, and Customer Success, and influence how they support your market's priorities.

What you’ll do

  • Own the region’s ARR plan, forecast, and qualified pipeline. Work with the CRO to set priorities, understand capacity needs, and support the team to deliver against the plan.

  • Build and lead the regional Sales team. Hire, onboard, coach, and develop sellers, while staying hands-on in priority opportunities from prospecting and discovery through qualification, evaluation, negotiation, and close.

  • Make clear, evidence-based recommendations to Product based on regional customer conversations, deal patterns, and market needs. Build and refine a repeatable regional sales approach using pipeline, win/loss learning, and customer outcomes.

  • Drive the plan in partnership with field marketing to set priorities for events, campaigns, customer advocacy and community programs, and direct how field marketing resources are used to support your pipeline and ARR goals.

  • Partner with the marketing leadership, who own field marketing standards, methods and team management, to make sure regional programs are well executed, measured and consistent with Dust's broader marketing approach

  • Partner with BDR and Growth leaders to build a qualified pipeline through a deliberate mix of outbound and other locally effective channels.

  • Set direction for how Partnerships can support regional priorities. Work with the Partnerships lead to identify opportunities for sourcing, co-selling, or delivery.

  • Coordinate with Solutions Engineering, Deployment, Professional Services, and Customer Success to support credible evaluations, successful implementations, customer outcomes, and expansion.

  • Represent regional customer needs internally and share market learning with the CRO and functional leaders, contributing to consistent GTM practices across Dust.

Market-specific focus

United Kingdom

Build on early customer and partner traction. Use customer referrals, targeted events, and focused market experiments to build qualified pipeline and strengthen local customer proof.

What we’re looking for

  • A proven sales professional who has grown from individual contributor into people leadership, with 5+ years leading B2B software sales and coaching regional sales teams and a hands-on understanding of how to help reps succeed in-market.

  • You've owned a market or segment revenue number end to end, not just a team's quota. You've built pipeline through functions you didn't manage, such as marketing, partners and pre-sales, and you've made real calls about where capacity and budget go, including between direct sales and partners

  • Ability to lead by example in priority opportunities, from discovery through close.

  • Experience building pipeline and customer relationships in a market where the brand or sales motion is still developing.

  • A disciplined approach to forecasting and performance feedback, paired with high EQ and a genuinely supportive leadership style.

  • An appetite for building, testing, and refining a market over multiple quarters while balancing near-term results with durable growth.

What success looks like

The region delivers against its ARR and pipeline goals while developing a repeatable sales approach suited to local customers. The team builds customer trust and referenceable outcomes, cross-functional support is focused on regional priorities, and market learning informs Dust’s broader GTM approach.

Location

We're prioritizing building our team with an in-person culture at our offices in Paris, London, San Francisco, and New York because we value the magic that happens when talented people work closely together.

We have an office-first culture. Some of the best things about building at Dust are the energy, the fast decisions, and the unexpected conversations that unlock a hard problem, which happen because we are in the same room. Being together is not a formality, it is how we do our best work, and it is something we actively protect.

That said, we hire people with strong judgement and we extend that trust to how they manage their time. When working from home makes more sense for what you need to get done that day, we trust you to make that call.

Why Dust

The models are powerful enough. What's missing is the product layer where AI meets how companies actually work. That's what we're building: the infrastructure that lets any team turn scattered knowledge and tools into coordinated execution with agents they build, own, and run themselves.

We use Dust ourselves every day. We get to shape how humans and agents collaborate while solving our own problems with the product we ship. That loop is rare, and it's why we move fast.

If you're excited about defining a new category and want to join a determined team of optimists who focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously, we'd love to talk.

Even if you don't check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we're more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Learn how we think and work.

  • Our product constitution, a story about our mission

  • Your Next Co-Worker Isn’t Human, Stanislas Polu, VivaTech 2026. A conversation about AI agents taking on larger parts of work and how teams collaborate with them.

title: Sales Team Lead (Small / Mid-market)
descriptionHtml:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐ Sales Team Lead (Small or mid-market) ⭐

We're opening Sales Team Lead roles in France to lead some of our growing crews of Sales:

  • Mid-market teams, covering companies with 30–300 employees.

  • A very small businesses team, covering companies with fewer than 10 employees, run fully inbound.

In this role, you will own acquisition on one of the Small / Mid-Market segments in France and run the business end-to-end. You'll be hands-on in the field while coaching and scaling a crew of Sales to win the associated market.

This position sits at the heart of our growth ambition. We have just passed the one million member milestone, and this is only the beginning. We're accelerating acquisition in France, and Mid-Market is one of the core pillars of that plan.

Why mid-market is exciting at Alan:

  • A large market with real momentum. You'll lead growth on a big B2B segment where our offer is already winning. We have strong references to build on.

  • Faster cycles, real stakes. Deals typically involve HR, Finance and the CEO, and sometimes a broker. Cycles are shorter than in Enterprise, so you see the results of your decisions quickly.

  • A strong product story. Companies in this range want a modern, digital health experience with fair pricing. They also want simple HR administration. This is where Alan stands out against traditional insurers and brokers.

  • Attractive economics. The segment has solid margins and is a key pillar of Alan's path to profitability in France.

⭐ What you will do ⭐

You will be the Sales leader of one of the Small / Mid-Market crews in France, responsible for both hitting the numbers and building the machine. More precisely, you will:

  • Own the associated Mid-Market acquisition plan in France. Design and execute the go-to-market strategy for 30–300 employee customers, from targeting to closing, to reach ambitious acquisition targets.

  • Lead a team of Sales:

    • Drive hiring, onboarding and career development as we scale the crew.

    • Help each team member reach their targets with clear expectations, rigorous follow-up, and ongoing coaching on methodology, deal execution and pipeline management.

    • Be in the field with the team: joining key meetings, supporting tough negotiations, and owning strategic opportunities to maximize win rates.

  • Empower every member of the crew. Create the conditions for everyone to reach and exceed their goals: a strong feedback culture, clear ownership and autonomy.

  • Ensure market fit and remove blockers. Surface customer expectations, patterns and blockers. Make sure they're addressed through the right plans (product, pricing, ops, marketing, etc.).

⭐ Is it what you are looking for? You may be a great fit at Alan if you... ⭐

  • Have at least 6 years of experience in B2B sales, with a proven track record of hitting and exceeding targets as an Account Executive and Sales Leader

  • Have experience leading and coaching sales teams, with the ability to set a high bar, give clear direction and help people grow

  • Have full working proficiency in French, and an advanced level of English for internal communication

  • Have a very hands-on mentality: you love being in the field with your team, joining customer meetings, helping on tough negotiations and sharing what works

  • Have experience selling to small or mid-market companies (30–300 employees) in multi-stakeholder deals

  • Are comfortable operating in fast-paced, ambiguous environments, and can prioritize ruthlessly

  • Are data-driven and analytical: you know how to use KPIs to drive performance, run analyses and make decisions

  • Have strong cross-functional collaboration skills and an appetite for building things with others (sales ops, marketing, etc.)

  • Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Nantes, Biarritz or Annecy

Nice-to-have:

  • Experience selling to HR, Finance and C-level stakeholders

  • Having already opened or scaled a new segment or market in a fast-growing company

  • Experience selling insurance, benefits, HR tech or SaaS

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range.

🙌   Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need, and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. 

Therefore, we offer:

  • Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only.

  • Flexible Office. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz.

  • All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones.

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Delightful healthcare insurance. Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% of the contribution covered by Alan for you and your family, for permanent contracts only.

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only.

Important note: we hire people not roles. 

After reading this job description, if you feel like you don’t have all the necessary prerequisites but that it matches where you are now or what you'd like to grow into in your next position, we encourage you to apply!

Not everybody will enter our recruitment process, but all, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

At Klim, we believe that a thriving workplace is built on the diverse backgrounds, talents, and perspectives of our team. We grow stronger together by embracing and building on each individual’s unique strengths.

How We’ll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for variable incentive pay, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

The On-Target Earnings (“OTE”) range for this role is €98,000 to €115,000 gross per year, which includes a split of 80% (base pay) / 20% (variable incentive). Of this OTE amount, the annual gross base salary range is €78,400 to €92,000. 

The OTE reflected on this job posting is the target cash compensation a candidate could earn in a year if they achieve 100% of their performance or sales goals. The variable incentive is not guaranteed and is governed by the terms of Airbnb’s Hotels Variable Compensation Plan (the “Plan”). The actual payouts depend on performance against targets set under the “Plan” and may be higher or lower than the range listed on this job posting.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

descriptionHtml:

descriptionHtml:
Jouw impact bij Movares

Jij zorgt met jouw geotechnisch advies dat civiele projecten veilig, uitvoerbaar en toekomstbestendig gerealiseerd kunnen worden.

Dit ga je doen bij Movares

  • Je werkt aan geotechnische analyses, adviezen en ontwerpen voor civiele en infrastructurele projecten.

Als senior adviseur geotechniek werk je aan uiteenlopende civiele en infrastructurele projecten, van spoor- en railinfrastructuur tot civiele constructies en waterbouwkundige werken. Je combineert technische analyses met advies en vertaalt complexe vraagstukken naar veilige, uitvoerbare en duurzame oplossingen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met opdrachtgevers en collega's. Binnen het team deel je jouw expertise en begeleid je, afhankelijk van je ervaring, ook junior adviseurs inhoudelijk.

Dit ben jij bij Movares

Je bent een ervaren geotechnisch adviseur die verder kijkt dan zijn eigen berekening. Je overziet het geheel, maakt inhoudelijke keuzes en weet collega’s daarin mee te nemen. Je vindt het leuk om kennis te delen en bij te dragen aan de ontwikkeling van collega’s en het team.

Werk je nu bij een gespecialiseerd bureau en mis je de breedte van projecten, de invloed op inhoudelijke keuzes of de ruimte om collega’s te begeleiden? Of wil je jouw geotechnische expertise inzetten in projecten met grote maatschappelijke impact? Dan past deze rol goed bij jou.

Dit breng je ook mee:

  • meerdere jaren ervaring binnen de geotechniek, passend bij een medior- of seniorrol;

  • ervaring met Deltares-software (D-serie); ervaring met Plaxis is een pre, net zoals affiniteit met lijninfrastructuur;

  • sterke schriftelijke en mondelinge vaardigheden in zowel het Nederlands als Engels.

Dit krijg je bij Movares

Bij Movares werk je aan opgaven die Nederland verder helpen. Tegelijk krijg je de ruimte om je werk en loopbaan in te richten op een manier die bij jou past. Met goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, veel flexibiliteit en volop mogelijkheden om je te ontwikkelen.

Een sterk fundament

Een goede basis begint bij voorwaarden waarop je kunt rekenen:

  • een salaris tussen € 4.650 en € 7.580 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur;

  • een flexibele pot van minimaal 15% van je jaarsalaris, inclusief vakantiegeld;

  • een goede pensioenregeling bij Zwitserleven, waarbij Movares twee derde van de pensioenpremie betaalt;

  • een NS Business Card voor woon-werkverkeer en zakelijke reizen. Privé profiteer je met de kaart van de dalurenkorting.

Maximaal flexibel

Vorm een manier van werken die aansluit bij jouw leven én jouw ambities. Maak keuzes die bij jou passen:

  • flexibel werken volgens ons Any Time Any Place-principe, passend bij je team, klanten en projecten;

  • De mogelijkheid om twee weken per jaar te werken vanaf je vakantieadres binnen de EU;

  • 20 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband, met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen te kopen vanuit je flexibele pot;

  • met je flexibele pot kies je wat voor jou belangrijk is, bijvoorbeeld voor extra inkomen, pensioen, een fiets, bedrijfsfitness, verduurzaming van je woning of het aflossen van je studieschuld;

  • € 750 budget per vijf jaar om je thuiswerkplek goed in te richten;

  • € 2,45 netto thuiswerkvergoeding per thuiswerkdag.

Veel ontwikkelmogelijkheden

  • Ontwikkel een loopbaan die past bij jouw talenten en ambities. Kies jouw eigen pad:

  • ruimte om je expertise, ambitie en loopbaan verder te ontwikkelen;

  • leren door te doen, samen met ervaren collega's en met gebruik van een breed aanbod aan ontwikkelmogelijkheden;

  • de kans om actief kennis te delen en mee te bouwen aan de toekomst van ons vakgebied.

Samen groeien

Deel mee in de waarde die we samen creëren en de groei van onze organisatie. Samen voor succes:

  • je flexibele pot groeit mee met de resultaten van Movares;

  • een winstdeling met een doelbedrag van 5% van je brutojaarsalaris, afhankelijk van de resultaten;

  • en de mogelijkheid tot participeren in de waardeontwikkeling van Movares door middel van aankoop van phantom-aandelen.

Jouw team bij Movares

Je werkt samen met een hechte groep geotechnische adviseurs die elkaar makkelijk weten te vinden. Eén dag per week – op woensdag – werken jullie sowieso samen op kantoor in Utrecht. Daarnaast is twee dagen per week op kantoor gangbaar, maar stemmen we locatie en werktijden flexibel af. Er is altijd iemand aanwezig en de lijnen zijn kort.

De sfeer in het team is open en gelijkwaardig. Er is weinig hiërarchie: senioriteit gaat hier niet over ‘boven iemand staan’, maar over kennis delen en elkaar verder helpen. Collega’s kunnen goed met elkaar opschieten, schakelen snel en staan voor elkaar klaar. Samenwerken doen we bewust, omdat we geloven dat je daar betere oplossingen van maakt.

title: Senior AI Engineer (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
About GeneralMind

GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains - processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, JDE, and Dynamics.

Our platform combines AI agents, operational context graphs, and real transaction data to achieve Autopilot-grade automation in real operational environments.

We work closely with leading global companies across manufacturing, retail, and logistics to deploy AI into mission-critical workflows.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer who treats LLMs as production software, not as magic. Someone who can own the agent layer of our platform end to end - from prompt and context design, through tool use and orchestration, to evals, reliability, and continuous improvement in live customer environments.

This role sits at the intersection of two things that are rarely mastered together: shipping LLM-powered systems that actually work in messy enterprise reality, and the discipline of a real engineer - evals, observability, cost, latency, failure modes. Models get smarter every month. What stays scarce is the engineering judgment to make them reliably useful on top of SAP, Oracle, and the mess of real operational data.

You will be a senior individual contributor working directly with the founders. The person in this role won’t be handed a roadmap - they’ll help define it, and build the AI practice around it.

What you will do

AI Ownership

  • Own the agent layer end-to-end: prompt and context design, tool use, orchestration, evals, and long-term technical direction.

  • Be the person who understands why an agent made the decision it made - and who other engineers come to when a model behaves in ways they can’t explain.

  • Set the bar on how we build with LLMs: eval-driven development, context engineering, structured outputs, cost and latency discipline.

  • Make foundational decisions with conviction - which model, which pattern, which guardrail - document the reasoning, and evolve them as the system grows.

LLM Systems in Production

title: Senior AI Engineer, Location AI
descriptionHtml:
Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What you'll do

This role is scoped by skill rather than by product. The problems below span multiple departments and show up across our Search and Places data work, our Location and Navigation Intelligence work, and the Platform work that makes Mapbox usable by agents. You'll be hired into one specific team or product area, but you'll work across teams where your expertise meets the highest-priority AI problems. You should expect to move between teams and tech stacks as the work demands.

At this level you own the technical design and delivery of a multi-component AI system, and you are accountable for the quality of what ships in your area.

In this role, you will:

  • Define how the products you own should work, build a measurement framework for it, and build evaluation systems for non-deterministic behavior. Formulate hypotheses around the products we build and seek the signal needed to validate them. Define what a correct result is for a given input and state, determine whether to assemble datasets from real usage or hand-written cases, and gate changes on regression results.

  • Run continuous evaluation of the products we build, whether APIs, SDKs, data representations, or reference applications, from the position of the end user, whether developer, agent, or consumer. Assess the gaps such as misuse of parameters or integration anti-patterns, recommend the fixes, and make sure they land.

  • Own the MVP against an agreed north star technical design, and balance technical perfection against shipping useful increments.

  • Build data pipelines and the tooling around them: ingestion, conflation, entity resolution, quality checks, and the batch and streaming jobs that keep a large dataset current.

  • Track and pull external datasets, models, and benchmarks from published research and open-source releases. Evaluate what fits the problem and constraints , and decide when to adopt what exists versus build your own.

  • Design feedback loops so that using a product generates data that improves it. Instrument systems so failures arrive with enough context to reproduce, then turn the recurring ones into evaluation cases.

  • Design the boundary between a model and the tools it calls. Build or improve the model harness, decide what the model handles, what it delegates, and how to keep it working from the state it actually fetched.

  • Work to a latency and cost target per request: streaming, partial results, caching, model routing, prompt structure.

  • Build the internal harnesses and tools (CLI, MCP, and others) your team needs to iterate quickly, and share the parts that generalize with other teams.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • Bachelors degree in STEM discipline and 5+ years of software engineering experience, with production ownership of services, pipelines, or SDKs.

  • 2+ years shipping LLM-backed features to real users, in systems that carried error budgets, on-call rotations, and customers who noticed regressions.

  • Data engineering depth: SQL, at least one distributed processing framework, and experience with pipelines where a wrong record mattered more than a slow one.

  • Fluency with tool calling and agent orchestration, including the failure modes: stale context, hallucinated arguments, silent partial success, unbounded loops.

  • Working knowledge of more than one agent harness, and opinions about where each of them is weak.

  • Strong Python or TypeScript, and comfort reading code in whatever language the caller happens to be written in.

  • Experience diagnosing latency in a distributed request path.

  • Comfort with ambiguity, and the judgment to ship something narrow that works while the general solution is still unclear.

  • Clear written communication. Mapbox is distributed across time zones and we make most decisions in documents and Slack.

Nice to have traits for this role

title: Senior AI Research Engineer - GPU Systems & Kernels
descriptionHtml:
As a Research Engineer on the Frontier Foundations team, you will partner with Research Scientists to make large-scale model training and inference as fast and efficient as the hardware allows. You will work at the lowest level of our stack, writing and tuning GPU kernels and removing the memory and communication bottlenecks that limit large Mixture-of-Experts models on the latest GPUs.

Building on our track record of AI-powered solutions (e.g., Bits AI, Bits Evolve, and our time series foundation model Toto), Datadog AI Research (DAIR) tackles high-risk, high-reward problems grounded in real-world challenges in cloud observability and security.

Frontier Foundations builds and maintains the high-performance infrastructure that lets us train and serve large language models at scale. It supports both of our research areas:

Trained Agents for Observability - Post-training models to operate autonomously across Datadog's domain. SRE incident response is our first target, with a clear path to code repair, security response, and infrastructure optimization. We build the simulation environments, RL training loops, and evaluation infrastructure needed to train agents that match or surpass frontier models at a fraction of the cost.

What You'll Do:

  • Write, tune, and debug GPU kernels (CUDA, Triton, or similar) for the operations that dominate LLM training and inference.
  • Optimize for the latest NVIDIA GPU generations, including memory hierarchy, tensor cores, and low-precision formats such as FP8 and FP4
  • Reduce communication cost in distributed workloads (all-to-all, all-reduce) and overlap communication with compute across NVLink and across nodes
  • Profile end-to-end training and rollout workloads to identify whether they are compute-, memory-, or communication-bound, and quantify the headroom
  • Build benchmarks, profiling tools, and regression tests that guide optimization decisions
  • Collaborate with Research Scientists to turn new model architectures into efficient implementations
  • Explore emerging techniques such as low-precision training and serving, speculative decoding, and fused or persistent kernels

Who You Are:

  • You have depth in at least one of: GPU kernel development and optimization (CUDA or similar), low-latency communication and collective operations (e.g., RDMA, NCCL), or large-scale training infrastructure
  • You can reason about hardware constraints (memory, bandwidth, interconnect topology) and explain where a bottleneck is and how you would confirm it
  • You are proficient in a systems language (e.g., C++, Rust, or CUDA C) and in Python
  • You have strong debugging and profiling skills, including tools such as Nsight
  • You can explain design and performance trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

Bonus Points (any of the following):

  • You have experience with Mixture-of-Experts models, expert parallelism, or sparse model inference
  • You are familiar with GPU communication libraries such as NCCL or NVSHMEM, and with compute/communication overlap
  • You have experience with Triton, CUTLASS, or similar kernel frameworks
  • You are familiar with distributed training frameworks such as Megatron-LM, TorchTitan, or DeepSpeed
  • You have built GPU-intensive systems in graphics, rendering, simulation, or scientific computing
  • You have contributed to open-source ML or systems infrastructure projects

title: Azure Cloud Security Senior Consultant (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
It all starts with the mission: NVISO is here to protect European society from potentially devastating cyber attacks! This means we offer cyber security services to private and governmental organizations to help them better prepare for, prevent, detect and respond to cyber security incidents.

All of this is built on four fundamental values that define who we are: We are Proud, We Break Barriers, We Care and No BS!

Tasks

You will be joining NVISO’s Cloud Security team as an Azure Cloud Security Senior Consultant (m/w/d). The ideal candidate has knowledge in Azure cloud services, with a particular focus on security.

As part of a team of security consultants and engineers, you will collaborate closely with other colleagues and our customers to understand their business and security requirements, assess their current security posture, and develop tailored cloud security solutions for them.

Responsibilities

We are aware that cloud security features and products are abundant; the following list apply to the ones of interest to us. If you have experience or feel capable of conducting only some of them (not the full list), please reach out!

Strategy and Governance

  • Assess cloud security posture against frameworks (e.g., CIS, NIST, ISO 27001) and Microsoft benchmarks (Azure Security Benchmark, M365 baseline).

  • Define cloud security strategy, target operating model, and roadmap aligned to business and regulatory requirements.

  • Develop and maintain cloud security policies, standards, and guardrails for Azure and M365.

Identity and Access Management (IAM)

  • Design and implement Microsoft Entra tenant architecture, including identity lifecycle, conditional access, and MFA.

  • Implement and tune Conditional Access policies, risk-based access, and device compliance integrations with Intune/Endpoint Manager.

  • Deploy and operate Privileged Access Management (PAM), including PIM for Azure and M365 roles, just-in-time access, and break-glass accounts.

  • Integrate on-premises identities (hybrid) with secure synchronization and hardening of federation where used.

Platform Security and Hardening (Azure)

  • Build secure landing zones using Azure Policy, Blueprints/Bicep/Terraform, and management groups.

  • Enforce baseline controls for networking (NSGs, Azure Firewall, Private Link), compute (secure images, patching), and storage (encryption, private endpoints).

  • Configure Azure Key Vault for secrets, keys, and certificates management with RBAC and purge protection.

  • Ensure encryption at rest and in transit, customer-managed keys (CMK), and double encryption where required.

  • Implement workload isolation, tagging, and resource locks; manage identity-based access (managed identities).

Threat Protection and Monitoring

  • Deploy and tune Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Defender for Cloud Apps (MCAS), Defender for Endpoint, and Defender for Identity.

  • Configure Microsoft Sentinel: data connectors, analytics rules, UEBA, watchlists, workbooks, and SOAR playbooks (Logic Apps).

  • Develop detection use cases, threat hunting queries (KQL), and incident response runbooks specific to Azure and M365 threats.

  • Establish alert triage, escalation paths, and continuous tuning to reduce noise and improve mean time to detect/respond.

Microsoft 365 Security – (Nice to have)

  • Configure and manage Microsoft Purview (Compliance portal) for DLP, information protection labels, data lifecycle, and insider risk.

  • Implement Exchange Online, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams security baselines, safe links/attachments, and anti-phishing policies.

  • Enforce device compliance via Intune, app protection policies, and conditional access for BYOD and corporate devices.

  • Secure collaboration and external sharing with sensitivity labels, access reviews, and entitlement management.

Data Protection and Encryption – (Nice to have)

  • Design data classification and labelling strategies with Microsoft Purview; enforce DLP across endpoints, Exchange, SharePoint, and Teams.

  • Implement eDiscovery, legal hold, and audit configurations for regulatory needs.

Requirements

  • You hold a citizenship of a NATO member state or the Austrian citizenship;

  • At least 3 years of experience in information security specific to Azure or Microsoft 365 cloud environments.

  • Proven expertise with Microsoft’s cloud security services, including Entra ID, Microsoft Sentinel, and Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Defender for Endpoint, Defender for Cloud Apps, Defender for Identity, Intune, and/or Purview.

  • Experience with cloud security best practices and related frameworks. For example: CIS Benchmarks, Microsoft Cloud Security Benchmark, etc.

  • Strong communication, documentation and reporting skills.

  • Relevant current Microsoft cloud certifications. For example: AZ-104, SC-900, SC-200, SC-300, SC-401, or SC-500.

Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cyber Security, Information Security, Engineering, Information Technology, or related studies.

  • Experience in consulting.

  • Other vendor-agnostic cybersecurity certifications. E.g. SSCP, CompTIA Security+, or equivalent.

  • Experience with scripting languages such as PowerShell or Python.

Benefits

At NVISO, we care. We are committed to offering you a highly competitive remuneration package including financial and non-financial components:

  • Working with and learning from the best people in the European cyber security “scene”. We have several SANS Instructors working for us and we are also represented at popular hacking conferences (BlackHat, BruCON, OWASP, etc.). In addition, our employees can take advantage of prestigious continuing education opportunities (GSE, GXPN, CISSP, OSCP, etc.);

  • Generous training budget of 10.000 EUR + 10 man days for attending lectures rolling over 2 years;

  • Base salary range (depending on experience and skillset): 69.000 EUR p.a. – 91.000 EUR p.a.;

  • Regular team-building and fun events;

  • Our commitment to coach and counsel you and help you grow; each employee receives a personal coach within the team, whose role is to ensure your well-being and helps you grow in your career!

  • Flexible working hours and home office possibilities (incl. working abroad weeks within the EU);

  • Business Bike Leasing;

  • BahnCard 50 1st class + public transfer ticket or EGYM WellPass;

  • 30 holidays;

  • Company Pension Scheme;

  • Cool offices in the center of Frankfurt and Munich (with BBQ, kicker table, table tennis, etc.).

IF YOU'RE INTERESTED, PLEASE SEND US YOUR APPLICATION!

WE'RE LOOKING FORWARD TO MEETING YOU!

Disclaimer on the Use of AI Tools in the Application Process

Please be aware that the creation and submission of application documents (e.g. CV, cover letter, case studies, etc.) using AI-powered tools is only permitted to a limited extent.

DATA PRIVACY STATEMENT

The controller

SKD SE

Französische Strasse 12, 10117 Berlin

Commercial register entry number: HRB 260878

Personal data collected as part of the application process

Fundamentals and purposes of processing personal data collected from application documents and during the application process

If you apply to us electronically, i.e. via e-mail or using our online form, we will collect and process your personal data for the purpose of executing the application process and preparing contracts.

By submitting an application via our recruitment website, you express your interest in taking up work with us. In this context, you transmit personal data, which we will use and store exclusively for the purpose of your job search / application process.

Furthermore, you can choose to upload expressive documents such as a cover letter, your CV and reference letters. These may contain additional personal data such as date of birth, address etc.

Only authorized HR staff and/or staff involved in the application process have access to your data.

The personal data is stored, as a rule, exclusively for the purpose of filling the vacancy for which you have applied.

Your data will be stored for a period of 180 days after the application process has been concluded. This is usually done to fulfill legal requirements and/or defending ourselves against any claims arising from legal provisions. After this period, we are obligated to delete or anonymize your data. In case of anonymization, the data will only be available to us in the form of so-called metadata, without any direct personal reference, for statistical analysis (for example, share of male and/or female applicants, number of applications per specified period of time etc.).

Furthermore, we reserve the right to store your data for 180 days after the application process has been concluded for the purpose of adding it to our Talent Pool in order to identify any other vacancies that may be of interest to you. Should you be offered and accept a position with us during the application process, we will store the personal data collected as part of the application process for at least the duration of your employment.

Disclosure of data to third parties

  • Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung von buchhalterischen Prozessen, Richtlinien und internen Kontrollen

  • Mitarbeit an Projekten im Finanzbereich, z. B. bei der Digitalisierung, ERP-Weiterentwicklung oder der Optimierung von Reporting-Strukturen

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse im HGB sowie fundierte Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen

  • Gute Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Debitoren-, Kreditoren-, Anlagen- und Hauptbuchhaltung

  • Gute Kenntnisse in umsatzsteuerlichen Fragestellungen; weitere steuerliche Kenntnisse von Vorteil

  • Strukturierte, sorgfältige und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Zuverlässigkeit

  • Hands-on-Mentalität und Freude an der operativen Mitarbeit im Tagesgeschäft

  • Analytisches Denkvermögen sowie Affinität zu Zahlen, Prozessen und Systemen

  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil

title: Senior Business Analist / Product Owner E-health
descriptionHtml:
Met je hoofd in de ICT, je hart bij de zorg en oog voor de mogelijkheden van AI.

Over PharmaPartners en eHealth

PharmaPartners ontwikkelt en beheert zorgsystemen voor de geïntegreerde eerstelijnszorg. Wij zijn een organisatie met een uitgesproken visie én aanpak op continue vernieuwing met de focus op groei. Daar kan jij een bijdrage aan leveren.

De business unit eHealth levert vernieuwende producten aan huisartsen en apotheken ter ondersteuning van hun patiënten. Met ons online portaal en onze app kunnen patiënten communiceren met hun huisarts en apotheek en onder andere hun medisch dossier inzien. Ruim 8 miljoen patiënten maken gebruik van ons portaal. Daarmee zijn we een van de grootste spelers op het gebied van e-health in de Nederlandse eerstelijnszorg.


Binnen Research & Development zetten we volop in op AI en agentic development. AI wordt steeds meer onderdeel van de manier waarop we analyseren, ontwerpen, ontwikkelen, testen en documenteren. Als Business Analist / Product Owner speel je hierin een actieve rol: je benut de mogelijkheden van AI, houdt regie op de inhoud en bewaakt samen met het team de kwaliteit, veiligheid en toepasbaarheid van de resultaten.

Jouw rol

Als Senior Business Analist / Product Owner ben je de brug tussen de business, klanten, gebruikers en development, met een leidende rol in de productontwikkeling. Je draagt bij aan de productvisie en roadmap en vertaalt die naar heldere prioriteiten voor de teams. Je begrijpt de behoeften van gebruikers en vertaalt deze naar functionele vereisten, technische specificaties en concrete ontwikkelvoorstellen.

Je werkt in een complexe en veranderende omgeving en houdt overzicht wanneer er veel tegelijk speelt. Je kijkt niet alleen naar wat vandaag nodig is, maar vooral naar wat morgen waarde levert: nieuwe marktontwikkelingen, innovatiekansen en de mogelijkheden van AI. Je neemt eigenaarschap over de volledige levenscyclus van je producten en je coacht collega’s in het vak. Je helpt het team om AI en agentic development verantwoord en effectief in te zetten binnen het ontwikkelproces.


Daarnaast vind jij het leuk om:

  • De behoeften van verschillende belanghebbenden, waaronder onze klanten en gebruikers, in kaart te brengen, documenteren en met elkaar in overeenstemming te brengen;

  • Eén of meer of meerdere scrum teams aan te sturen, die je begeleid in het ontwikkelproces volgens de SCRUM methodiek (planning, retrospective, refinements, e.d.);

  • De kwaliteit van de producten te waarborgen en continu te verbeteren door afstemming met de ontwikkelteams en alle betrokken stakeholders;

  • De schakel te zijn tussen klant en organisatie, waarbij je de klantwensen vertaalt naar concrete voorstellen en deze prioriteert op een product backlog;

  • AI in te zetten ter ondersteuning van bijvoorbeeld analyse, requirements, prototyping, documentatie en voorbereiding van refinements (natuurlijk zorg je ook voor een grondige controle, review en validatie op de output van AI;

  • De kwaliteit van producten bewaken en borgen dat deze voldoen aan de kwaliteits-, product- en informatiebeveiligingsnormen, in afstemming met ontwikkelteams en stakeholders;

  • De product backlog creëren, prioriteren en onderhouden, zodat het developmentteam aan de juiste ontwikkelingen werkt.

Werken met AI en agentic development

AI verandert de manier waarop software wordt ontwikkeld. Binnen PharmaPartners werken R&D-teams toe naar een gedeelde agentic way of working. De mens blijft verantwoordelijk voor keuzes en resultaten, terwijl AI ondersteunt bij onderdelen van het werk. Daarom zoeken we iemand die kansen ziet, kritisch blijft en nieuwe werkwijzen snel eigen maakt.

Heb je al ervaring met AI-tools, AI-agents, skills, prompten of agentic development? Dan is dat een duidelijke pré. Heb je die ervaring nog niet, maar ben je nieuwsgierig, leergierig en bereid je hierin actief onder te dompelen? Dan nodigen we je ook van harte uit om te reageren.

Waar kom je terecht?

Je werkt in een enthousiast Portfolio- en R&D-team en rapporteert aan de Teamlead Portfolio. Je levert een zichtbare bijdrage aan de verdere ontwikkeling van een van de grootste eHealth-platformen van Nederland en hebt als senior invloed op de koers van het product en de werkwijze van het team. Dat doe je samen met open, eerlijke, en behulpzame collega’s in een hechte en informele organisatie.


Herken jij je hierin?

  • Jij hebt minimaal HBO+ werk- en denkniveau in de richting van bedrijfskunde, IT, zorgtechnologie of iets soortgelijks;

  • Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar relevante werkervaring in de zorg-ICT, in een rol als business analist of product owner;

  • Jouw kennis van de Nederlandse taal zit op minimaal C2-niveau. Ook in het Engels kun jij je zowel mondeling als schriftelijk goed uitdrukken;

  • Ruime ervaring met business analysetechnieken en het documenteren van requirements, ook bij complexe vraagstukken;

  • Je hebt ervaring met het bijdragen aan productvisie en roadmap en met het prioriteren op basis van strategische doelen;

  • Je vindt het niet erg als jouw werkdag soms anders loopt, of buiten een vast 9 tot 5 patroon valt;

  • Je deelt gemakkelijk kennis (van de Nederlandse zorgmarkt) en informatie met anderen;

  • Je staat stevig in je schoenen, ook als de druk op je werk toeneemt en houdt altijd overzicht.

Je bent communicatief vaardig, ambitieus en gedisciplineerd. Je durft vragen te stellen, keuzes te onderbouwen en verantwoordelijkheid te nemen, en je neemt anderen mee in je koers. Tegelijk werk je graag samen, sta je open voor feedback en heb je de nieuwsgierigheid en het lef om nieuwe technologie verantwoord toe te passen.

Klaar om samen met ons de koers van eHealth en softwareontwikkeling te bepalen?

Dan zoeken we jou!

En is dit wat je zoekt?

  • Een passend salaris: Voor deze vacature geldt een range van € 4.000 - € 5.500 bruto p/m op basis van een fulltime werkweek.

  • €500,- persoonlijk budget: Gebruik het voor een sportabonnement, of investeer in je eigen ontwikkeling.

  • 26 vakantiedagen en 8,33% vakantiegeld: Eventueel kun je zelfs nog 5 extra vakantiedagen erbij kopen (naar rato).

  • Beschikbare pensioenpremie: wij zijn aangesloten bij Allianz en bieden een premie met een eigen bijdrage van 4,8%.

  • Ruimte voor groei: Binnen PharmaPartners bieden wij diverse Talentenprogamma’s aan, die gericht zijn op persoonlijke ontwikkeling, het inzetten van jouw talent en kracht en een programma om erachter te komen of dat jij jezelf in een leidinggevende rol ziet!

  • Een hechte, open werksfeer: Ervaar een warme, open werkomgeving waar collega’s samen successen vieren. Binnen PharmaPartners zorgt de Brabantse gezelligheid voor een laagdrempelige benadering en een sterke teamspirit.

  • Leaseauto : Wij bieden jou een leaseregeling aan zodat jij met goed vervoer jouw klanten kunt bezoeken.

  • Uitdagende functie: Ga de uitdaging aan bij een organisatie die impact maakt in de samenleving in de zorgsector. Je draagt direct bij aan de maatschappij door te werken voor de zorg, waar jouw inzet het verschil maakt.

  • Sporten onder werktijd: Bij PharmaPartners moedigen we een gezonde levensstijl aan, inclusief sporten onder werktijd. Op dinsdag en donderdag heb je de mogelijkheid om samen met collega’s aan het eind van de dag te gaan sporten.

  • Hybride werken: Hybride werken bij ons betekent dat je twee keer per week op kantoor wordt verwacht, terwijl je de rest van de tijd de vrijheid hebt om vanuit huis te werken. Deze aanpak zorgt voor een balans van interactie en flexibiliteit.

  • Teamspirit: Versterk de teamgeest door deel te nemen aan diverse sportevenementen, zoals een tennistoernooi of de singelloop in Breda. Bouw samen met je collega's aan een hechter team.

title: Senior Consultant Informationssicherheit & BSI IT-Grundschutz (d/w/m)
descriptionHtml:
Ob du auf der Suche nach einer beruflichen Veränderung bist oder deine Expertise auf das nächste Level bringen möchtest – Bei uns findest du die richtigen Perspektiven. Wir unterstützen seit über 15 Jahren unsere Kundinnen und Kunden bei der Entwicklung ihrer Service-Landschaft. Für diese sind wir ein verlässlicher, vertrauenswürdiger und loyaler Partner. Unsere Kolleginnen und Kollegen schätzen das agile Umfeld, die offene Kommunikation und das hohe Maß an Flexibilität im Arbeitsalltag. Mit uns wirst du Kunden in den Schwerpunkten IT-Geschäftsmodell- und IT-Strategieentwicklung, IT-Security oder Cloud-Architektur beraten, wobei uns vor allem die Verknüpfung dieser drei Disziplinen ausmacht.

Aufgaben

  • Du berätst unsere Kunden zu Themen der Informationssicherheit und IT-Sicherheit auf Basis des BSI IT-Grundschutz

  • Du bist verantwortlich für den Aufbau und Pflege eines ISMS nach BSI-Standard 200-1 und der Erstellung von Sicherheitskonzepten nach BSI-Standard 200-2 bei unseren Kunden

  • Dabei leitest du Interviews mit Ansprechpartnern von Kunden in Eigenregie durch, um interne Abläufe und Systemlandschaften von Grund auf zu dokumentieren

  • Du führst Grundschutz-Checks durch, verschriftlichst die Ergebnisse und präsentierst diese beim Kunden

  • Du erstellst Risikoanalysen nach BSI-Standard 200-3, die dafür notwendige Sicherheitsdokumente und pflegst diese in GRC-Tools wie HiScout oder Verinice

  • Du begleitest bei Bedarf Audits bei den jeweiligen Kunden und assentierst Kunden bei BSI-Grundschutz-Zertifizierungen oder der NIS-2-Umsetzung

  • Du implementierst ein Business Continuity Management (BCM) nach BSI-Standard 200-4 beim Kunden

Qualifikation

  • Du kannst ein abgeschlossenes Studium (bspw. in Informatik oder Wirtschaftsinformatik) vorzeigen oder eine sehr gut abgeschlossene Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration nachweisen

  • Du besitzt ein tiefes Verständnis über den BSI IT-Grundschutz und der BSI-Standard 200-X

  • Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Beratung von Kunden, im Idealfall im öffentlichen Sektor

  • Du kannst Erfahrung im Entwurf von Sicherheitskonzepten nach BSI-Standard 200-X vorweisen

  • Du beherrschst gängige IT-Security Standards (z.B. ISO 27001, BSI IT-Grundschutz) und kannst diese durch erste entsprechende Zertifizierungen nachweisen (z.B. IT-Grundschutz Praktiker)

  • Du kannst im Gespräch mit Kunden und Lieferanten fachliche Anforderungen identifizieren und konzeptionell auf hohem und mittlerem Abstraktionslevel Lösungen entwerfen

  • Dabei kannst du fließend zwischen den Sprachwelten von C-Level Management und IT-Spezialisten vermitteln, um eine zielgerichtete IT-Sicherheitsberatung zu leisten

  • Du kommunizierst und präsentierst sicher auf Deutsch (C2) und Englisch (mind. B2)

  • Deine Arbeitsweise ist gekennzeichnet durch eine Hands-on-Mentalität, ein hohes Maß an Eigenmotivation und eine serviceorientierte Denkweise

  • Du bist teamfähig, kommunizierst und dokumentierst in strukturierter Weise

  • Du möchtest dich laufend weiterbilden und hast Trends und Treiber im Blick

Benefits

  • Remote-First, mit festen Teamtagen. Du arbeitest überwiegend mobil innerhalb Deutschlands, Kundentermine vor Ort gehören dazu, wo das Projekt es braucht. Regelmäßig treffen wir uns im Office am Lohsepark: moderne Arbeitsplätze, höhenverstellbare Tische, kostenfreie Getränke.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeit mit Kernzeit. 40-Stunden-Woche. Überstunden werden erfasst, verfallen nicht und werden in ganzen Tagen abgebaut.

  • Transparentes Gehalt. Offene Gehaltsbänder, jährlich gegen den Markt geprüft, mit Inflationsausgleich.

  • Weiterbildung mit festem Rahmen. Jedes Jahr stehen dir Arbeitszeit und ein eigenes Budget für Fortbildungen und Zertifizierungen zur Verfügung, z. B. IT-Grundschutz-Berater. Gemeinsam planen wir deine persönliche Qualifikationsroadmap.

  • Dein Gehaltspaket, flexibel zusammengestellt. Per Gehaltsumwandlung: Dienstwagen (E-Auto), Deutschlandticket oder Firmenfitness.

  • Ausstattung und Extras. Deine Hardware suchst du dir selbst aus. Dazu ein persönliches Mitarbeiter-Budget, 30 Urlaubstage und die Corporate-Benefits-Plattform.

  • Offene Kultur. Wir teilen unsere Zahlen inklusive Umsatz und Gewinn, arbeiten in kleinen Teams und entwickeln Führungskräfte aus den eigenen Reihen.

Es ist uns wichtig, tolle Charaktere nicht nur zu finden, sondern auch zu halten und weiterzuentwickeln. Wir freuen uns über deine Bewerbung!
