title: Senior Fraud Strategy Analyst
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Parcel delivery has a quality problem the industry has learned to live with. Parcels go missing between depots. Parcels get marked as delivered and never reach the customer. Most carriers treat a steady rate of loss as a cost of doing business. Relay is building the delivery company where that stops being true.

That is harder for us than for most, because nearly everyone who touches a Relay parcel is an independent partner. We can't manage them into performance. We have to build the standards, the evidence and the product that make doing the job well the natural outcome. Engineering builds the product changes you design.

Partner Excellence Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide which signals count, which checks become rules, and whether each fix belongs in product, policy or training. The squad lead acts on your calls.

  • Most of a parcel's journey happens between scans. How do you prove a handover happened without making the job slower for the people doing it?

  • A delivery is marked complete and the customer says it never came. How do you tell a wrong address from a handover that went wrong, and put the fix where it belongs: product, policy or training?

  • Some checks can only answer "can't tell". Which are worth making provable, and which should we stop measuring?

  • A whole area, not a slice: you decide what evidence a whole network runs on, and the result is on the street the next morning.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Fraud Strategy Analyst at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Partner Excellence problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Partner Excellence decides: which signals count, what evidence the network runs on, and what good looks like.

  • Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove which fixes worked. In a year, the squad can prove every handover in the network.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned fraud, risk or trust decisions end to end: turned investigations into rules, standards or interventions, and owned their number, such as the false positive rate you were held to, rather than building the model.

  • Have run investigations in fraud, risk, financial crime or trust and safety, and decided whether a signal was real or noise.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or engineers built what you asked for.

  • Have worked somewhere with enough volume for a false positive rate to mean something, where your rules ran live and something happened when they were wrong.

  • Have got records created by teams who didn't report to you, and know how long it takes.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Senior Frontend Engineer, Marketing Website
descriptionHtml:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

The Role

As a Senior Frontend Engineer on our Website team, you'll be a co-owner of the platform behind synthesia.io: the component library, content model and rendering stack that every page on our marketing site is built from. You'll shape direction and make key technical decisions with the team, likely with a focus area of your own but context across the whole system. This is a hands-on engineering role, and your primary output is high-quality component and schema code, plus the tooling that lets others build with it.

Millions of people visit synthesia.io every month, and it is one of the main ways we win new customers. That comes with real responsibility. The decisions you make are seen at scale, and we set the quality bar accordingly.

The defining challenge of this role is composability: a marketing site that marketers, and increasingly AI agents, can build pages with, without breaking design, performance or SEO.

What You'll Do

  • Build, scale and evolve our section library: the Astro components, Sanity schemas and design tokens that let us compose marketing pages consistently and accessibly.

  • Own the content model. Design schemas that resist misuse, so an editor, or an agent, can build a page that is correct by construction rather than correct by review.

  • Take Figma component specs all the way to production: responsive across mobile, tablet and desktop, accessible by default, matching design intent precisely.

  • Extend the platform for AI-assisted development, so coding agents can generate on-brand, on-spec sections from a design spec as reliably as a person can.

  • Own SEO integrity as a first-class engineering concern: canonicals, sitemaps, structured data, redirects, and no traffic cliffs on launch.

  • Raise the bar on engineering standards across the website surface: thorough code review, patterns others can follow, and tests around the parts that actually break.

  • Maintain and extend localisation across nine locales and a translation pipeline, so the system works for a global audience.

  • Shape the technical direction of the website platform over the next 6 to 12 months, and champion its adoption with the people who publish on it.

We’d love to hear from you if you have

  • At least five (5+) years as a software engineer, including three (3) at senior level, building front end for content-driven or marketing platforms.

  • Real ownership of a content model in Sanity. You've designed schemas other people had to live with, and you have opinions about references vs. embedded objects, when a variant belongs in the schema versus at runtime, and how to stop a section library sprawling. GROQ and Portable Text are familiar territory.

  • Deep front-end expertise: expert HTML, CSS and TypeScript, with a strong command of component API design and the developer experience of a shared library.

  • You can work end to end. Comfortable owning the server side as well as the front end: SSR, serverless and edge runtimes, API routes, a SQL database, secrets and CI. You should be able to take a feature from schema to component to the route that serves it without handing off, and be happy debugging something that only reproduces in production.

  • Solid understanding of responsive design, cross-browser compatibility and web performance, and comfortable building to WCAG 2.2 AA. Accessibility is part of your definition of done, not a separate pass.

  • You care that marketing sites are measured, on performance, SEO, analytics events and conversion, and you're happy being accountable to those numbers.

  • A strong sense of craft and attention to detail, and the judgement to balance design intent against engineering constraints.

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills. You explain your reasoning, review generously, and treat levelling up the people around you as part of the job.

We’d be particularly excited if

  • Prior experience working on a large SaaS marketing website, at real traffic and with real stakes attached.

  • Astro, or another islands or static-site framework.

  • Cloudflare Workers, or another edge or serverless platform.

  • Experience with AWS Lambda.

  • Tailwind CSS v4, and experience working from a token-based design system.

  • Experience, or strong interest, in making component libraries and content models consumable by AI agents.

  • A strong design sensibility: an eye for visual detail and the judgement to push back on and improve design decisions, not just build them.

  • Experience with localisation and internationalisation at scale for a global audience.

  • Analytics and tag management implementation: dataLayer events, server-side tagging, getting attribution right without hurting performance.

Location
Our preference is for this role to be based hybrid out of our London, UK office. We can also accommodate remote workers elsewhere in Europe subject to compliance and right to work checks.

  • Retainer & Content Production: Oversee end-to-end execution of fast-turnaround social assets, localised multi-market campaigns, and platform-native video deliverables.

  • Resourcing & Mentorship: Partner with Resource Management to cast internal teams and external freelancers effectively, while providing mentorship and workflow guidance to mid-level and junior team members.

     

Qualifications

  • Language Expertise: Native-level fluency in German (written and spoken) is required, along with full professional fluency in English.

  • Project Management Synergy: While this is a Senior Integrated Producer role, candidates bringing a strong foundation or background in Project Management - experienced in running scrums, structuring workflows, and tracking deliverables - will be a natural fit.

  • Client-Facing Mindset: Genuinely enjoys being client-facing and comfortable serving as the day-to-day operational contact for high-level brand partners.

  • Rigorous QC Standards: An exceptional eye for detail, proofreading, and linguistic/visual quality assurance for social content.

  • Experience delivering marketing or social campaigns within film, streaming, TV, or broader entertainment media.

  • Exposure to live-action shoot production logistics and modern AI-driven production workflows.

Note: We emphasise skills, expertise and behavioural attributes over years of experience and traditional degrees. If you want to join our collaborative team, we invite you to apply today with your resume in English.

title: Senior IT Systemadministrator (m/w/d) M365 & Azure
descriptionHtml:
📍 Berlin | Bezirk Lichtenberg | 2 Tage Home Office
💻 Microsoft 365 | Azure | Automatisierung | Digitalisierung

Du möchtest als zentrale IT Ansprechperson die technische Infrastruktur eines Unternehmens gestalten, weiterentwickeln und automatisieren?

Dann könnte diese Position genau das Richtige für dich sein.

Unser Kunde ist ein dynamisch wachsendes E Commerce Unternehmen in Berlin, das mit tausenden Produkten in verschiedenen Kategorien erfolgreich auf digitalen Marktplätzen agiert. Aufgaben

Als fachlich führende IT Person verantwortest du die gesamte interne IT Umgebung. Da die Infrastruktur bewusst schlank gehalten ist und der Support überschaubar bleibt, liegt dein Fokus vor allem auf Architektur, Sicherheit, Automatisierung und der Weiterentwicklung der IT.

  • Microsoft 365: Vollständige Administration und Weiterentwicklung von Entra ID, Intune, Exchange Online, SharePoint und Teams einschließlich Conditional Access und Geräte Compliance.

  • Netzwerk & Security: Verantwortung für Netzwerk, Sophos Firewall und VPN sowie Sicherstellung eines stabilen und sicheren Betriebs.
  • Automatisierung: Konzeption und Umsetzung von Geschäftsprozess Automatisierungen mit Power Automate und PowerShell in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen.

  • 3rd Level Support: Fachliche Unterstützung der Junior Kollegin, die den 1st und 2nd Level Support übernimmt, sowie Übernahme komplexer technischer Fragestellungen im 3rd Level.
  • Wissensaufbau: Fachliche Weiterentwicklung der Junior Kollegin sowie Vermittlung von Wissen und Best Practices innerhalb des Unternehmens.
  • KI & Digitalisierung: Weiterentwicklung des strukturellen Einsatzes von KI Lösungen und Automatisierungstechnologien zur Optimierung interner Prozesse.
  • Prozessoptimierung: Analyse bestehender Geschäftsprozesse, Identifikation von Digitalisierungspotenzialen und Entwicklung nachhaltiger technischer Lösungen.

Qualifikation

  • Rund 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Systemadministration oder als Systems Engineer.
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Entra ID, Intune und der Microsoft 365 Administration, einschließlich der Fähigkeit, dieses Wissen weiterzugeben.
  • Mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure, insbesondere mit virtuellen Maschinen, Netzwerken und Backups.
  • Erfahrung mit Netzwerken und Firewalls, idealerweise mit Sophos.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit PowerShell im Arbeitsalltag.
  • Erfahrung mit Power Automate oder die klare Bereitschaft, sich in diesem Bereich weiterzuentwickeln.
  • Ausgeprägtes Prozessverständnis und der Anspruch, Prozesse zunächst zu verstehen und anschließend sinnvoll zu automatisieren.
  • Eigenständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit hohem Verantwortungsbewusstsein.
  • Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben und Kolleginnen und Kollegen fachlich zu unterstützen.
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gutes technisches Englisch.

Benefits

  • Attraktive Vergütung: Ein leistungsgerechtes Fixgehalt, das deiner Erfahrung und Qualifikation entspricht.
  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit 2 Home-Office Tagen, einer 40-Stunden-Woche, Gleitzeit mit Arbeitsbeginn zwischen 6:00 und 10:00 Uhr.
  • Langfristige Sicherheit: Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag sowie 30 Urlaubstage in einem wirtschaftlich erfolgreichen und zukunftssicheren Unternehmen.
  • Weiterentwicklung: Ob fachlich oder persönlich – deine Entwicklung wird aktiv gefördert und langfristig begleitet.
  • Modernes Arbeitsumfeld: Freue dich auf ein modernes Büro im Berliner Bezirk Lichtenberg.
  • Mobilität: Ob mit den öffentlichen Verkehrsmitteln oder dem Auto – profitiere von einem bezuschussten Jobticket oder kostenlosen Parkplätzen direkt am Büro.
  • Teamkultur: Flache Hierarchien, offene Kommunikation, eine gelebte Du-Kultur und regelmäßige Team- sowie Firmenevents wie „Grill & Chill“ sorgen für ein starkes Miteinander.
  • Verpflegung: Kostenlose Getränke sowie frisches Obst stehen dir im Arbeitsalltag jederzeit zur Verfügung.
  • Mitarbeitervorteile: Profitiere von attraktiven Mitarbeiterrabatten auf das Sortiment sowie weiteren Corporate Benefits.

Als Senior Systems Engineer möchtest du moderne IT Strukturen nicht nur betreiben, sondern aktiv weiterentwickeln und digitale Prozesse nachhaltig verbessern?

title: Senior Kreditorenbuchhalter (m/f/d)
descriptionHtml:
Bei Statista dreht sich alles um Daten und Fakten, denn wir sind die weltweit führende Business Data Plattform. Durch die Bereitstellung verlässlicher und einfach nutzbarer Daten sowie verschiedener Datenanalyseprodukte und -dienstleistungen unterstützen wir Menschen weltweit, faktenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen.

2007 in Hamburg gegründet, haben wir uns schnell zu einem globalen Unternehmen mit Büros in Metropolen wie London, New York und Tokio entwickelt. Und wir haben auch weiterhin viel vor. Unser stetiges Wachstum ist nicht nur Beweis für unseren Erfolg, sondern schafft auch immer neue Entwicklungs- und Karrieremöglichkeiten für unsere Mitarbeiter:innen.

Wir schätzen und feiern unsere vielfältige Kultur. Hier bist Du willkommen, egal, wer Du bist, woher Du kommst, wie Du aussiehst oder welche Graphen und Diagramme Du bevorzugst. Deine Geschichte ist wichtig – schreibe sie weiterhin als Teil unseres Teams. Überzeuge dich selbst und werde Teil unseres Teams!

Dein Job

'• Kreditorenbuchhaltung im Tagesgeschäft: Du bearbeitest Eingangsrechnungen und klärst Abweichungen und offene Posten eigenständig. Auch bei hohem Volumen sorgst du für zügige Bearbeitung und verlässlich hohe Qualität.

• Verantwortung für den Prozess: Du behältst den gesamten Purchase-to-Pay-Prozess (P2P) im Blick – von Bestellung über Wareneingang und Rechnungsprüfung bis zur Zahlung – und arbeitest eng mit den beteiligten Teams zusammen.

• Abschlüsse und Abstimmungen: Du stimmst Kreditorenkonten ab, bearbeitest Klärfälle und lieferst belastbare Beiträge zu den Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen.

• Prozessverbesserung und Projekte: Du analysierst bestehende Abläufe über Teamgrenzen hinweg, identifizierst Engpässe und setzt Verbesserungen gemeinsam mit den relevanten Schnittstellen um.

• Automatisierung und KI: Du prüfst, wo Automatisierung und KI die Bearbeitung sinnvoll unterstützen können, und gestaltest Lösungen mit, die Effizienz und Qualität verbessern – mit angemessenen Kontrollen und fachlicher Prüfung.

Dein Profil

'• Fundierte Praxis in der Kreditorenbuchhaltung: Du beherrschst das operative Geschäft sicher, priorisierst auch bei hohem Belegaufkommen gut und lieferst eigenständig präzise Ergebnisse.

• End-to-End-Verständnis: Du kennst die wesentlichen Teilbereiche des P2P-Prozesses aus der Praxis und hast bereits Projekte zur Analyse oder Verbesserung bereichsübergreifender Abläufe begleitet.

• SAP-Erfahrung: Du hast in der Kreditorenbuchhaltung mit SAP gearbeitet; Erfahrung mit SAP S/4HANA ist besonders willkommen.

• Gestaltungswille: Du hinterfragst Routinen konstruktiv, denkst über die eigene Aufgabe hinaus und setzt Verbesserungen pragmatisch um.

• Offenheit für neue Technologien: Du interessierst dich dafür, wie Automatisierung und KI Kreditorenprozesse verbessern können. Spezifische KI-Toolkenntnisse setzen wir nicht voraus.

• Sprachen: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Was wir bieten

Neben unserem großartigen Team, unserer Unternehmenskultur und dem gemeinsamen Ziel, Menschen mit Daten zu empowern, gibt es viele weitere Gründe, warum Statista ein großartiger Arbeitsplatz ist! Werde Teil unseres Teams und profitiere von folgenden Vorteilen:

  • Arbeiten aus dem Ausland: 10 Tage pro Jahr (bis zu 30 Tage, wenn deine Familie im Ausland lebt)

  • Hybrides Arbeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Internationales Team und regelmäßige Teamevents

  • Karriere- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

  • Attraktive Standorte und moderne Büros

  • Unterstützung für mentale Gesundheit durch OpenUp

Einige der hier aufgeführten Benefits gelten nur für die deutsche Gesellschaft und für Positionen ab Junior-Level.

title: Senior Legal Counsel - Privacy
descriptionHtml:
ABOUT THE ROLE

The LeoVegas Mobile Gaming Group is seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Legal Counsel focused on privacy, to join our dynamic and growing Privacy team. This is a pivotal role within the organisation, instrumental in safeguarding the personal data of our customers and employees, and ensuring robust data protection practices across our diverse brands, entities, and markets.

You will play a leading role in the strategic development and operational implementation of our privacy program, with the opportunity of exploring more general legal and regulatory affairs focused matters, as necessary.

YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:

  • As Senior Legal Counsel - Privacy, your core duties will include, but are not limited to:

  • Take responsibility for ensuring compliance with all privacy related laws and regulations for assigned entities, brands, and markets within the LeoVegas Mobile Gaming Group.

  • Serve as Data Protection Officer (DPO) for designated Group entities, fulfilling all statutory duties and responsibilities associated with the role, ensuring compliance with relevant data protection laws and regulations.

  • Collaborate closely with other DPOs and internal stakeholders on all pertinent data protection matters, contributing to a cohesive and effective privacy framework.

  • Conduct comprehensive data protection due diligence on prospective and existing business partners

  • Draft, review, and negotiate complex data protection agreements, clauses, and terms.

  • Draft, review, and update privacy policies and related procedures, privacy notices, and cookie policies for the Group and its partners, ensuring clarity, accuracy, and legal compliance.

  • Develop and refine internal procedures and policies to ensure robust personal data protection and GDPR compliance across all business operations.

  • Provide expert legal advice and guidance on a broad spectrum of data protection issues to various business units, senior management, and project teams.

  • Actively participate in and lead data protection workstreams within significant company projects, including mergers & acquisitions (M&As), ensuring privacy by design and by default principles are integrated from inception.

  • Take ownership of and lead major privacy-related initiatives, representing the Privacy team in critical cross-functional company projects and steering groups.

  • Mentor junior team members and contribute significantly to the professional development and knowledge sharing within the Privacy team, fostering a culture of continuous learning.

  • Contribute strategically to the evolution and implementation of the Group's overall privacy program and strategy, aligning with business objectives and regulatory landscapes.

  • Provide assistance and legal advice concerning data subjects' rights requests, ensuring timely and compliant responses.

  • Manage and provide expert advice on customer complaints related to data protection, including conducting thorough internal investigations, drafting submission, and preparing comprehensive reports.

  • Liaise effectively with data protection supervisory authorities and other regulators regarding complaints, inquiries, audits, and other regulatory matters.

  • Handle any data breaches and associated reporting requirements in a timely and compliant manner;

  • Ensure that material data protection risks are escalated appropriately and that regulatory reporting obligations are discharged within statutory timeframes.

  • Conduct, manage, advise on, and assist with Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), other privacy related assessments or investigations, and privacy audits, identifying risks and recommending mitigation strategies.


OUR SUCCESSFUL CANDIDATE WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING:

ESSENTIAL SKILLS

  • A recognised legal qualification demonstrating a strong foundation in legal principles and analysis.

  • A minimum of 4-6 years of progressive experience in a dedicated privacy legal role, preferably within a multinational or complex corporate environment.

  • Deep and demonstrable expertise in GDPR and other relevant global data protection laws.

  • Proven experience in drafting, reviewing, and negotiating complex data protection agreements and privacy-related policies.

  • Demonstrated ability to act as a DPO or hold a similar lead privacy advisory role, including managing regulatory interactions.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with the ability to translate complex legal requirements into practical business solutions.

  • Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to advise and influence stakeholders at all levels of the organisation.

  • Ability to work autonomously, manage multiple priorities, and thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic, and evolving regulatory landscape.

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

NICE TO HAVES

  • Specific experience within the iGaming, financial services, or technology sectors is considered a very strong asset due to the inherent data intensity and regulatory scrutiny.

  • Any relevant privacy certifications.

WHO WE ARE

At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build, and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We’re a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators, and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 18 offices worldwide.

BENEFITS

  • Hybrid working - 3 days per week at the office, with flexibility for 2 days at home

  • Workation – Take your job on an adventure with our Workation benefit for up to 4 weeks per year (T&Cs apply).

  • Plenty of time to recharge – 28 days of paid leave, plus all public and bank holidays in England.

  • Invest in your future – We match pension contributions up to 6%.

  • Comprehensive healthcare – BUPA coverage, including pre-existing conditions, plus a cashback plan for dental, optical, and other treatments.

  • Wellbeing allowance – £250 annual allowance for you to invest in your health and wellbeing (T&Cs apply).

  • A great workplace experience – Talented colleagues, complimentary snacks and drinks, as well as breakfasts and lunches on a weekly basis

  • A social culture you’ll love – Regular opportunities to attend sporting events throughout the year, plus a quarterly team budget for even more fun.

  • Support for growing families – Up to 6 months of full pay for maternity leave.

  • Stay active & save money – Cycle-to-work scheme and gym discounts to keep you moving.

  • Work in style – at our newly renovated offices at Tailors Corner are just a 2-minute walk from Leeds Train Station.

  • And there’s more… We’ll share even more perks related to your role when you chat with our Talent Acquisition team!

 

JOIN US!

In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don’t wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen!

Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar!

As our company working language is English, we’d like to see your CV in English, please

title: Senior Localisation Quality Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?

Sony Interactive Entertainment isn’t just the Best Place to Play — it’s also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we’re part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity.

Role overview

We are seeking a Senior Localisation Quality Engineer, a highly skilled and innovative individual who brings together design-phase product thinking, software engineering expertise, localisation awareness, and technical problem solving.

The role builds on the core responsibilities of a Senior Localisation QA Engineer, combining strong localization quality expertise with software engineering, automation, and earlier involvement in the product design and development lifecycle.

This role is ideal for someone who has worked closely with design teams in Figma, has experience reviewing and validating designs before implementation, understands how localisation impacts product and UI design, and can build scalable technical solutions to improve quality across the product lifecycle. You will partner with design, engineering, product, and localisation teams to identify risks early, improve design quality and localisation readiness, and create tools, systems, and solutions that enable faster and smarter delivery.

Rather than focusing only on post-implementation testing, this role emphasises early engagement in the design phase, including reviewing Figma files, prototypes, design systems, user flows, and content structures to ensure they are scalable, testable, and ready for localisation across languages and regions. You will also contribute as a hands-on engineer, building software, automation, integrations, and AI-driven solutions such as agents, assistants, or plugins that improve workflows, validation, and quality decision-making.

The ideal candidate combines strong software development skills, experience working with design systems and Figma-based workflows, practical understanding of localisation and internationalisation, and hands-on interest in engineering solutions to product and quality challenges.

Responsibilities

Design Systems, Figma & Early Product Quality

- Partner with designers, product managers, engineers, and the wider Localisation team to help identify localisation risks early in the design phase.
- Support the Localisation team by reviewing Figma designs and providing technical and design expertise to improve localisation readiness before implementation.
- Help the Localisation team identify and address design risks such as text expansion, truncation, layout issues, bidirectional languages, locale-aware components, and cross-market scalability.
- .Build and improve tools, automation, and processes that enable Localisation QA to identify issues earlier and at scale, including automated design and content validation, screenshot capture, localisation readiness checks, and quality validation across languages and regions.
- Work with the wider Localisation team to define best practices and guidance that help designers and engineers create products that are ready for localisation from the start.
- Collaborate with design teams on design systems, UI patterns, and content structures to improve quality and reduce downstream issues before code is written.
- Help define quality expectations, localisation considerations, and implementation guidance directly from design artefacts and product requirements.

Localisation Quality & Testing

- Perform hands-on Localisation QA testing across multiple languages, platforms, products, and regions, including linguistic, functional, visual, and internationalisation testing.
- Lead and support complex localisation quality initiatives, while contributing directly to day-to-day testing when needed.
- Develop and improve localisation test strategies covering linguistic, functional, visual, and internationalisation quality.
- Investigate complex localisation and internationalisation issues and work with engineering, design, product, and localisation teams to identify root causes and appropriate solutions.
- Help define localisation quality standards and ensure localisation considerations are integrated throughout the product development lifecycle, from design through implementation and release.

Software Engineering & Technical Solutions

- Design and develop software, internal tools, automation, and reusable services that improve product quality, design validation, and workflow efficiency.
- Build scalable software solutions that support validation of product experiences across design, development, and release stages.
- Contribute to codebases, frameworks, and technical infrastructure that improve quality signals, design consistency, and localisation support.
- Partner with software engineers to improve feature readiness, system testability, and quality-by-design practices.
- Integrate validation and quality workflows into modern development environments and CI/CD pipelines where appropriate.

Automation, Tooling & Process Improvement

- Identify opportunities to reduce manual work and improve localisation and product quality across design, engineering, and localisation workflows.
- Design and build tools, automation, integrations, or other technical solutions that help teams review designs, validate content, detect issues, and improve workflows.
- Choose the right technical approach for each problem, which may include traditional automation, scripts, plugins, APIs, AI/LLMs, or existing internal tools.
- Develop solutions that help identify localisation and quality issues earlier in the product lifecycle and provide faster feedback to teams.
- Prototype and test new approaches, measure their value, and develop successful solutions so they can be used by the wider Localisation team and potentially other teams.

Cross-Functional Leadership

- Act as a bridge across design, engineering, product, and localisation teams, helping align quality, scalability, and user experience goals.
- Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex issues into actionable recommendations.
- Influence teams toward a shift-left, design-led quality approach.
- Contribute to planning, design reviews, implementation discussions, and release readiness with a focus on preventing issues early.
- Provide technical guidance and mentorship to members of the Localisation team, sharing engineering, automation, localisation, and quality best practices.
- Promote a culture of innovation, technical excellence, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

Education

  • BS/BA in Computer Science, Engineering, Human-Computer Interaction, Design Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Experience

- 5+ years of experience in software engineering, design technology, quality engineering, localisation engineering, or related product development roles.
- Strong hands-on experience in software development, with the ability to build tools, systems, integrations, or automation that solve real product challenges.
- Experience working closely with design teams and Figma workflows, including reviewing designs, prototypes, component systems, and user journeys before implementation.
- Experience validating or testing Figma designs for quality, scalability, localisation readiness, and implementation feasibility.
- Practical understanding of localisation and internationalisation principles in digital products.
- Experience with localisation quality or testing across multilingual products, platforms, or regions.
- Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or Java.
- Hands-on experience building or experimenting with AI agents, plugins, copilots, or intelligent workflow tools.
- Experience with APIs, structured data, system integrations, and modern software development practices.
- Familiarity with developer collaboration tools such as GitHub, JIRA, and Confluence.
- Strong understanding of product development lifecycle, Agile methodologies, and cross-functional delivery models.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong product thinking and problem-solving ability.
  • Comfortable operating across design, engineering, product, and localisation domains.
  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and effective in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organisational and stakeholder management skills.

Desired qualifications

  • Experience with Figma design systems, component libraries, and design-to-development workflows.
  • Experience creating or contributing to Figma plugins, design validation tools, or workflow extensions.
  • Experience building AI agents, assistants, or plugins for design, engineering, content, or localisation use cases.
  • Experience influencing product quality earlier in the lifecycle through design review and engineering collaboration.
  • Familiarity with multilingual product development, translation workflows, or international launch readiness.
  • Experience in video games, consumer technology, digital entertainment, or large-scale product environments.
  • Fluency in one or more non-English languages is a plus.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to shape next-generation quality, localisation, and design-to-development practices.
  • A dynamic and inclusive workplace where technical excellence, collaboration, and global impact thrive.
  • Competitive compensation, performance bonuses, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Career growth opportunities in a forward-looking engineering environment focused on quality, localisation, automation, intelligent systems, and early product excellence.

Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks.

Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice (where applicable) for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights.

title: Senior logistiek medewerker Meppel
descriptionHtml:
Werk jij graag in de logistiek en neem je makkelijk het voortouw? Dan zoeken wij jou. Je werkt actief mee op de werkvloer, begeleidt collega's en zorgt ervoor dat onze operatie veilig en efficiënt verloopt.

Waar kom je te werken?

Je komt te werken in ons depot in Meppel. Samen met je collega's zorg je ervoor dat duizenden pakketten iedere dag op tijd worden verwerkt. Je werkt in een vast rooster met wisselende diensten:

  • 01:00 - 09:30 uur (nacht/ochtend);

  • 13:30 - 22:00 uur (middag/avond).

Je bent bereid beide diensten te werken volgens een vooraf vastgesteld rooster.


Wat ga je doen?

Als senior logistiek medewerker begeleid je collega's op de werkvloer en ondersteun je de Teamleader Operations bij de dagelijkse operatie.

  • Laden, lossen, sorteren en scannen van pakketten.

  • Bewaken van de voortgang, kwaliteit en veiligheid.

  • Collega's ondersteunen en begeleiden.

  • Knelpunten signaleren en helpen oplossen.

  • Aanspreekpunt zijn tijdens de dienst.

  • De Teamleader Operations ondersteunen of vervangen.

  • Meedenken over verbeteringen in het proces.

Wat bieden we jou?

  • Een salaris tussen € 2.501,82 en € 3.574,03 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring.

  • Een functie 38,75 (1 fte) uur per week.

  • Een gunstige ORT (onregelmatigheidstoeslag)

    • 30% tussen 20:00 uur en 24:00 uur;

    • 45% tussen 00:00 uur 06:00 uur;

    • 50% op zaterdagen en zondagen;

    • 100% op feestdagen;

  • Opleidingskansen, ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en onbeperkt toegang tot onze Studyhub.

  • 28 vakantiedagen (+ optie tot bijkoop) en reiskostenvergoeding.

  • Veel extra’s, zoals een collectieve zorgverzekering en een aantrekkelijk pensioen.


Wat neem je mee?

  • Mbo werk- en denkniveau.

  • Ervaring in logistiek, productie of operations.

  • Ervaring met het begeleiden van collega's is een pre.

  • Kennis van Excel.

  • Je communiceert makkelijk en neemt initiatief.

  • Je houdt overzicht en hebt oog voor mensen én processen.

Over DPD Nederland

Met 12 depots in Nederland en als onderdeel van Geopost, zijn we verbonden met een internationaal netwerk dat jaarlijks 1,2 miljard pakketten verwerkt. Achter deze indrukwekkende cijfers staan duizenden collega’s die zich elke dag inzetten, straks samen met jou.

Onze cultuur is ondernemend, betrouwbaar en mensgericht. Wat ooit begon als een nuchter MKB-bedrijf leeft nog steeds voort: praktisch, sociaal en trots. We geloven in persoonlijk contact, samenwerking en zelf aanpakken. Uitdagingen gaan we niet uit de weg. Dat zit in ons DNA.

We groeien hard, hebben grote ambities en jij hoort er straks écht bij. Samen maken we het verschil.

Solliciteren

Solliciteer eenvoudig via onderstaande sollicitatiebutton. Wij nemen zo snel mogelijk contact met je op. Zijn we allebei enthousiast? Dan zetten we samen de volgende stappen in de sollicitatieprocedure.

  • Lead consolidated planning and forecasting. Own the annual budget and quarterly forecast process, bringing together inputs across revenue, gross profit and operating expenditure. Challenge assumptions, resolve inconsistencies across plans, and ensure alignment with Airwallex’s strategic priorities, long-range plan and EBITDA targets.

  • Translate company-wide performance into decisions. Lead monthly management reporting and performance reviews, explaining the drivers of results and their implications for the outlook. Identify material risks and opportunities, build scenarios to assess trade-offs, and recommend actions to senior management.

  • Partner with corporate leaders on resource allocation. Translate business priorities into headcount and spending plans, evaluate investment requests and vendor commitments, and challenge assumptions.   • Partner with People & Talent on workforce planning. Build and maintain the consolidated headcount and employee cost forecast with finance and business owners. Assess the implications of hiring pace, workforce mix and organisational changes, and keep hiring plans, budgets and forecasts aligned.

  • Drive operating leverage across corporate functions. Develop cost, capacity and productivity measures suited to each function. Evaluate opportunities through automation, process improvements and vendor arrangements, and track whether investments deliver the expected outcomes.

  • Strengthen FP&A tools, data and processes. Stay hands-on with financial models and analysis, partnering with Accounting, Data and Finance Architecture to improve reporting accuracy and planning consistency. Use AI and automation to simplify recurring work, improve forecasting and enable faster investigation of business questions.

You'll work from our London office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, a quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 10+ years of progressive FP&A or related finance experience, with clear ownership of consolidated budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting in high-growth businesses.

  • Strong understanding of the full P&L and underlying accounting, with the ability to connect operational drivers, accruals, expense timing and one-off items to financial performance and forecast assumptions.

  • Experience partnering with corporate functions on headcount, employee costs, operating expenditure and investment decisions, including constructively challenging resource requests and assessing business cases.

  • Advanced financial modelling skills in Excel or Google Sheets, including driver-based forecasting and scenario analysis using large datasets.

  • A track record of translating complex financial analysis into clear recommendations for senior, non-finance stakeholders, with the judgement and confidence to influence decisions.

  • A hands-on approach and strong execution discipline: comfortable investigating data, resolving discrepancies and coordinating planning cycles across teams, with experience building or improving FP&A processes in a changing environment.

Preferred

  • FP&A experience in a fast-growing technology or fintech company, ideally with global exposure to SaaS, payments or multi-region business models.

  • Early-career training in Big 4 audit, deals or transaction services, investment banking, private equity or consulting, followed by in-house corporate finance experience.

  • Hands-on experience with modern FP&A or BI tools such as Pigment, Anaplan, Databricks, Tableau or Looker, and experience extracting data with SQL.

  • Practical experience applying AI or automation to financial analysis, planning or reporting workflows.

You'll thrive here if

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You're comfortable operating across time zones with a globally distributed team, including colleagues based in APAC and EMEA.

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

  • You simplify complexity rather than hiding behind it.

Learn more about your team

Finance & Corporate Development helps Airwallex grow with control. We’re a trusted partner to the business, providing actionable insights on performance, supporting market and product expansion and helping to shape the future of our product. We ensure that Airwallex meets its financial reporting, tax and safeguarding obligations globally. We work with existing and prospective investors to raise capital and ensure it is deployed effectively.

This is a team for people who want to reimagine how the CFO office works. We’re looking for founder-like energy, high integrity and a passion for technology. You’ll thrive here if you enjoy working cross-functionally, think from first principles and can balance speed of execution with analytical precision.

title: Senior Manager, Product Partnerships
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including Bolt, GoCardless, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

About the Role

Perk works best when it connects seamlessly with the tools and platforms our customers

already rely on. From ERP and accounting systems to workplace software, mobility providers,

technology platforms, and emerging AI ecosystems, these third-party relationships can directly

shape the value customers get from Perk.

We’re looking for a Senior Manager, Product Partnerships to own and build those relationships.

Unlike our Growth Partnerships and Supplier Partnerships teams, this role isn’t responsible for

generating sales pipeline or supplier commission revenue. Its goal is to make Perk’s product

and customer experience stronger through the third parties we depend on and integrate with.

You’ll determine where strategic relationships can unlock the most customer value, build and

manage those partnerships, secure the access and agreements our teams need, and work

closely with Product and Engineering to turn them into successful customer-facing experiences.

This is a new role at Perk with significant opportunity to define how Product Partnerships should

work as we scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Build our product partnership strategy: Translate Perk’s product and company priorities into a clear roadmap of third-party relationships across areas such as ERP and accounting, business software, mobility, integration platforms, and AI.

  • Own strategic partner relationships: Serve as Perk’s primary relationship owner for the external platforms and technology companies that enable or enhance customer-facing product experiences.

  • Unlock Product and Engineering: Secure the developer access, API licences, programme memberships, certifications, marketplace approvals, and other partner support our teams need to build and maintain integrations.

  • Structure and negotiate partnerships: Lead commercial and strategic discussions around API access, data, licensing, marketplace participation, co-marketing, and other partnership terms, working closely with Legal, Security, Finance, Product, and Engineering.

  • Partner with Product on priorities: Bring the partner and market perspective into roadmap discussions while Product Managers own product requirements and delivery. Help determine which external relationships and integration models create the greatest customer value.

  • Own the partner lifecycle: Manage relationships from initial engagement through integration, certification, launch, ongoing roadmap alignment, escalations, programme changes, and renewals.

  • Drive adoption and customer value: Work with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, Sales, and Support to ensure partnerships aren’t simply launched—they are discoverable, useful, reliable, and adopted by customers.

  • Build the Product Partnerships playbook: Establish how Perk evaluates, prioritises, launches, measures, and manages product partnerships as this function grows.

What We’re Looking For

  • Proven experience in strategic partnerships, ecosystem partnerships, business development, or a product-adjacent role within SaaS, fintech, or B2B technology.

  • Experience building and managing complex relationships with technology or platform companies, ideally including developer, API, certification, or marketplace programmes.

  • Comfortable working with Product and Engineering and understanding technical concepts such as APIs, OAuth, data models, sandboxes, and integration dependencies without needing to be an engineer.

  • Ability to distinguish between an interesting partnership and one that will meaningfully improve Perk’s product or customer experience.

  • Strong relationship-building, negotiation, and communication skills across both external partners and senior internal stakeholders.

  • Able to move complex initiatives forward across Product, Engineering, Legal, Security, Finance, Marketing, Customer Success, Support, and Sales without relying on direct authority.

  • Comfortable defining the strategy, operating model, priorities, and processes for a new function rather than inheriting an established playbook.

  • Able to build the case for a partnership and measure its impact through adoption, customer experience, integration quality, and other relevant outcomes.

  • Based within commuting distance of our London or Barcelona hub.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with ERP, accounting, spend management, payments, travel, or fintech ecosystems.

  • Experience managing relationships with major business software, technology, mobility, or AI platforms.

  • Familiarity with unified API or integration-platform models.

  • Experience with European ERP and accounting ecosystems across markets such as DACH, Benelux, France, the Nordics, or the UK.

  • Additional European languages.

 

What We Offer

  • Receive competitive compensation and equity ownership in Perk

  • Rest and recharge with 25 days of annual leave plus bank holidays

  • Take control of your physical health with private medical cover and voluntary dental insurance from Bupa, and discounted gym memberships with GymFlex

  • Plan for your future with our qualifying earnings company pension plan with Aviva

  • Know that your loved ones are protected financially through your Life Insurance if the worst were to happen

  • Rest assured that you’re covered by income protection in case you experience a long-term sickness or absence

  • Leverage tax-efficient cycle and electric car schemes with Cycle2Work & Octopus

  • Join our unforgettable Perk events, including our spectacular annual summer party

  • Always feel supported with Spring Health, our market-leading wellbeing partner, providing fast, comprehensive access to 12x therapy and 12x coaching sessions for you and your loved ones

  • Focus on your family with 12-16 weeks’ paid parental leave

  • Contribute to your community with 16 paid hours per year to spend volunteering for your dearest charitable causes

  • Broaden your horizons with up to 20 "Work from Anywhere" days per year

  • Stay savvy with access to a wide variety of discounts and rewards

  • Follow your passions and take a four-week, fully paid sabbatical once you reach 5 years

  • Let us help you move to one of our hubs with relocation support

The Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview - 30 mins - Virtual

  • Hiring Manager Interview - 30 mins - Virtual

  • Assessment Interview - 60 mins - IRL / Virtual

  • Values interview - 30 mins - Virtual

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. If you receive a message claiming to be from Perk that seems suspicious, please do not respond. Forward it to security [at] perk .com, and we will confirm whether it is legitimate.

title: Senior ML Engineer
descriptionHtml:
For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands.

About SkinVision

Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped over 3 million people worldwide. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin cancer images and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. Where needed, cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need.

Senior Machine Learning Engineer at SkinVision

We're on the lookout for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer based in our Amsterdam office with the right skills and experience to ensure the Machine Learning team releases models with exceptional performance making use of state-of-the-art techniques. Not only are ML models vital to our product and hence for our end users, e.g., enabling early detection of skin cancer, they also enable our internal team to perform optimally. The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in training new and optimizing existing Machine Learning and computer vision models (Python), has hands-on experience in MLOps and deploying models to production (preferably in AWS) and is able to gather requirements and communicate results to the stakeholders directly involved in the model development and deployment. Moreover, in this senior role, it is vital that you can mentor other team members, own the technical processes and actively contribute to the ML roadmap. Knowledge of data orchestration tools (Apache Airflow), data modeling (dbt) and working in a regulated and/or medical environment are a plus!

What you will do

  • Drive the full ML model development lifecycle: from understanding and co-defining the problem to providing inputs on data collection, assessing the quality of data, model training, validation, deployment and monitoring.

  • Create requirements for data collection for both new and existing models. This includes data for model training and testing.

  • Develop and improve efficient ML training pipelines in the cloud (AWS or similar).

  • Involve stakeholders appropriately during the entire development, deployment and monitoring lifecycle.

  • Scale the ML environment and processes to multiple models being developed and deployed simultaneously.

  • Ensure ML development aligns with medical device standards if applicable, including ML best practices, experiment tracking, traceability, data lineage and documentation.

  • Support and mentor team members.

  • Showcase ML models and capabilities both internally and externally, by giving presentations, workshops, training, etc.

  • Stay abreast of the latest industry standards, best practices and emerging trends in Machine Learning and AI and share insights with the broader team.


Your profile

  • 8-10 years of proven professional experience as a Machine Learning Engineer or similar role, showcasing exceptional proficiency in model training, deployment within a consumer product, data analysis, stakeholder management and teamwork/mentoring.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Econometrics, Statistics, Computer Science or a related field.

Skills

  • Ability to translate user needs and requirements into technical requirements and a development plan.

  • Hands-on expertise with modern deep learning architectures and other ML architectures, ideally but not restricted to image data.

  • Hands-on experience with MLOps practices for scalable training, deployment and monitoring.

  • Experience in developing and deploying ML models for a consumer product (mature development processes), ideally in the healthcare space or a regulated environment.

  • Ability to iterate quickly from ideas to experiments, learning from results and making data-driven decisions.

  • Strong analytical mindset, problem-solving skills and the ability to extract actionable insights from intricate datasets.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the capacity to effectively convey technical concepts to diverse audiences.

  • Proven ability to thrive in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment, managing multiple priorities and deadlines.

  • Experience with mentoring and leading team members.

What we offer you

  • A competitive salary, additional benefits, and a hybrid working policy

  • A vibrant, dynamic, and rapidly growing scale-up in Amsterdam

  • An enthusiastic, professional, and international team

  • Regular team events, including off-sites and fun activities

  • Unlimited skin checks for you

title: Senior Network Operations Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About the job

Turn complex network faults into lasting fixes, and make new services ready for reliable operation.

As a Senior Network Operations Engineer in Bristol, UK, you’ll keep Graphcore’s networks reliable and secure. This full-time role spans the network lifecycle, from shaping operational requirements to resolving complex incidents.

Your improvements will reduce downtime and manual errors across new and existing services. You’ll help colleagues operate services confidently, with practical runbooks and recovery procedures ready when problems arise.

You’ll troubleshoot routing and firewalls, improve monitoring and automate routine operations. You’ll also support upgrades and deployments through testing, controlled changes and clear handovers.

Your scope includes AWS networking, Cisco Software-Defined Access and SD-WAN across cloud and on-premises environments. Occasional travel to remote data centres and offices will involve installations, troubleshooting and hands-on support. 

The team and culture

You’ll join a supportive, multidisciplinary IT infrastructure team that works closely together and regularly shares knowledge. With new projects ahead, you’ll bring operational experience into network designs alongside architects and project teams.

As a senior escalation point, you’ll own complex incidents through to resolution. You’ll use monitoring evidence and recurring incident trends to prioritise reliability improvements. 

What we’re looking for

AWS networking, Cisco Software-Defined Access (SDA) or SD-WAN experience would be particularly valuable, but is not essential.

  • At least five years’ hands-on network engineering experience, focused on production support, with certification in a major networking platform.
  • Strong practical knowledge of large-scale L2/L3 networks, including BGP, OSPF, switching, routing and resilience.
  • Experience supporting centrally controlled Wi-Fi, such as Cisco Meraki or Aruba, and resolving connectivity and performance issues.
  • Experience managing and troubleshooting centralised firewalls, including rulesets, NAT and VPNs, plus familiarity with open-source products such as pfSense.
  • Hands-on use of Ansible, Python or similar tools to automate operations and manage network configurations.
  • Evidence-led troubleshooting using monitoring, packet captures and logs, alongside clear communication, documentation and sound judgement during incidents. 

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.

Benefits

  • Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
  • Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
  • Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
  • Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
  • Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
  • Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
  • Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice
  • Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme and dental cover

We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences and are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work.

We’re an equal opportunity employer and recognise that everyone brings different strengths and perspectives. If you need any adjustments during the interview process, just let us know - we’re happy to support you. 

Sponsorship

Applicants must have the legal right to work in the UK. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide visa sponsorship or support visa applications for this role. 

Access to controlled technology

Some roles at Graphcore involve access to technology subject to U.S. export control regulations. Depending on the role, we may need to assess whether export authorisation is required, taking account of factors such as work location, citizenship and immigration status. Where authorisation is required, this may affect whether or when you can start the role. We’ll explain any relevant requirements during the recruitment process. 

Join the Team at Graphcore

Graphcore is one of the world’s leading innovators in Artificial Intelligence compute. It is developing hardware, software and systems infrastructure that will unlock the next generation of AI breakthroughs and power the widespread adoption of AI solutions across every industry.

As part of the SoftBank Group, Graphcore is a member of an elite family of companies responsible for some of the world’s most transformative technologies. Together, they share a bold vision: to enable Artificial Super Intelligence and ensure its benefits are accessible to everyone.

Graphcore’s teams are drawn from diverse backgrounds and bring a broad range of skills and perspectives. A melting pot of AI research specialists, silicon designers, software engineers and systems architects, Graphcore brings together deep expertise to solve complex problems and deliver meaningful progress in AI compute. 

Apply to join Graphcore in Bristol and turn your network operations expertise into more reliable services.

title: Senior NX CAD Application Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Maya HTT is a world leading developer of digital industries software solutions. The world’s top tier engineering and manufacturing organizations rely on Maya’s experience and expertise to achieve the full potential of their software investment. Maya HTT is also a Value Added Reseller (VAR) for the Siemens PLM Software products, with a focus on CAE-based simulation and providing engineering services, including software training, migration, implementation, and custom development, along with consulting.

Position Summary

We’re looking for an experienced Senior NX CAD Application Engineer to join our UK team. In this role, you’ll be a trusted technical partner to our customers, helping leading engineering organizations solve complex design challenges and get more value from Siemens NX and the broader digital engineering ecosystem. You’ll bring deep NX CAD expertise while taking a broader view of customer success - helping lead technical projects, supporting other engineers, identifying opportunities for automation and innovation, AI adoption and making sure solutions deliver real value for our customers. This is an ideal opportunity for an experienced NX professional who wants to move beyond traditional CAD support into a role with greater technical ownership, customer responsibility, and deliver digital engineering transformation via automations and AI.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as a senior subject matter expert for Siemens NX CAD and NX best practices.

  • Explore and leverage AI to provide agentic solutions to improve engineering workflows and customer outcomes.

  • Contribute to automation and customization initiatives using NX Open, journaling, scripting, and related technologies.

  • Contribute to presales activities, including discovery sessions, technical presentations, demonstrations, solution definition, and proposals.

  • Take technical ownership of customer engagements, helping coordinate activities, solve problems, and ensure successful outcomes.

  • Collaborate with Maya HTT specialists across PLM, software development, simulation, manufacturing, and AI to deliver broader customer solutions.

  • Build trusted relationships with customers, understanding their engineering challenges and proactively helping them identify solutions.

  • Deliver high-quality NX CAD consulting services and technical training.

  • Mentor and support other engineers working on NX-related projects.

What You Bring

  • 10+ years of industrial experience working with Siemens NX CAD, (product design, configuring and administering NX environments)

  • UK nationality (British citizenship) is required due to the nature of the projects associated with this role.

  • An interest in applying AI and emerging technologies to engineering and product development workflows.

  • Experience working directly with customers or internal engineering stakeholders in a consulting, application engineering, technical support, or similar role.

  • Ability to troubleshoot complex problems beyond standard user-level functionality and the confidence to navigate unfamiliar technical challenges

  • A strong sense of ownership and the ability to take a customer problem from initial discussion through to resolution.

  • Experience leading technical activities, work packages, or customer projects.

  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build credibility with both technical specialists and customer stakeholders.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams.

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

  • Occasional travel to customer sites when required.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with NX Open, NX journaling, or NX automation/customisation.

  • Experience with scripting or programming, such as Python, TCL, C#, C++, or similar technologies.

  • Exposure to Teamcenter or other PLM systems, particularly from an NX user or power-user perspective.

  • Experience with NX CAM, NX Post Builder, Siemens Post Configurator, or related manufacturing tools.

  • Experience with Solid Edge or other commercial CAD platforms.

  • Experience delivering or supporting design automation solutions.

  • Experience mentoring engineers or informally leading technical teams.

  • Experience with additive manufacturing or other advanced manufacturing technologies.

What Success Looks Like

You’ll become one of the senior technical anchors for NX within our UK team - someone customers and colleagues can rely on when a problem is complex, when a project needs technical leadership, or when an opportunity requires connecting CAD expertise with automation, PLM, software, or emerging technologies.

You won’t need to be the expert in every technology. What matters is knowing NX deeply, understanding engineering, having a keen interest to adopt new technology such as AI, taking ownership, and knowing how to bring the right people together to solve the customer’s problem.

Why join Maya HTT?

  • Permanent Position, Competitive Base Salary, and Yearly Increase.

  • Employer-Paid Benefits starting from Day One: private healthcare, vision and dental care, travel insurance, critical illness, income protection and life insurance

  • Retirement Savings with Employer Contributions and open to join from Day One

  • Career Growth Opportunities: Our flexible career paths allow you to grow, and we like to promote internally.

  • Learning Opportunities: Learn from the best in the industry and develop your skills.

  • Generous Time-Off Policy: We promote a Healthy Work-Life Balance with a Flexible PTO Policy, Sick/Personal Days, and a Summer Flex Schedule.

  • Structured Onboarding Program: We’re invested in your success; you’ll have team members to support you and provide a wide range of assistance from Day One.

  • Join an award-winning company that is recognized worldwide as an industry leader.

Our Candidate Experience Flow: HRScreen - Virtual Interviews using Microsoft Teams - Job Offer

Maya HTT is an equal opportunity employer and committed to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the hiring and selection process.

title: Senior Paid Media Manager Freelance (UK Based)
descriptionHtml:

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. Our platform manages the full lifecycle — creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

About the role

Paid amplification is how our creator work reaches beyond organic. This role sits alongside our Director of Paid Strategy and owns the performance of paid campaigns across our client portfolio — planning them, running them, and being the person in the room who can explain what the numbers mean. You'll also be the senior voice in the paid team, setting the standard for how we test and how we report, and bringing a Paid Media Executive up to speed as the team grows. Six months in, our clients should be getting sharper recommendations and our optimisation decisions should be faster and better evidenced than they are today.

What you'll do

  • Own the planning, activation, and optimisation of paid campaigns across TikTok and Meta, with YouTube in the mix — from media plan through to post-campaign readout

  • Run a genuine test-and-learn programme against client KPIs: form the hypothesis, structure the test, act on the result, and write down what we learned so the next campaign starts further ahead

  • Manage budgets of $1M+ and make the call on where spend moves, with the analysis to justify it

  • Present performance to clients directly — regular reporting plus the data-led recommendations that come with it

  • Mentor a Paid Media Executive, and set the templates, naming conventions, and QA habits the whole paid team works to

  • Partner with our strategy and creative production teams so paid and creator work are planned together, not bolted on

  • Track platform and channel changes and tell us what to do differently because of them

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years in digital paid media, in-house or agency-side, with deep hands-on ownership of TikTok and Meta

  • AI Savvy, experience using AI in your workflow (Claude preferred).

  • A track record of improving campaign performance through analysis you did yourself — you can walk us through a specific example

  • Experience managing paid budgets of $1M+ and being accountable for the outcome

  • High proficiency in Excel and strong numeracy — you're comfortable being the person who checks the maths

  • The judgement to make a call that affects client performance and defend it clearly

  • Real attention to detail on the administrative side: reporting accuracy, budget tracking, and campaign hygiene

  • Comfort working with clients and teams across multiple countries and time zones

Nice to have

  • Experience mentoring or line-managing a junior paid media hire

  • Background working directly with creators or on creator-led paid social

  • Comfort with SQL or a BI tool for cutting your own performance data

How we hire

A 30-minute intro call with our recruiter, a conversation with the hiring manager, and a panel with 2-3 people from the team you'd be working with. We share feedback within 5 working days at each stage. We tell you what we're paying upfront — no salary games.

 

AI is core to how we operate. Use it to elevate your work. But everything in your application should reflect your own judgement and experience.

💟 Support

If you have a condition or require an adjustment to our interview process - please let us know so we can make adjustments to support you. Please note that when you submit an application or resume, your data will be processed in line with our privacy policy.
