title: Social Media Senior Manager
descriptionHtml:
Your wellbeing, our mission. Join a company shaping a healthier world.

GET TO KNOW US

At Wellhub we're revolutionizing workplace wellness. Our platform connects employees worldwide to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep—all in one simple subscription. Headquartered in NYC with team members in Europe, North America and South America, we’re on a mission to make every company a wellness company.

We believe work should be fulfilling, inspiring, and balanced. Here, you’ll find a team that values wellbeing, collaboration, and different perspectives, where passion and creativity push boundaries to create real impact. Your contributions will help shape a healthier, more balanced world for you and millions of people globally. 

Join us in redefining the future of wellbeing!

THE OPPORTUNITY

We're looking for a Senior Manager of Social Media who will own the shaping and execution of our UK social media strategy and lead social media managers across all European markets where Wellhub operates. As the most senior Social Media professional in Europe, you'll be the regional lead for the team and the primary social media partner for senior stakeholders.In this role, you'll partner closely with our Senior Director of Global Social Media to bring the UK strategy to life—creating platform-specific content, developing cultural relevance, supporting local influencer and ambassador programs, and elevating Wellhub's presence across key platforms like Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, YouTube, and emerging channels.You're someone who lives and breathes social. You understand UK culture deeply. You know how to move fast, test fearlessly, and capture moments in real time. You have a video-first mindset and love being behind—and occasionally in front of—the camera.You'll combine hands-on UK ownership with European team management, stakeholder leadership, and accountability for regional alignment and performance. Your creativity, agility, and understanding of UK social trends will shape how consumers, partners, and companies experience Wellhub.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Shape and Execute the UK Social Media Strategy.
  • Shape, localize, and operationalize Wellhub's social media strategy for the UK market.
  • Build regionally relevant content plans tailored for B2C, B2B, and B2P audiences.
  • Support Wellhub's GEO efforts through content strategy, partnering with relevant teams and European social media managers to align content priorities and strengthen brand authority and discoverability across the region.
  • Manage the editorial calendar for the UK and ensure seamless alignment with global priorities, launches, campaigns, and cultural moments.
  • Lead Social Media Managers Across Europe.
  • Manage, coach, and develop social media managers across all European markets where Wellhub operates, setting clear objectives, supporting professional growth, and enabling local ownership.
  • Set regional priorities with the Senior Director of Global Social Media, align local plans with global strategy, and establish regular planning and performance reviews.
  • Share insights and successful formats across countries, resolve competing priorities, and represent the European social team in global discussions.
  • Create High Impact Video First Content Concept, script, shoot, and edit content optimized for Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and LinkedIn.
  • Capture spontaneous, social-worthy moments at local events, content shoots, and partner activations.
  • Work with creative and production colleagues to bring fresh ideas to life.
  • Drive Cultural Relevance.
  • Identify UK cultural trends, memes, humor, and moments that Wellhub can authentically participate in.Adapt global narratives to fit the UK social landscape and audience expectations.
  • Monitor competitor activity and industry trends to keep Wellhub culturally and creatively ahead.
  • Lead Local Ambassador and Influencer Execution.
  • Support the development and execution of influencer and ambassador programs in the UK
  • Partner with creators and wellness influencers who authentically represent the Wellhub brand.
  • Manage briefings, content feedback, deliverables, and performance tracking.
  • Lead Stakeholder Relationships Across Europe
  • Act as the most senior Social Media representative in Europe and the primary partner for regional leadership, country leaders, and senior marketing, sales, people, PR, and partner stakeholders.
  • Build alignment on social strategy, priorities, and expectations across European markets.
  • Guide decisions, constructively challenge requests, and resolve escalations while protecting local relevance and global brand consistency.
  • Collaborate with UK marketing, sales, people, PR, and partner teams to amplify locally relevant moments.Work closely with the global creative team to align content quality, storytelling, sonic identity, and brand voice.
  • Support country leaders and internal spokespeople with social content, thought leadership, and engagement guidance. 
  • Own Measurement Optimisation and Insights.
  • Track and report on performance metrics across awareness, engagement, growth, and sentiment.Test new formats, creative variations, and posting strategies to continuously improve results.
  • Conduct social listening to understand audience behavior and guide content direction.
  • Review performance across European markets with local social managers and turn shared learnings into regional recommendations and improvements.
  • Community Engagement and Brand Advocacy
  • Oversee proactive community management across the UK channels—engaging in conversations, responding to comments, and cultivating brand advocates.
  • Ensure alignment with global crisis and response protocols.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You have 7+ years of experience in social media, content creation, or digital marketing—ideally in fast-moving B2C or lifestyle brands.
  • You're fluent in UK social culture, humor, trends, and how different audiences behave online.
  • You have excellent English writing and editorial skills.
  • You're a video-first creator who is comfortable planning, shooting, editing—and occasionally stepping in front of the camera.
  • You're obsessed with social platforms: their algorithms, nuances, and emerging formats.
  • You understand how to speak to diverse audiences—consumers, HR leaders, corporate buyers, wellness partners.
  • You're highly creative, but also organized and able to manage calendars, workflows, approvals, and reporting.
  • You have experience managing and developing social media teams across markets, with the judgement and autonomy to serve as the senior regional lead.
  • You can influence senior stakeholders, explain your recommendations, manage difficult conversations, and align regional priorities with local needs.
  • You excel in ambiguous, fast-paced environments and aren't afraid to test new ideas.
  • You're a collaborative team player who values feedback, teamwork, and cross-functional partnership.
  • You're proactive, curious, and passionate about wellbeing and digital storytelling.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. 

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

With thoughtful benefits, emotional wellbeing resources, and a culture that empowers you to take ownership of your role and your wellbeing, we create an environment where you can thrive in all dimensions of your life. Our benefits include:

WELLHUB:  Free Gold membership with access to onsite gyms and studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental wellbeing support, and more! Add up to three family members to your plan, ensuring access to wellness for those who matter most to you.

HEALTHCARE: Health and dental insurance. 

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE:  Flexibility for us isn’t just about where we work—it also means being able to shape how and when we get things done. Together with their leaders, employees define schedules that align with their time zones, team needs, and personal routines.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is to take time away from work to recharge. Employees receive a minimum of 25 days paid holiday per year with an additional day for each year of tenure (up to 5) in addition to annual holidays (including an extra holiday on your birthday!). 

PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life. Take the time to be present and enjoy your growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents. Parents giving birth are eligible for an extended leave and a ramp-back period to return part-time while they get settled.  

CAREER GROWTH: Access world-class platforms, participate in interactive sessions,  build your personalized development roadmap, and explore internal opportunities. We focus on continuous learning and feedback to support your journey toward personal and professional success. 

CULTURE: You’ll join a team of passionate people who come together to break boundaries, support each other, and create a meaningful impact in workplace wellness. We win together, building trust through open communication and a culture where every perspective matters. Learn more about our shared culture and values here. 

Want to see what it’s really like to work here? Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and watch our team video on YouTube!

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong. 

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Our commitment to inclusion also extends to how we recognize and reward our people. We’re proud to be Syndio Fair Pay Certified, reflecting our ongoing dedication to equitable and fair pay practices across our global team. Read more about it here.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test
descriptionHtml:
Cambridge, UK | Full-time or Part-time | Permanent (or Temporary) | Hybrid 

Salary: £64,000 to £76,000, DOE  

The salary range for this role is broad, as we are able to consider varying levels of experience.  Any offer made will carefully take into account level of experience (including relevant industry experience), transferable relevant skills and previous relevant achievements.

About us 

Riverlane’s mission is to master quantum error correction (QEC) and unlock a new age of human progress. From advances in material and climate science, to complex chemistry simulation for new drug design, quantum computers will help humanity solve some of its most important challenges. But without QEC, the industry’s defining technical challenge, such breakthroughs can never be achieved.  Riverlane is the world leader in QEC technology. QEC is a complex problem that requires a range of skills, talent and passion.  

Having raised more than $125M in funding to date to accelerate our cutting-edge R&D in quantum error correction (QEC), Riverlane partners with many of the world’s leading quantum hardware providers and government agencies to make fault-tolerant quantum computing a reality. We’re making remarkable progress and growing fast.  

About the role: 

We’re looking for a Software Development Engineer in Test, to join our Test Engineering team in Cambridge. You’ll test Riverlane’s QEC software from end to end, across Deltakit (our open-source Python SDK), our compiler and Deltaflow (our real-time quantum error correction system). 

This role suits a developer with some experience in quantum, who wants to move towards testing. You’ll write and maintain tests, and you’ll also think like a user: does this feature behave the way a customer would expect, and could it be easier to use? What you learn will feed directly into how we improve the product. 

What you will do (specific responsibilities) : 

  • Design, write and maintain Python tests (using pytest) across our QEC software stack, including Deltakit and the compiler front end 
  • Test features from the customer’s point of view, and check that your tests reflect how users will actually work with the product 
  • Spot where functionality could be clearer or easier to use, and propose improvements 
  • Share findings with engineering and product teams, and follow your suggestions through to changes in the product 
  • Work closely with developers to understand new features and plan how they should be tested 

What we need:

  • Knowledge of quantum computation and core concepts such as quantum circuits. One relevant project or piece of experience is enough (for example, building and running circuits with a framework such as Qiskit) 
  • Experience as a developer working on a product, either software or hardware, and an interest in moving towards test 
  • Strong Python skills. All the interfaces you’ll use day to day are in Python, from pytest to our compiler front end and Deltakit 
  • A user-focused mindset. You think about how functionality comes across to a customer and how it could be made easier to use 
  • A track record of suggesting improvements to a product or software library 

Even better if you have…

  • Knowledge of quantum error correction (QEC) 
  • Direct experience of testing software or hardware 

What can you expect from us 

  • A comprehensive benefits package that includes an annual bonus plan, private medical insurance, life insurance, and a contributory pension scheme  
  • Equity, so that our team can share in the long-term success of Riverlane  
  • 28 days annual leave, plus bank holidays and enhanced family leave  
  • A diverse work environment that brings together experts in many fields (including software and hardware development, quantum information theory, physics and maths) and over 20 different nationalities  
  • A learning environment that encourages individual, team and company growth and development, including a regular programme of learning events and training and conference budgets 

How to apply 

Please upload a CV and covering letter by clicking 'Apply'. Your covering letter should explain why you are applying for the job and what skills and experience you can bring to the role. 

We review CVs as we receive them and interview as soon as we have applications that look like a good match. We do not use closing dates. So, please apply as soon as possible to avoid missing out on this role. 

If you have any queries, please contact com. 

Everyone is welcome at Riverlane. We are an equal opportunities employer and encourage applications from eligible and suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, ethnicity, gender, gender reassignment, religion or belief, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, or pregnancy and maternity/paternity. 

Women and other underrepresented groups may be less likely to apply for a role unless they meet all or nearly all of the requirements.  If this applies to you, we still encourage you to apply - you may be a great fit, even if you don’t meet every single qualification. We’d love to hear from you. 

If you need any adjustments made to the application or selection process so you can do your best, please let us know. We will be happy to help. 

GDPR notice: Riverlane collects and processes personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. If you are a European Job Applicant see the privacy notice for further details.

title: Software Engineer - Gimbal
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

About the Role

We are seeking an Software Engineer (4+ years of experience) to join our multidisciplinary, high-caliber Gimbal team in Paris. In this role, you will take ownership of gimbal control and GNC (Guidance, Navigation, and Control) software running on custom hardware platforms and embedded Linux/microcontrollers. Working closely with Software, GNC, Mechanical, Hardware, and Test Bench/Industrialization teams, you will drive critical developments from initial concept to full realization, spending time both at the desk/lab and conducting field test evaluations every few weeks.

Responsibilities

  • Software & Firmware Development: Design, build, and optimize embedded software running on custom microcontrollers (MCU) and embedded Linux platforms where real-time execution is critical.

  • Gimbal & GNC Ownership: Take full ownership of gimbal control algorithms, master the GNC software framework, and lead ongoing initiatives for next-generation multi-axis systems and new sensor integrations.

  • Diagnostics & Performance Tooling: Develop PC software tools and diagnostic utilities to analyze telemetry logs, system friction, calibration, and motor/IMU communication.

  • Testing & Field Operations: Lead flight test preparations, participate in lab experiments (oscilloscopes, prototype boards), and perform post-flight telemetry analysis to validate system performance.

  • System Architecture & Rigor: Define and implement rigorous protocols and software architecture to ensure peak system integrity, performance, and seamless collaboration across engineering disciplines.

  • Mentorship: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members as senior initiatives expand.

Candidate Requirements

  • Educational Background: Strong academic foundation or proven, verifiable track record of delivering complex software for robotic/embedded systems.

  • Technical Expertise:

  • Solid experience in embedded software development (C/C++, MCU, embedded Linux) where real-time constraints and low-level debugging matter.

  • Strong grasp of core robotics concepts, linear algebra, and mathematics (e.g., quaternions, matrices, attitude, pose, reference/setpoint, estimation).

  • Familiarity with GNC (Guidance, Navigation, and Control) frameworks and robotic architectures (such as autopilots for drones, rovers, or autonomous vehicles).

  • Proven Accomplishments & Attributes:

  • Demonstrated ability to navigate, understand, and enhance large-scale robotic codebases.

  • Methodical, rigorous, and investigative approach to diagnostic resolution (calibration, friction, telemetry analysis).

  • Adaptability & Mobility: Thrives under pressure in a fast-paced environment; comfortable balancing desk coding with hands-on lab and field test activities.

  • Communication & Collaboration: Excellent written and verbal communication skills; capable of working effectively across cross-functional engineering teams (Hardware, Mechanics, GNC).

  • Commitment: 100% dedication to Harmattan AI's mission, vision, and ambitious growth plans, ready to go the extra mile to ensure operational excellence.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

title: Software Engineer JVM
descriptionHtml:
About Pelico

Traditional industrial manufacturing systems were built for predictability. Supply chains no longer are. Today, real-time data is buried in legacy tools that weren't designed for constant disruption. By the time an issue surfaces, it has already snowballed, sending everyone into firefighting mode. Pelico exists to close the gap between production plans and the daily reality on the factory floor.

We've built the manufacturing orchestration platform trusted by the world's most complex industrial operations : companies like Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Eaton, and Cartier. Our AI connects fragmented supply chain, production, and quality data into a single live operational picture — then puts AI agents to work anticipating disruptions, simulating recovery options, and keeping every team aligned before small problems become expensive ones.

Founded in 2019 and backed by General Catalyst, 83North, and Serena, we've raised $72M and are growing fast — 300% year-over-year revenue growth, deployed in 15+ countries, and supporting factories worldwide. We're headquartered in Paris, with offices in Miami, London and Amsterdam, and we're just getting started.

This is a rare chance to join a company that's redefining an industry that hasn't been disrupted in decades — from the inside.

About the Role

This role focuses on building performant, maintainable systems while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver impactful features that meet business and customer needs. You'll lead development of Pelico's ETL backend in Java, owning scalability and performance for the systems that turn complex, high-volume manufacturing data into a single live operational picture.

Your mission

  • Design, develop, and optimize Pelico's ETL backend components in Java, building scalable and efficient solutions for complex data processing

  • Architect scalable, modular services while ensuring data integrity, security, and availability across distributed environments

  • Integrate third-party services and APIs to extend platform capabilities, and collaborate with DevOps to optimize CI/CD pipelines and deployment strategies

  • Develop solutions for large-scale data ingestion, processing, and analysis, optimizing relational database interactions and distributed data systems

  • Mentor junior engineers through code reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions, leading by example on Java best practices

  • Write clean, maintainable, testable code and drive unit, integration, and performance testing to guarantee system stability

What we're looking for

  • Strong proficiency in Java or Kotlin (backend), with experience in relational databases and API development

  • Solid understanding of distributed systems concepts and performance optimization techniques

  • Strong grasp of software design principles (SOLID, separation of concerns, DRY) and design patterns, with the ability to write maintainable, testable code

  • Experience with automated testing and CI/CD, and the ability to define and document technical specifications, balancing feature development with technical debt

  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills, with the ability to design robust, scalable solutions and identify and mitigate risk

What we offer

descriptionHtml:
Software Engineer

Experience Level: +3 years commercial software engineering experience

About Investa

Investa is building the UK’s first zero-commission Options and Stocks trading platform. Legacy platforms typically feature high fees and complex interfaces that cut out the majority of retail investors. We are building a streamlined alternative to fix that. Investa is the first FCA-regulated platform to offer completely free US share trading with no FX, no commission, and no other fees.

Our Traction So Far:

  • £3.5M+ raised in funding with 1,000+ shareholders backing our vision

  • FCA-regulated and multi-award winning in 2026: Best Options Trading App (Good Money Guide) & Best App for Options Trading (ADVFN)

  • Available on iOS and Android, scaling rapidly toward our next milestones of 10,000 and 100,000 active users

  • 8,000+ trades processed, 2,500+ early supporters rewarded, and 150+ 5-star reviews

Our Mission: To democratise options trading for UK investors

Our Vision: Think Options, Think Investa

We are a lean, agile team where every employee directly shapes the business. We don't have a corporate way of working. Instead, we look for people who want high autonomy, care about making a visible impact, and align with our core values of being Collaborative, Curious, and Creative.

We are growing and looking for ambitious talent to help us democratise retail investing across the UK.

The Role

The Investa app was installed over 1,000 times within the first 24 hours of our priority access launch, and we’re now looking for a driven Software Engineer to join our founding engineering team as we scale.

Having passed the junior stage of your career, you bring over 3 years of commercial experience writing clean code and shipping features independently. In this role, you will take true end-to-end ownership of core platform features, work across our stack, and step outside your comfort zone to level up your technical depth alongside our talented engineering team of 4.

If you’re passionate about building best-in-class products to tackle complex financial challenges and you excel in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, we want to hear from you.

What the Role Involves

  • Founding Team Ownership: Designing, building, and maintaining robust, scalable services by joining our founding team of 4 engineers. Working directly with the founders without corporate red tape, , you won’t just pull tickets from a backlog - you will actually own your work end-to-end, see your code ship, and see its immediate impact on users.

  • Building the Engineering Culture: Joining our founding engineering team means you are actively building our engineering culture, not just stepping into one. You will have a direct voice in shaping how we collaborate day-to-day, how we learn from each other, and how we preserve a friendly, agile, and tight-knit environment as we grow.

  • Full-Stack Versatility & Growth: Hands-on Building: Writing high-quality, secure code for our FCA-regulated platform. You’ll navigate our stack to ship features that delight users. Driven by our fast-paced environment, you will have the opportunity to step outside your comfort zone and get hands-on with the wider technical stack, levelling up your skills significantly faster than in a traditional, highly specialised role.

  • System Design & Architectural Contribution: Partnering directly with the engineering team to tackle complex systems design and actively shape our evolving architecture. Your technical perspective will give you a strong voice in our high-level design choices. You will have true design ownership over the specific services and components you build, ensuring they remain robust, secure, and performant as we scale.

  • Technical Excellence: Maintaining a high bar for code quality, testing, and documentation. You’ll participate in (and contribute to) meaningful code reviews.

  • System Integrity: Monitoring and improving system reliability, ensuring our trading platform is always "always-on."

  • Production Support: Root-causing real-time production issues; we all take pride in the stability of what we ship

Your Background

  • Experience: +3 years of commercial software engineering experience, ideally with experience building or maintaining distributed systems or backend APIs.

  • Hands-on Coder: You are a strong practitioner who loves shipping clean, readable code and takes pride in seeing features go live.

  • Tech Stack Proficiency: Proficient in at least one modern language (e.g., Python, TypeScript, Java, Go) and comfortable working within cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

  • Pragmatic Mindset: You understand the balance between elegant code and delivering real value to users in a fast-moving startup environment.

  • Curious & First-Principles Thinker: You enjoy dissecting how systems work under the hood and are ready to quickly pick up domain concepts like options pricing, execution mechanics, and financial regulations.

On-call

All engineers at Investa participate in supporting our production applications. This involves responding to critical system events outside of working hours and ensuring our platform stays dependable.

What we offer:

Career Ownership & Impact: While we provide clear levels to grow into, you also have autonomy over your execution and your career trajectory. Your work impacts the business immediately without corporate red tape. You can choose whether you want to pave a path as a high-level individual contributor or step into management as we scale - you shape your career.

Collaboration & Proximity: You’ll work directly alongside our Co-Founders, Alec and Ross, and our founding engineers to co-author both the product roadmap and our engineering architecture. Because of our size, our culture is extremely personal. Everyone has firsthand insight into top-level strategy, cross-departmental exposure, and a direct voice in how we solve deep technical issues as we scale.

Creativity & Speed: We prioritise innovation through speed, agility, thinking outside the box, and resource-efficient solutions.

Shared Success & Equity: We are in this together. To ensure everyone benefits from our growth, every employee receives meaningful company EMI equity. Our success is your success.

The Package and Perks: Competitive base salaries, private medical insurance, team socials chosen by you, milestone celebrations, and hybrid flexibility.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Equity: Initial grant of 0.1% - 0.2% in stock options. We reward impact with additional performance-based grants and milestone-linked top-ups.

title: Softwarearchitekt – HMI / Automatisierungstechnik (w/m/d)
descriptionHtml:
Du willst nicht einfach irgendeine Code‑Rolle übernehmen. Du willst die technische Gesamtarchitektur von industriellen Bedienoberflächen bestimmen.

Hier geht es nicht um reine UI‑Entwicklung. Hier geht es um Security‑by‑Design nach IEC 62443, Skalierbarkeit und die Integration in komplexe Anlagen.

5 Jahre HMI‑Erfahrung, 2 Jahre in einer architekturverantwortlichen Position und gelegentliche Kundenreisen sind für dich Normalität.

Unser Kunde

Der Kunde ist ein mittelständisches Unternehmen im Bereich Automatisierungstechnik und Maschinenbau, das weltweit industrielle Anlagen und Steuerungssysteme liefert. Mit mehreren Standorten in der Schweiz und Europa entwickelt das Unternehmen integrierte Softwarelösungen, darunter eine einheitliche HMI‑Plattform für seine Produkte. Es positioniert sich als Innovationsführer im Bereich industrieller Bedienoberflächen.

Warum diese Rolle spannend ist

  • Technische Führungsrolle mit direktem Einfluss auf die Produktarchitektur
  • Arbeit mit Qt, QML, WinCC Unified und Web‑HMI‑Technologien
  • Verantwortung für Security nach IEC 62443 (Benutzerverwaltung, Verschlüsselung)
  • Vielfältige Industrieprojekte von Maschinen‑ bis Anlagenbau
  • Gelegentliche Kundenreisen zur Inbetriebnahme und Feldunterstützung
  • Gestaltung einer einheitlichen, wiederverwendbaren HMI‑Plattform

Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwurf, Dokumentation und Weiterentwicklung der HMI‑Softwarearchitektur (Schichten, Module, Schnittstellen)
  • Auswahl und Bewertung von HMI‑Frameworks und Tools (Qt/QML, WinCC Unified, TIA Portal, Web‑HMI)
  • Definition von Architekturprinzipien, Design‑Patterns (z. B. MVVM) und Coding‑Guidelines
  • Aufbau wiederverwendbarer Komponentenbibliotheken und Bedienbausteine
  • Konzeption der Anbindung an Steuerungen über OPC UA, Profinet, Modbus oder MQTT
  • Umsetzung von Security‑by‑Design, Rollen‑ und Rechtekonzepten nach IEC 62443
  • Fachliche Anleitung und Coaching des HMI‑Entwicklungsteams
  • Mitgestaltung von CI/CD‑Pipelines, Versionsverwaltung und Release‑Prozessen

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der HMI‑ oder Embedded‑Softwareentwicklung
  • Davon mindestens 2 Jahre in einer architekturverantwortlichen oder leitenden technischen Rolle
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit C++ (modern), Qt, QML, WinCC Unified und TypeScript/JavaScript
  • Sicherer Umgang mit OPC UA, MQTT, Profinet und feldbasierten Kommunikationsprotokollen
  • Kenntnisse in Security‑Standards IEC 62443 und Erfahrung in deren Umsetzung
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch‑ und Englischkenntnisse (C2)

Was hier nicht funktioniert

  • Job‑Hopper – häufige Wechsel sind ein Dealbreaker
  • Nur Front‑End‑Entwickler ohne Embedded‑Erfahrung – fehlt das Systemverständnis
  • Kein Interesse an Security – du vernachlässigst IEC 62443‑Anforderungen
  • Unflexibel – keine Bereitschaft zu gelegentlichen Kundenreisen
  • Mangelnde Kommunikationsfähigkeit – du kannst technische Konzepte nicht verständlich vermitteln

Deine Benefits

Was diese Rolle besonders macht

  • Du bestimmst die technische Zukunft der HMI‑Plattform eines Innovationsführers
  • Du kombinierst tiefes Fachwissen mit strategischer Gestaltungskraft
  • Du arbeitest in einem internationalen Umfeld mit Projekten von Bern bis in die ganze Schweiz

Viel Verantwortung, viel Gestaltung, wenig Ausreden. Für manche ein Albtraum. Für die Richtigen: genau das, was sie suchen.

Bereit?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt als Softwarearchitekt – HMI / Automatisierungstechnik (w/m/d).

Egal ob dein Titel Lead HMI Engineer, HMI Architect, Embedded UI Architect, Senior HMI Developer heißt: Entscheidend ist nicht der Titel. Entscheidend ist, ob du mindestens fünf Jahre HMI‑Erfahrung mitbringst und Sicherheit nach IEC 62443 in der Praxis umsetzen kannst.

title: Softwaretester / QA Engineer als Scrum Master (m/w/d)
descriptionHtml:
Mach aus guten Ideen Software, die im Alltag überzeugt

Du probierst neue Funktionen aus und merkst schnell, wenn etwas nicht rundläuft? Du willst Fehler verstehen, Lösungen mitgestalten und gemeinsam mit einem kleinen Team ein Produkt besser machen? Dann könnte das deine Rolle bei AUGLETICS sein.

Wir entwickeln und produzieren smarte Rudergeräte in Königs Wusterhausen bei Berlin. Bei uns siehst du direkt, wie deine Arbeit das Training unserer Kunden verbessert: Du testest am echten Gerät, arbeitest eng mit der Entwicklung zusammen und begleitest neue Funktionen bis zum Release.

Du ergänzt unser Softwareteam mit vier bis fünf Personen und arbeitest direkt mit unserem CTO Christopher Klabunde. Dein Schwerpunkt ist Softwarequalität. Dazu übernimmst du technische Projektkoordination: Du bringst Ordnung in offene Aufgaben, klärst Anforderungen und hilfst dem Team, Ideen zuverlässig umzusetzen. In diese Verantwortung kannst du hineinwachsen.

Das machst du bei uns

  • App und Gerät gründlich testen: Du prüfst neue Funktionen, typische Trainingsabläufe und Grenzfälle und gibst konkretes Feedback zu Funktion und Bedienbarkeit.

  • Tests aufbauen und verbessern: Du entwickelst Testfälle, Checklisten und wiederholbare Regressionstests. Schritt für Schritt baust du Testautomatisierung auf – immer dort, wo sie dem Produkt und dem Team hilft.

  • Fehler bis zur Lösung verfolgen: Du beschreibst reproduzierbare Schritte, grenzt Ursachen gemeinsam mit der Entwicklung ein und prüfst, ob eine Korrektur auch im Zusammenspiel mit anderen Funktionen funktioniert.

  • Projekte ins Ziel bringen: Du strukturierst Aufgaben, formulierst klare Abnahmekriterien, koordinierst Abhängigkeiten und machst Fortschritt und offene Fragen sichtbar.

  • Zusammenarbeit erleichtern: Du moderierst agile Abstimmungen, etwa aus Scrum oder Kanban, und hilfst, Hindernisse zu beseitigen. Gemeinsam mit Chris und dem Team entwickelst du Abläufe weiter, die zu uns passen.

  • KI praktisch nutzen: Du setzt KI-gestützte Werkzeuge für Testideen, Fehleranalyse, kleine Hilfsprogramme und Automatisierung ein und überprüfst die Ergebnisse sorgfältig.

Deine Rolle als Scrum Master

Du verbindest deine technische Arbeit mit der Verantwortung dafür, dass unsere Projekte gemeinsam vorankommen. Als Scrum Master koordinierst du die Zusammenarbeit im Softwareteam und mit externen Entwicklungsagenturen. Du arbeitest eng mit CTO Christopher Klabunde zusammen; disziplinarische Personalführung gehört nicht zur Rolle.

  • Du bringst interne Entwicklung und externe Partner in eine gemeinsame Planung und sorgst für klare Zuständigkeiten, nächste Schritte und nachvollziehbare Abnahmekriterien.

  • Du bereitest agile Abstimmungen vor und moderierst sie, zum Beispiel Sprint Planning, kurze tägliche Abstimmungen, Reviews und Retrospektiven – passend zu unseren Projekten.

  • Du behältst Abhängigkeiten, Termine und offene Entscheidungen im Blick, sprichst Hindernisse früh an und hilfst dem Team, sie zu lösen.

  • Du sorgst dafür, dass Ergebnisse zusammengeführt, gemeinsam getestet und für einen verlässlichen Release vorbereitet werden.

Wenn du bereits Scrum-Master- oder Projektkoordinationserfahrung hast, kannst du sie direkt einbringen. Wenn du neu in der Rolle bist, wachsen wir mit dir hinein: Chris und das Team unterstützen dich dabei. Eine Scrum-Master-Zertifizierung ist ein Plus, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Das bringst du mit

  • Interesse an Softwaretests, Qualitätssicherung und technischen Projekten. Erste Erfahrung ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung – auch ein eigener Lernweg oder die Motivation, dich neu in das Thema einzuarbeiten, interessieren uns.

  • Freude daran, genau hinzuschauen und Probleme systematisch zu lösen. Du kannst verständlich erklären, was nicht funktioniert und wie es sich nachstellen lässt.

  • Technisches Verständnis für das Zusammenspiel von App, Gerät und Backend sowie Lust, dich tiefer einzuarbeiten.

  • Eigeninitiative und eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise. Du fragst nach, hältst offene Punkte nach und übernimmst Verantwortung für Ergebnisse.

  • Offenheit für KI-unterstützte Entwicklung und Tests. Wenn du damit schon selbst experimentiert hast, zeig uns gern ein Beispiel.

  • Gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift ist erforderlich, um technische Themen im Team sicher zu besprechen und zu dokumentieren. Deutschkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

  • Bereitschaft, regelmäßig vor Ort in Königs Wusterhausen zu arbeiten: Viele Tests finden direkt am Rudergerät statt.

Ein Studium der Informatik oder einer verwandten Fachrichtung, eine passende Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Kenntnisse sind eine gute Grundlage.

Mit Erfahrung oder am Anfang: Wir wollen dich kennenlernen

Du hast schon mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in diesem Bereich? Super – bring deine Ideen und deinen Blick von außen ein. Du stehst noch am Anfang oder hast bisher keine Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich? Auch das ist in Ordnung. Wenn du für unser Produkt brennst, technische Grundlagen mitbringst und dich schnell in neue Themen einarbeitest, möchten wir dich kennenlernen.

In beiden Fällen ist es unsere Aufgabe, dich gut ins Team zu integrieren und dir Wissen, Werkzeuge und Unterstützung für einen erfolgreichen Start bereitzustellen. Gemeinsam mit Chris und dem Team lernst du unser Produkt und unsere Abläufe kennen. Aufgaben und Verantwortung stimmen wir auf deinen Erfahrungsstand ab und entwickeln sie mit dir weiter.

Zusätzliche Pluspunkte

  • Erfahrung mit Android-Entwicklung, zum Beispiel mit Kotlin oder Java.

  • Erfahrung mit Firebase als Backend für Apps und dem Zusammenspiel von App, Benutzerkonten und gespeicherten Daten.

  • Erfahrung in der iOS-Entwicklung, idealerweise mit Swift oder SwiftUI.

  • Erste Kenntnisse in Testautomatisierung, Git, CI/CD oder agiler Projektarbeit. Eine Scrum-Master-Zertifizierung ist nicht erforderlich.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Ein eigenes Produkt, das du anfassen und ausprobieren kannst, und viele Ideen, die wir gemeinsam in hoher Qualität umsetzen wollen.

  • Ein Team von rund 25 Mitarbeitenden, kurze Entscheidungswege und direkte Zusammenarbeit mit CTO Christopher Klabunde.

  • Raum, fachlich zu wachsen und zunehmend Verantwortung für Qualität, Tests und Projektabläufe zu übernehmen.

  • Unbefristete Vollzeitstelle mit 40 Stunden pro Woche und 28 Urlaubstagen im Jahr.

  • 50.000 bis 65.000 € brutto pro Jahr, abhängig von deinen relevanten Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen.

  • Arbeitsplatz Zur Heide 10 in Königs Wusterhausen bei Berlin. Ein bis zwei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche sind nach Absprache möglich.

Dein Arbeitsplatz bei Berlin

Unser Standort ist Zur Heide 10 in Königs Wusterhausen. Der Bahnhof Königs Wusterhausen ist mit der S-Bahn S46 und Regionalzügen direkt an Berlin angebunden. Die Strecke vom Bahnhof zu uns lässt sich mit dem Fahrrad zurücklegen. Vor Ort entwickelst und testest du direkt am Produkt; ein bis zwei Tage Homeoffice pro Woche sind nach Absprache möglich.

Einfach bewerben

Schick uns deinen Lebenslauf auf Deutsch oder Englisch. Ein klassisches Anschreiben brauchst du nicht. Ein Beispielprojekt oder ein Testkonzept ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung.

Zum Einstieg lernen wir uns in einem kurzen Onlinegespräch kennen. Danach schauen wir gemeinsam auf deine bisherigen Erfahrungen, deinen Lernweg und die Aufgaben bei AUGLETICS.

English-speaking applicants are welcome. English is required; German is a strong plus. The role focuses on hands-on software testing and quality assurance, with growing responsibility for project coordination. Based in Königs Wusterhausen near Berlin, with one to two home-office days per week by agreement.

descriptionHtml:

title: Solution Engineer - Vehicle OS
descriptionHtml:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the role

We are looking for a bright engineer to help our customers solve complex technical problems across Applied Intuition’s Vehicle OS portfolio. In this role you will work closely with vehicle software and tooling teams at OEMs and Tier 1s to ensure Applied’s solutions deliver maximum impact in advancing customers’ Software-Defined-Vehicle (SDV) strategies and in-cabin user experiences.

Vehicle OS is Applied Intuition’s software platform for SDV. It enables OEMs to modernize their E/E architecture through three interconnected areas:

  • Middleware & architecture Service-oriented, middleware-driven software stacks built on AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform, SOME/IP, and DDS. Helps OEMs migrate from distributed ECU architectures to zonal, centralized compute.

  • Developer toolchain A code-first toolchain that replaces GUI-bound configuration workflows. Engineers model vehicle behavior in Python, manage changes through pull requests, and validate in virtual ECU environments analogous to what cloud virtual engineering workbenches (e.g., AWS VEW) brought to cloud-native development, but purpose-built for automotive E/E systems.

  • IVI & in-vehicle infotainment Android Automotive OS (AAOS) based platform, HMI/cluster software, and intelligent in-cabin experiences including Cabin Intelligence (DMS, OMS, voice, occupant interaction).

This role sits at the intersection of all three areas, and the balance will depend on the customer mix.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

  • Act as the technical bridge between automotive customers and Applied Intuition’s engineering and product teams

  • Support OEMs in adopting Vehicle OS: middleware stack, developer SDK, and IVI/infotainment integration

  • Lead technical discussions, architecture reviews, demos, and early-stage deployments with OEM and Tier 1 engineering teams

  • Help customers adopt Applied’s code-first developer toolchain, onboarding engineering teams onto the SDK, setting up virtual ECU environments, and integrating with customers’ existing CI/CD pipelines

  • Guide OEMs through the design and implementation of service-oriented vehicle architectures and support system integration across ECUs, domain controllers and high-performance compute

  • Work with customers’ IVI and infotainment teams on AAOS integration, Linux-based IVI stack deployment, HMI/cluster software, and Cabin Intelligence features (driver monitoring, occupant monitoring, voice/AI interaction)

  • Collaborate with customers and internal product teams to triage and resolve technical issues

  • Manage project milestones and communicate progress across multiple customer and internal stakeholders

We're looking for someone who has:

  • 3+ years of experience working with automotive OEMs or suppliers, ideally in SDV, E/E architecture, developer tooling, or in-vehicle infotainment/IVI

  • Experience with AUTOSAR (Classic or Adaptive) and automotive developer tooling

  • Familiarity with vehicle communication protocols: SOME/IP, DDS, CAN, LIN, or automotive Ethernet

  • Experience with at least one of the following:

    • Vehicle software developer toolchain: SDK-based development, virtual ECUs, SIL environments, or CI/CD pipelines for automotive software

    • IVI / infotainment platforms: Android Automotive OS (AAOS), Linux-based IVI, HMI/cluster software, or display middleware

  • Execution-driven mindset with strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple customer engagements in parallel

  • Experience working directly with customers on complex problems at the intersection of software and vehicle systems

  • Degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field

  • Basic / intermediate programming experience in C/C++, Python, or similar

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; German and/or additional European language is a significant plus

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with Applied Intuition’s Vehicle OS or a comparable SDV platform

  • Knowledge of zonal E/E architectures, HPC platforms, or software-defined networking in vehicles

  • Experience with OTA systems and vehicle software lifecycle management

  • Familiarity with ISO 26262 functional safety or SOTIF in the context of IVI or ADAS systems

  • Experience with Cabin Intelligence technologies: driver monitoring (DMS), occupant monitoring (OMS), or in-cabin perception and AI

  • Exposure to perception systems or AI/ML pipelines applied to in-vehicle experiences

  • Experience with simulation environments or digital twin platforms to validate vehicle software

  • Project management experience in cross-functional, customer-facing programs

Benefits:

  • 30 days of paid vacation per year

  • Daily meal benefits: €19 lunch budget and €19 dinner budget, free breakfast, snacks, and drinks in the office

  • You’ll receive €965 annual learning & development and €580 annual fitness budget

  • Subsidized Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms, studios, and wellness facilities across Germany

  • €25 monthly contribution to your Deutschlandticket for regional public transport across Germany

  • Generous parental leave: on top of statutory parental leave

title: Special Projects
descriptionHtml:
Special Projects

London (Shoreditch) | In person | Full time

About Seamflow

We're removing one of the last great barriers to progress in the physical world. While software moves fast, industries like healthcare, aerospace, and energy are still slowed by outdated, manual systems.

Our vision is to unlock enormous value for Testing, Inspection, and Certification companies globally. The market is vast, the problem is real, and we're just getting started.

We're rapidly growing following our 14x oversubscribed seed round backed by Tier 1 investors including Northzone and Initialized Capital. These funds backed the founders of Coinbase, Reddit, Klarna, and Spotify.

We're growing very fast; demand is outstripping our supply, and we're building fast to keep up.

The Team

Our team includes AI researchers from world-leading academic institutions like Johns Hopkins, MIPT, Oxford, Cambridge and UCL, former founding engineers at unicorn startups, and alumni of X, Google, Amazon, and Yandex, alongside former leaders from McKinsey, BCG and Bain. We look for people who move fast, think clearly, and hold themselves to a high bar. The standard here is very high, and we're looking for someone who raises it further.

The Role

Special Projects sits directly alongside the CEO and Chief of Staff and takes on whatever the company needs most at that moment. There is no fixed remit and there is no playbook.

One month that means preparing the material and the numbers behind a fundraise. The next it's working through legal, regulatory, and market access questions in a country we're entering, or holding an entire function open on your own until we've hired someone permanent into it. Whatever is broken, missing, or unowned lands here first.

Be clear eyed about what this is. It is demanding, and a lot of it is unglamorous. Some of it is detail work that simply has to be right, with nobody available to check it behind you. What we need is a workhorse who is obsessive about detail, who closes things out rather than hands them back, and whose work nobody ever has to second guess. If that reads as a description of you rather than a warning, this is the highest leverage seat in the company for someone early in their career. You will be in the room for decisions most people see five years later.

What We're Looking For

1–3 years in an environment with a high bar and short feedback loops: investment banking, strategy consulting, a fast growing startup, or something equally demanding we haven't thought of.

An exceptional track record: We care that you were at the top of whatever room you were in, academically and professionally.

AI-native: You already run your work through AI and operate at 10x as a result. You reach for these tools by default, not as a novelty, and you're constantly finding new ways to compress what used to take days into hours.

Structured thinking: You break messy, ambiguous problems into parts, work out what actually matters, and sequence it. You can explain your reasoning on a whiteboard in two minutes.

Ruthless organisation: Multiple workstreams, nothing dropped, nothing chased twice, everything written down.

Strong with Excel, slides, and written communication: Most of our work travels as documents and models read by executives at large regulated businesses.

Bias to action: You'd rather ship a good plan today than a perfect one next week.

Work nobody has to check: You close the loop, catch your own mistakes, and flag the things you couldn't resolve rather than leaving them to be discovered.

Low ego, high agency: The work ranges from a board memo to cleaning a customer data set at 9pm. Neither is beneath you, and you'll take on the boring half as readily as the interesting half.

Someone who wants to be in the room, not on a call. This role is in-person, full time at our Shoreditch office.

Nice to have: European languages, particularly German or French.

What You'll Get

A huge amount of responsibility and trust from day one, and direct exposure to every decision that shapes the company

A front row seat to enterprise sales, product, fundraising, and operations, and a real say in all of them

A clear path into an operating or commercial leadership role as we scale or insight into how to start your own tech company some day

A team that moves fast, works hard, and backs each other fully

Lunch and dinner covered, 24/7 gym access

Comment vas-tu contribuer au projet ?

En tant que membre de l'équipe Support applicatif et technique comptable, tu es le point de relais central entre nos clients Dirigeants, leurs Comptables internalisés et les Cabinets Comptable. Tu es en contact quotidien avec les utilisateurs et tu cherches à comprendre les problèmes qu'ils rencontrent.

Quelles seront tes missions au quotidien ?

- Tu apprends tout ce qu'il faut savoir sur notre entreprise, notre vision, et nos différents départements.

- Tu apprends à identifier toutes les parties prenantes et à collaborer efficacement au sein de ton équipe, ainsi qu'avec les différents départements.

- Tu commences à répondre à des demandes liées à la comptabilité : tu réceptionnes les demandes, les qualifies en t’appuyant sur une compréhension approfondie des principes comptables et apportes des réponses rapides et impactantes.

- Tu deviens un expert produit et fais gagner en efficacité ton équipe en identifiant les axes d'amélioration.

- Tu prends le contrôle et mène au succès des projets qui te tiennent à cœur et qui te font progresser.

Compétences requises

- De formation comptable (BTS CGO, DCG, BTS assistant de gestion PME-PMI, Master CCA ou Bachelor Responsable admin et comptable).

- Expérience d'au moins 3 ans en cabinet comptable (idéalement avoir fait au moins trois périodes fiscales).

- Un travail en direct avec le dirigeant est un plus (conseil interne par exemple).

- Appétence pour les outils de travail innovants et les nouvelles technologies.

- Autonomie, capacité à résoudre des problèmes seul(e) et à trouver des solutions.

- Une connaissance de l'outil Pennylane est un plus.

- Avoir un niveau professionnel en anglais.

- Aisance rédactionnelle et pédagogue pour interagir avec les utilisateurs de manière claire et professionnelle.

- Capacité à comprendre et à répondre aux besoins des clients, à offrir un excellent service et à maintenir de bonnes relations avec les clients.

- Aptitude à travailler de manière autonome et en équipe.

- Flexibilité pour s’adapter aux évolutions rapides de l’outil.

- Volonté d’apprendre et de rester à jour sur les évolutions du produit.

🤝 Process de recrutement

● Une première rencontre avec notre Talent Acquisition Manager (30 min)

● Un second entretien et un case study en direct avec un(e) Associate Team Lead (1h)

● Un entretien final avec un(e) Team Lead (45 min)

💵 Une enveloppe de BSPCE

🏃‍♀️ Un accès à 8000 salles de sport partout en France et plus de 300 activités de bien-être via notre partenaire Gymlib

💻 Un Mac

🎉 Nous pratiquons de nombreux sports ensemble et avons à cœur de nous réunir régulièrement autour d’événements d’entreprise tels que les Tech Days (qui permettent aux Pennylaners en remote de se réunir tous les 3 mois) ou notre séminaire d’entreprise qui a lieu une fois par an, et qui favorise de grands moments de cohésion pour toutes et tous.

-Parler anglais (le niveau est évalué et apprécié en fonction du département auquel tu postules)

-Apprécier travailler dans un environnement en changement constant

-Faire de la collaboration une priorité au sein de son équipe ou avec d'autres parties prenantes

-Avoir un recul suffisant pour prioriser les actions à fort impact business dans son activité quotidienne.

Nous savons que certaines personnes sont moins susceptibles de postuler que d'autres si elles estiment ne pas remplir l'intégralité des critères.

Si tu hésites, nous t'encourageons à postuler quand même : qui sait, cela pourrait être le début d'une collaboration significative et durable !

Les tentatives d’arnaque au recrutement sont en hausse. Nous vous invitons à rester vigilant(e) lors de vos échanges.

Candidature uniquement via nos canaux officiels : postulez exclusivement via nos offres publiées sur nos supports officiels (site carrière, pages officielles partenaires).

Vérifiez systématiquement l’adresse e-mail de l’expéditeur : nos communications sont envoyées depuis des adresses professionnelles avec les domaine @pennylane.com ou ----- .

Nous ne vous demanderons jamais de paiement, ni d’informations financières (coordonnées bancaires, paiement pour un entretien, achat de matériel, etc.) dans le cadre du recrutement.

Si une telle demande vous est faite, il s’agit d’une fraude. Nous vous invitons à ne pas répondre et à nous le signaler immédiatement."

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. title: Spezialist in der Qualifizierung und Softwarevalidierung (Mensch)
descriptionHtml:
💡 Du denkst in Prozessen, hast ein Auge fürs Detail und liebst es, wenn alles nach Plan läuft? Dann bist du hier genau richtig! Unser Kunde, ein pharmazeutisches Unternehmen mit höchsten Qualitätsansprüchen, sucht einen Spezialisten in der Qualifizierung / Softwarevalidierung (Mensch), der mit technischem Know-how und GMP-Expertise Anlagen und Prozesse auf ein neues Level hebt.

⚙️ Deine Mission

  • Du stellst sicher, dass Bestandsanlagen in der pharmazeutischen Produktion (z. B. Abfüllanlagen, Reinmedienanlagen, Autoklaven) den GMP-Vorgaben entsprechen.

  • Du erstellst und pflegst wiederkehrende Bewertungen, jährliche Requalifizierungen und Audit-Trail-Reviews.

  • Du übernimmst die Planung, Durchführung und Dokumentation von Qualifizierungen und Requalifizierungen.

  • Du entwickelst URS (User Requirement Specifications) und führst Risikoanalysen gemäß GMP-Richtlinien durch.

  • Du schreibst und aktualisierst SOPs zur Bedienung und Reinigung von Anlagen.

  • Du begleitest Audits, erstellst Abweichungsberichte, Change-Control-Anträge und CAPAs.

  • Du treibst die Optimierung der GMP-Compliance voran und unterstützt bei Behörden-Audits.


🏆 Das bringst du mit

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium als Pharmaingenieur oder Chemieingenieur – oder eine technische Ausbildung mit entsprechender Weiterbildung (z. B. Pharmakant, Chemikant mit Techniker-Fortbildung).

  • Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen Produktion und solide Kenntnisse in GMP-Compliance & Qualifizierungssystemen.

  • Erfahrung in der Computersoftwarevalidierung.

  • Expertise in Audit-Trail-Reviews, URS-Erstellung und Risikoanalysen (z. B. FMEA).

  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS-Office sowie sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Eigeninitiative, eine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Verantwortungsbewusstsein.

  • Technisches Verständnis mit einer pragmatischen, lösungsorientierten Herangehensweise.

  • Eine kommunikative, teamorientierte und belastbare Persönlichkeit.

Das erwartet dich

✅ Freundliche Kollegen & kleine Teams – Hier zählt der Mensch!
✅ Gute Work-Life-Balance – Homeoffice teilweise möglich.
✅ Attraktive Vergütung plus betriebliche Altersvorsorge & Krankenzusatzversicherung.
✅ Flache Hierarchien & viel Gestaltungsspielraum – Deine Ideen sind gefragt!
✅ Top-Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten & moderne Arbeitsplätze.
✅ Zusätzliche Benefits wie kostenloser Kaffee & Wasser, Verpflegungszuschuss, Corporate Benefits & Parkmöglichkeiten vor Ort.

🚀 Bereit für eine spannende Herausforderung? Dann bewirb dich jetzt – wir freuen uns auf dich!

title: Sr. Compliance Associate - Market Surveillance
descriptionHtml:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken's Market Surveillance function is responsible for detecting, investigating and reporting market abuse across our regulated trading venues, spanning spot crypto markets, crypto futures, tokenised equities, OTC markets and consumer trading. As our licensing footprint and product range grow, so does the scale and complexity of the surveillance programme behind them.

We are hiring several Senior Compliance Associates to carry out day to day surveillance across our markets, investigate what that surveillance uncovers, and help us build the programme out as the business grows.

 

The opportunity

  • Review and disposition surveillance alerts across our regulated markets, and record the reasoning behind each decision clearly enough that someone else can follow it.

  • Carry out analytical reviews that begin with trade and order data rather than with a system-generated alert.

  • Experience reviewing and dispositioning surveillance alerts, and writing up what you found to a standard others can rely on.

  • Clear, evidence-first written communication. Your case files and escalations will sometimes be read by auditors and regulators without you in the room to explain them.

  • Comfort using generative AI and other automation tools to improve the speed and quality of investigative work, while maintaining the oversight that regulated casework requires.

  • Based in the UK, Ireland, Cyprus, Malta, Romania or Canada, with fluency in English.

title: Staff AI Engineer — Agent Platform (all genders)
descriptionHtml:
wingmaite captures the knowledge companies never write down: who decides what, how work actually gets done, and why decisions were made. Our AI agents use that knowledge to answer questions and get work done.

We're looking for a Staff engineer to own the technical quality and direction of our agent platform. You'll build features end to end, from the agent into the backend. You won't manage people. You'll work closely with our CTO as a technical sparring partner.

What You'll Do

  • Design the agents: Decide how our agents plan, use tools and handle multi-step work, and where people need to step in. Build reusable components so each new use case doesn't need its own system.

  • Connect agents to company knowledge: Build how that knowledge reaches the agents, together with the people who decide what it should contain.

  • Make answers reliable: Agents should be correct, cite their sources, show people only what they're allowed to see, and know when not to act.

  • Track quality: Build evals, monitor quality and cost, and keep our model choices up to date.

  • Ship end to end: Build features from the agent through to the backend yourself.

  • Keep the architecture consistent: Set the patterns others build on, document decisions, keep specs current, and review designs with engineering, product and design.

How We Work

We build features as one team: design, product, engineering and AI together, from the first idea to production. You'll help shape a feature while it's still a problem and stay with it until it works for users. Agents depend on the knowledge behind them, so we build both as one system. We write decisions down and discuss disagreements openly.

What This Role Is Not

A management role, a prompt-engineering role, or an infrastructure or security role.

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

  • You've shipped multi-step, tool-using LLM agents to production (LangGraph or similar)

  • You know when sub-agents help, how to build good evals, and why retrieval fails

  • Fluent in Python and productive in TypeScript/Node (NestJS is a plus)

  • PostgreSQL and data modeling

  • You use AI coding tools such as Claude Code every day

  • You write clear specs and can explain trade-offs to people who aren't engineers

  • Fluent English (C1–C2)

Nice-to-Haves

None of these are required, but they'll help you get up to speed faster:

  • You've connected agents to tools and data through MCP

  • You've worked with knowledge graphs or other ways of modeling how people, work and information relate

  • You've run models in production on AWS Bedrock or Vertex AI

  • You've traced and debugged agents with LLM observability tools such as Langfuse

  • You speak German

Who You Are

  • You've set technical direction beyond your own work, and others build on your patterns

  • You start from what users need and what could go wrong, then choose the tools

  • You care whether the system still makes sense in a year

  • You're happy to do backend work when a feature needs it

  • You want influence through your work, not through a title

  • You like working with designers and product people

  • You enjoy technical debate and change your mind when the other argument is better

What We Offer

  • Flexible remote setup

  • Learning & development opportunities

  • Generous vacation & workation budget

  • Technical ownership of the platform at the core of wingmaite's product

How to Apply

Upload your CV through join and fill in the questionnaire so we can consider your application for the role! Optional: a link to agent or eval work you're proud of.

title: Staff Data Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We Are Sparta

Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders.

Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has.

We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market.

At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done.

Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies.

Staff Data Engineer

At Sparta, we're on a mission to build the next generation of commodity trading platforms - replacing the fragmented tools traders depend on with a single, powerful dashboard. Our product is a data-driven platform that aggregates real-time feeds from across the commodities domain, transforming them into intuitive, actionable visualisations within one unified interface. Users can explore pre-built data views or build their own custom formulas - turning raw market data into decisions.

At the heart of Sparta is a serious data engineering challenge. We're building a platform that enables the rapid development of reliable, scalable ETL pipelines - the foundation everything else depends on. As our data volumes grow and our product ambitions expand, the demands on that infrastructure grow with them. We're looking for experienced data engineers who are familiar with these challenges at scale — people who understand what it takes to keep a data platform performing as complexity increases.

We want people who thrive with ownership. At Sparta, you'll be handed problems, not solutions - and we expect you to run with them. Speed matters, autonomy is real, and we'd rather you move fast and course-correct than wait for permission. As a Staff engineer, you'll also be shaping the direction of the platform itself: engaging directly with stakeholders, contributing to product thinking, and investing meaningfully in the engineers around you.

This role can be based in the UK (London) or Spain (Barcelona, Madrid), and we would expect to spend some time together with the team in-office (2 -3 days a week).

Core Responsibilities

  • Play a leading role in the design, build, and ongoing evolution of scalable data pipelines and ETL frameworks that power both real-time and analytical data processing.

  • Take shared ownership of the health and performance of our data platform - optimising for latency, throughput, and reliability at scale.

  • Collaborate closely with engineering and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure data infrastructure aligns with product goals and trader-facing outcomes - acting as the connective tissue between data and backend engineering.

  • Drive architectural decisions across our data platform, with a focus on pipeline reliability, data quality, and scalability.

  • Contribute to the definition of our target architecture - shaping how we ingest, transform, store, and serve data as the platform evolves.

  • Mentor and support other engineers through design reviews, technical discussions, and hands-on knowledge sharing.

Skills & Experience

  • 7+ years of experience as a data or software engineer, with a strong track record of delivering production-quality data systems.

  • 2+ years working within a product-focused organisation, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

  • Proven experience building and scaling data-intensive pipelines and platforms in production environments.

  • Deep understanding of stream and batch processing frameworks - hands-on experience with Flink or Spark is essential.

  • Comfortable working across multiple programming languages - we primarily work with Kotlin, Python, and TypeScript.

  • Equally comfortable designing high-level architecture as diving deep into low-level implementation details.

  • Experienced in designing and deploying data infrastructure in cloud environments such as AWS or GCP.

  • Hands-on experience with core data infrastructure tooling such as Kafka, Redis, and/or clustered Postgres.

Nice to have experience

  • Familiarity with open lakehouse technologies, such as Apache Iceberg and dbt.

  • Experience building data infrastructure to support AI agents - including low-latency retrieval and analytical interfaces.

  • Experience leading teams or managing engineers, driving both delivery and technical excellence.

  • Exposure to complex distributed environments with demanding constraints such as high throughput, low latency, or large-scale datasets.

Working style

Whereas Sparta is a remote-first company, for this role we’re looking for someone who values a hybrid working style, which in a typical week could involve spending a couple of days in the office - with flexibility built in.

Why Join Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded.

• Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company

• $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment

• Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale

• Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence

• Top-tier tools and technology to support your success

What's the Culture Like at Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers.

The Sparta Code

Understanding is non-negotiable

Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.

The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed.

Ask for forgiveness, not for permission

Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not.

90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned.

Fall in love with the problem

The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to.

Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working.

It's your fault. Lucky you.

If it's on you, it's in your control.

True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.

Conflict is a gift

Honesty is an expression of care.

Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it.

descriptionHtml:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

As Staff Engineer, you'll own the architecture, agents and skills that let every builder in your tribe ship sound, well-architected work without waiting on a handoff, at a moment when Mews has moved almost entirely to an agentic-first engineering model. The problem this role exists to solve is easy to state and hard to do: most technical decisions now get made by builders and the agents they run, not by senior engineers in review, so the standard has to be built into the tooling itself or the gaps show up in what customers touch. Mews is rebuilding hospitality software from the ground up at a genuinely unusual pace, which makes this one of the few staff engineering roles where the leverage you build gets used by everyone around you within weeks.

You'll be attached to one tribe, reporting into its Director, and working alongside other staff engineers, staff product managers and staff designers across your division. Your job isn't to ship features. It's to produce the architecture, agents and skills that give every builder in the tribe the context to make sound calls on their own, and to stay hands-on with the hardest problems yourself: the gnarly migrations and system-wide refactors that need an approach invented rather than executed.

As Mews moves builders to own a sub-metric end-to-end, with AI covering what they're lighter in, the risk isn't slower shipping, it's the architecture fragmenting underneath the speed. This role exists so the foundations get stronger as the tribe ships faster, not shakier.

What you would do 

  • Own the tribe's engineering context, agents and skills, and be accountable for keeping them coherent, current and grounded in real product work
  • Build and evaluate the internal engineering agents and skills that Product Builders use daily, encoding architectural standards, review logic and quality gates directly into the tools they run
  • Extend and improve the tribe's agentic tooling when it isn't good enough yet, since agentic development is the default way you build, not a fallback
  • Stay hands-on with the hardest technical problems: gnarly migrations, system-wide refactors and architecture calls that will shape years of future building
  • When work ships off-bar, trace it back to what was missing in the agents or patterns and fix it at the root so the same class of miss doesn't recur

AI Fluency Level 4: in this role that means building and shipping the engineering agents and skills that Product Builders rely on every day, not just using AI tools yourself. You need enough understanding of the underlying models and infrastructure to make real engineering decisions about them, because the agents you build become part of the tribe's production system.

For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to "AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates" on Confluence.

What you would bring 

  • A track record as a senior or staff-level engineer who has shipped and owned complex systems at scale, not just contributed to them
  • Experience turning hard-won technical judgment into reusable architecture, tooling or standards that other engineers actually adopt, rather than documentation that goes unused
  • Comfort holding a multi-cycle technical view (migrations, refactors, architecture decisions that play out over years) while still being able to drop into what needs to ship today
  • Clear communication across levels: builders, your Director, Principals and, when it counts, the C-suite
  • AI Fluency Level 4 or the equivalent hands-on experience: you've shipped something where AI is a core component and can make engineering decisions about the underlying models and infrastructure

Nice to have 

  • Experience in hospitality, travel or another operationally complex B2B SaaS environment
  • A track record of coaching or multiplying other engineers' output, not just your own
  • Public writing or speaking about technical work you've shipped
