title: Staff Product Analyst, Marketplace
descriptionHtml:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Delivery companies have always bought capacity by guesswork. Book too few drivers and parcels wait; book too many and you pay for empty vans. Most carriers accept that waste as the price of being reliable. Relay is building a marketplace where it isn't. You can't schedule drivers. You can only design what's on offer, and measure what happens.

Every part of our network runs on decisions. The next two years are about building the systems that make them well, and proving they do. Engineering and operational research build what you design.

Marketplace Highlights

  • You own decision-making, not the model: you decide what Marketplace changes on booking, matching and shifts, and recommend on pay. Our scientists' models and experiments feed your calls, and the squad lead acts on them.

  • Drivers choose when to work. What makes a shift worth booking early, and how do you prove what works when a clean experiment isn't possible?

  • Every booked shift is paid, used or not, and every unserved route means late parcels. Where should each area sit between the two, and what would let the network get there on its own?

  • Local shops hold our parcels while running their own businesses. Where does the network need more of them, what should a shop be paid, and how would you see a closed shop coming?

  • A whole area, not a slice: no playbook, and the result is on the street the next morning.

  • Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

The Opportunity

As a Staff Product Analyst, Marketplace at Relay, you'll:

  • Decide which Marketplace problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

  • Design how Marketplace decides: which signals count, and what good looks like for booking, matching and pay.

  • Tell the squad lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

  • Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

  • Go and look when the data and the street disagree: the sort centre, the van, the shop.

  • Get the missing data built, and prove whether each change worked. In a year, Marketplace's booking and pay decisions run on a system you designed.

We're looking for candidates who…

  • Have owned the decisions a matching, pricing or incentive model fed, in a two-sided marketplace or gig platform, rather than building the model itself.

  • Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or engineers built what you asked for.

  • Can trace why drivers or couriers stop booking or cancel, and can read the experiments behind a pricing or incentive change, including when a clean test isn't possible.

  • Have been through real change, such as a pivot, fast growth or a new market, and rebuilt something because of it.

  • Are hands-on and fluent in SQL, with or without AI, and happy to build their own analysis apps, monitors and alerts.

  • Would rather ship a working answer this week than a perfect one next quarter. No logistics experience needed, just the appetite to learn a physical operation fast.

Don't tick every box? If this problem excites you, we'd still love to hear from you.

Who Thrives at Relay?

  • Aim with Precision: You define problems clearly and measure your impact meticulously.

  • Play to Win: You chase bold bets, tackle the hard stuff, and view constraints as fuel, not friction.

  • 1% Better Every Day: You believe that small, consistent improvements lead to exponential growth. You move quickly, deliver results, and learn from every experience.

  • All In, All the Time: You show up and step up. You take ownership from start to finish and do what it takes to deliver when it counts.

  • People-Powered Greatness: You invest in your teammates. You give and receive feedback with care and candour. You build trust through high standards and shared success.

  • Grow the Whole Pie: You seek out win-win solutions for merchants, couriers, and our customers, because when they thrive, so do we.

    If these resonate, and you combine strong technical fundamentals with entrepreneurial drive, let’s connect.

Relay is an equal-opportunity employer committed to diversity, inclusion, and fostering a workplace where everyone thrives.

title: Staff Security Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Build security platforms, not security processes

We are looking for a Staff Security Engineer to strengthen the security of our products, data and engineering platform.

This is a highly technical and hands-on role. You will work closely with Engineering teams to continuously harden our systems while helping design the next generation of our security architecture.

You will operate across two horizons:

  • Strengthen security today: continuously harden our applications, access controls and data-protection mechanisms against evolving threats.

  • Build the privacy architecture of tomorrow: move beyond traditional perimeter and access-control security by designing systems where sensitive data is cryptographically isolated, minimally exposed, and increasingly usable without being directly revealed.

The ultimate objective is not simply to make Swile harder to breach. It is to make a breach increasingly uninteresting, because there is less usable data available to steal.


What you will do

We want Security Engineering to create capabilities that scale across hundreds of engineers.

You will:

  • Identify and reduce high-impact security risks across our applications, APIs and internal tools.

  • Strengthen authentication, authorization and access controls.

  • Improve the protection of sensitive and personal data.

  • Design controls that limit the blast radius of compromised accounts, services or infrastructure.

  • Improve security monitoring, auditability and detection of suspicious access patterns.

  • Perform threat modelling and targeted security reviews.

  • Build reusable security capabilities directly into our engineering platform and development lifecycle.

  • Contribute to long-term architectures around data isolation, encryption, tokenisation and privacy-preserving systems.

  • Partner with engineering teams to address systemic security risks rather than individual findings.

    • Where possible, a security requirement should become code rather than documentation.


What we are looking for

You are first and foremost a strong engineer.

You have significant experience building or securing production software and distributed systems. You are comfortable reading and writing production code, designing systems and working directly with Engineering teams.

You have deep security engineering expertise and strong experience in several of the following areas:

  • Application and Product Security

  • API Security

  • IAM, authentication and authorization

  • OAuth2 / OIDC, WebAuthn / FIDO2

  • RBAC / ABAC and privilege management

  • Cloud security

  • Cryptography, KMS / HSM and envelope encryption

  • Tokenisation and secrets management

  • Data Security and Privacy Engineering

  • Threat modelling and secure software architecture

  • Security monitoring and detection

    • Stronger attacker mindset

    You naturally ask:

  • What happens if this employee becomes malicious?

  • What happens if this backend is compromised?

  • What happens if someone dumps this database?

  • Can this endpoint be called directly?

  • How much data can one account access before we notice?

  • Where else does this information get replicated?

  • Why do we have this data at all?

    • You think in terms of attack paths, blast radius and least privilege, not just compliance requirements.

    Pragmatism

    You know that security engineering is a prioritisation problem.

    You can distinguish between:

  • something that needs to be fixed this week;

  • something that requires an architectural redesign;

  • something cryptographically elegant but operationally unnecessary.

    • You are comfortable deploying simple, high-impact controls quickly while designing stronger long-term foundations.

    What would make you stand out

    Experience with:

  • large-scale SaaS or fintech platforms;

  • highly sensitive or regulated data;

  • multi-tenant architectures;

  • insider risk or data-loss prevention;

  • advanced cryptographic or privacy-enhancing technologies.

    • What success looks like

  • Sensitive data is exposed to fewer systems and people.

  • Access to sensitive resources is increasingly scoped, attributable and auditable.

  • Compromising a single account or service has a limited blast radius.

  • Security controls are increasingly enforced by the platform rather than by process.

  • Product teams can build secure systems faster and with less friction.

    • What this role is not

    This is not primarily a GRC, SOC, compliance, policy-writing or penetration-testing role.

    Those disciplines are important, but this role exists to change how our products and systems are engineered.

    We expect this person to design systems, write code, influence architecture and ship security capabilities into production.


    Localization of this position
    This position can be based at our offices in Paris, Toulouse, or Montpellier on a flex-remote basis.

title: Staff Software Engineer - Alwin
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer in our Amsterdam office to build Alwin, our Agentic Automation Platform for audit and finance, and the systems around it. Alwin agents run multi-step audit procedures over client evidence and return finished workpapers with every number traced back to source. Humans plan, review and sign off.

This is a hands-on role: most of your time will be spent writing code, building the hardest parts of the runtime, prototyping new capabilities and getting them into production. You lead by example: engineers follow your direction because they see it work in your code. Your impact will also come through the engineers and teams you work with.

Your mission is to build the best agentic runtime for audit: one that completes audit tasks faster, more accurately, more reliably and at lower cost, while scaling to meet the needs of our largest customers.

You will identify the problems that most constrain that mission, align teams around a technical direction and drive solutions through to measurable results, while building the foundations other engineers use and raising the quality of Alwin’s agents in production.

Why DataSnipper?

The hardest AI problems aren't about getting an answer fast. They're about getting one people can trust.

We believe trust is essential to how society works. Every day, we rely on information that's been independently verified, from financial statements to the products we buy, to the sustainability claims companies make. Behind that trust are audit and finance professionals who examine evidence, verify information and hold organizations accountable.

At DataSnipper, we build AI solutions that empower those professionals. By making evidence easier to trace and verify, we help them focus on the judgment and expertise that make their work so important.

For our product and engineering team, this is where things get exciting. In audit, a plausible answer isn't good enough. Every output has to be explainable and traceable back to its source. We've just launched a brand new agentic platform, Alwin by DataSnipper. AI agents running in the cloud across hundreds of documents at once, reasoning across PDF, Word and Excel, with a full audit trail behind every step. There are lots of greenfield problems ahead, and real room to shape what we build and how we build it.

And we build at scale. title: Staff UX Researcher
descriptionHtml:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About The Role:

We are looking for a Staff UX Researcher to join our Design team and shape how research informs the products we build.

You will be a hands-on researcher, leading qualitative and quantitative research into our most important and ambiguous customer and product questions. Working closely with Product, Design, Engineering, AI, and leadership, you will turn what we learn into insights that shape product decisions and strategy.

Alongside your research, you will establish and evolve our Research Operations. Our embedded Product Designers already conduct research within their product teams. You will enable them to do this effectively while building the practices, tools, and systems that strengthen and scale research across Parloa.

You will research both the people who build and manage AI agents and the customers who interact with them. This creates complex questions around how people understand, trust, control, and collaborate with AI, and how expectations and behaviors change as AI becomes increasingly capable.

Areas Of Ownership:

  • Lead hands-on research into our most important and ambiguous customer and product questions, using qualitative and quantitative methods from problem framing and study design through analysis, synthesis, and communication.

  • Shape product decisions through research by uncovering needs and opportunities, challenging assumptions, and ensuring customer evidence informs product direction, priorities, and strategy.

  • Enable Product Designers to conduct high-quality research independently through coaching, methodological guidance, and lightweight research practices.

  • Establish and evolve Research Operations that make research easier, faster, higher quality, and more scalable, including participant recruitment, tooling, governance, research practices, and knowledge management.

  • Build organizational knowledge by connecting research across teams and studies, making existing insights accessible, and identifying broader patterns, knowledge gaps, and strategic insights that individual teams may not see.

Who You Are:

  • You are an excellent mixed-method researcher, with deep qualitative expertise and strong quantitative research skills. You know how to combine methods and sources of evidence to answer complex questions.

  • You have experience researching across both complex B2B/expert and consumer/end-user experiences, and can adapt your approach to different users, contexts, and levels of expertise.

  • You are comfortable starting with ambiguous product and customer problems, identifying what needs to be understood, and determining the right research approach rather than waiting for a predefined research brief.

  • You have a track record of research influencing meaningful product decisions, priorities, or strategy, and can work effectively with Product, Design, Engineering, and senior leadership.

  • You are strong at synthesis and storytelling, able to make sense of complex or contradictory evidence, connect insights across studies, and communicate what matters clearly to different audiences.

  • You have experience enabling others to conduct high-quality research through coaching, frameworks, methodological guidance, or research practices.

  • You have experience building or improving Research Operations and can create systems and practices that increase research quality and speed without introducing unnecessary process.

  • You are comfortable creating clarity and direction in ambiguous, fast-moving environments, and influencing across teams and disciplines without relying on authority.

Nice to have: 

  • Experience researching AI-powered products or emerging technologies where user mental models, expectations, and behaviors are still evolving.

  • Experience with conversational, voice, or multimodal experiences.

Our Recruiting Process:

Recruiter Interview → Hiring Manager Interview → Live Research Working Session → Cross-Functional Collaboration Interview → Bar Raiser Interview

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We're building agentic AI that enterprises trust with their most important customer moments: complex questions, high volumes, real stakes. When millions of people reach out to a brand, those interactions aren't just support tickets; they're defining experiences. We're here to raise the standard: making every conversation seamless, intelligent, and genuinely helpful. If you care about shaping how businesses and customers connect at scale and want your work to matter in real, everyday moments, this is where you do it.

At Parloa, ownership isn't a buzzword; it means being accountable for outcomes, not just tasks. We operate in a category that's evolving fast, where the bar is high, and the problems are complex. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.

If you receive an offer of employment from Parloa, you will need to go through the E-Verify process of digital verification of your employment authorization documents as provided on the Form I-9. Participation in E-Verify does not limit your right to work and verification will only be completed after you become an employee with Parloa.

descriptionHtml:

Burson, part of WPP, is the global communications leader built to create value for clients through reputation. For more information visit bursonglobal.com and follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Hoe versterken we de reputatie van één van de grootste werkgevers van Nederland? Welke influencers schakelen we in bij een lancering van een nieuw product? Hoe zorgen we dat de onze klant goed in de media komt? Als jouw hart sneller gaat kloppen van deze vragen, dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Wat ga je doen?

Stage lopen bij Burson betekent dat je meteen veel verantwoordelijkheden krijgt. Als stagiair maak je écht onderdeel uit van ons team en word je zoveel mogelijk betrokken bij verschillende activiteiten.

Je werkt nauw samen met je collega’s aan opdrachten voor merken zoals SharkNinja, Jaguar Land Rover en Procter & Gamble (o.a. Gillette, Always en Olay). Afhankelijk van de klanten in jouw portfolio ondersteun je bijvoorbeeld bij andere inhoudelijke taken als het verzamelen van relevante informatie, het maken van media-, concurrentie- of stakeholderanalyses, het meedenken over de invulling van nieuwe social media- of influencer-campagnes en het creëren van content voor verschillende kanalen. Er wordt hard gewerkt in de diverse klantteams, maar de werksfeer is open, informeel en eigen initiatief wordt zeer gewaardeerd!

Wie zijn wij? 

Burson staat voor strategie en communicatie, met adviseurs die door opdrachtgevers worden ingeschakeld als het er echt om gaat. Wij helpen bedrijven en organisaties in de meest uiteenlopende en vaak uitdagende omstandigheden, waarbij wij ze adviseren in hun transities en transformaties. Met het creëren van stakeholderacceptatie als doel. Nooit om de status quo te beschermen, niet om op elke hype in te gaan, maar om ze met een gegronde strategie toekomstbestendig te maken.

Onze adviseurs zijn met hun brede ervaring, vakmanschap en integriteit erkende boardroompartners. Onafhankelijk en kritisch zetten zij de discussie met onze opdrachtgevers op scherp. Burson heeft jarenlange ervaring in het adviseren van bedrijven in complexe situaties, onder meer op het gebied van strategie, stakeholdermanagement en geloofwaardige communicatie.

We zijn onderdeel van Burson Group, een internationaal communicatiebureau bestaande uit een groot netwerk met meer dan 95 kantoren in ruim 40 landen. Samen maken wij onderdeel uit van WPP: het grootste marketing- en communicatiebedrijf ter wereld. Sinds 2019 zijn wij onder één dak gevestigd op onze Amsteldok-campus in Amsterdam. Daarnaast hebben wij in Nederland ook een kantoor in Den Haag.

Wie ben jij?

Heb jij je altijd al afgevraagd hoe het is om stage te lopen bij een internationaal communicatiebureau? Ben je goed op de hoogte van het laatste nieuws? Weet je je weg te vinden in de onlinewereld? Ben je communicatief vaardig, leergierig en stel je altijd de juiste vragen? Dan past deze stage perfect bij jou.

Je staat open voor nieuwe ideeën en opvattingen, bent breed geïnteresseerd en zoekt graag dingen tot op de bodem uit. Bij ons zijn studenten van alle studieachtergronden welkom die geïnteresseerd zijn in communicatie, marketing en media.

Wat bieden wij?

Tijdens je stage ontvang je een maandelijkse stagevergoeding van €650 (gebaseerd op een volledige werkweek) en word je begeleid door twee collega’s. Elke maand heb je een coachingsgesprek over je eigen ambities en wensen. Halverwege je stage is er een tussentijds feedbackgesprek waarin genoeg ruimte is om aan te geven wat je nog meer uit je stage wil halen. Daarnaast kun je altijd terecht bij andere Young Professionals (trainees), consultants en senior-adviseurs met vragen. Tenslotte worden je reiskosten vergoed en is het mogelijk om op vrijdagen  vanuit huis te werken.

Enthousiast?

Solliciteer dan via onderstaande link!

Je kunt solliciteren t/m 1 december. De gesprekken zullen dan in de weken erna plaatsvinden. De startdatum van de stage is flexibel, maar idealiter 1 februari.

  • Gasten ontvangen, instappen begeleiden en wachtrijen op de kade coördineren;

  • Contact onderhouden met planners, duty managers, hosts, schippers en havenpartners;

  • Checklists en registraties bijhouden en operationele gegevens verwerken;

  • Meewerken aan projecten en verbeteringen binnen Operations.

Praktisch

  • Startdatum: zo snel mogelijk;

  • Duur: 3 tot 6 maanden;

  • Type stage: meewerkstage;

  • Werktijden: Een combinatie van kantoortijden en operationele diensten. Beschikbaarheid in avonden en weekenden is vereist;

  • Stagevergoeding: € 500 per maand;

  • Locatie: kantoor in hartje Amsterdam en de kade.

Wat we aanbieden

  • Een afwisselende meewerkstage waarin je zowel organisatorische als praktische ervaring opdoet;

  • De kans om mee te werken aan de vaarten van het Amsterdam Light Festival en een uniek kijkje achter de schermen te krijgen bij een van de grootste rondvaartoperaties van Amsterdam;

  • Een centraal gelegen kantoor op ca. 15 minuten lopen van Amsterdam Centraal;

  • Legendarische vrijdagmiddagborrels, sportieve uitjes en bedrijfsfeesten;

  • Een heerlijke verzorgde lunch op kantoor;

  • 25% personeelskorting op rondvaarten en andere activiteiten binnen Flagship Holding.

Functievereisten

  • Een mbo-, hbo- of wo-opleiding in operations, events, hospitality, toerisme of bedrijfskunde;

  • Beschikbaar tijdens het Amsterdam Light Festival (ALF), ook in de avonden en weekenden;

  • Kennis van Excel is een plus.


Over Flagship Amsterdam

Flagship Amsterdam is een snelgroeiende rederij in het hart van Amsterdam. Wat in 2017 begon met drie boten, is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een vloot van meer dan 70 boten, en we groeien nog steeds elke dag verder! Jaarlijks verwelkomen we gasten uit meer dan 55 verschillende landen, en we varen het hele jaar door. Dit doen we met een gedreven en ambitieus team van meer dan 800 (seizoensgebonden) medewerkers.

Maar Flagship is meer dan alleen rondvaarten. Vanuit dezelfde energie bouwen we aan verschillende concepten die allemaal draaien om beleving, gastvrijheid en de stad Amsterdam. Zo ontdek je de stad op de fiets met Flagship Bike Tours, proef je de sfeer bij Flagship Waffle Experience Amsterdam, en werken we bij Shipyard aan creatieve projecten op en rond het water. Daarnaast hebben we labels zoals Voyage Amsterdam, Captain Jack en Aemstelland, elk met hun eigen stijl en doelgroep. Samen vormen ze één organisatie, maar met verschillende manieren om mensen de stad te laten ervaren.

title: Stage Ressources Humaines (H/F)
descriptionHtml:
L’Hôtel Le Provençal (4★), situé au cœur de la Presqu’île de Giens, est une maison familiale emblématique depuis plus de 75 ans. Entièrement rénové, l’établissement propose plusieurs restaurants aux univers variés dans un cadre naturel exceptionnel entre mer et pinède.

descriptionHtml:
L’Agence du Numérique en Santé (ANS) accompagne la transformation numérique du système de santé en France. Elle œuvre, aux côtés de ses partenaires institutionnels et professionnels, à garantir la confiance dans le numérique en santé, à sécuriser les échanges de données et à promouvoir des outils au service de la qualité des soins et du pilotage du système de santé.

Vous rejoindrez le Centre de Services Data de la Direction des opérations (DOPS). Cette équipe transverse accompagne les programmes métiers de l’ANS dans la valorisation des données, pilote la plateforme data et l’Observatoire de la e-Santé et contribue à la diffusion de pratiques fiables de traitement et d’exploitation des données. Pour faciliter l’accès aux données, leur compréhension et leur utilisation par les équipes comme par les outils d’intelligence artificielle, le centre renforce sa gouvernance, ses processus et sa documentation. Vous participerez à l’évaluation des pratiques existantes et à la mise en œuvre d’améliorations concrètes.

🎯 Missions principales

Évaluer et faire évoluer la gouvernance des données

  • Auditer les processus de gouvernance existants et les comparer aux bonnes pratiques applicables aux plateformes Data.

  • Évaluer le niveau de maturité des processus, identifier les axes de renforcement et proposer de nouveaux dispositifs.

  • Contribuer à l’élaboration d’un plan d’évolution des pratiques, puis à la mise en œuvre des actions retenues.

Fiabiliser l’accès aux données et la documentation

  • Revoir et enrichir les documents existants, notamment le catalogue de données, et créer la documentation manquante.

  • Produire des supports facilitant la compréhension et l’identification des modèles de données, y compris par les outils d’IA générative.

  • Contribuer à l’étude visant à traduire des demandes formulées en langage naturel en requêtes SQL, puis formaliser le cadre de gouvernance dans des documents adaptés aux directions et aux équipes opérationnelles.


🧑‍🎓 Profil recherché

  • Vous êtes étudiant·e en études supérieures, de niveau Bac+4 ou Bac+5, dans un cursus en informatique, gestion des données ou systèmes d’information.

  • Vous êtes à la recherche d’un stage de 6 mois à partir de janvier 2027.

title: Steuerungstechniker:in Kundendienst
descriptionHtml:
Würenlos (AG) · 100 % · ca. 50 % bei Kunden vor Ort

Bei der AKSA Würenlos AG entwickeln, realisieren und betreuen wir hochverfügbare Notstromlösungen – individuell, technisch anspruchsvoll und geschäftskritisch für unsere Kunden.

Unsere Steuerungstechniker:innen für Projekte begleiten eine Anlage bis zur Abnahme. Danach übernimmst Du: Du verantwortest die Steuerungstechnik unserer Anlagen im Betrieb – bei Retrofit-Projekten, Änderungen und im Service. Dafür brauchst Du dasselbe Können wie im Projektgeschäft, nur setzt Du es an bestehenden Anlagen ein, die oft anders aussehen als auf dem Plan.

Wenn Du nicht einfach Störungen beheben, sondern Ursachen verstehen, Lösungen konzipieren und Verantwortung übernehmen möchtest, bist Du bei uns richtig.

Deine Aufgaben

Elektrokonstruktion

  • Erstellung komplexer Stromlaufpläne für Retrofit-Projekte und Anlagenänderungen (eXs-CAD) gemäss Konzept

  • Aufnahme und Nachführung bestehender Schemas, auch bei Fremdfabrikaten und lückenhafter Dokumentation

Automationsplanung

  • Verantwortung für Steuerungslösungen in Retrofit- und Service-Projekten

  • Unterstützung bei der Erarbeitung von Retrofit-Konzepten inkl. Umschaltplan und Rückfallebene, abgestimmt mit dem Projektleiter

  • Integration von Notstromanlagen in übergeordnete Systeme (SPS, Leitsysteme, Gebäudeautomation)

Steuerungssysteme

  • Programmierung und Anpassung von SPS-Programmen, auch in fremden und älteren Systemen

  • Parametrierung und Optimierung von Generatorsteuerungen (z. B. ComAp, Cummins PCC)

  • Anpassung und Optimierung von Netzersatz-, Synchronisations- und Lastmanagementfunktionen

Service, Tests und Inbetriebnahme

  • Analyse umfassender Störungen vor Ort und Ableitung nachhaltiger Lösungen

  • Test von Änderungen im Prüffeld und Inbetriebnahme nach Retrofits und Anlagenänderungen beim Kunden

  • Durchführung anspruchsvoller Prüfungen der Steuerungs- und Elektrotechnik

Dokumentation und Standards

  • Sicherstellung einer sauberen, nachvollziehbaren Dokumentation aller Änderungen

  • Rückmeldung von Erfahrungen aus dem Feld ans Engineering zur Weiterentwicklung von Standards

Team und Zusammenarbeit

  • Übernahme der Anlagen von den Projekt-Steuerungstechniker:innen nach der Abnahme

  • Fachliche Unterstützung der Servicetechniker:innen bei steuerungstechnischen Fragen

  • Technische Ansprechperson für Kunden, Betreiber und Projektleitende im After-Sales

Dein Profil

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Automation oder vergleichbar

  • Weiterbildung (z.B. HF Systemtechnik oder ähnlich) von Vorteil

  • Erfahrung in der Steuerungstechnik im industriellen Umfeld

  • Fundierte Erfahrung in Inbetriebnahme, Fehlersuche und im Umgang mit komplexen Anlagen

  • Erfahrung im Schema-Engineering (vorzugsweise eXs) – Du erstellst Schemas, nicht nur Änderungen

  • Erfahrung mit SPS-Systemen

  • Erfahrung mit Umbauten oder Modernisierungen bestehender Anlagen

  • Erfahrung mit Generatorsteuerungen von Vorteil

  • Kenntnisse in der Integration von Anlagen und Systemen

  • Gute Kenntnisse von Stromnetzen, Netzformen und Netzverhalten

  • Sicheres und kundenorientiertes Auftreten

  • Lösungsorientierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise, Qualitätsbewusstsein

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse, Englisch- und Französischkenntnisse von Vorteil

  • Führerausweis Kategorie B

  • Reisebereitschaft ca. 50 %

  • Pikettdienst

Was Dich auszeichnet

  • Systemisches Denken – Du erkennst Zusammenhänge, auch an Anlagen, die Du nicht selbst gebaut hast

  • Analytische Stärke – Du findest Ursachen, nicht nur Symptome

  • Hands-on & pragmatisch – Du bist gerne dort, wo die Anlage steht

  • Ruhe beim Kunden – Du behältst den Überblick, wenn etwas nicht läuft, und erklärst verständlich, was Du tust

  • Umsetzungsstärke – Du bringst Dinge zu Ende

Bist Du das?

Du bist nicht der Typ, der nur tauscht, was kaputt ist. Du verstehst, warum eine Anlage so aufgebaut ist – und sorgst dafür, dass sie auch nach Jahren im Betrieb zuverlässig läuft. Bei uns arbeitest Du an Anlagen, bei denen es zählt, dass sie wirklich laufen.

Was Dich bei uns erwartet

Technik, die zählt:

Du arbeitest an Notstromsystemen, die im Ernstfall funktionieren müssen – kein Spielplatz, sondern echte Verantwortung.

Abwechslung:

Einsätze beim Kunden und Engineering im Haus, etwa zur Hälfte.

Stabilität trifft Wachstum:

Ein etabliertes Unternehmen mit klarer Richtung – und gleichzeitig genug Dynamik, um Dinge wirklich voranzubringen.

title: Storyteller / Journaliste & Content Manager
descriptionHtml:
Nous avons créé Green-Got pour transformer le système le plus fermé et le plus puissant qui existe : le système financier. Ce système est verrouillé car c’est la matrice : il fait fonctionner toute la société. Tant qu’il ne change pas, rien d’essentiel ne changera.

C’est notre mission chez Green-Got. Chaque euro déposé chez nous finance la transition énergétique, pas les énergies fossiles. Notre arme, c'est la transparence radicale : dévoiler ce que les grandes banques préfèrent garder dans l'ombre, et construire un système qui soit différent.

Nous sommes une petite équipe qui produit beaucoup et qui doit être plus rusée, plus rapide et plus owner que les autres. La communication est centrale dans notre modèle : elle informe, elle recrute, elle fidélise. Pas de budget pub démesuré. Le contenu doit organiquement exploser.

Vos missions

👉 Le poste

Nous cherchons notre prochain renard : un conteur né capable de rendre l’impact de la finance et des projets qu’on finance captivants, concrets et impossibles à ignorer, sans jamais vulgariser à l'extrême ni ennuyer.

C'est un poste pour une plume affûtée qui sait raconter de belles histoires, trouver le meilleur angle et conclure avec puissance.

Tu vas enquêter, chercher, visiter les projets et entreprises et produire sans filet : des carrousels qui arrêtent le scroll dès la première slide, des scripts vidéo indispensables sur des sujets complexes (finance, géopolitique, énergie), et des réponses à notre communauté qui engagent sans trahir notre ton.

L'équipe est petite. Il n'y a pas de strates de validation entre toi et la publication : ce que tu écris sort directement.

C'est la liberté qu'on t'offre, et la responsabilité qui va avec.

Si tu cherches un poste où ton jugement éditorial compte dès le premier jour, c'est ici.

👉 L’équipe

Tu rejoins l'équipe communication aux côtés de la fondatrice et CMO (Maud Caillaux), du Head of Communication et d'un motion designer/graphiste, avec l'appui d'un pool de freelances pour les gros projets. Tu auras une autonomie réelle : on ne t'expliquera pas comment construire un format, c'est toi qui viens avec l'expertise. Notre rôle sera de te transmettre l'ADN de la marque.

👉 Les missions

La vision macro (ton obsession quotidienne) :

  • Faire exploser le reach de notre impact : Trouver l'angle parfait pour mettre en lumière les projets et les entreprises de la transition que l'on finance et dans lesquels on investit. Rendre l'écologie financière non seulement évidente, mais profondément désirable.
  • Hacker l'organique : Imaginer, concevoir et propulser des contenus pensés dès la première seconde pour exploser et devenir viraux, sans injecter un seul euro de budget publicitaire.

L'exécution par canal :

  • Réseaux Sociaux Textuels & Visuels (Instagram, LinkedIn) : Concevoir et rédiger nos carrousels emblématiques de A à Z (de l'accroche qui stoppe le scroll à la slide finale de conversion). Tu veilles au grain, repères les tendances émergentes et les plies au service du message Green-Got, sans jamais forcer le trait et sans jamais trahir la marque.
  • Réseaux Sociaux Vidéo (YouTube, Reels, TikTok) : Co-piloter la production éditoriale de nos formats vidéo (longs et shorts). YouTube est une page blanche : on ne cherche pas quelqu'un pour exécuter un modèle existant, mais pour inventer le nôtre. Tu gères les angles, écris les scripts et imposes le rythme.
  • Community Management Éditorial : Piloter nos espaces de commentaires avec l'exigence et le sang-froid d'un rédacteur en chef. Qu'il s'agisse d'une réponse ultra-sourcée sur un sujet géopolitique clivant, d'une vanne qui tombe à pic ou d'une crise à éteindre, tu réponds sans jamais trembler.
  • Copywriting Transversal & UX : Planifier la diffusion globale de nos contenus et poser ton empreinte sur chaque point de contact textuel de la marque : des newsletters aux articles de blog, jusqu'à l'UX writing de nos notifications d'application. Absolument tout ce qui sort de chez Green-Got peut et devrait porter ta patte.

Vos compétences

Le profil recherché

Tu es à la croisée du journalisme, du copywriting, du CM et de la création de contenu. Tu ne rentres pas dans les cases, et c’est tant mieux.

Ce que tu maîtrises :

  • tu maitrises comme personne le fond : tu peux rendre passionnant n’importe quelle histoire de Gérard de la compta.
  • tu sais empaqueter le fond dans la forme qu’il faut pour la circonstance et le message.
  • tu connais l'art du rythme et de la structure narrative (varier les registres : factuel, incisif, drôle ou pédagogue).
  • tu enquêtes, approfondis les sujets, comprends en profondeur, pour ensuite les rendre intéressants.
  • Bonus : tu sais faire de la production concrète de contenus sur Instagram et YouTube, tu connais les algo.

Ce qui te définit :

  • L’art de l’émotion : tu sais quelle émotion fair passer et quand pour captiver ton lecteur
  • L'exécution rapide : Tu produis et tu testes, tu ne passes pas des semaines sur un brief.
  • L'audace : Tu comprends vite les codes d'une marque et tu sais t'effacer derrière elle tout en y injectant ta personnalité.
  • La profondeur : Tu ne t’arrêtes pas à la surface, tu cherches jusqu’à ce que tu trouves la bonne info, la bonne accroche, le bon angle...

Ce qu'on ne cherche pas :

  • Un profil purement stratégique qui délègue la création. Ici, tout le monde met la main à la pâte.
  • Quelqu'un qui a besoin d'un cadre et de process établis pour avancer. On invente beaucoup en marchant et on marche dans le chaos.

Avantages

Contrat : Part-time, Full-time, CDI, CDD, alternance, Stage, Freelance. Nous cherchons le talent. Nous ne nous formaliserons pas du reste :)
Salaire : CDI 52k-55k€, Freelance : TJM correspondant, Alternant - Stagiaire : fourchette haute.
De 7 à 77 ans, nous cherchons le talent, pas un CV

Process :
Etape 1 : Nous ne regarderons pas ton CV. Nous ne regarderons pas tes errances ou tes belles lignes. Nous ne regarderons pas tes travaux précédents.
Nous regarderons que ce que tu as à nous raconter aujourd’hui :)

Si Étape 1 validée, Étape 2 : Échange avec Mickael, Head of Com

Étape 3 : Business case

Étape 4 : Debrief et rencontre avec la CMO

descriptionHtml:
🚀 About WRITER

WRITER is the AI platform built for the world’s most ambitious marketing and revenue teams, bringing the frontier of AI to the people who drive enterprise growth. With WRITER, autonomous agents work across the buyer journey, continuously executing on market signals and enterprise intelligence to grow revenue faster. Every agent action and asset is grounded in trust, built on an Enterprise Brain that unites brand, product, and company knowledge with fiduciary-grade governance and compliance.

Fortune 500 companies are transforming how they go to market with WRITER, including 3 of the top 5 US banks, 2 of the 5 largest global CPG conglomerates, and 4 of the top 5 US healthcare insurers. Founded in 2020, WRITER is backed by investors including Insight Partners, ICONIQ, Radical Ventures, Premji Invest, Balderton, B Capital, Salesforce Ventures, Adobe Ventures, Accenture, Citi Ventures, IBM Ventures, WndrCo, and others. Learn more at WRITER.com.

📐 About the role

Join WRITER's sales team as a strategic account executive and help shape the future of work. You'll empower global enterprises (8,000+ employees) to transform their operations through our cutting-edge AI agent platform, enabling organizations to deploy AI at scale and unlock unprecedented productivity. This isn't just about hitting quota – it's about becoming a trusted advisor to some of the world's most influential companies as they navigate their AI transformation journey.

This role is perfect for high performers who thrive in fast-paced, intellectually stimulating environments where you have the autonomy to drive results and build lasting relationships with both clients and teammates. If you're energized by meaningful work, the opportunity to make a real impact, and the challenge of selling category-defining technology, we want to hear from you. You'll be selling solutions that fundamentally change how enterprises operate, working with executive buyers who are making multi-million dollar, multi-year commitments to AI transformation.

This is a hybrid role based out of our London hub. You'll be reporting to our regional vice president.

🦸🏻‍♀️ What you need

  • 7-10+ years of quota-carrying strategic SaaS sales experience with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding annual quotas in complex, value-based sales motions targeting Fortune 500 and Global 2000 financial services accounts

  • Deep understanding of the UK and European financial services landscape — banking, asset management, insurance, and fintech — including its regulatory environment, buying cycles, and communication standards

  • Demonstrated expertise in managing sophisticated enterprise sales cycles with multiple stakeholders, navigating procurement and security processes, and orchestrating cross-functional resources to drive deals through technical evaluations and executive approvals

  • Executive presence and communication skills that allow you to credibly engage with C-suite buyers (CIOs, CDOs, CTOs, COOs), translate complex technical concepts into business value, and build authentic relationships based on trust and strategic insight

  • Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to conduct discovery that uncovers underlying business challenges, connects AI capabilities to measurable outcomes, and creates urgency around transformation initiatives in regulated industries

  • Experience in outbound prospecting, account mapping, and territory planning, with a hunter mentality that drives you to consistently create new opportunities rather than waiting for inbound leads

  • Comfort with ambiguity and a bias for ownership — you thrive in fast-paced environments where you're expected to figure things out, make decisions with incomplete information, and drive your own success with minimal oversight

  • Deep alignment with WRITER's values: you naturally Connect across functions and build collaborative relationships, you Challenge the status quo and aren't afraid to have difficult conversations, and you Own your outcomes with accountability and a commitment to long-term impact

⭐️ Is this you?

  • You've sold into financial services institutions and understand what it takes to navigate complex, regulated buying environments — from security and compliance reviews to board-level approvals

  • You're a closer who has consistently carried and exceeded seven-figure quotas, and you can point to deals where you created the opportunity from scratch rather than working an inbound lead

  • You think like a consultant but sell like a hunter — your discovery uncovers pain buyers didn't know they had, and your storytelling connects AI to outcomes that matter to a CIO and a CFO alike

  • You understand the UK FS market specifically — the players, the regulators, the buying rhythms — and you have or can build a network that opens doors

  • You're comfortable in the boardroom and the back office — equally credible presenting an AI transformation vision to an exec team and working through the technical and procurement details with the people who sign off

  • You move fast, own your number, and don't wait to be told what to do next

Preferred skills

  • Existing network and relationships within UK or European financial services institutions

  • Background in management consulting, particularly with FS clients

  • Experience selling AI, data, or enterprise platform deals into regulated industries

  • Familiarity with the compliance, security, and governance requirements that shape FS buying decisions

  • Experience supporting or leading large-scale rollouts or change management programs

  • Strong storytelling and presentation skills for executive audiences

🍩 Benefits & perks (UK full-time employees):

  • Generous PTO, plus company holidays

  • Comprehensive medical and dental insurance

  • Paid parental leave for all parents (16 weeks)

  • Fertility and family planning support

  • Early-detection cancer testing through Galleri

  • Competitive pension scheme and company contribution

  • Annual work-life stipends for:

    • Wellness stipend for gym, massage/chiropractor, personal training, etc.

    • Learning and development stipend

  • Company-wide off-sites and team off-sites

  • Competitive compensation and company stock options

title: Strategic Account Executive
descriptionHtml:
📍Manchester (Hybrid) | 💰 Basic £50k, realistic £100k OTE

Street Group is one of the fastest-growing PropTech companies in the UK. We want to be the leading creator of delightful experiences for everybody involved in buying, selling, renting and letting property, regardless of their involvement, to improve the industry for everybody by elevating UK Estate Agencies through world-class technology.

Join our Enterprise Sales team to drive new business growth across Spectre and Street.co.uk. With the support of our industry-leading, multi-award-winning prospecting and CRM technology, you’ll have the opportunity to drive new business, close high-value deals, and play a key role in shaping the future of PropTech in the UK.

As we continue to scale, we’re looking for a Strategic Account Executive to spearhead enterprise-level sales, working closely with our VP of Sales to drive revenue growth. You’ll be responsible for prospecting, engaging, and closing high-value deals, selling to board-level stakeholders and securing strategic partnerships. This role requires a consultative sales approach, strong negotiation skills, and the ability to multi-thread across complex organisations to drive adoption of our full product suite.

If you love autonomy, are naturally curious, and want to have a genuine impact within a rapidly growing company, we think you’d fit right in!

A bit about you…

  • You have 2+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with a strong track record in enterprise sales.

  • Enterprise sales strategy expertise, including account mapping, multi-threading, and engaging multiple stakeholders.

  • Strong outbound prospecting skills, with experience in either Challenger, Gap Selling or PClub sales methodology, MEDDIC qualification methodology, forecasting, and ABM/ABS strategies.

  • Exceptional negotiation and presentation skills, with the ability to influence decision-makers and close high-value deals.

  • Consultative sales approach, able to understand business challenges and position tailored solutions.

  • Resilience, confidence, and presence - you can hold the room, drive conversations, and articulate value effectively.

  • A team player mindset, working collaboratively across departments to drive success.

  • Coachability, always seeking to refine your approach and stay ahead in enterprise sales best practices.


Here’s what you can expect to be working on as a Strategic Account Executive at Street Group

  • Executing ABM/ABS strategies, identifying and targeting key accounts with a structured approach.

  • Prospecting and outbound outreach, using cold calling, email, and LinkedIn to generate new business opportunities.

  • Managing and optimising CRM data, ensuring accurate tracking of leads, interactions, and progress.

  • Conducting research on industries, prospects, and competitors to craft personalised outreach.

  • Handling objections with confidence, positioning value-driven solutions tailored to client needs.

  • Collaborating with our Technical Pre-Sales team to map prospect workflows and demonstrate how Street transforms the way their agency operates end to end.

  • Developing strong relationships with multiple stakeholders within a business to drive engagement.

  • Becoming a product expert, understanding how our solutions solve industry challenges.

  • Refining sales processes and methodologies, working closely with leadership to enhance effectiveness.

  • Collaborating with sales, marketing, and a Strategic SDR to ensure seamless lead handoff, targeted outreach, and effective nurture strategies.

  • Continuously improving performance, embracing feedback, and adapting to new strategies and insights.

You probably shouldn't apply if:

  • You've only ever done inside sales. This role is field-based, and roughly half your time is out with customers.

  • You need a fully qualified pipeline handed to you. Prospecting and pipeline generation are core to the role.

  • You're expecting a job where you can coast on existing relationships. We're hunting for new business into accounts we don't yet own.

  • You're looking for a fully remote role. We need you in the Manchester office a minimum of three days per week, every other week, and out with customers the rest of the time.

  • You think your product knowledge matters more than your ability to sell. We'll teach you the product; your commercial acumen is what we're hiring.


Research has shown that women tend to rule themselves out of applying for jobs unless they meet 100% of the requirements. If you fall into that category and are about to rule yourself out based on the above criteria; please consider applying anyway. We'd love to see your application!

Who are Street Group?

We’re an award-winning PropTech business based in Manchester, founded in 2015 by brother and sister duo, Tom & Heather Staff. Most of us have personal experience of how painful moving can be, and Tom and Heather saw an opportunity to change this: utilising technology, as well as our incredibly talented team, to improve the industry for everyone.

Our products, Street.co.uk and Spectre form a powerful duo, working harmoniously together to transform an agent’s job. From securing more leads and winning new instructions to streamlining business operations and growing market share, our products are supercharging 1,000s of agencies across the UK.

Back in 2015, our co-Founder, Tom Staff, spent his evenings building Spectre v1.0. He’d seen first-hand an opportunity to automate the very manual process of winning new business for estate agents. Spectre is now our multi award-winning, instruction generation tool, generating an average return on investment for them of over 3000%!

Why join Street Group?

🏠 Hybrid-working
🏖️ Guilt-Free R&R - £1000 towards a holiday after your first year with the team (we'll even cover the tax!)
💪 Joining a culture that supports your development and encourages growth
📚 £500 yearly L&D budget for your career development
🎂 Your birthday on us - we pay, you stay away
🙋 ‘Give something back’ - 2 paid days volunteering on us
👶 Enhanced maternity, paternity & adoption pay
🧠 Mental health & well-being support via Health Assured
🧘 Regular well-being initiatives
🕒 Flexible working hours
🚀 Joining a new team in an exciting business with huge ambition
👥 Be a part of something bigger - everyone in our team is passionate about improving the entire property industry! It's a huge goal, but it motivates us to do better every single day
👩🏿‍💻 A chance to work on cutting-edge technology
🚂 Public transport season ticket loans
🌷 Paid menopause leave
🌞 Holiday buying scheme
🐶 Comfortable, relaxed office space - office dogs welcome!
🍻 Fully stocked fridge and beers (or an alternative) on us every Friday afternoon
🎊 Company and team off-sites, events and happy hours
🚴 Cycle to work scheme
🚗 Electric car salary sacrifice scheme
🌍 Feel good about sustainability - we're a climate-positive company!


Salary

Basic £50k with an estimated OTE of £100,000. However, sometimes the perfect person is far more or less experienced than we anticipated. In these situations, planned ranges go out the window. If you think that might be the case, please apply and just let us know.

We care deeply about helping the tech industry become a more inclusive and diverse place and we work hard to lead by example. We are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity through attracting and retaining a complementary team of employees and building an inclusive environment for all. Candidates must be eligible to live and work in the UK and be able to perform the work specified.

🕧 Interview Process: 2 stages (incl. a presentation) = Introductory call with one of our Talent team > Technical Interview and presentation with our VP of Sales and Co.Founder.

We want to make our interviews as inclusive as possible, so if you need any adjustments made, or if there's anything you think we should be aware of during the interview process, please do let us know!

A note on using AI in your job application

As a fast-moving and rapidly evolving tech company, we embrace the advantages of AI and encourage its use throughout our application process. However, our goal is to get to know and hire the authentic you - your skills, experience, and values. We don't want to hire an AI-generated version of you. We consider AI to be a valuable tool, not something that should overshadow you as an individual.

Candidate experience is really important to us, and our Talent team use AI notetakers on interviews so that they can focus purely on their conversation with you. All decisions are made by humans - not AI. Let us know if you have any questions!

Built to replace fragmented tools with a single system of record, Carta brings together the software, services, and legal infrastructure that founders use to manage equity, fund managers use to run administration and reporting, and legal teams use to close transactions. Our customers are primarily Venture Capital, Private Equity and Private Credit Funds.  Carta's platform allows these clients to track and manage their portfolios while liaising with their investors.

  • Drive revenue through strategic outbound prospecting

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Role

As Omnea's Account Manager, you own the relationship with our customers across their entire lifecycle, working with some of our largest and most strategic accounts. Your job is to make sure customers get real, measurable value from Omnea from day one, and to turn that value into renewals, expansion, and upsell.

Omnea's product is sticky: it's a business transformation, not a point tool, so once a customer is live, expansion tends to follow. Your focus skews heavily toward that expansion motion, not just keeping accounts renewed.

You'll build deep, long-term relationships with your champions and become a trusted advisor to stakeholders at every level, from procurement managers up to CFOs. You'll be the internal voice of the customer, working closely with both technical and commercial teams to keep Omnea customer-centric at its core.

This is an early hire on the customer team, working directly with Abs, Ben, and Rebe to build the function from the ground up. There's no fixed playbook yet: you'll help write it.

What You'll Do

  • Own a revenue number: You'll carry an NRR quota covering both expansion and retention across your enterprise book. That means proactively identifying upsell opportunities, running commercial conversations at exec level, and owning the renewal process end-to-end.

  • Build relationships that go all the way to the top: Your relationships will run from procurement managers to CFOs. You'll multi-thread across each account, building genuine trust across multiple stakeholders, and you'll be the person customers call when something goes wrong or when they're thinking about what's next.

  • Build the playbook from scratch: There's no fully built playbook yet - you'll help shape it. You'll work alongside an exceptional implementation team, product experts, and leadership that have scaled world-class companies to define the commercial rhythms, norms, and processes to set the standard as the function grows.

  • Shape what Omnea builds next: You're the closest person to what our customers will and won't pay for. You'll feed that signal directly to Product and Revenue leadership, surfacing what's blocking adoption, what's driving expansion, and where we should be investing.

What's Different About This Role

  • This isn't a traditional post-sale account management role. Omnea's product is a business transformation, not a point tool, so most of your quota comes from expansion, not just renewal.

  • We're not looking for a narrow "Account Manager" background. We want people from GTM roles broadly or from customer-facing roles with heavy commercial/GTM crossover.

  • There's no fully built playbook. You'll define the commercial rhythms and processes as you go, working directly with Abs, Ben, and Rebe.

  • You'll be as close to the product roadmap as anyone outside Product itself: what you hear from customers directly shapes what gets built next.

About You

We don't expect you to know exactly how to do all of this when you join. We're looking for someone with the right attitude and skillset to take this on.

TL;DR: you're commercially sharp, and you instinctively know how to navigate complex organisations. You might come from a GTM role (sales, customer success, partnerships) or a customer-facing role with heavy GTM crossover. What matters is that you've worked in real enterprise environments, managed senior stakeholders with high expectations, and have a track record of getting things done.

  • 4-8 years of experience in a top-tier, fast-paced environment: a startup, scale-up, VC, consulting, banking, or something you built yourself

    • If you've been in a commercial role, you've worked six-figure ARR+ accounts, navigated multi-stakeholder buying committees, and built genuine executive relationships

  • You build rapport, influence people, and drive change, whether with a distinguished exec or a junior operator. You have the gravitas to engage senior leadership, ideally up to CFOs, Legal, or Procurement

  • You're comfortable in ambiguity. You don't need a fully built playbook: you'll build it as you go and improve it as you learn. You're organised enough to manage a complex book of business without dropping anything, and confident enough to push back on customers when they're wrong

  • You're ambitious, competitive, and care about doing excellent work, with a track record of high performance in whatever you've turned your hand to: sales, academia, sport, or something of your own. You take ownership seriously, and you'd rather work hard on something meaningful than coast on something safe

At Omnea, we embrace diversity. To build a product that's loved by everyone, we're best served by a team with all sorts of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't quite match the full job spec! And regardless of your race, religion, colour, gender, or anything else! If you think you could be a good fit for Omnea, please reach out.

A few things to note:

  • We offer competitive geo-localised benefits, and you can check out our UK Benefits Package here and our US Benefits Package here.

  • We work Tuesdays, Wednesdays & Thursdays in-person at our offices. At this early stage of our company life-cycle it's important to us that we get this together-time, and you can read more about why we believe this is a winning move here

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

title: Strategic Engagement Manager

Why Parloa?

We're at the beginning of a new era in customer experience, one where AI doesn't just respond, but understands, reasons, and takes action. We hire people who think in solutions, communicate with clarity, and follow through. People who are comfortable making decisions, taking responsibility, and raising the standard for themselves and those around them.

We've grown beyond the earliest startup phase, but we've kept the intensity: fast execution, direct feedback, and a strong expectation to contribute meaningfully from day one.

Backed by leading global investors like General Catalyst, EQT Ventures, and Altimeter Capital, we're scaling with a clear ambition: to become the global category leader in enterprise-grade conversational AI.

Parloa is committed to upholding the highest data protection standards for our clients' and employees' data. All our employees are instrumental in ensuring the utmost care, GDPR, and ISO compliance, including ISO 27001, in handling sensitive information.

descriptionHtml:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, accessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who love building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who care about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it’s the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit is building its investment business from Vilnius. As Strategy & Operations Lead of Doit Lithuania, you will build and run the business in Lithuania and grow it across the European Economic Area.

You will be the first senior hire in Lithuania. You will own the regulatory relationship, the build of the team, the partner network and the launch. You will sit on the management board and lead the business day to day.

We’re looking for a generalist who learns quickly, thinks deeply, and enjoys solving difficult problems in a fast-moving, regulated environment.

What You’ll Own

  • Own the relationship with the Bank of Lithuania and other regulators.

  • Build the Vilnius team, including compliance, operations and control functions.

  • Select and negotiate with execution, custody, fund and banking partners.

  • Own the business plan, financial projections, capital plan and budget.

  • Launch the investment platform in Lithuania and roll it out across the EEA.

  • Set up governance, policies and controls that meet EU and Lithuanian requirements.

  • Work with group leadership on product, engineering and growth.

  • Report to the board and take ownership of business and regulatory outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

  • Generalist background in consulting, investment banking, start-ups, private equity or venture capital.

  • Experience building or scaling a business, ideally in financial services or fintech.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn regulation quickly and work credibly with regulators.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with boards, regulators, partners and teams.

  • Comfortable working across product, operations, finance and compliance.

  • A clean record and good reputation, suitable for regulatory approval as a senior manager.

  • Based in Lithuania, or open to relocating to Lithuania.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

Nice to Have

  • Lithuanian language ability.

  • An existing working relationship with the Bank of Lithuania.

  • Experience with MiFID II, brokerage, wealth management or fund distribution.

  • Experience building or running a regulated financial business in the EU.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only want to attend meetings.

  • Candidates who cannot follow up aggressively and professionally.

  • Those who need fixed scope and slow timelines.

  • People who avoid messy cross-functional problems.

  • People who produce long updates without clear decisions or next actions.

  • People who see regulation as someone else’s problem.

Location

This role is based in Vilnius, Lithuania. This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our Vilnius office at least 3 days per week.

You must be a European citizen or already hold a valid right to work in Lithuania. We are not able to offer visa sponsorship for this role.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process.

Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritised.

title: Strategy & Operations Lead, Data & Intelligence
descriptionHtml:
GRESB is the global sustainability intelligence standard for real assets. For over 15 years, real estate and infrastructure managers have reported to us, building a dataset of 150,000+ assets across more than 2,000 portfolios. Together with Asset Impact, which tracks emissions for over 300,000 physical assets and 77,000 companies, we’re turning that data into decision-grade intelligence for investors, lenders, index providers and regulators.

We’re building a new Client & Data Intelligence organization to showcase the value of the data to investors and develop new use cases within the ecosystem. It brings sales, product and data teams together under one leader, the Chief Client & Data Intelligence Officer. This role is the person who makes that organization run. The role is based out of Amsterdam.

The Role

You’ll work directly with the Chief Client & Data Intelligence Officer as the strategist and operator at the center of a newly formed team. Your job is to keep decisions moving, teams connected and priority work getting finished, so the leadership team can focus on clients and growth.

It’s a role for someone who can shape a problem and then see it through. One week you might be building the business case for a new data product; the next you’re tightening the sales pipeline, preparing a board update and unblocking a delivery issue between product and engineering. You’ll move between sales enablement, product and data operations, and you’ll be trusted to run several projects at once without dropping any of them.

You’ll see the whole business, from client conversations to product decisions to the CEO’s agenda, and you’ll have influence over how a new organization works.

What you will do

Strategy and priority projects

  • Lead the organization’s highest-priority initiatives end to end, for example pricing, our investor program, entry into new markets and maturing the data strategy
  • Frame the problem, build the analysis, align stakeholders and drive the work through to a decision and implementation
  • Bring a recommendation, not just options

Operating rhythm and decision-making

  • Run the team’s operating cadence: weekly deal desk, fortnightly product council and monthly business review
  • Own the decision log, so it’s always clear what was decided, by whom and what happens next
  • Spot blockers between sales, product and data teams early and clear them

Commercial operations and sales enablement

  • Own pricing and support deal structuring with the sales team
  • Keep pipeline and ARR reporting accurate and trusted, with one view across GRESB
  • Work with sales and product to make sure the team has what it needs to showcase the value of the data products

Reporting and communication

title: System Architect
descriptionHtml:
Hyperscale Power is building the power backbone for the AI data center era: a complete power conversion chain from 13.8kV–35kV medium-voltage AC down to 800V DC, combining ultra-compact SiC-based power blocks. Our Solid-State Transformers (SSTs) are the core of this revolution, providing unprecedented control, efficiency, and compactness.

As a System Architect, you will be responsible for our solid-state transformer as a complete system. You will connect the work of our power electronics, magnetics, and mechanical and thermal engineering teams into one coherent system, and ensure it meets the requirements of hyperscale data center customers.

Instead of specializing in a single subsystem, your mission is to keep the whole system in view: balancing efficiency, size, cost, reliability and manufacturability, guiding the key technical trade-offs, and taking our SST from prototype to a product ready for certification and series production.

This role is for you if…
you’ve owned a complex high-power system rather than one part of it. You enjoy keeping the whole picture in view, making the call on trade-offs between expert teams, and bringing just enough structure to a fast-moving team without slowing it down.

This role isn’t for you if…
you’ve spent your career going deep on a single component or subsystem, or you manage projects without making the technical decisions yourself. It’s also not a fit if you need a fixed specification and established processes before you can start.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the system architecture of the SST and its key performance metrics, including efficiency, power density, cost, thermal performance, reliability, manufacturability and control performance.

  • Coordinate the subsystems of the SST (AC/DC, DC/DC, magnetics, mechanical and thermal) and their interfaces, ensuring the work of each team is compatible and consistent with the system design.

  • Lead system-level trade-off decisions and set technical priorities across teams.

  • Define and maintain system requirements, interface specifications and change management, ensuring design changes are assessed for their impact across the system.

  • Translate the requirements of data center operators and hyperscalers into system specifications, and track how they evolve.

  • Explore and compare different system architectures and their integration in the datacenter power supply chain

  • Drive standardization and design for manufacturing across subsystems in preparation for series production.

  • Work with the compliance and certification team to define a feasible certification path for the system.

  • Identify technical risks at system level early and propose mitigations.

Qualifications

  • MSc or a higher degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.

  • 8+ years of industry experience in developing complex power electronic systems.

  • Proven responsibility at system or platform level, e.g. as system engineer, system architect, technical lead or team lead.

  • Track record of taking power electronic systems from development to series product.

  • Experience with high-power systems such as EV charging, electric drivetrains, rail traction, industrial drives, renewable energy converters or robotics.

  • Broad understanding of the electrical, magnetic, thermal, mechanical and control aspects of power electronic systems, and how they interact.

  • Working knowledge of cooling concepts and the mechanical integration of high-power electronics.

  • Experience with standards, norms and certification processes for power electronic products.

  • Strong communication and decision-making skills; able to align experts across disciplines and drive decisions.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment with evolving requirements.

The job will be located at our HQ in Egg b. Zürich, Switzerland.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with medium-voltage converter systems or solid-state transformers.

  • Knowledge of data center power architectures.

  • Experience in design for manufacturing and cost engineering.

  • Experience establishing systems engineering processes in a growing organization.

Benefits

  • Equity + competitive salary.

  • Unique technology and market opportunity – shape the architecture of a new product category for the energy transition.

  • Hybrid work with flexible working times.

descriptionHtml:
About Us

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

  • We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

  • We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

  • We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

About the role
Legora is building the AI-native workspace for legal work, with lawyers. Our Legal Engineers are lawyers who help the world's leading firms turn AI into real change in how they practise. France is one of our fastest-growing markets, and we have just opened our Paris office.
We are looking for a Team Lead to lead our Legal Engineering team for law firms in France. This is a player-coach role: you will lead and develop a team of Legal Engineers while personally running our most strategic firm engagements. You will report to the Director of Legal Engineering, South EMEA.

What you'll be doing

  • Leading the team day to day: priorities, 1:1s, coaching, quality review, capacity and escalations.

  • Hiring, onboarding and developing Legal Engineers, and setting the standard of excellence for the team.

  • Personally leading high-value engagements, from discovery and pilots to firm-wide rollouts, with managing partners, practice heads, innovation and IT teams.

  • Turning commercial priorities into execution with our Go-To-Market and Engagement teams: pilots that convert, rollouts that stick, renewals and expansions.

  • Building relationships at partner and management level, and designing sponsor and champion models inside firms.

  • Turning what works into reusable methods: playbooks, templates, French-language content and training.

  • Being the voice of French law firms inside Legora, bringing evidenced product feedback to our Product team.

  • Representing Legora in the French legal market, on AI and the future of legal practice.

What you bring

  • A strong legal background, typically 8+ years of experience in sophisticated law-firm practice, ideally at counsel or senior associate level in a top-tier firm.

  • Proven people management: you have hired, coached, given hard feedback and managed performance.

  • Commercial acumen: you understand how firms make money, how partners decide and how firms buy, and you can tie your work to business outcomes.

  • Credibility with senior lawyers: you can run a difficult workshop with partners and lead an executive readout.

  • Real fluency with generative AI: you use it, you test it, you know where it fails and you can explain why.

  • Structure without bureaucracy, and the energy to build in a fast-growing team.

  • Native or bilingual French and fluent English.

Strong pluses

  • Experience in legal innovation, knowledge management, legal tech or legal AI.

  • A track record of building something: a practice, a team, a function or a company.

  • A visible voice in the French legal community.

A few more things
You will join a company that moves fast, with a lot of autonomy and real ownership of how Legal Engineering grows in France. We care about Lean In, Fight for Excellence and Grow Together. If that sounds exciting rather than daunting, we'd love to hear from you.

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Compensation: €65K – €170K
